ai_act/art/2.action: apply to AI systems developed or used exclusively for military purposes.
ai_act/art/2.span: This Regulation shall not apply to AI systems developed or used exclusively for military purposes.

ai_act/art/2.action: apply to public authorities in a third country nor to international organisations falling within the scope of this Regulation pursuant to paragraph 1, where those authorities or organisations use AI systems in the framework of international agreements for law enforcement and judicial cooperation with the Union or with one or more Member States.
ai_act/art/2.span: This Regulation shall not apply to public authorities in a third country nor to international organisations falling within the scope of this Regulation pursuant to paragraph 1, where those authorities or organisations use AI systems in the framework of international agreements for law enforcement and judicial cooperation with the Union or with one or more Member States.

ai_act/art/2.action: affect the application of the provisions on the liability of intermediary service providers set out in Chapter II, Section IV of Directive 2000/31/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council [as to be replaced by the corresponding provisions of the Digital Services Act].
ai_act/art/2.span: This Regulation shall not affect the application of the provisions on the liability of intermediary service providers set out in Chapter II, Section IV of Directive 2000/31/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council [as to be replaced by the corresponding provisions of the Digital Services Act].

ai_act/art/5.action: be prohibited — the placing on the market, putting into service or use of an AI system that deploys subliminal techniques beyond a person’s consciousness in order to materially distort a person’s behaviour in a manner that causes or is likely to cause that person or another person physical or psychological harm;
ai_act/art/5.span: the placing on the market, putting into service or use of an AI system that deploys subliminal techniques beyond a person’s consciousness in order to materially distort a person’s behaviour in a manner that causes or is likely to cause that person or another person physical or psychological harm;

ai_act/art/5.action: be prohibited — the placing on the market, putting into service or use of an AI system that exploits any of the vulnerabilities of a specific group of persons due to their age, physical or mental disability, in order to materially distort the behaviour of a person pertaining to that group in a manner that causes or is likely to cause that person or another person physical or psychological harm;
ai_act/art/5.span: the placing on the market, putting into service or use of an AI system that exploits any of the vulnerabilities of a specific group of persons due to their age, physical or mental disability, in order to materially distort the behaviour of a person pertaining to that group in a manner that causes or is likely to cause that person or another person physical or psychological harm;

ai_act/art/5.action: be prohibited — the placing on the market, putting into service or use of AI systems by public authorities or on their behalf for the evaluation or classification of the trustworthiness of natural persons over a certain period of time based on their social behaviour or known or predicted personal or personality characteristics, with the social score leading to either or both of the following:
ai_act/art/5.span: the placing on the market, putting into service or use of AI systems by public authorities or on their behalf for the evaluation or classification of the trustworthiness of natural persons over a certain period of time based on their social behaviour or known or predicted personal or personality characteristics, with the social score leading to either or both of the following:

ai_act/art/5.action: be prohibited — the use of ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for the purpose of law enforcement, unless and in as far as such use is strictly necessary for one of the following objectives:
ai_act/art/5.span: the use of ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for the purpose of law enforcement, unless and in as far as such use is strictly necessary for one of the following objectives:

ai_act/art/5.addressee_text: The use of ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for the purpose of law enforcement for any of the objectives referred to in paragraph 1 point d)
ai_act/art/5.action: take into account the following elements: […] In addition, the use of ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for the purpose of law enforcement for any of the objectives referred to in paragraph 1 point d) shall comply with necessary and proportionate safeguards and conditions in relation to the use, in particular as regards the temporal, geographic and personal limitations.
ai_act/art/5.span: The use of ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for the purpose of law enforcement for any of the objectives referred to in paragraph 1 point d) shall take into account the following elements: […] In addition, the use of ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for the purpose of law enforcement for any of the objectives referred to in paragraph 1 point d) shall comply with necessary and proportionate safeguards and conditions in relation to the use, in particular as regards the temporal, geographic and personal limitations.

ai_act/art/5.addressee_text: The use of ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for the purpose of law enforcement for any of the objectives referred to in paragraph 1 point d)
ai_act/art/5.action: take into account the following elements — the nature of the situation giving rise to the possible use, in particular the seriousness, probability and scale of the harm caused in the absence of the use of the system;
ai_act/art/5.span: the nature of the situation giving rise to the possible use, in particular the seriousness, probability and scale of the harm caused in the absence of the use of the system;

ai_act/art/5.addressee_text: The use of ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for the purpose of law enforcement for any of the objectives referred to in paragraph 1 point d)
ai_act/art/5.action: take into account the following elements — the consequences of the use of the system for the rights and freedoms of all persons concerned, in particular the seriousness, probability and scale of those consequences.
ai_act/art/5.span: the consequences of the use of the system for the rights and freedoms of all persons concerned, in particular the seriousness, probability and scale of those consequences.

ai_act/art/5.addressee_text: each individual use for the purpose of law enforcement of a ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification system in publicly accessible spaces
ai_act/art/5.action: be subject to a prior authorisation granted by a judicial authority or by an independent administrative authority of the Member State in which the use is to take place, issued upon a reasoned request and in accordance with the detailed rules of national law referred to in paragraph 4.
ai_act/art/5.span: As regards paragraphs 1, point (d) and 2, each individual use for the purpose of law enforcement of a ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification system in publicly accessible spaces shall be subject to a prior authorisation granted by a judicial authority or by an independent administrative authority of the Member State in which the use is to take place, issued upon a reasoned request and in accordance with the detailed rules of national law referred to in paragraph 4.

ai_act/art/5.addressee_text: However, in a duly justified situation of urgency, the use of the system
ai_act/art/5.action: be commenced without an authorisation and the authorisation may be requested only during or after the use.
ai_act/art/5.span: However, in a duly justified situation of urgency, the use of the system may be commenced without an authorisation and the authorisation may be requested only during or after the use.

ai_act/art/5.addressee_text: The competent judicial or administrative authority
ai_act/art/5.action: only grant the authorisation where it is satisfied, based on objective evidence or clear indications presented to it, that the use of the ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification system at issue is necessary for and proportionate to achieving one of the objectives specified in paragraph 1, point (d), as identified in the request.
ai_act/art/5.span: The competent judicial or administrative authority shall only grant the authorisation where it is satisfied, based on objective evidence or clear indications presented to it, that the use of the ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification system at issue is necessary for and proportionate to achieving one of the objectives specified in paragraph 1, point (d), as identified in the request.

ai_act/art/5.addressee_text: In deciding on the request, the competent judicial or administrative authority
ai_act/art/5.action: take into account the elements referred to in paragraph 2.
ai_act/art/5.span: In deciding on the request, the competent judicial or administrative authority shall take into account the elements referred to in paragraph 2.

ai_act/art/5.action: decide to provide for the possibility to fully or partially authorise the use of ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for the purpose of law enforcement within the limits and under the conditions listed in paragraphs 1, point (d), 2 and 3.
ai_act/art/5.span: A Member State may decide to provide for the possibility to fully or partially authorise the use of ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for the purpose of law enforcement within the limits and under the conditions listed in paragraphs 1, point (d), 2 and 3.

ai_act/art/5.action: lay down in its national law the necessary detailed rules for the request, issuance and exercise of, as well as supervision relating to, the authorisations referred to in paragraph 3.
ai_act/art/5.span: That Member State shall lay down in its national law the necessary detailed rules for the request, issuance and exercise of, as well as supervision relating to, the authorisations referred to in paragraph 3.

ai_act/art/5.action: also specify in respect of which of the objectives listed in paragraph 1, point (d), including which of the criminal offences referred to in point (iii) thereof, the competent authorities may be authorised to use those systems for the purpose of law enforcement.
ai_act/art/5.span: Those rules shall also specify in respect of which of the objectives listed in paragraph 1, point (d), including which of the criminal offences referred to in point (iii) thereof, the competent authorities may be authorised to use those systems for the purpose of law enforcement.

ai_act/art/6.addressee_text: Irrespective of whether an AI system is placed on the market or put into service independently from the products referred to in points (a) and (b), that AI system
ai_act/art/6.action: be considered high-risk where both of the following conditions are fulfilled — the AI system is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or is itself a product, covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex II;
ai_act/art/6.span: the AI system is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or is itself a product, covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex II;

ai_act/art/6.addressee_text: the product whose safety component is the AI system, or the AI system itself as a product,
ai_act/art/6.action: undergo a third-party conformity assessment with a view to the placing on the market or putting into service of that product pursuant to the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex II.
ai_act/art/6.span: the product whose safety component is the AI system, or the AI system itself as a product, is required to undergo a third-party conformity assessment with a view to the placing on the market or putting into service of that product pursuant to the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex II.

ai_act/art/6.addressee_text: In addition to the high-risk AI systems referred to in paragraph 1, AI systems referred to in Annex III
ai_act/art/6.span: In addition to the high-risk AI systems referred to in paragraph 1, AI systems referred to in Annex III shall also be considered high-risk.

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing for the purposes of paragraph 1 whether an AI system poses a risk of harm to the health and safety or a risk of adverse impact on fundamental rights that is equivalent to or greater than the risk of harm posed by the high-risk AI systems already referred to in Annex III
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the intended purpose of the AI system;
ai_act/art/7.span: the intended purpose of the AI system;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing for the purposes of paragraph 1 whether an AI system poses a risk of harm to the health and safety or a risk of adverse impact on fundamental rights that is equivalent to or greater than the risk of harm posed by the high-risk AI systems already referred to in Annex III
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the extent to which an AI system has been used or is likely to be used;
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which an AI system has been used or is likely to be used;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing for the purposes of paragraph 1 whether an AI system poses a risk of harm to the health and safety or a risk of adverse impact on fundamental rights that is equivalent to or greater than the risk of harm posed by the high-risk AI systems already referred to in Annex III
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the extent to which the use of an AI system has already caused harm to the health and safety or adverse impact on the fundamental rights or has given rise to significant concerns in relation to the materialisation of such harm or adverse impact, as demonstrated by reports or documented allegations submitted to national competent authorities;
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which the use of an AI system has already caused harm to the health and safety or adverse impact on the fundamental rights or has given rise to significant concerns in relation to the materialisation of such harm or adverse impact, as demonstrated by reports or documented allegations submitted to national competent authorities;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing for the purposes of paragraph 1 whether an AI system poses a risk of harm to the health and safety or a risk of adverse impact on fundamental rights that is equivalent to or greater than the risk of harm posed by the high-risk AI systems already referred to in Annex III
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the potential extent of such harm or such adverse impact, in particular in terms of its intensity and its ability to affect a plurality of persons;
ai_act/art/7.span: the potential extent of such harm or such adverse impact, in particular in terms of its intensity and its ability to affect a plurality of persons;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing for the purposes of paragraph 1 whether an AI system poses a risk of harm to the health and safety or a risk of adverse impact on fundamental rights that is equivalent to or greater than the risk of harm posed by the high-risk AI systems already referred to in Annex III
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the extent to which potentially harmed or adversely impacted persons are dependent on the outcome produced with an AI system, in particular because for practical or legal reasons it is not reasonably possible to opt-out from that outcome;
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which potentially harmed or adversely impacted persons are dependent on the outcome produced with an AI system, in particular because for practical or legal reasons it is not reasonably possible to opt-out from that outcome;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing for the purposes of paragraph 1 whether an AI system poses a risk of harm to the health and safety or a risk of adverse impact on fundamental rights that is equivalent to or greater than the risk of harm posed by the high-risk AI systems already referred to in Annex III
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the extent to which potentially harmed or adversely impacted persons are in a vulnerable position in relation to the user of an AI system, in particular due to an imbalance of power, knowledge, economic or social circumstances, or age;
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which potentially harmed or adversely impacted persons are in a vulnerable position in relation to the user of an AI system, in particular due to an imbalance of power, knowledge, economic or social circumstances, or age;

ai_act/art/7.addressee_text: the extent to which the outcome produced with an AI system is easily reversible, whereby outcomes having an impact on the health or safety of persons
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which the outcome produced with an AI system is easily reversible, whereby outcomes having an impact on the health or safety of persons shall not be considered as easily reversible;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing for the purposes of paragraph 1 whether an AI system poses a risk of harm to the health and safety or a risk of adverse impact on fundamental rights that is equivalent to or greater than the risk of harm posed by the high-risk AI systems already referred to in Annex III
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the extent to which existing Union legislation provides for:
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which existing Union legislation provides for:

ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.action: comply with the requirements established in this Chapter.
ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.span: High-risk AI systems shall comply with the requirements established in this Chapter.

ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.addressee_text: The intended purpose of the high-risk AI system and the risk management system referred to in Article 9
ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.action: be taken into account when ensuring compliance with those requirements.
ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.span: The intended purpose of the high-risk AI system and the risk management system referred to in Article 9 shall be taken into account when ensuring compliance with those requirements.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be established, implemented, documented and maintained in relation to high-risk AI systems.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: A risk management system shall be established, implemented, documented and maintained in relation to high-risk AI systems.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: consist of a continuous iterative process run throughout the entire lifecycle of a high-risk AI system, requiring regular systematic updating.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: The risk management system shall consist of a continuous iterative process run throughout the entire lifecycle of a high-risk AI system, requiring regular systematic updating.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: comprise the following steps — identification and analysis of the known and foreseeable risks associated with each high-risk AI system;
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: identification and analysis of the known and foreseeable risks associated with each high-risk AI system;

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: estimation and evaluation of the risks that
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: emerge when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose and under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse;
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: estimation and evaluation of the risks that may emerge when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose and under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse;

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: comprise the following steps — evaluation of other possibly arising risks based on the analysis of data gathered from the post-market monitoring system referred to in Article 61;
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: evaluation of other possibly arising risks based on the analysis of data gathered from the post-market monitoring system referred to in Article 61;

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: comprise the following steps — adoption of suitable risk management measures in accordance with the provisions of the following paragraphs.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: adoption of suitable risk management measures in accordance with the provisions of the following paragraphs.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: The risk management measures referred to in paragraph 2, point (d)
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: give due consideration to the effects and possible interactions resulting from the combined application of the requirements set out in this Chapter 2.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: The risk management measures referred to in paragraph 2, point (d) shall give due consideration to the effects and possible interactions resulting from the combined application of the requirements set out in this Chapter 2.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: take into account the generally acknowledged state of the art, including as reflected in relevant harmonised standards or common specifications.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: They shall take into account the generally acknowledged state of the art, including as reflected in relevant harmonised standards or common specifications.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: The risk management measures referred to in paragraph 2, point (d)
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be such that any residual risk associated with each hazard as well as the overall residual risk of the high-risk AI systems is judged acceptable, provided that the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: The risk management measures referred to in paragraph 2, point (d) shall be such that any residual risk associated with each hazard as well as the overall residual risk of the high-risk AI systems is judged acceptable, provided that the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be communicated to the user.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: Those residual risks shall be communicated to the user.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: In identifying the most appropriate risk management measures, the following
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be ensured: […] In eliminating or reducing risks related to the use of the high-risk AI system, due consideration shall be given to the technical knowledge, experience, education, training to be expected by the user and the environment in which the system is intended to be used.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: In identifying the most appropriate risk management measures, the following shall be ensured: […] In eliminating or reducing risks related to the use of the high-risk AI system, due consideration shall be given to the technical knowledge, experience, education, training to be expected by the user and the environment in which the system is intended to be used.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: In identifying the most appropriate risk management measures, the following
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be ensured — elimination or reduction of risks as far as possible through adequate design and development;
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: elimination or reduction of risks as far as possible through adequate design and development;

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: In identifying the most appropriate risk management measures, the following
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be ensured — where appropriate, implementation of adequate mitigation and control measures in relation to risks that cannot be eliminated;
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: where appropriate, implementation of adequate mitigation and control measures in relation to risks that cannot be eliminated;

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: In identifying the most appropriate risk management measures, the following
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be ensured — provision of adequate information pursuant to Article 13, in particular as regards the risks referred to in paragraph 2, point (b) of this Article, and, where appropriate, training to users.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: provision of adequate information pursuant to Article 13, in particular as regards the risks referred to in paragraph 2, point (b) of this Article, and, where appropriate, training to users.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be tested for the purposes of identifying the most appropriate risk management measures.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: High-risk AI systems shall be tested for the purposes of identifying the most appropriate risk management measures.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: ensure that high-risk AI systems perform consistently for their intended purpose and they are in compliance with the requirements set out in this Chapter.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: Testing shall ensure that high-risk AI systems perform consistently for their intended purpose and they are in compliance with the requirements set out in this Chapter.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be suitable to achieve the intended purpose of the AI system and do not need to go beyond what is necessary to achieve that purpose.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: Testing procedures shall be suitable to achieve the intended purpose of the AI system and do not need to go beyond what is necessary to achieve that purpose.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: The testing of the high-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be performed, as appropriate, at any point in time throughout the development process, and, in any event, prior to the placing on the market or the putting into service.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.timing: prior to the placing on the market or the putting into service
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: The testing of the high-risk AI systems shall be performed, as appropriate, at any point in time throughout the development process, and, in any event, prior to the placing on the market or the putting into service.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be made against preliminarily defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds that are appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: Testing shall be made against preliminarily defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds that are appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.condition: When implementing the risk management system described in paragraphs 1 to 7
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be given to whether the high-risk AI system is likely to be accessed by or have an impact on children.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: When implementing the risk management system described in paragraphs 1 to 7, specific consideration shall be given to whether the high-risk AI system is likely to be accessed by or have an impact on children.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: For credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU, the aspects described in paragraphs 1 to 8
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be part of the risk management procedures established by those institutions pursuant to Article 74 of that Directive.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: For credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU, the aspects described in paragraphs 1 to 8 shall be part of the risk management procedures established by those institutions pursuant to Article 74 of that Directive.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems which make use of techniques involving the training of models with data
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be developed on the basis of training, validation and testing data sets that meet the quality criteria referred to in paragraphs 2 to 5.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: High-risk AI systems which make use of techniques involving the training of models with data shall be developed on the basis of training, validation and testing data sets that meet the quality criteria referred to in paragraphs 2 to 5.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Training, validation and testing data sets
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be subject to appropriate data governance and management practices.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be subject to appropriate data governance and management practices.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Those practices
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: concern in particular,
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: Those practices shall concern in particular,

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Training, validation and testing data sets
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be relevant, representative, free of errors and complete.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be relevant, representative, free of errors and complete.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: They
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: have the appropriate statistical properties, including, where applicable, as regards the persons or groups of persons on which the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: They shall have the appropriate statistical properties, including, where applicable, as regards the persons or groups of persons on which the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: These characteristics of the data sets
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be met at the level of individual data sets or a combination thereof.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: These characteristics of the data sets may be met at the level of individual data sets or a combination thereof.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Training, validation and testing data sets
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: take into account, to the extent required by the intended purpose, the characteristics or elements that are particular to the specific geographical, behavioural or functional setting within which the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: Training, validation and testing data sets shall take into account, to the extent required by the intended purpose, the characteristics or elements that are particular to the specific geographical, behavioural or functional setting within which the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: the providers of such systems
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.condition: To the extent that it is strictly necessary for the purposes of ensuring bias monitoring, detection and correction in relation to the high-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: process special categories of personal data referred to in Article 9(1) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Article 10 of Directive (EU) 2016/680 and Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) 2018/1725, subject to appropriate safeguards for the fundamental rights and freedoms of natural persons, including technical limitations on the re-use and use of state-of-the-art security and privacy-preserving measures, such as pseudonymisation, or encryption where anonymisation may significantly affect the purpose pursued.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: To the extent that it is strictly necessary for the purposes of ensuring bias monitoring, detection and correction in relation to the high-risk AI systems, the providers of such systems may process special categories of personal data referred to in Article 9(1) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Article 10 of Directive (EU) 2016/680 and Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) 2018/1725, subject to appropriate safeguards for the fundamental rights and freedoms of natural persons, including technical limitations on the re-use and use of state-of-the-art security and privacy-preserving measures, such as pseudonymisation, or encryption where anonymisation may significantly affect the purpose pursued.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Appropriate data governance and management practices
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: apply for the development of high-risk AI systems other than those which make use of techniques involving the training of models in order to ensure that those high-risk AI systems comply with paragraph 2.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: Appropriate data governance and management practices shall apply for the development of high-risk AI systems other than those which make use of techniques involving the training of models in order to ensure that those high-risk AI systems comply with paragraph 2.

ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.addressee_text: The technical documentation of a high-risk AI system
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.action: be drawn up before that system is placed on the market or put into service and shall be kept up-to date.
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.span: The technical documentation of a high-risk AI system shall be drawn up before that system is placed on the market or put into service and shall be kept up-to date.

ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.action: be drawn up in such a way to demonstrate that the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements set out in this Chapter and provide national competent authorities and notified bodies with all the necessary information to assess the compliance of the AI system with those requirements.
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.span: The technical documentation shall be drawn up in such a way to demonstrate that the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements set out in this Chapter and provide national competent authorities and notified bodies with all the necessary information to assess the compliance of the AI system with those requirements.

ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.action: contain, at a minimum, the elements set out in Annex IV.
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.span: It shall contain, at a minimum, the elements set out in Annex IV.

ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.addressee_text: is placed on the market or put into service one single technical documentation
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.condition: Where a high-risk AI system related to a product, to which the legal acts listed in Annex II, section A apply
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.action: be drawn up containing all the information set out in Annex IV as well as the information required under those legal acts.
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.span: Where a high-risk AI system related to a product, to which the legal acts listed in Annex II, section A apply, is placed on the market or put into service one single technical documentation shall be drawn up containing all the information set out in Annex IV as well as the information required under those legal acts.

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: be designed and developed with capabilities enabling the automatic recording of events (‘logs’) while the high-risk AI systems is operating.
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed with capabilities enabling the automatic recording of events (‘logs’) while the high-risk AI systems is operating.

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: conform to recognised standards or common specifications.
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: Those logging capabilities shall conform to recognised standards or common specifications.

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: ensure a level of traceability of the AI system’s functioning throughout its lifecycle that is appropriate to the intended purpose of the system.
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: The logging capabilities shall ensure a level of traceability of the AI system’s functioning throughout its lifecycle that is appropriate to the intended purpose of the system.

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: enable the monitoring of the operation of the high-risk AI system with respect to the occurrence of situations that may result in the AI system presenting a risk within the meaning of Article 65(1) or lead to a substantial modification, and facilitate the post-market monitoring referred to in Article 61.
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: In particular, logging capabilities shall enable the monitoring of the operation of the high-risk AI system with respect to the occurrence of situations that may result in the AI system presenting a risk within the meaning of Article 65(1) or lead to a substantial modification, and facilitate the post-market monitoring referred to in Article 61.

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in paragraph 1, point (a) of Annex III, the logging capabilities
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: provide, at a minimum — recording of the period of each use of the system (start date and time and end date and time of each use);
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: recording of the period of each use of the system (start date and time and end date and time of each use);

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in paragraph 1, point (a) of Annex III, the logging capabilities
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: provide, at a minimum — the reference database against which input data has been checked by the system;
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: the reference database against which input data has been checked by the system;

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in paragraph 1, point (a) of Annex III, the logging capabilities
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: provide, at a minimum — the input data for which the search has led to a match;
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: the input data for which the search has led to a match;

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in paragraph 1, point (a) of Annex III, the logging capabilities
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: provide, at a minimum — the identification of the natural persons involved in the verification of the results, as referred to in Article 14 (5).
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: the identification of the natural persons involved in the verification of the results, as referred to in Article 14 (5).

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: be designed and developed in such a way to ensure that their operation is sufficiently transparent to enable users to interpret the system’s output and use it appropriately.
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way to ensure that their operation is sufficiently transparent to enable users to interpret the system’s output and use it appropriately.

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: An appropriate type and degree of transparency
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: be ensured, with a view to achieving compliance with the relevant obligations of the user and of the provider set out in Chapter 3 of this Title.
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: An appropriate type and degree of transparency shall be ensured, with a view to achieving compliance with the relevant obligations of the user and of the provider set out in Chapter 3 of this Title.

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: be accompanied by instructions for use in an appropriate digital format or otherwise that include concise, complete, correct and clear information that is relevant, accessible and comprehensible to users.
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: High-risk AI systems shall be accompanied by instructions for use in an appropriate digital format or otherwise that include concise, complete, correct and clear information that is relevant, accessible and comprehensible to users.

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: The information referred to in paragraph 2
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: specify — the identity and the contact details of the provider and, where applicable, of its authorised representative;
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: the identity and the contact details of the provider and, where applicable, of its authorised representative;

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: The information referred to in paragraph 2
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: specify — the characteristics, capabilities and limitations of performance of the high-risk AI system, including:
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: the characteristics, capabilities and limitations of performance of the high-risk AI system, including:

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: the level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity referred to in Article 15 against which the high-risk AI system has been tested and validated and which can be expected, and any known and foreseeable circumstances that
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: have an impact on that expected level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity;
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: the level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity referred to in Article 15 against which the high-risk AI system has been tested and validated and which can be expected, and any known and foreseeable circumstances that may have an impact on that expected level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity;

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: any known or foreseeable circumstance, related to the use of the high-risk AI system in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse, which
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: lead to risks to the health and safety or fundamental rights;
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: any known or foreseeable circumstance, related to the use of the high-risk AI system in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse, which may lead to risks to the health and safety or fundamental rights;

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: The information referred to in paragraph 2
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: specify — the changes to the high-risk AI system and its performance which have been pre-determined by the provider at the moment of the initial conformity assessment, if any;
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: the changes to the high-risk AI system and its performance which have been pre-determined by the provider at the moment of the initial conformity assessment, if any;

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: The information referred to in paragraph 2
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: specify — the human oversight measures referred to in Article 14, including the technical measures put in place to facilitate the interpretation of the outputs of AI systems by the users;
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: the human oversight measures referred to in Article 14, including the technical measures put in place to facilitate the interpretation of the outputs of AI systems by the users;

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: The information referred to in paragraph 2
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: specify — the expected lifetime of the high-risk AI system and any necessary maintenance and care measures to ensure the proper functioning of that AI system, including as regards software updates.
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: the expected lifetime of the high-risk AI system and any necessary maintenance and care measures to ensure the proper functioning of that AI system, including as regards software updates.

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which the AI system is in use.
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which the AI system is in use.

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: aim at preventing or minimising the risks to health, safety or fundamental rights that may emerge when a high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse, in particular when such risks persist notwithstanding the application of other requirements set out in this Chapter.
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: Human oversight shall aim at preventing or minimising the risks to health, safety or fundamental rights that may emerge when a high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse, in particular when such risks persist notwithstanding the application of other requirements set out in this Chapter.

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be ensured through either one or all of the following measures — identified and built, when technically feasible, into the high-risk AI system by the provider before it is placed on the market or put into service;
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: identified and built, when technically feasible, into the high-risk AI system by the provider before it is placed on the market or put into service;

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be ensured through either one or all of the following measures — identified by the provider before placing the high-risk AI system on the market or putting it into service and that are appropriate to be implemented by the user.
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.timing: before placing the high-risk AI system on the market or putting it into service and that are appropriate to be implemented by the user
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: identified by the provider before placing the high-risk AI system on the market or putting it into service and that are appropriate to be implemented by the user.

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.addressee_text: The measures referred to in paragraph 3
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: enable the individuals to whom human oversight is assigned to do the following, as appropriate to the circumstances — fully understand the capacities and limitations of the high-risk AI system and be able to duly monitor its operation, so that signs of anomalies, dysfunctions and unexpected performance can be detected and addressed as soon as possible;
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: fully understand the capacities and limitations of the high-risk AI system and be able to duly monitor its operation, so that signs of anomalies, dysfunctions and unexpected performance can be detected and addressed as soon as possible;

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.addressee_text: The measures referred to in paragraph 3
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: enable the individuals to whom human oversight is assigned to do the following, as appropriate to the circumstances — remain aware of the possible tendency of automatically relying or over-relying on the output produced by a high-risk AI system (‘automation bias’), in particular for high-risk AI systems used to provide information or recommendations for decisions to be taken by natural persons;
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: remain aware of the possible tendency of automatically relying or over-relying on the output produced by a high-risk AI system (‘automation bias’), in particular for high-risk AI systems used to provide information or recommendations for decisions to be taken by natural persons;

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.addressee_text: The measures referred to in paragraph 3
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: enable the individuals to whom human oversight is assigned to do the following, as appropriate to the circumstances — be able to correctly interpret the high-risk AI system’s output, taking into account in particular the characteristics of the system and the interpretation tools and methods available;
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: be able to correctly interpret the high-risk AI system’s output, taking into account in particular the characteristics of the system and the interpretation tools and methods available;

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.addressee_text: The measures referred to in paragraph 3
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: enable the individuals to whom human oversight is assigned to do the following, as appropriate to the circumstances — be able to decide, in any particular situation, not to use the high-risk AI system or otherwise disregard, override or reverse the output of the high-risk AI system;
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: be able to decide, in any particular situation, not to use the high-risk AI system or otherwise disregard, override or reverse the output of the high-risk AI system;

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.addressee_text: The measures referred to in paragraph 3
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: enable the individuals to whom human oversight is assigned to do the following, as appropriate to the circumstances — be able to intervene on the operation of the high-risk AI system or interrupt the system through a “stop” button or a similar procedure.
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: be able to intervene on the operation of the high-risk AI system or interrupt the system through a “stop” button or a similar procedure.

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1(a) of Annex III, the measures referred to in paragraph 3
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be such as to ensure that, in addition, no action or decision is taken by the user on the basis of the identification resulting from the system unless this has been verified and confirmed by at least two natural persons.
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1(a) of Annex III, the measures referred to in paragraph 3 shall be such as to ensure that, in addition, no action or decision is taken by the user on the basis of the identification resulting from the system unless this has been verified and confirmed by at least two natural persons.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be designed and developed in such a way that they achieve, in the light of their intended purpose, an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity, and perform consistently in those respects throughout their lifecycle.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they achieve, in the light of their intended purpose, an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity, and perform consistently in those respects throughout their lifecycle.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.addressee_text: The levels of accuracy and the relevant accuracy metrics of high-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be declared in the accompanying instructions of use.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: The levels of accuracy and the relevant accuracy metrics of high-risk AI systems shall be declared in the accompanying instructions of use.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be resilient as regards errors, faults or inconsistencies that may occur within the system or the environment in which the system operates, in particular due to their interaction with natural persons or other systems.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: High-risk AI systems shall be resilient as regards errors, faults or inconsistencies that may occur within the system or the environment in which the system operates, in particular due to their interaction with natural persons or other systems.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.addressee_text: The robustness of high-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be achieved through technical redundancy solutions, which may include backup or fail-safe plans.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: The robustness of high-risk AI systems may be achieved through technical redundancy solutions, which may include backup or fail-safe plans.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems that continue to learn after being placed on the market or put into service
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be developed in such a way to ensure that possibly biased outputs due to outputs used as an input for future operations (‘feedback loops’) are duly addressed with appropriate mitigation measures.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: High-risk AI systems that continue to learn after being placed on the market or put into service shall be developed in such a way to ensure that possibly biased outputs due to outputs used as an input for future operations (‘feedback loops’) are duly addressed with appropriate mitigation measures.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be resilient as regards attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter their use or performance by exploiting the system vulnerabilities.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: High-risk AI systems shall be resilient as regards attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter their use or performance by exploiting the system vulnerabilities.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.addressee_text: The technical solutions aimed at ensuring the cybersecurity of high-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be appropriate to the relevant circumstances and the risks.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: The technical solutions aimed at ensuring the cybersecurity of high-risk AI systems shall be appropriate to the relevant circumstances and the risks.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.addressee_text: The technical solutions to address AI specific vulnerabilities
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: include, where appropriate, measures to prevent and control for attacks trying to manipulate the training dataset (‘data poisoning’), inputs designed to cause the model to make a mistake (‘adversarial examples’), or model flaws.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: The technical solutions to address AI specific vulnerabilities shall include, where appropriate, measures to prevent and control for attacks trying to manipulate the training dataset (‘data poisoning’), inputs designed to cause the model to make a mistake (‘adversarial examples’), or model flaws.

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — ensure that their high-risk AI systems are compliant with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: ensure that their high-risk AI systems are compliant with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — have a quality management system in place which complies with Article 17;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: have a quality management system in place which complies with Article 17;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — draw-up the technical documentation of the high-risk AI system;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: draw-up the technical documentation of the high-risk AI system;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — when under their control, keep the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: when under their control, keep the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — ensure that the high-risk AI system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure, prior to its placing on the market or putting into service;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.timing: prior to its placing on the market or putting into service
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: ensure that the high-risk AI system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure, prior to its placing on the market or putting into service;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 51;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 51;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — take the necessary corrective actions, if the high-risk AI system is not in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: take the necessary corrective actions, if the high-risk AI system is not in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — inform the national competent authorities of the Member States in which they made the AI system available or put it into service and, where applicable, the notified body of the non-compliance and of any corrective actions taken;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: inform the national competent authorities of the Member States in which they made the AI system available or put it into service and, where applicable, the notified body of the non-compliance and of any corrective actions taken;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — to affix the CE marking to their high-risk AI systems to indicate the conformity with this Regulation in accordance with Article 49;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: to affix the CE marking to their high-risk AI systems to indicate the conformity with this Regulation in accordance with Article 49;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — upon request of a national competent authority, demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: upon request of a national competent authority, demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: put a quality management system in place that ensures compliance with this Regulation.
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall put a quality management system in place that ensures compliance with this Regulation.

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — a strategy for regulatory compliance, including compliance with conformity assessment procedures and procedures for the management of modifications to the high-risk AI system;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: a strategy for regulatory compliance, including compliance with conformity assessment procedures and procedures for the management of modifications to the high-risk AI system;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — techniques, procedures and systematic actions to be used for the design, design control and design verification of the high-risk AI system;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: techniques, procedures and systematic actions to be used for the design, design control and design verification of the high-risk AI system;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — techniques, procedures and systematic actions to be used for the development, quality control and quality assurance of the high-risk AI system;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: techniques, procedures and systematic actions to be used for the development, quality control and quality assurance of the high-risk AI system;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — examination, test and validation procedures to be carried out before, during and after the development of the high-risk AI system, and the frequency with which they have to be carried out;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: examination, test and validation procedures to be carried out before, during and after the development of the high-risk AI system, and the frequency with which they have to be carried out;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — technical specifications, including standards, to be applied and, where the relevant harmonised standards are not applied in full, the means to be used to ensure that the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: technical specifications, including standards, to be applied and, where the relevant harmonised standards are not applied in full, the means to be used to ensure that the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — systems and procedures for data management, including data collection, data analysis, data labelling, data storage, data filtration, data mining, data aggregation, data retention and any other operation regarding the data that is performed before and for the purposes of the placing on the market or putting into service of high-risk AI systems;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: systems and procedures for data management, including data collection, data analysis, data labelling, data storage, data filtration, data mining, data aggregation, data retention and any other operation regarding the data that is performed before and for the purposes of the placing on the market or putting into service of high-risk AI systems;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — the risk management system referred to in Article 9;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: the risk management system referred to in Article 9;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — the setting-up, implementation and maintenance of a post-market monitoring system, in accordance with Article 61;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: the setting-up, implementation and maintenance of a post-market monitoring system, in accordance with Article 61;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — procedures related to the reporting of serious incidents and of malfunctioning in accordance with Article 62;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: procedures related to the reporting of serious incidents and of malfunctioning in accordance with Article 62;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — the handling of communication with national competent authorities, competent authorities, including sectoral ones, providing or supporting the access to data, notified bodies, other operators, customers or other interested parties;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: the handling of communication with national competent authorities, competent authorities, including sectoral ones, providing or supporting the access to data, notified bodies, other operators, customers or other interested parties;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — systems and procedures for record keeping of all relevant documentation and information;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: systems and procedures for record keeping of all relevant documentation and information;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — resource management, including security of supply related measures;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: resource management, including security of supply related measures;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — an accountability framework setting out the responsibilities of the management and other staff with regard to all aspects listed in this paragraph.
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: an accountability framework setting out the responsibilities of the management and other staff with regard to all aspects listed in this paragraph.

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.addressee_text: The implementation of aspects referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be proportionate to the size of the provider’s organisation.
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: The implementation of aspects referred to in paragraph 1 shall be proportionate to the size of the provider’s organisation.

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.addressee_text: For providers that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/ EU, the obligation to put a quality management system in place
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be deemed to be fulfilled by complying with the rules on internal governance arrangements, processes and mechanisms pursuant to Article 74 of that Directive.
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: For providers that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/ EU, the obligation to put a quality management system in place shall be deemed to be fulfilled by complying with the rules on internal governance arrangements, processes and mechanisms pursuant to Article 74 of that Directive.

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.addressee_text: In that context, any harmonised standards referred to in Article 40 of this Regulation
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be taken into account.
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: In that context, any harmonised standards referred to in Article 40 of this Regulation shall be taken into account.

ai_act/proposal/art/18.action: draw up the technical documentation referred to in Article 11 in accordance with Annex IV.
ai_act/proposal/art/18.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall draw up the technical documentation referred to in Article 11 in accordance with Annex IV.

ai_act/proposal/art/18.addressee_text: Providers that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU
ai_act/proposal/art/18.action: maintain the technical documentation as part of the documentation concerning internal governance, arrangements, processes and mechanisms pursuant to Article 74 of that Directive.
ai_act/proposal/art/18.span: Providers that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU shall maintain the technical documentation as part of the documentation concerning internal governance, arrangements, processes and mechanisms pursuant to Article 74 of that Directive.

ai_act/proposal/art/19.action: ensure that their systems undergo the relevant conformity assessment procedure in accordance with Article 43, prior to their placing on the market or putting into service.
ai_act/proposal/art/19.timing: prior to their placing on the market or putting into service
ai_act/proposal/art/19.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall ensure that their systems undergo the relevant conformity assessment procedure in accordance with Article 43, prior to their placing on the market or putting into service.

ai_act/proposal/art/19.condition: Where the compliance of the AI systems with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title has been demonstrated following that conformity assessment
ai_act/proposal/art/19.action: draw up an EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 48 and affix the CE marking of conformity in accordance with Article 49.
ai_act/proposal/art/19.span: Where the compliance of the AI systems with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title has been demonstrated following that conformity assessment, the providers shall draw up an EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 48 and affix the CE marking of conformity in accordance with Article 49.

ai_act/proposal/art/19.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 5(b) of Annex III that are placed on the market or put into service by providers that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU, the conformity assessment
ai_act/proposal/art/19.action: be carried out as part of the procedure referred to in Articles 97 to101 of that Directive.
ai_act/proposal/art/19.span: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 5(b) of Annex III that are placed on the market or put into service by providers that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU, the conformity assessment shall be carried out as part of the procedure referred to in Articles 97 to101 of that Directive.

ai_act/art/19.action: keep the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems, to the extent such logs are under their control by virtue of a contractual arrangement with the user or otherwise by law.
ai_act/art/19.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall keep the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems, to the extent such logs are under their control by virtue of a contractual arrangement with the user or otherwise by law.

ai_act/art/19.action: be kept for a period that is appropriate in the light of the intended purpose of high-risk AI system and applicable legal obligations under Union or national law.
ai_act/art/19.span: The logs shall be kept for a period that is appropriate in the light of the intended purpose of high-risk AI system and applicable legal obligations under Union or national law.

ai_act/art/19.addressee_text: Providers that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU
ai_act/art/19.action: maintain the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems as part of the documentation under Articles 74 of that Directive.
ai_act/art/19.span: Providers that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU shall maintain the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems as part of the documentation under Articles 74 of that Directive.

ai_act/art/20.addressee_text: Providers of high-risk AI systems which consider or have reason to consider that a high-risk AI system which they have placed on the market or put into service is not in conformity with this Regulation
ai_act/art/20.action: immediately take the necessary corrective actions to bring that system into conformity, to withdraw it or to recall it, as appropriate.
ai_act/art/20.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems which consider or have reason to consider that a high-risk AI system which they have placed on the market or put into service is not in conformity with this Regulation shall immediately take the necessary corrective actions to bring that system into conformity, to withdraw it or to recall it, as appropriate.

ai_act/art/20.action: inform the distributors of the high-risk AI system in question and, where applicable, the authorised representative and importers accordingly.
ai_act/art/20.span: They shall inform the distributors of the high-risk AI system in question and, where applicable, the authorised representative and importers accordingly.

ai_act/proposal/art/22.condition: Where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 65(1) and that risk is known to the provider of the system
ai_act/proposal/art/22.action: immediately inform the national competent authorities of the Member States in which it made the system available and, where applicable, the notified body that issued a certificate for the high-risk AI system, in particular of the non-compliance and of any corrective actions taken.
ai_act/proposal/art/22.span: Where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 65(1) and that risk is known to the provider of the system, that provider shall immediately inform the national competent authorities of the Member States in which it made the system available and, where applicable, the notified body that issued a certificate for the high-risk AI system, in particular of the non-compliance and of any corrective actions taken.

ai_act/art/21.action: , upon request by a national competent authority, provide that authority with all the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, in an official Union language determined by the Member State concerned.
ai_act/art/21.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall, upon request by a national competent authority, provide that authority with all the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, in an official Union language determined by the Member State concerned.

ai_act/art/21.condition: Upon a reasoned request from a national competent authority
ai_act/art/21.action: also give that authority access to the logs automatically generated by the high-risk AI system, to the extent such logs are under their control by virtue of a contractual arrangement with the user or otherwise by law.
ai_act/art/21.span: Upon a reasoned request from a national competent authority, providers shall also give that authority access to the logs automatically generated by the high-risk AI system, to the extent such logs are under their control by virtue of a contractual arrangement with the user or otherwise by law.

ai_act/proposal/art/24.condition: Where a high-risk AI system related to products to which the legal acts listed in Annex II, section A, apply, is placed on the market or put into service together with the product manufactured in accordance with those legal acts and under the name of the product manufacturer
ai_act/proposal/art/24.action: take the responsibility of the compliance of the AI system with this Regulation and, as far as the AI system is concerned, have the same obligations imposed by the present Regulation on the provider.
ai_act/proposal/art/24.span: Where a high-risk AI system related to products to which the legal acts listed in Annex II, section A, apply, is placed on the market or put into service together with the product manufactured in accordance with those legal acts and under the name of the product manufacturer, the manufacturer of the product shall take the responsibility of the compliance of the AI system with this Regulation and, as far as the AI system is concerned, have the same obligations imposed by the present Regulation on the provider.

ai_act/art/22.condition: Prior to making their systems available on the Union market, where an importer cannot be identified
ai_act/art/22.action: , by written mandate, appoint an authorised representative which is established in the Union.
ai_act/art/22.span: Prior to making their systems available on the Union market, where an importer cannot be identified, providers established outside the Union shall, by written mandate, appoint an authorised representative which is established in the Union.

ai_act/art/22.action: perform the tasks specified in the mandate received from the provider.
ai_act/art/22.span: The authorised representative shall perform the tasks specified in the mandate received from the provider.

ai_act/art/22.action: empower the authorised representative to carry out the following tasks — keep a copy of the EU declaration of conformity and the technical documentation at the disposal of the national competent authorities and national authorities referred to in Article 63(7);
ai_act/art/22.span: keep a copy of the EU declaration of conformity and the technical documentation at the disposal of the national competent authorities and national authorities referred to in Article 63(7);

ai_act/art/22.action: empower the authorised representative to carry out the following tasks — provide a national competent authority, upon a reasoned request, with all the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate the conformity of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, including access to the logs automatically generated by the high-risk AI system to the extent such logs are under the control of the provider by virtue of a contractual arrangement with the user or otherwise by law;
