ai_act/art/22.span: provide a national competent authority, upon a reasoned request, with all the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate the conformity of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, including access to the logs automatically generated by the high-risk AI system to the extent such logs are under the control of the provider by virtue of a contractual arrangement with the user or otherwise by law;

ai_act/art/22.action: empower the authorised representative to carry out the following tasks — cooperate with competent national authorities, upon a reasoned request, on any action the latter takes in relation to the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/art/22.span: cooperate with competent national authorities, upon a reasoned request, on any action the latter takes in relation to the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/art/23.condition: Before placing a high-risk AI system on the market
ai_act/art/23.action: ensure that — the appropriate conformity assessment procedure has been carried out by the provider of that AI system
ai_act/art/23.span: the appropriate conformity assessment procedure has been carried out by the provider of that AI system

ai_act/art/23.condition: Before placing a high-risk AI system on the market
ai_act/art/23.action: ensure that — the provider has drawn up the technical documentation in accordance with Annex IV;
ai_act/art/23.span: the provider has drawn up the technical documentation in accordance with Annex IV;

ai_act/art/23.condition: Before placing a high-risk AI system on the market
ai_act/art/23.action: ensure that — the system bears the required conformity marking and is accompanied by the required documentation and instructions of use.
ai_act/art/23.span: the system bears the required conformity marking and is accompanied by the required documentation and instructions of use.

ai_act/art/23.condition: Where an importer considers or has reason to consider that a high-risk AI system is not in conformity with this Regulation
ai_act/art/23.action: place that system on the market until that AI system has been brought into conformity.
ai_act/art/23.span: Where an importer considers or has reason to consider that a high-risk AI system is not in conformity with this Regulation, it shall not place that system on the market until that AI system has been brought into conformity.

ai_act/art/23.condition: Where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 65(1)
ai_act/art/23.action: inform the provider of the AI system and the market surveillance authorities to that effect.
ai_act/art/23.span: Where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 65(1), the importer shall inform the provider of the AI system and the market surveillance authorities to that effect.

ai_act/art/23.action: indicate their name, registered trade name or registered trade mark, and the address at which they can be contacted on the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, as applicable.
ai_act/art/23.span: Importers shall indicate their name, registered trade name or registered trade mark, and the address at which they can be contacted on the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, as applicable.

ai_act/art/23.action: ensure that, while a high-risk AI system is under their responsibility, where applicable, storage or transport conditions do not jeopardise its compliance with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.
ai_act/art/23.span: Importers shall ensure that, while a high-risk AI system is under their responsibility, where applicable, storage or transport conditions do not jeopardise its compliance with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.

ai_act/art/23.action: provide national competent authorities, upon a reasoned request, with all necessary information and documentation to demonstrate the conformity of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title in a language which can be easily understood by that national competent authority, including access to the logs automatically generated by the high-risk AI system to the extent such logs are under the control of the provider by virtue of a contractual arrangement with the user or otherwise by law.
ai_act/art/23.span: Importers shall provide national competent authorities, upon a reasoned request, with all necessary information and documentation to demonstrate the conformity of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title in a language which can be easily understood by that national competent authority, including access to the logs automatically generated by the high-risk AI system to the extent such logs are under the control of the provider by virtue of a contractual arrangement with the user or otherwise by law.

ai_act/art/23.action: also cooperate with those authorities on any action national competent authority takes in relation to that system.
ai_act/art/23.span: They shall also cooperate with those authorities on any action national competent authority takes in relation to that system.

ai_act/art/24.condition: Before making a high-risk AI system available on the market
ai_act/art/24.action: verify that the high-risk AI system bears the required CE conformity marking, that it is accompanied by the required documentation and instruction of use, and that the provider and the importer of the system, as applicable, have complied with the obligations set out in this Regulation.
ai_act/art/24.span: Before making a high-risk AI system available on the market, distributors shall verify that the high-risk AI system bears the required CE conformity marking, that it is accompanied by the required documentation and instruction of use, and that the provider and the importer of the system, as applicable, have complied with the obligations set out in this Regulation.

ai_act/art/24.condition: Where a distributor considers or has reason to consider that a high-risk AI system is not in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title
ai_act/art/24.action: make the high-risk AI system available on the market until that system has been brought into conformity with those requirements.
ai_act/art/24.span: Where a distributor considers or has reason to consider that a high-risk AI system is not in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, it shall not make the high-risk AI system available on the market until that system has been brought into conformity with those requirements.

ai_act/art/24.addressee_text: Furthermore, where the system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 65(1), the distributor
ai_act/art/24.action: inform the provider or the importer of the system, as applicable, to that effect.
ai_act/art/24.span: Furthermore, where the system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 65(1), the distributor shall inform the provider or the importer of the system, as applicable, to that effect.

ai_act/art/24.action: ensure that, while a high-risk AI system is under their responsibility, where applicable, storage or transport conditions do not jeopardise the compliance of the system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.
ai_act/art/24.span: Distributors shall ensure that, while a high-risk AI system is under their responsibility, where applicable, storage or transport conditions do not jeopardise the compliance of the system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.

ai_act/art/24.addressee_text: A distributor that considers or has reason to consider that a high-risk AI system which it has made available on the market is not in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title
ai_act/art/24.action: take the corrective actions necessary to bring that system into conformity with those requirements, to withdraw it or recall it or shall ensure that the provider, the importer or any relevant operator, as appropriate, takes those corrective actions.
ai_act/art/24.span: A distributor that considers or has reason to consider that a high-risk AI system which it has made available on the market is not in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title shall take the corrective actions necessary to bring that system into conformity with those requirements, to withdraw it or recall it or shall ensure that the provider, the importer or any relevant operator, as appropriate, takes those corrective actions.

ai_act/art/24.condition: Where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 65(1)
ai_act/art/24.action: immediately inform the national competent authorities of the Member States in which it has made the product available to that effect, giving details, in particular, of the non-compliance and of any corrective actions taken.
ai_act/art/24.span: Where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 65(1), the distributor shall immediately inform the national competent authorities of the Member States in which it has made the product available to that effect, giving details, in particular, of the non-compliance and of any corrective actions taken.

ai_act/art/24.condition: Upon a reasoned request from a national competent authority
ai_act/art/24.action: provide that authority with all the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate the conformity of a high-risk system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.
ai_act/art/24.span: Upon a reasoned request from a national competent authority, distributors of high-risk AI systems shall provide that authority with all the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate the conformity of a high-risk system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.

ai_act/art/24.action: also cooperate with that national competent authority on any action taken by that authority.
ai_act/art/24.span: Distributors shall also cooperate with that national competent authority on any action taken by that authority.

ai_act/art/25.addressee_text: Any distributor, importer, user or other third-party
ai_act/art/25.action: be considered a provider for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the provider under Article 16, in any of the following circumstances — they place on the market or put into service a high-risk AI system under their name or trademark;
ai_act/art/25.span: they place on the market or put into service a high-risk AI system under their name or trademark;

ai_act/art/25.addressee_text: Any distributor, importer, user or other third-party
ai_act/art/25.action: be considered a provider for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the provider under Article 16, in any of the following circumstances — they modify the intended purpose of a high-risk AI system already placed on the market or put into service;
ai_act/art/25.span: they modify the intended purpose of a high-risk AI system already placed on the market or put into service;

ai_act/art/25.addressee_text: Any distributor, importer, user or other third-party
ai_act/art/25.action: be considered a provider for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the provider under Article 16, in any of the following circumstances — they make a substantial modification to the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/art/25.span: they make a substantial modification to the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/art/25.addressee_text: the provider that initially placed the high-risk AI system on the market or put it into service
ai_act/art/25.condition: Where the circumstances referred to in paragraph 1, point (b) or (c), occur
ai_act/art/25.action: no longer be considered a provider for the purposes of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/25.span: Where the circumstances referred to in paragraph 1, point (b) or (c), occur, the provider that initially placed the high-risk AI system on the market or put it into service shall no longer be considered a provider for the purposes of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/26.action: use such systems in accordance with the instructions of use accompanying the systems, pursuant to paragraphs 2 and 5.
ai_act/art/26.span: Users of high-risk AI systems shall use such systems in accordance with the instructions of use accompanying the systems, pursuant to paragraphs 2 and 5.

ai_act/art/26.condition: Without prejudice to paragraph 1, to the extent the user exercises control over the input data
ai_act/art/26.action: ensure that input data is relevant in view of the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/art/26.span: Without prejudice to paragraph 1, to the extent the user exercises control over the input data, that user shall ensure that input data is relevant in view of the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/art/26.action: monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system on the basis of the instructions of use.
ai_act/art/26.span: Users shall monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system on the basis of the instructions of use.

ai_act/art/26.condition: When they have reasons to consider that the use in accordance with the instructions of use
ai_act/art/26.action: result in the AI system presenting a risk within the meaning of Article 65(1) they shall inform the provider or distributor and suspend the use of the system.
ai_act/art/26.span: When they have reasons to consider that the use in accordance with the instructions of use may result in the AI system presenting a risk within the meaning of Article 65(1) they shall inform the provider or distributor and suspend the use of the system.

ai_act/art/26.action: also inform the provider or distributor when they have identified any serious incident or any malfunctioning within the meaning of Article 62 and interrupt the use of the AI system.
ai_act/art/26.span: They shall also inform the provider or distributor when they have identified any serious incident or any malfunctioning within the meaning of Article 62 and interrupt the use of the AI system.

ai_act/art/26.addressee_text: In case the user is not able to reach the provider, Article 62
ai_act/art/26.action: apply mutatis mutandis.
ai_act/art/26.span: In case the user is not able to reach the provider, Article 62 shall apply mutatis mutandis.

ai_act/art/26.addressee_text: For users that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU, the monitoring obligation set out in the first subparagraph
ai_act/art/26.action: be deemed to be fulfilled by complying with the rules on internal governance arrangements, processes and mechanisms pursuant to Article 74 of that Directive.
ai_act/art/26.span: For users that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU, the monitoring obligation set out in the first subparagraph shall be deemed to be fulfilled by complying with the rules on internal governance arrangements, processes and mechanisms pursuant to Article 74 of that Directive.

ai_act/art/26.action: keep the logs automatically generated by that high-risk AI system, to the extent such logs are under their control.
ai_act/art/26.span: Users of high-risk AI systems shall keep the logs automatically generated by that high-risk AI system, to the extent such logs are under their control.

ai_act/art/26.action: be kept for a period that is appropriate in the light of the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system and applicable legal obligations under Union or national law.
ai_act/art/26.span: The logs shall be kept for a period that is appropriate in the light of the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system and applicable legal obligations under Union or national law.

ai_act/art/26.addressee_text: Users that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU
ai_act/art/26.action: maintain the logs as part of the documentation concerning internal governance arrangements, processes and mechanisms pursuant to Article 74 of that Directive.
ai_act/art/26.span: Users that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU shall maintain the logs as part of the documentation concerning internal governance arrangements, processes and mechanisms pursuant to Article 74 of that Directive.

ai_act/art/26.action: use the information provided under Article 13 to comply with their obligation to carry out a data protection impact assessment under Article 35 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 or Article 27 of Directive (EU) 2016/680, where applicable.
ai_act/art/26.span: Users of high-risk AI systems shall use the information provided under Article 13 to comply with their obligation to carry out a data protection impact assessment under Article 35 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 or Article 27 of Directive (EU) 2016/680, where applicable.

ai_act/art/28.action: designate or establish a notifying authority responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment, designation and notification of conformity assessment bodies and for their monitoring.
ai_act/art/28.span: Each Member State shall designate or establish a notifying authority responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment, designation and notification of conformity assessment bodies and for their monitoring.

ai_act/art/28.action: designate a national accreditation body referred to in Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 as a notifying authority.
ai_act/art/28.span: Member States may designate a national accreditation body referred to in Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 as a notifying authority.

ai_act/art/28.action: be established, organised and operated in such a way that no conflict of interest arises with conformity assessment bodies and the objectivity and impartiality of their activities are safeguarded.
ai_act/art/28.span: Notifying authorities shall be established, organised and operated in such a way that no conflict of interest arises with conformity assessment bodies and the objectivity and impartiality of their activities are safeguarded.

ai_act/art/28.action: be organised in such a way that decisions relating to the notification of conformity assessment bodies are taken by competent persons different from those who carried out the assessment of those bodies.
ai_act/art/28.span: Notifying authorities shall be organised in such a way that decisions relating to the notification of conformity assessment bodies are taken by competent persons different from those who carried out the assessment of those bodies.

ai_act/art/28.action: offer or provide any activities that conformity assessment bodies perform or any consultancy services on a commercial or competitive basis.
ai_act/art/28.span: Notifying authorities shall not offer or provide any activities that conformity assessment bodies perform or any consultancy services on a commercial or competitive basis.

ai_act/art/28.action: safeguard the confidentiality of the information they obtain.
ai_act/art/28.span: Notifying authorities shall safeguard the confidentiality of the information they obtain.

ai_act/art/28.action: have a sufficient number of competent personnel at their disposal for the proper performance of their tasks.
ai_act/art/28.span: Notifying authorities shall have a sufficient number of competent personnel at their disposal for the proper performance of their tasks.

ai_act/art/28.action: make sure that conformity assessments are carried out in a proportionate manner, avoiding unnecessary burdens for providers and that notified bodies perform their activities taking due account of the size of an undertaking, the sector in which it operates, its structure and the degree of complexity of the AI system in question.
ai_act/art/28.span: Notifying authorities shall make sure that conformity assessments are carried out in a proportionate manner, avoiding unnecessary burdens for providers and that notified bodies perform their activities taking due account of the size of an undertaking, the sector in which it operates, its structure and the degree of complexity of the AI system in question.

ai_act/art/29.action: submit an application for notification to the notifying authority of the Member State in which they are established.
ai_act/art/29.span: Conformity assessment bodies shall submit an application for notification to the notifying authority of the Member State in which they are established.

ai_act/art/29.action: be accompanied by a description of the conformity assessment activities, the conformity assessment module or modules and the artificial intelligence technologies for which the conformity assessment body claims to be competent, as well as by an accreditation certificate, where one exists, issued by a national accreditation body attesting that the conformity assessment body fulfils the requirements laid down in Article 33.
ai_act/art/29.span: The application for notification shall be accompanied by a description of the conformity assessment activities, the conformity assessment module or modules and the artificial intelligence technologies for which the conformity assessment body claims to be competent, as well as by an accreditation certificate, where one exists, issued by a national accreditation body attesting that the conformity assessment body fulfils the requirements laid down in Article 33.

ai_act/art/29.addressee_text: Any valid document related to existing designations of the applicant notified body under any other Union harmonisation legislation
ai_act/art/29.span: Any valid document related to existing designations of the applicant notified body under any other Union harmonisation legislation shall be added.

ai_act/art/29.condition: Where the conformity assessment body concerned cannot provide an accreditation certificate
ai_act/art/29.action: provide the notifying authority with the documentary evidence necessary for the verification, recognition and regular monitoring of its compliance with the requirements laid down in Article 33.
ai_act/art/29.span: Where the conformity assessment body concerned cannot provide an accreditation certificate, it shall provide the notifying authority with the documentary evidence necessary for the verification, recognition and regular monitoring of its compliance with the requirements laid down in Article 33.

ai_act/art/29.addressee_text: For notified bodies which are designated under any other Union harmonisation legislation, all documents and certificates linked to those designations
ai_act/art/29.action: be used to support their designation procedure under this Regulation, as appropriate.
ai_act/art/29.span: For notified bodies which are designated under any other Union harmonisation legislation, all documents and certificates linked to those designations may be used to support their designation procedure under this Regulation, as appropriate.

ai_act/art/30.action: notify only conformity assessment bodies which have satisfied the requirements laid down in Article 33.
ai_act/art/30.span: Notifying authorities may notify only conformity assessment bodies which have satisfied the requirements laid down in Article 33.

ai_act/art/30.action: notify the Commission and the other Member States using the electronic notification tool developed and managed by the Commission.
ai_act/art/30.span: Notifying authorities shall notify the Commission and the other Member States using the electronic notification tool developed and managed by the Commission.

ai_act/art/30.action: include full details of the conformity assessment activities, the conformity assessment module or modules and the artificial intelligence technologies concerned.
ai_act/art/30.span: The notification shall include full details of the conformity assessment activities, the conformity assessment module or modules and the artificial intelligence technologies concerned.

ai_act/art/30.action: perform the activities of a notified body only where no objections are raised by the Commission or the other Member States within one month of a notification.
ai_act/art/30.span: The conformity assessment body concerned may perform the activities of a notified body only where no objections are raised by the Commission or the other Member States within one month of a notification.

ai_act/art/30.action: notify the Commission and the other Member States of any subsequent relevant changes to the notification.
ai_act/art/30.span: Notifying authorities shall notify the Commission and the other Member States of any subsequent relevant changes to the notification.

ai_act/art/31.action: verify the conformity of high-risk AI system in accordance with the conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 43.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall verify the conformity of high-risk AI system in accordance with the conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 43.

ai_act/art/31.action: satisfy the organisational, quality management, resources and process requirements that are necessary to fulfil their tasks.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall satisfy the organisational, quality management, resources and process requirements that are necessary to fulfil their tasks.

ai_act/art/31.addressee_text: The organisational structure, allocation of responsibilities, reporting lines and operation of notified bodies
ai_act/art/31.action: be such as to ensure that there is confidence in the performance by and in the results of the conformity assessment activities that the notified bodies conduct.
ai_act/art/31.span: The organisational structure, allocation of responsibilities, reporting lines and operation of notified bodies shall be such as to ensure that there is confidence in the performance by and in the results of the conformity assessment activities that the notified bodies conduct.

ai_act/art/31.action: be independent of the provider of a high-risk AI system in relation to which it performs conformity assessment activities.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall be independent of the provider of a high-risk AI system in relation to which it performs conformity assessment activities.

ai_act/art/31.action: also be independent of any other operator having an economic interest in the high-risk AI system that is assessed, as well as of any competitors of the provider.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall also be independent of any other operator having an economic interest in the high-risk AI system that is assessed, as well as of any competitors of the provider.

ai_act/art/31.action: be organised and operated so as to safeguard the independence, objectivity and impartiality of their activities.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall be organised and operated so as to safeguard the independence, objectivity and impartiality of their activities.

ai_act/art/31.action: document and implement a structure and procedures to safeguard impartiality and to promote and apply the principles of impartiality throughout their organisation, personnel and assessment activities.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall document and implement a structure and procedures to safeguard impartiality and to promote and apply the principles of impartiality throughout their organisation, personnel and assessment activities.

ai_act/art/31.action: have documented procedures in place ensuring that their personnel, committees, subsidiaries, subcontractors and any associated body or personnel of external bodies respect the confidentiality of the information which comes into their possession during the performance of conformity assessment activities, except when disclosure is required by law.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall have documented procedures in place ensuring that their personnel, committees, subsidiaries, subcontractors and any associated body or personnel of external bodies respect the confidentiality of the information which comes into their possession during the performance of conformity assessment activities, except when disclosure is required by law.

ai_act/art/31.action: be bound to observe professional secrecy with regard to all information obtained in carrying out their tasks under this Regulation, except in relation to the notifying authorities of the Member State in which their activities are carried out.
ai_act/art/31.span: The staff of notified bodies shall be bound to observe professional secrecy with regard to all information obtained in carrying out their tasks under this Regulation, except in relation to the notifying authorities of the Member State in which their activities are carried out.

ai_act/art/31.action: have procedures for the performance of activities which take due account of the size of an undertaking, the sector in which it operates, its structure, the degree of complexity of the AI system in question.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall have procedures for the performance of activities which take due account of the size of an undertaking, the sector in which it operates, its structure, the degree of complexity of the AI system in question.

ai_act/art/31.action: take out appropriate liability insurance for their conformity assessment activities, unless liability is assumed by the Member State concerned in accordance with national law or that Member State is directly responsible for the conformity assessment.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall take out appropriate liability insurance for their conformity assessment activities, unless liability is assumed by the Member State concerned in accordance with national law or that Member State is directly responsible for the conformity assessment.

ai_act/art/31.action: be capable of carrying out all the tasks falling to them under this Regulation with the highest degree of professional integrity and the requisite competence in the specific field, whether those tasks are carried out by notified bodies themselves or on their behalf and under their responsibility.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall be capable of carrying out all the tasks falling to them under this Regulation with the highest degree of professional integrity and the requisite competence in the specific field, whether those tasks are carried out by notified bodies themselves or on their behalf and under their responsibility.

ai_act/art/31.action: have sufficient internal competences to be able to effectively evaluate the tasks conducted by external parties on their behalf.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall have sufficient internal competences to be able to effectively evaluate the tasks conducted by external parties on their behalf.

ai_act/art/31.addressee_text: To that end, at all times and for each conformity assessment procedure and each type of high-risk AI system in relation to which they have been designated, the notified body
ai_act/art/31.action: have permanent availability of sufficient administrative, technical and scientific personnel who possess experience and knowledge relating to the relevant artificial intelligence technologies, data and data computing and to the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.
ai_act/art/31.span: To that end, at all times and for each conformity assessment procedure and each type of high-risk AI system in relation to which they have been designated, the notified body shall have permanent availability of sufficient administrative, technical and scientific personnel who possess experience and knowledge relating to the relevant artificial intelligence technologies, data and data computing and to the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.

ai_act/art/31.action: participate in coordination activities as referred to in Article 38.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall participate in coordination activities as referred to in Article 38.

ai_act/art/31.action: also take part directly or be represented in European standardisation organisations, or ensure that they are aware and up to date in respect of relevant standards.
ai_act/art/31.span: They shall also take part directly or be represented in European standardisation organisations, or ensure that they are aware and up to date in respect of relevant standards.

ai_act/art/31.action: make available and submit upon request all relevant documentation, including the providers’ documentation, to the notifying authority referred to in Article 30 to allow it to conduct its assessment, designation, notification, monitoring and surveillance activities and to facilitate the assessment outlined in this Chapter.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall make available and submit upon request all relevant documentation, including the providers’ documentation, to the notifying authority referred to in Article 30 to allow it to conduct its assessment, designation, notification, monitoring and surveillance activities and to facilitate the assessment outlined in this Chapter.

ai_act/art/33.condition: Where a notified body subcontracts specific tasks connected with the conformity assessment or has recourse to a subsidiary
ai_act/art/33.action: ensure that the subcontractor or the subsidiary meets the requirements laid down in Article 33 and shall inform the notifying authority accordingly.
ai_act/art/33.span: Where a notified body subcontracts specific tasks connected with the conformity assessment or has recourse to a subsidiary, it shall ensure that the subcontractor or the subsidiary meets the requirements laid down in Article 33 and shall inform the notifying authority accordingly.

ai_act/art/33.action: take full responsibility for the tasks performed by subcontractors or subsidiaries wherever these are established.
ai_act/art/33.span: Notified bodies shall take full responsibility for the tasks performed by subcontractors or subsidiaries wherever these are established.

ai_act/art/33.action: be subcontracted or carried out by a subsidiary only with the agreement of the provider.
ai_act/art/33.span: Activities may be subcontracted or carried out by a subsidiary only with the agreement of the provider.

ai_act/art/33.action: keep at the disposal of the notifying authority the relevant documents concerning the assessment of the qualifications of the subcontractor or the subsidiary and the work carried out by them under this Regulation.
ai_act/art/33.span: Notified bodies shall keep at the disposal of the notifying authority the relevant documents concerning the assessment of the qualifications of the subcontractor or the subsidiary and the work carried out by them under this Regulation.

ai_act/art/35.action: assign an identification number to notified bodies.
ai_act/art/35.span: The Commission shall assign an identification number to notified bodies.

ai_act/art/35.action: assign a single number, even where a body is notified under several Union acts.
ai_act/art/35.span: It shall assign a single number, even where a body is notified under several Union acts.

ai_act/art/35.action: make publicly available the list of the bodies notified under this Regulation, including the identification numbers that have been assigned to them and the activities for which they have been notified.
ai_act/art/35.span: The Commission shall make publicly available the list of the bodies notified under this Regulation, including the identification numbers that have been assigned to them and the activities for which they have been notified.

ai_act/art/35.action: ensure that the list is kept up to date.
ai_act/art/35.span: The Commission shall ensure that the list is kept up to date.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: that authority
ai_act/art/36.condition: Where a notifying authority has suspicions or has been informed that a notified body no longer meets the requirements laid down in Article 33, or that it is failing to fulfil its obligations
ai_act/art/36.action: without delay investigate the matter with the utmost diligence.
ai_act/art/36.span: Where a notifying authority has suspicions or has been informed that a notified body no longer meets the requirements laid down in Article 33, or that it is failing to fulfil its obligations, that authority shall without delay investigate the matter with the utmost diligence.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: In that context, it
ai_act/art/36.action: inform the notified body concerned about the objections raised and give it the possibility to make its views known.
ai_act/art/36.span: In that context, it shall inform the notified body concerned about the objections raised and give it the possibility to make its views known.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: it
ai_act/art/36.condition: If the notifying authority comes to the conclusion that the notified body investigation no longer meets the requirements laid down in Article 33 or that it is failing to fulfil its obligations
ai_act/art/36.action: restrict, suspend or withdraw the notification as appropriate, depending on the seriousness of the failure.
ai_act/art/36.span: If the notifying authority comes to the conclusion that the notified body investigation no longer meets the requirements laid down in Article 33 or that it is failing to fulfil its obligations, it shall restrict, suspend or withdraw the notification as appropriate, depending on the seriousness of the failure.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: It
ai_act/art/36.action: also immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States accordingly.
ai_act/art/36.span: It shall also immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States accordingly.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: In the event of restriction, suspension or withdrawal of notification, or where the notified body has ceased its activity, the notifying authority
ai_act/art/36.action: take appropriate steps to ensure that the files of that notified body are either taken over by another notified body or kept available for the responsible notifying authorities at their request.
ai_act/art/36.span: In the event of restriction, suspension or withdrawal of notification, or where the notified body has ceased its activity, the notifying authority shall take appropriate steps to ensure that the files of that notified body are either taken over by another notified body or kept available for the responsible notifying authorities at their request.

ai_act/art/37.action: , where necessary, investigate all cases where there are reasons to doubt whether a notified body complies with the requirements laid down in Article 33.
ai_act/art/37.span: The Commission shall, where necessary, investigate all cases where there are reasons to doubt whether a notified body complies with the requirements laid down in Article 33.

ai_act/art/37.action: provide the Commission, on request, with all relevant information relating to the notification of the notified body concerned.
ai_act/art/37.span: The Notifying authority shall provide the Commission, on request, with all relevant information relating to the notification of the notified body concerned.

ai_act/art/37.action: ensure that all confidential information obtained in the course of its investigations pursuant to this Article is treated confidentially.
ai_act/art/37.span: The Commission shall ensure that all confidential information obtained in the course of its investigations pursuant to this Article is treated confidentially.

ai_act/art/37.condition: Where the Commission ascertains that a notified body does not meet or no longer meets the requirements laid down in Article 33
ai_act/art/37.action: adopt a reasoned decision requesting the notifying Member State to take the necessary corrective measures, including withdrawal of notification if necessary.
ai_act/art/37.span: Where the Commission ascertains that a notified body does not meet or no longer meets the requirements laid down in Article 33, it shall adopt a reasoned decision requesting the notifying Member State to take the necessary corrective measures, including withdrawal of notification if necessary.

ai_act/art/37.action: be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 74(2).
ai_act/art/37.span: That implementing act shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 74(2).

ai_act/art/38.action: ensure that, with regard to the areas covered by this Regulation, appropriate coordination and cooperation between notified bodies active in the conformity assessment procedures of AI systems pursuant to this Regulation are put in place and properly operated in the form of a sectoral group of notified bodies.
ai_act/art/38.span: The Commission shall ensure that, with regard to the areas covered by this Regulation, appropriate coordination and cooperation between notified bodies active in the conformity assessment procedures of AI systems pursuant to this Regulation are put in place and properly operated in the form of a sectoral group of notified bodies.

ai_act/art/38.action: ensure that the bodies notified by them participate in the work of that group, directly or by means of designated representatives.
ai_act/art/38.span: Member States shall ensure that the bodies notified by them participate in the work of that group, directly or by means of designated representatives.

ai_act/art/39.addressee_text: Conformity assessment bodies established under the law of a third country with which the Union has concluded an agreement
ai_act/art/39.action: be authorised to carry out the activities of notified Bodies under this Regulation.
ai_act/art/39.span: Conformity assessment bodies established under the law of a third country with which the Union has concluded an agreement may be authorised to carry out the activities of notified Bodies under this Regulation.

ai_act/art/32.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems which are in conformity with harmonised standards or parts thereof the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union
ai_act/art/32.action: be presumed to be in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, to the extent those standards cover those requirements.
ai_act/art/32.span: High-risk AI systems which are in conformity with harmonised standards or parts thereof the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union shall be presumed to be in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, to the extent those standards cover those requirements.

ai_act/art/41.condition: Where harmonised standards referred to in Article 40 do not exist or where the Commission considers that the relevant harmonised standards are insufficient or that there is a need to address specific safety or fundamental right concerns
ai_act/art/41.action: , by means of implementing acts, adopt common specifications in respect of the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.
ai_act/art/41.span: Where harmonised standards referred to in Article 40 do not exist or where the Commission considers that the relevant harmonised standards are insufficient or that there is a need to address specific safety or fundamental right concerns, the Commission may, by means of implementing acts, adopt common specifications in respect of the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.

ai_act/art/41.action: be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 74(2).
ai_act/art/41.span: Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 74(2).

ai_act/art/41.addressee_text: The Commission, when preparing the common specifications referred to in paragraph 1,
ai_act/art/41.action: gather the views of relevant bodies or expert groups established under relevant sectorial Union law.
ai_act/art/41.span: The Commission, when preparing the common specifications referred to in paragraph 1, shall gather the views of relevant bodies or expert groups established under relevant sectorial Union law.

ai_act/art/41.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems which are in conformity with the common specifications referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/41.action: be presumed to be in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, to the extent those common specifications cover those requirements.
ai_act/art/41.span: High-risk AI systems which are in conformity with the common specifications referred to in paragraph 1 shall be presumed to be in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, to the extent those common specifications cover those requirements.

ai_act/art/41.condition: Where providers do not comply with the common specifications referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/41.action: duly justify that they have adopted technical solutions that are at least equivalent thereto.
ai_act/art/41.span: Where providers do not comply with the common specifications referred to in paragraph 1, they shall duly justify that they have adopted technical solutions that are at least equivalent thereto.

ai_act/art/42.addressee_text: Taking into account their intended purpose, high-risk AI systems that have been trained and tested on data concerning the specific geographical, behavioural and functional setting within which they are intended to be used
ai_act/art/42.action: be presumed to be in compliance with the requirement set out in Article 10(4).
ai_act/art/42.span: Taking into account their intended purpose, high-risk AI systems that have been trained and tested on data concerning the specific geographical, behavioural and functional setting within which they are intended to be used shall be presumed to be in compliance with the requirement set out in Article 10(4).

ai_act/art/42.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems that have been certified or for which a statement of conformity has been issued under a cybersecurity scheme pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/881 of the European Parliament and of the Council and the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union
ai_act/art/42.action: be presumed to be in compliance with the cybersecurity requirements set out in Article 15 of this Regulation in so far as the cybersecurity certificate or statement of conformity or parts thereof cover those requirements.
ai_act/art/42.span: High-risk AI systems that have been certified or for which a statement of conformity has been issued under a cybersecurity scheme pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/881 of the European Parliament and of the Council and the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union shall be presumed to be in compliance with the cybersecurity requirements set out in Article 15 of this Regulation in so far as the cybersecurity certificate or statement of conformity or parts thereof cover those requirements.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems listed in point 1 of Annex III, where, in demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, the provider has applied harmonised standards referred to in Article 40, or, where applicable, common specifications referred to in Article 41, the provider
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: follow one of the following procedures: […] Where, in demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, the provider has not applied or has applied only in part harmonised standards referred to in Article 40, or where such harmonised standards do not exist and common specifications referred to in Article 41 are not available, the provider shall follow the conformity assessment procedure set out in Annex VII. […] For the purpose of the conformity assessment procedure referred to in Annex VII, the provider may choose any of the notified bodies.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: For high-risk AI systems listed in point 1 of Annex III, where, in demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, the provider has applied harmonised standards referred to in Article 40, or, where applicable, common specifications referred to in Article 41, the provider shall follow one of the following procedures: […] Where, in demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, the provider has not applied or has applied only in part harmonised standards referred to in Article 40, or where such harmonised standards do not exist and common specifications referred to in Article 41 are not available, the provider shall follow the conformity assessment procedure set out in Annex VII. […] For the purpose of the conformity assessment procedure referred to in Annex VII, the provider may choose any of the notified bodies.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: However, when the system is intended to be put into service by law enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities as well as EU institutions, bodies or agencies, the market surveillance authority referred to in Article 63(5) or (6), as applicable,
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: act as a notified body.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: However, when the system is intended to be put into service by law enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities as well as EU institutions, bodies or agencies, the market surveillance authority referred to in Article 63(5) or (6), as applicable, shall act as a notified body.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems listed in point 1 of Annex III, where, in demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, the provider has applied harmonised standards referred to in Article 40, or, where applicable, common specifications referred to in Article 41, the provider
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: follow one of the following procedures — the conformity assessment procedure based on internal control referred to in Annex VI;
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: the conformity assessment procedure based on internal control referred to in Annex VI;

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems listed in point 1 of Annex III, where, in demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, the provider has applied harmonised standards referred to in Article 40, or, where applicable, common specifications referred to in Article 41, the provider
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: follow one of the following procedures — the conformity assessment procedure based on assessment of the quality management system and assessment of the technical documentation, with the involvement of a notified body, referred to in Annex VII.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: the conformity assessment procedure based on assessment of the quality management system and assessment of the technical documentation, with the involvement of a notified body, referred to in Annex VII.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in points 2 to 8 of Annex III, providers
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: follow the conformity assessment procedure based on internal control as referred to in Annex VI, which does not provide for the involvement of a notified body.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: For high-risk AI systems referred to in points 2 to 8 of Annex III, providers shall follow the conformity assessment procedure based on internal control as referred to in Annex VI, which does not provide for the involvement of a notified body.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 5(b) of Annex III, placed on the market or put into service by credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU, the conformity assessment
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: be carried out as part of the procedure referred to in Articles 97 to101 of that Directive.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 5(b) of Annex III, placed on the market or put into service by credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU, the conformity assessment shall be carried out as part of the procedure referred to in Articles 97 to101 of that Directive.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems, to which legal acts listed in Annex II, section A, apply, the provider
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: follow the relevant conformity assessment as required under those legal acts.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: For high-risk AI systems, to which legal acts listed in Annex II, section A, apply, the provider shall follow the relevant conformity assessment as required under those legal acts.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: The requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: apply to those high-risk AI systems and shall be part of that assessment.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: The requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title shall apply to those high-risk AI systems and shall be part of that assessment.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: Points 4.3., 4.4., 4.5. and the fifth paragraph of point 4.6 of Annex VII
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: also apply.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: Points 4.3., 4.4., 4.5. and the fifth paragraph of point 4.6 of Annex VII shall also apply.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: notified bodies which have been notified under those legal acts
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.condition: For the purpose of that assessment
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: be entitled to control the conformity of the high-risk AI systems with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, provided that the compliance of those notified bodies with requirements laid down in Article 33(4), (9) and (10) has been assessed in the context of the notification procedure under those legal acts.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: For the purpose of that assessment, notified bodies which have been notified under those legal acts shall be entitled to control the conformity of the high-risk AI systems with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, provided that the compliance of those notified bodies with requirements laid down in Article 33(4), (9) and (10) has been assessed in the context of the notification procedure under those legal acts.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: that manufacturer
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.condition: Where the legal acts listed in Annex II, section A, enable the manufacturer of the product to opt out from a third-party conformity assessment, provided that that manufacturer has applied all harmonised standards covering all the relevant requirements
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: make use of that option only if he has also applied harmonised standards or, where applicable, common specifications referred to in Article 41, covering the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: Where the legal acts listed in Annex II, section A, enable the manufacturer of the product to opt out from a third-party conformity assessment, provided that that manufacturer has applied all harmonised standards covering all the relevant requirements, that manufacturer may make use of that option only if he has also applied harmonised standards or, where applicable, common specifications referred to in Article 41, covering the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: undergo a new conformity assessment procedure whenever they are substantially modified, regardless of whether the modified system is intended to be further distributed or continues to be used by the current user.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: High-risk AI systems shall undergo a new conformity assessment procedure whenever they are substantially modified, regardless of whether the modified system is intended to be further distributed or continues to be used by the current user.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems that continue to learn after being placed on the market or put into service, changes to the high-risk AI system and its performance that have been pre-determined by the provider at the moment of the initial conformity assessment and are part of the information contained in the technical documentation referred to in point 2(f) of Annex IV,
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: constitute a substantial modification.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: For high-risk AI systems that continue to learn after being placed on the market or put into service, changes to the high-risk AI system and its performance that have been pre-determined by the provider at the moment of the initial conformity assessment and are part of the information contained in the technical documentation referred to in point 2(f) of Annex IV, shall not constitute a substantial modification.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: The Commission
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: adopt such delegated acts taking into account the effectiveness of the conformity assessment procedure based on internal control referred to in Annex VI in preventing or minimizing the risks to health and safety and protection of fundamental rights posed by such systems as well as the availability of adequate capacities and resources among notified bodies.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: The Commission shall adopt such delegated acts taking into account the effectiveness of the conformity assessment procedure based on internal control referred to in Annex VI in preventing or minimizing the risks to health and safety and protection of fundamental rights posed by such systems as well as the availability of adequate capacities and resources among notified bodies.

ai_act/art/44.addressee_text: Certificates issued by notified bodies in accordance with Annex VII
ai_act/art/44.action: be drawn-up in an official Union language determined by the Member State in which the notified body is established or in an official Union language otherwise acceptable to the notified body.
ai_act/art/44.span: Certificates issued by notified bodies in accordance with Annex VII shall be drawn-up in an official Union language determined by the Member State in which the notified body is established or in an official Union language otherwise acceptable to the notified body.

ai_act/art/44.action: be valid for the period they indicate, which shall not exceed five years.
ai_act/art/44.span: Certificates shall be valid for the period they indicate, which shall not exceed five years.

ai_act/art/44.addressee_text: On application by the provider, the validity of a certificate
ai_act/art/44.action: be extended for further periods, each not exceeding five years, based on a re-assessment in accordance with the applicable conformity assessment procedures.
ai_act/art/44.span: On application by the provider, the validity of a certificate may be extended for further periods, each not exceeding five years, based on a re-assessment in accordance with the applicable conformity assessment procedures.

ai_act/art/44.condition: Where a notified body finds that an AI system no longer meets the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title
ai_act/art/44.action: , taking account of the principle of proportionality, suspend or withdraw the certificate issued or impose any restrictions on it, unless compliance with those requirements is ensured by appropriate corrective action taken by the provider of the system within an appropriate deadline set by the notified body.
ai_act/art/44.span: Where a notified body finds that an AI system no longer meets the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title, it shall, taking account of the principle of proportionality, suspend or withdraw the certificate issued or impose any restrictions on it, unless compliance with those requirements is ensured by appropriate corrective action taken by the provider of the system within an appropriate deadline set by the notified body.
The notified body shall give reasons for its decision.

ai_act/proposal/art/45.action: ensure that an appeal procedure against decisions of the notified bodies is available to parties having a legitimate interest in that decision.
ai_act/proposal/art/45.span: Member States shall ensure that an appeal procedure against decisions of the notified bodies is available to parties having a legitimate interest in that decision.

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the notifying authority of the following — any Union technical documentation assessment certificates, any supplements to those certificates, quality management system approvals issued in accordance with the requirements of Annex VII;
ai_act/art/45.span: any Union technical documentation assessment certificates, any supplements to those certificates, quality management system approvals issued in accordance with the requirements of Annex VII;

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the notifying authority of the following — any refusal, restriction, suspension or withdrawal of a Union technical documentation assessment certificate or a quality management system approval issued in accordance with the requirements of Annex VII;
ai_act/art/45.span: any refusal, restriction, suspension or withdrawal of a Union technical documentation assessment certificate or a quality management system approval issued in accordance with the requirements of Annex VII;

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the notifying authority of the following — any circumstances affecting the scope of or conditions for notification;
ai_act/art/45.span: any circumstances affecting the scope of or conditions for notification;

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the notifying authority of the following — any request for information which they have received from market surveillance authorities regarding conformity assessment activities;
ai_act/art/45.span: any request for information which they have received from market surveillance authorities regarding conformity assessment activities;

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the notifying authority of the following — on request, conformity assessment activities performed within the scope of their notification and any other activity performed, including cross-border activities and subcontracting.
ai_act/art/45.span: on request, conformity assessment activities performed within the scope of their notification and any other activity performed, including cross-border activities and subcontracting.

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the other notified bodies of — quality management system approvals which it has refused, suspended or withdrawn, and, upon request, of quality system approvals which it has issued;
ai_act/art/45.span: quality management system approvals which it has refused, suspended or withdrawn, and, upon request, of quality system approvals which it has issued;

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the other notified bodies of — EU technical documentation assessment certificates or any supplements thereto which it has refused, withdrawn, suspended or otherwise restricted, and, upon request, of the certificates and/or supplements thereto which it has issued.
ai_act/art/45.span: EU technical documentation assessment certificates or any supplements thereto which it has refused, withdrawn, suspended or otherwise restricted, and, upon request, of the certificates and/or supplements thereto which it has issued.

ai_act/art/45.action: provide the other notified bodies carrying out similar conformity assessment activities covering the same artificial intelligence technologies with relevant information on issues relating to negative and, on request, positive conformity assessment results.
ai_act/art/45.span: Each notified body shall provide the other notified bodies carrying out similar conformity assessment activities covering the same artificial intelligence technologies with relevant information on issues relating to negative and, on request, positive conformity assessment results.

ai_act/art/46.condition: By way of derogation from Article 43
ai_act/art/46.action: authorise the placing on the market or putting into service of specific high-risk AI systems within the territory of the Member State concerned, for exceptional reasons of public security or the protection of life and health of persons, environmental protection and the protection of key industrial and infrastructural assets.
ai_act/art/46.span: By way of derogation from Article 43, any market surveillance authority may authorise the placing on the market or putting into service of specific high-risk AI systems within the territory of the Member State concerned, for exceptional reasons of public security or the protection of life and health of persons, environmental protection and the protection of key industrial and infrastructural assets.

ai_act/art/46.action: be for a limited period of time, while the necessary conformity assessment procedures are being carried out, and shall terminate once those procedures have been completed.
ai_act/art/46.span: That authorisation shall be for a limited period of time, while the necessary conformity assessment procedures are being carried out, and shall terminate once those procedures have been completed.

ai_act/art/46.action: be undertaken without undue delay.
ai_act/art/46.span: The completion of those procedures shall be undertaken without undue delay.

ai_act/art/46.addressee_text: The authorisation referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/46.action: be issued only if the market surveillance authority concludes that the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements of Chapter 2 of this Title.
ai_act/art/46.span: The authorisation referred to in paragraph 1 shall be issued only if the market surveillance authority concludes that the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements of Chapter 2 of this Title.

ai_act/art/46.action: inform the Commission and the other Member States of any authorisation issued pursuant to paragraph 1.
ai_act/art/46.span: The market surveillance authority shall inform the Commission and the other Member States of any authorisation issued pursuant to paragraph 1.

ai_act/art/46.condition: Where, within 15 calendar days of receipt of the information referred to in paragraph 2, no objection has been raised by either a Member State or the Commission in respect of an authorisation issued by a market surveillance authority of a Member State in accordance with paragraph 1
ai_act/art/46.action: be deemed justified.
ai_act/art/46.span: Where, within 15 calendar days of receipt of the information referred to in paragraph 2, no objection has been raised by either a Member State or the Commission in respect of an authorisation issued by a market surveillance authority of a Member State in accordance with paragraph 1, that authorisation shall be deemed justified.

ai_act/art/46.condition: Where, within 15 calendar days of receipt of the notification referred to in paragraph 2, objections are raised by a Member State against an authorisation issued by a market surveillance authority of another Member State, or where the Commission considers the authorisation to be contrary to Union law or the conclusion of the Member States regarding the compliance of the system as referred to in paragraph 2 to be unfounded
ai_act/art/46.action: without delay enter into consultation with the relevant Member State; the operator(s) concerned shall be consulted and have the possibility to present their views.
ai_act/art/46.span: Where, within 15 calendar days of receipt of the notification referred to in paragraph 2, objections are raised by a Member State against an authorisation issued by a market surveillance authority of another Member State, or where the Commission considers the authorisation to be contrary to Union law or the conclusion of the Member States regarding the compliance of the system as referred to in paragraph 2 to be unfounded, the Commission shall without delay enter into consultation with the relevant Member State; the operator(s) concerned shall be consulted and have the possibility to present their views.

ai_act/art/46.action: decide whether the authorisation is justified or not.
ai_act/art/46.span: In view thereof, the Commission shall decide whether the authorisation is justified or not.

ai_act/art/46.action: address its decision to the Member State concerned and the relevant operator or operators.
ai_act/art/46.span: The Commission shall address its decision to the Member State concerned and the relevant operator or operators.

ai_act/art/46.condition: If the authorisation is considered unjustified
ai_act/art/46.action: be withdrawn by the market surveillance authority of the Member State concerned.
ai_act/art/46.span: If the authorisation is considered unjustified, this shall be withdrawn by the market surveillance authority of the Member State concerned.

ai_act/art/46.addressee_text: Article 59 of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 and Article 54 of Regulation (EU) 2017/746
ai_act/art/46.condition: By way of derogation from paragraphs 1 to 5, for high-risk AI systems intended to be used as safety components of devices, or which are themselves devices, covered by Regulation (EU) 2017/745 and Regulation (EU) 2017/746
ai_act/art/46.action: apply also with regard to the derogation from the conformity assessment of the compliance with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.
ai_act/art/46.span: By way of derogation from paragraphs 1 to 5, for high-risk AI systems intended to be used as safety components of devices, or which are themselves devices, covered by Regulation (EU) 2017/745 and Regulation (EU) 2017/746, Article 59 of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 and Article 54 of Regulation (EU) 2017/746 shall apply also with regard to the derogation from the conformity assessment of the compliance with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.

ai_act/art/47.action: draw up a written EU declaration of conformity for each AI system and keep it at the disposal of the national competent authorities for 10 years after the AI system has been placed on the market or put into service.
ai_act/art/47.span: The provider shall draw up a written EU declaration of conformity for each AI system and keep it at the disposal of the national competent authorities for 10 years after the AI system has been placed on the market or put into service.

ai_act/art/47.action: identify the AI system for which it has been drawn up.
ai_act/art/47.span: The EU declaration of conformity shall identify the AI system for which it has been drawn up.

ai_act/art/47.addressee_text: A copy of the EU declaration of conformity
ai_act/art/47.action: be given to the relevant national competent authorities upon request.
ai_act/art/47.span: A copy of the EU declaration of conformity shall be given to the relevant national competent authorities upon request.

ai_act/art/47.action: state that the high-risk AI system in question meets the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.
ai_act/art/47.span: The EU declaration of conformity shall state that the high-risk AI system in question meets the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.

ai_act/art/47.action: contain the information set out in Annex V and shall be translated into an official Union language or languages required by the Member State(s) in which the high-risk AI system is made available.
ai_act/art/47.span: The EU declaration of conformity shall contain the information set out in Annex V and shall be translated into an official Union language or languages required by the Member State(s) in which the high-risk AI system is made available.

ai_act/art/47.addressee_text: a single EU declaration of conformity
ai_act/art/47.condition: Where high-risk AI systems are subject to other Union harmonisation legislation which also requires an EU declaration of conformity
ai_act/art/47.action: be drawn up in respect of all Union legislations applicable to the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/art/47.span: Where high-risk AI systems are subject to other Union harmonisation legislation which also requires an EU declaration of conformity, a single EU declaration of conformity shall be drawn up in respect of all Union legislations applicable to the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/art/47.action: contain all the information required for identification of the Union harmonisation legislation to which the declaration relates.
ai_act/art/47.span: The declaration shall contain all the information required for identification of the Union harmonisation legislation to which the declaration relates.

ai_act/art/47.addressee_text: By drawing up the EU declaration of conformity, the provider
ai_act/art/47.action: assume responsibility for compliance with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.
ai_act/art/47.span: By drawing up the EU declaration of conformity, the provider shall assume responsibility for compliance with the requirements set out in Chapter 2 of this Title.

ai_act/art/47.action: keep the EU declaration of conformity up-to-date as appropriate.
ai_act/art/47.span: The provider shall keep the EU declaration of conformity up-to-date as appropriate.

ai_act/art/47.action: be empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 73 for the purpose of updating the content of the EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V in order to introduce elements that become necessary in light of technical progress.
ai_act/art/47.span: The Commission shall be empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 73 for the purpose of updating the content of the EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V in order to introduce elements that become necessary in light of technical progress.

ai_act/art/48.action: be affixed visibly, legibly and indelibly for high-risk AI systems.
ai_act/art/48.span: The CE marking shall be affixed visibly, legibly and indelibly for high-risk AI systems.

ai_act/art/48.condition: Where that is not possible or not warranted on account of the nature of the high-risk AI system
ai_act/art/48.action: be affixed to the packaging or to the accompanying documentation, as appropriate.
ai_act/art/48.span: Where that is not possible or not warranted on account of the nature of the high-risk AI system, it shall be affixed to the packaging or to the accompanying documentation, as appropriate.

ai_act/art/48.addressee_text: The CE marking referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article
ai_act/art/48.action: be subject to the general principles set out in Article 30 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.
ai_act/art/48.span: The CE marking referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be subject to the general principles set out in Article 30 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.

ai_act/art/48.action: be followed by the identification number of the notified body responsible for the conformity assessment procedures set out in Article 43.
ai_act/art/48.span: Where applicable, the CE marking shall be followed by the identification number of the notified body responsible for the conformity assessment procedures set out in Article 43.

ai_act/art/48.action: also be indicated in any promotional material which mentions that the high-risk AI system fulfils the requirements for CE marking.
ai_act/art/48.span: The identification number shall also be indicated in any promotional material which mentions that the high-risk AI system fulfils the requirements for CE marking.

ai_act/art/18.action: , for a period ending 10 years after the AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, keep at the disposal of the national competent authorities — the technical documentation referred to in Article 11;
ai_act/art/18.span: the technical documentation referred to in Article 11;

ai_act/art/18.action: , for a period ending 10 years after the AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, keep at the disposal of the national competent authorities — the documentation concerning the quality management system referred to Article 17;
ai_act/art/18.span: the documentation concerning the quality management system referred to Article 17;

ai_act/art/18.action: , for a period ending 10 years after the AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, keep at the disposal of the national competent authorities — the documentation concerning the changes approved by notified bodies where applicable;
ai_act/art/18.span: the documentation concerning the changes approved by notified bodies where applicable;

ai_act/art/18.action: , for a period ending 10 years after the AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, keep at the disposal of the national competent authorities — the decisions and other documents issued by the notified bodies where applicable;
ai_act/art/18.span: the decisions and other documents issued by the notified bodies where applicable;

ai_act/art/18.action: , for a period ending 10 years after the AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, keep at the disposal of the national competent authorities — the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 48.
ai_act/art/18.span: the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 48.

ai_act/art/49.condition: Before placing on the market or putting into service a high-risk AI system referred to in Article 6(2), the provider or, where applicable
ai_act/art/49.action: register that system in the EU database referred to in Article 60.
ai_act/art/49.span: Before placing on the market or putting into service a high-risk AI system referred to in Article 6(2), the provider or, where applicable, the authorised representative shall register that system in the EU database referred to in Article 60.

ai_act/art/50.action: ensure that AI systems intended to interact with natural persons are designed and developed in such a way that natural persons are informed that they are interacting with an AI system, unless this is obvious from the circumstances and the context of use.
ai_act/art/50.span: Providers shall ensure that AI systems intended to interact with natural persons are designed and developed in such a way that natural persons are informed that they are interacting with an AI system, unless this is obvious from the circumstances and the context of use.

ai_act/art/50.action: apply to AI systems authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate and prosecute criminal offences, unless those systems are available for the public to report a criminal offence.
ai_act/art/50.span: This obligation shall not apply to AI systems authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate and prosecute criminal offences, unless those systems are available for the public to report a criminal offence.

ai_act/art/50.addressee_text: Users of an emotion recognition system or a biometric categorisation system
ai_act/art/50.action: inform of the operation of the system the natural persons exposed thereto.
ai_act/art/50.span: Users of an emotion recognition system or a biometric categorisation system shall inform of the operation of the system the natural persons exposed thereto.
