ai_act/art/50.action: apply to AI systems used for biometric categorisation, which are permitted by law to detect, prevent and investigate criminal offences.
ai_act/art/50.span: This obligation shall not apply to AI systems used for biometric categorisation, which are permitted by law to detect, prevent and investigate criminal offences.

ai_act/art/50.addressee_text: Users of an AI system that generates or manipulates image, audio or video content that appreciably resembles existing persons, objects, places or other entities or events and would falsely appear to a person to be authentic or truthful (‘deep fake’),
ai_act/art/50.action: disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated.
ai_act/art/50.span: Users of an AI system that generates or manipulates image, audio or video content that appreciably resembles existing persons, objects, places or other entities or events and would falsely appear to a person to be authentic or truthful (‘deep fake’), shall disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated.

ai_act/art/50.action: apply where the use is authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate and prosecute criminal offences or it is necessary for the exercise of the right to freedom of expression and the right to freedom of the arts and sciences guaranteed in the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU, and subject to appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of third parties.
ai_act/art/50.span: However, the first subparagraph shall not apply where the use is authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate and prosecute criminal offences or it is necessary for the exercise of the right to freedom of expression and the right to freedom of the arts and sciences guaranteed in the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU, and subject to appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of third parties.

ai_act/art/50.action: affect the requirements and obligations set out in Title III of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/50.span: Paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 shall not affect the requirements and obligations set out in Title III of this Regulation.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: AI regulatory sandboxes established by one or more Member States competent authorities or the European Data Protection Supervisor
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: provide a controlled environment that facilitates the development, testing and validation of innovative AI systems for a limited time before their placement on the market or putting into service pursuant to a specific plan.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: AI regulatory sandboxes established by one or more Member States competent authorities or the European Data Protection Supervisor shall provide a controlled environment that facilitates the development, testing and validation of innovative AI systems for a limited time before their placement on the market or putting into service pursuant to a specific plan.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: take place under the direct supervision and guidance by the competent authorities with a view to ensuring compliance with the requirements of this Regulation and, where relevant, other Union and Member States legislation supervised within the sandbox.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: This shall take place under the direct supervision and guidance by the competent authorities with a view to ensuring compliance with the requirements of this Regulation and, where relevant, other Union and Member States legislation supervised within the sandbox.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: ensure that to the extent the innovative AI systems involve the processing of personal data or otherwise fall under the supervisory remit of other national authorities or competent authorities providing or supporting access to data, the national data protection authorities and those other national authorities are associated to the operation of the AI regulatory sandbox.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: Member States shall ensure that to the extent the innovative AI systems involve the processing of personal data or otherwise fall under the supervisory remit of other national authorities or competent authorities providing or supporting access to data, the national data protection authorities and those other national authorities are associated to the operation of the AI regulatory sandbox.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: affect the supervisory and corrective powers of the competent authorities.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: The AI regulatory sandboxes shall not affect the supervisory and corrective powers of the competent authorities.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: Any significant risks to health and safety and fundamental rights identified during the development and testing of such systems
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: result in immediate mitigation and, failing that, in the suspension of the development and testing process until such mitigation takes place.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: Any significant risks to health and safety and fundamental rights identified during the development and testing of such systems shall result in immediate mitigation and, failing that, in the suspension of the development and testing process until such mitigation takes place.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: Participants in the AI regulatory sandbox
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: remain liable under applicable Union and Member States liability legislation for any harm inflicted on third parties as a result from the experimentation taking place in the sandbox.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: Participants in the AI regulatory sandbox shall remain liable under applicable Union and Member States liability legislation for any harm inflicted on third parties as a result from the experimentation taking place in the sandbox.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: Member States’ competent authorities that have established AI regulatory sandboxes
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: coordinate their activities and cooperate within the framework of the European Artificial Intelligence Board.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: Member States’ competent authorities that have established AI regulatory sandboxes shall coordinate their activities and cooperate within the framework of the European Artificial Intelligence Board.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: submit annual reports to the Board and the Commission on the results from the implementation of those scheme, including good practices, lessons learnt and recommendations on their setup and, where relevant, on the application of this Regulation and other Union legislation supervised within the sandbox.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: They shall submit annual reports to the Board and the Commission on the results from the implementation of those scheme, including good practices, lessons learnt and recommendations on their setup and, where relevant, on the application of this Regulation and other Union legislation supervised within the sandbox.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: The modalities and the conditions of the operation of the AI regulatory sandboxes, including the eligibility criteria and the procedure for the application, selection, participation and exiting from the sandbox, and the rights and obligations of the participants
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: be set out in implementing acts.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: The modalities and the conditions of the operation of the AI regulatory sandboxes, including the eligibility criteria and the procedure for the application, selection, participation and exiting from the sandbox, and the rights and obligations of the participants shall be set out in implementing acts.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 74(2).
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 74(2).

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: The processing
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be based on Member State or Union law;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: The processing shall be based on Member State or Union law;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: the innovative AI systems
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be developed for safeguarding substantial public interest in one or more of the following areas — public safety and public health, including disease prevention, control and treatment;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: public safety and public health, including disease prevention, control and treatment;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: the innovative AI systems
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be developed for safeguarding substantial public interest in one or more of the following areas — a high level of protection and improvement of the quality of the environment;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: a high level of protection and improvement of the quality of the environment;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed for the purposes of developing and testing certain innovative AI systems in the sandbox under the following conditions — the data processed are necessary for complying with one or more of the requirements referred to in Title III, Chapter 2 where those requirements cannot be effectively fulfilled by processing anonymised, synthetic or other non-personal data;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: the data processed are necessary for complying with one or more of the requirements referred to in Title III, Chapter 2 where those requirements cannot be effectively fulfilled by processing anonymised, synthetic or other non-personal data;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: there are effective monitoring mechanisms to identify if any high risks to the fundamental rights of the data subjects
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: arise during the sandbox experimentation as well as response mechanism to promptly mitigate those risks and, where necessary, stop the processing;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: there are effective monitoring mechanisms to identify if any high risks to the fundamental rights of the data subjects may arise during the sandbox experimentation as well as response mechanism to promptly mitigate those risks and, where necessary, stop the processing;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed for the purposes of developing and testing certain innovative AI systems in the sandbox under the following conditions — any personal data to be processed in the context of the sandbox are in a functionally separate, isolated and protected data processing environment under the control of the participants and only authorised persons have access to that data;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: any personal data to be processed in the context of the sandbox are in a functionally separate, isolated and protected data processing environment under the control of the participants and only authorised persons have access to that data;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed for the purposes of developing and testing certain innovative AI systems in the sandbox under the following conditions — any personal data processed are not be transmitted, transferred or otherwise accessed by other parties;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: any personal data processed are not be transmitted, transferred or otherwise accessed by other parties;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed for the purposes of developing and testing certain innovative AI systems in the sandbox under the following conditions — any processing of personal data in the context of the sandbox do not lead to measures or decisions affecting the data subjects;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: any processing of personal data in the context of the sandbox do not lead to measures or decisions affecting the data subjects;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed for the purposes of developing and testing certain innovative AI systems in the sandbox under the following conditions — any personal data processed in the context of the sandbox are deleted once the participation in the sandbox has terminated or the personal data has reached the end of its retention period;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: any personal data processed in the context of the sandbox are deleted once the participation in the sandbox has terminated or the personal data has reached the end of its retention period;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed for the purposes of developing and testing certain innovative AI systems in the sandbox under the following conditions — the logs of the processing of personal data in the context of the sandbox are kept for the duration of the participation in the sandbox and 1 year after its termination, solely for the purpose of and only as long as necessary for fulfilling accountability and documentation obligations under this Article or other application Union or Member States legislation;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: the logs of the processing of personal data in the context of the sandbox are kept for the duration of the participation in the sandbox and 1 year after its termination, solely for the purpose of and only as long as necessary for fulfilling accountability and documentation obligations under this Article or other application Union or Member States legislation;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed for the purposes of developing and testing certain innovative AI systems in the sandbox under the following conditions — complete and detailed description of the process and rationale behind the training, testing and validation of the AI system is kept together with the testing results as part of the technical documentation in Annex IV;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: complete and detailed description of the process and rationale behind the training, testing and validation of the AI system is kept together with the testing results as part of the technical documentation in Annex IV;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed for the purposes of developing and testing certain innovative AI systems in the sandbox under the following conditions — a short summary of the AI project developed in the sandbox, its objectives and expected results published on the website of the competent authorities.
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: a short summary of the AI project developed in the sandbox, its objectives and expected results published on the website of the competent authorities.

ai_act/innovation/sme_measures.action: undertake the following actions — provide small-scale providers and start-ups with priority access to the AI regulatory sandboxes to the extent that they fulfil the eligibility conditions;
ai_act/innovation/sme_measures.span: provide small-scale providers and start-ups with priority access to the AI regulatory sandboxes to the extent that they fulfil the eligibility conditions;

ai_act/innovation/sme_measures.action: undertake the following actions — organise specific awareness raising activities about the application of this Regulation tailored to the needs of the small-scale providers and users;
ai_act/innovation/sme_measures.span: organise specific awareness raising activities about the application of this Regulation tailored to the needs of the small-scale providers and users;

ai_act/innovation/sme_measures.action: undertake the following actions — where appropriate, establish a dedicated channel for communication with small-scale providers and user and other innovators to provide guidance and respond to queries about the implementation of this Regulation.
ai_act/innovation/sme_measures.span: where appropriate, establish a dedicated channel for communication with small-scale providers and user and other innovators to provide guidance and respond to queries about the implementation of this Regulation.

ai_act/innovation/sme_measures.addressee_text: The specific interests and needs of the small-scale providers
ai_act/innovation/sme_measures.action: be taken into account when setting the fees for conformity assessment under Article 43, reducing those fees proportionately to their size and market size.
ai_act/innovation/sme_measures.span: The specific interests and needs of the small-scale providers shall be taken into account when setting the fees for conformity assessment under Article 43, reducing those fees proportionately to their size and market size.

ai_act/proposal/art/56.action: provide advice and assistance to the Commission in order to — contribute to the effective cooperation of the national supervisory authorities and the Commission with regard to matters covered by this Regulation;
ai_act/proposal/art/56.span: contribute to the effective cooperation of the national supervisory authorities and the Commission with regard to matters covered by this Regulation;

ai_act/proposal/art/56.action: provide advice and assistance to the Commission in order to — coordinate and contribute to guidance and analysis by the Commission and the national supervisory authorities and other competent authorities on emerging issues across the internal market with regard to matters covered by this Regulation;
ai_act/proposal/art/56.span: coordinate and contribute to guidance and analysis by the Commission and the national supervisory authorities and other competent authorities on emerging issues across the internal market with regard to matters covered by this Regulation;

ai_act/proposal/art/56.action: provide advice and assistance to the Commission in order to — assist the national supervisory authorities and the Commission in ensuring the consistent application of this Regulation.
ai_act/proposal/art/56.span: assist the national supervisory authorities and the Commission in ensuring the consistent application of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/65.action: be composed of the national supervisory authorities, who shall be represented by the head or equivalent high-level official of that authority, and the European Data Protection Supervisor.
ai_act/art/65.span: The Board shall be composed of the national supervisory authorities, who shall be represented by the head or equivalent high-level official of that authority, and the European Data Protection Supervisor.

ai_act/art/65.action: be invited to the meetings, where the issues discussed are of relevance for them.
ai_act/art/65.span: Other national authorities may be invited to the meetings, where the issues discussed are of relevance for them.

ai_act/art/65.action: adopt its rules of procedure by a simple majority of its members, following the consent of the Commission.
ai_act/art/65.span: The Board shall adopt its rules of procedure by a simple majority of its members, following the consent of the Commission.

ai_act/art/65.action: also contain the operational aspects related to the execution of the Board’s tasks as listed in Article 58.
ai_act/art/65.span: The rules of procedure shall also contain the operational aspects related to the execution of the Board’s tasks as listed in Article 58.

ai_act/art/65.action: establish sub-groups as appropriate for the purpose of examining specific questions.
ai_act/art/65.span: The Board may establish sub-groups as appropriate for the purpose of examining specific questions.

ai_act/art/65.action: be chaired by the Commission.
ai_act/art/65.span: The Board shall be chaired by the Commission.

ai_act/art/65.action: convene the meetings and prepare the agenda in accordance with the tasks of the Board pursuant to this Regulation and with its rules of procedure.
ai_act/art/65.span: The Commission shall convene the meetings and prepare the agenda in accordance with the tasks of the Board pursuant to this Regulation and with its rules of procedure.

ai_act/art/65.action: provide administrative and analytical support for the activities of the Board pursuant to this Regulation.
ai_act/art/65.span: The Commission shall provide administrative and analytical support for the activities of the Board pursuant to this Regulation.

ai_act/art/65.action: invite external experts and observers to attend its meetings and may hold exchanges with interested third parties to inform its activities to an appropriate extent.
ai_act/art/65.span: The Board may invite external experts and observers to attend its meetings and may hold exchanges with interested third parties to inform its activities to an appropriate extent.

ai_act/art/65.action: facilitate exchanges between the Board and other Union bodies, offices, agencies and advisory groups.
ai_act/art/65.span: To that end the Commission may facilitate exchanges between the Board and other Union bodies, offices, agencies and advisory groups.

ai_act/art/66.condition: When providing advice and assistance to the Commission in the context of Article 56(2)
ai_act/art/66.action: in particular — collect and share expertise and best practices among Member States;
ai_act/art/66.span: collect and share expertise and best practices among Member States;

ai_act/art/66.condition: When providing advice and assistance to the Commission in the context of Article 56(2)
ai_act/art/66.action: in particular — contribute to uniform administrative practices in the Member States, including for the functioning of regulatory sandboxes referred to in Article 53;
ai_act/art/66.span: contribute to uniform administrative practices in the Member States, including for the functioning of regulatory sandboxes referred to in Article 53;

ai_act/art/66.condition: When providing advice and assistance to the Commission in the context of Article 56(2)
ai_act/art/66.action: in particular — issue opinions, recommendations or written contributions on matters related to the implementation of this Regulation, in particular
ai_act/art/66.span: issue opinions, recommendations or written contributions on matters related to the implementation of this Regulation, in particular

ai_act/art/70.action: be established or designated by each Member State for the purpose of ensuring the application and implementation of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/70.span: National competent authorities shall be established or designated by each Member State for the purpose of ensuring the application and implementation of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/70.action: be organised so as to safeguard the objectivity and impartiality of their activities and tasks.
ai_act/art/70.span: National competent authorities shall be organised so as to safeguard the objectivity and impartiality of their activities and tasks.

ai_act/art/70.action: designate a national supervisory authority among the national competent authorities.
ai_act/art/70.span: Each Member State shall designate a national supervisory authority among the national competent authorities.

ai_act/art/70.action: act as notifying authority and market surveillance authority unless a Member State has organisational and administrative reasons to designate more than one authority.
ai_act/art/70.span: The national supervisory authority shall act as notifying authority and market surveillance authority unless a Member State has organisational and administrative reasons to designate more than one authority.

ai_act/art/70.action: inform the Commission of their designation or designations and, where applicable, the reasons for designating more than one authority.
ai_act/art/70.span: Member States shall inform the Commission of their designation or designations and, where applicable, the reasons for designating more than one authority.

ai_act/art/70.action: ensure that national competent authorities are provided with adequate financial and human resources to fulfil their tasks under this Regulation.
ai_act/art/70.span: Member States shall ensure that national competent authorities are provided with adequate financial and human resources to fulfil their tasks under this Regulation.

ai_act/art/70.action: have a sufficient number of personnel permanently available whose competences and expertise shall include an in-depth understanding of artificial intelligence technologies, data and data computing, fundamental rights, health and safety risks and knowledge of existing standards and legal requirements.
ai_act/art/70.span: In particular, national competent authorities shall have a sufficient number of personnel permanently available whose competences and expertise shall include an in-depth understanding of artificial intelligence technologies, data and data computing, fundamental rights, health and safety risks and knowledge of existing standards and legal requirements.

ai_act/art/70.action: report to the Commission on an annual basis on the status of the financial and human resources of the national competent authorities with an assessment of their adequacy.
ai_act/art/70.span: Member States shall report to the Commission on an annual basis on the status of the financial and human resources of the national competent authorities with an assessment of their adequacy.

ai_act/art/70.action: transmit that information to the Board for discussion and possible recommendations.
ai_act/art/70.span: The Commission shall transmit that information to the Board for discussion and possible recommendations.

ai_act/art/70.action: facilitate the exchange of experience between national competent authorities.
ai_act/art/70.span: The Commission shall facilitate the exchange of experience between national competent authorities.

ai_act/art/70.action: provide guidance and advice on the implementation of this Regulation, including to small-scale providers.
ai_act/art/70.span: National competent authorities may provide guidance and advice on the implementation of this Regulation, including to small-scale providers.

ai_act/art/70.addressee_text: the competent national authorities under that Union legislation
ai_act/art/70.condition: Whenever national competent authorities intend to provide guidance and advice with regard to an AI system in areas covered by other Union legislation
ai_act/art/70.action: be consulted, as appropriate.
ai_act/art/70.span: Whenever national competent authorities intend to provide guidance and advice with regard to an AI system in areas covered by other Union legislation, the competent national authorities under that Union legislation shall be consulted, as appropriate.

ai_act/art/70.action: also establish one central contact point for communication with operators.
ai_act/art/70.span: Member States may also establish one central contact point for communication with operators.

ai_act/art/70.condition: When Union institutions, agencies and bodies fall within the scope of this Regulation
ai_act/art/70.action: act as the competent authority for their supervision.
ai_act/art/70.span: When Union institutions, agencies and bodies fall within the scope of this Regulation, the European Data Protection Supervisor shall act as the competent authority for their supervision.

ai_act/art/71.action: , in collaboration with the Member States, set up and maintain a EU database containing information referred to in paragraph 2 concerning high-risk AI systems referred to in Article 6(2) which are registered in accordance with Article 51.
ai_act/art/71.span: The Commission shall, in collaboration with the Member States, set up and maintain a EU database containing information referred to in paragraph 2 concerning high-risk AI systems referred to in Article 6(2) which are registered in accordance with Article 51.

ai_act/art/71.addressee_text: The data listed in Annex VIII
ai_act/art/71.action: be entered into the EU database by the providers.
ai_act/art/71.span: The data listed in Annex VIII shall be entered into the EU database by the providers.

ai_act/art/71.action: provide them with technical and administrative support.
ai_act/art/71.span: The Commission shall provide them with technical and administrative support.

ai_act/art/71.addressee_text: Information contained in the EU database
ai_act/art/71.span: Information contained in the EU database shall be accessible to the public.

ai_act/art/71.action: contain personal data only insofar as necessary for collecting and processing information in accordance with this Regulation.
ai_act/art/71.span: The EU database shall contain personal data only insofar as necessary for collecting and processing information in accordance with this Regulation.

ai_act/art/71.action: include the names and contact details of natural persons who are responsible for registering the system and have the legal authority to represent the provider.
ai_act/art/71.span: That information shall include the names and contact details of natural persons who are responsible for registering the system and have the legal authority to represent the provider.

ai_act/art/71.action: be the controller of the EU database.
ai_act/art/71.span: The Commission shall be the controller of the EU database.

ai_act/art/71.action: also ensure to providers adequate technical and administrative support.
ai_act/art/71.span: It shall also ensure to providers adequate technical and administrative support.

ai_act/art/72.action: establish and document a post-market monitoring system in a manner that is proportionate to the nature of the artificial intelligence technologies and the risks of the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/art/72.span: Providers shall establish and document a post-market monitoring system in a manner that is proportionate to the nature of the artificial intelligence technologies and the risks of the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/art/72.action: actively and systematically collect, document and analyse relevant data provided by users or collected through other sources on the performance of high-risk AI systems throughout their lifetime, and allow the provider to evaluate the continuous compliance of AI systems with the requirements set out in Title III, Chapter 2.
ai_act/art/72.span: The post-market monitoring system shall actively and systematically collect, document and analyse relevant data provided by users or collected through other sources on the performance of high-risk AI systems throughout their lifetime, and allow the provider to evaluate the continuous compliance of AI systems with the requirements set out in Title III, Chapter 2.

ai_act/art/72.action: be based on a post-market monitoring plan.
ai_act/art/72.span: The post-market monitoring system shall be based on a post-market monitoring plan.

ai_act/art/72.action: be part of the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV.
ai_act/art/72.span: The post-market monitoring plan shall be part of the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV.

ai_act/art/72.action: adopt an implementing act laying down detailed provisions establishing a template for the post-market monitoring plan and the list of elements to be included in the plan.
ai_act/art/72.span: The Commission shall adopt an implementing act laying down detailed provisions establishing a template for the post-market monitoring plan and the list of elements to be included in the plan.

ai_act/art/72.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems covered by the legal acts referred to in Annex II, where a post-market monitoring system and plan is already established under that legislation, the elements described in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3
ai_act/art/72.action: be integrated into that system and plan as appropriate.
ai_act/art/72.span: For high-risk AI systems covered by the legal acts referred to in Annex II, where a post-market monitoring system and plan is already established under that legislation, the elements described in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 shall be integrated into that system and plan as appropriate.

ai_act/art/72.action: also apply to high-risk AI systems referred to in point 5(b) of Annex III placed on the market or put into service by credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU.
ai_act/art/72.span: The first subparagraph shall also apply to high-risk AI systems referred to in point 5(b) of Annex III placed on the market or put into service by credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU.

ai_act/art/73.addressee_text: Providers of high-risk AI systems placed on the Union market
ai_act/art/73.action: report any serious incident or any malfunctioning of those systems which constitutes a breach of obligations under Union law intended to protect fundamental rights to the market surveillance authorities of the Member States where that incident or breach occurred.
ai_act/art/73.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems placed on the Union market shall report any serious incident or any malfunctioning of those systems which constitutes a breach of obligations under Union law intended to protect fundamental rights to the market surveillance authorities of the Member States where that incident or breach occurred.

ai_act/art/73.action: be made immediately after the provider has established a causal link between the AI system and the incident or malfunctioning or the reasonable likelihood of such a link, and, in any event, not later than 15 days after the providers becomes aware of the serious incident or of the malfunctioning.
ai_act/art/73.span: Such notification shall be made immediately after the provider has established a causal link between the AI system and the incident or malfunctioning or the reasonable likelihood of such a link, and, in any event, not later than 15 days after the providers becomes aware of the serious incident or of the malfunctioning.

ai_act/art/73.condition: Upon receiving a notification related to a breach of obligations under Union law intended to protect fundamental rights
ai_act/art/73.action: inform the national public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 64(3).
ai_act/art/73.span: Upon receiving a notification related to a breach of obligations under Union law intended to protect fundamental rights, the market surveillance authority shall inform the national public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 64(3).

ai_act/art/73.action: develop dedicated guidance to facilitate compliance with the obligations set out in paragraph 1.
ai_act/art/73.span: The Commission shall develop dedicated guidance to facilitate compliance with the obligations set out in paragraph 1.

ai_act/art/73.action: be issued 12 months after the entry into force of this Regulation, at the latest.
ai_act/art/73.span: That guidance shall be issued 12 months after the entry into force of this Regulation, at the latest.

ai_act/art/73.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 5(b) of Annex III which are placed on the market or put into service by providers that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU and for high-risk AI systems which are safety components of devices, or are themselves devices, covered by Regulation (EU) 2017/745 and Regulation (EU) 2017/746, the notification of serious incidents or malfunctioning
ai_act/art/73.action: be limited to those that that constitute a breach of obligations under Union law intended to protect fundamental rights.
ai_act/art/73.span: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 5(b) of Annex III which are placed on the market or put into service by providers that are credit institutions regulated by Directive 2013/36/EU and for high-risk AI systems which are safety components of devices, or are themselves devices, covered by Regulation (EU) 2017/745 and Regulation (EU) 2017/746, the notification of serious incidents or malfunctioning shall be limited to those that that constitute a breach of obligations under Union law intended to protect fundamental rights.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
ai_act/art/74.action: apply to AI systems covered by this Regulation.
ai_act/art/74.span: Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 shall apply to AI systems covered by this Regulation.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: any reference to an economic operator under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
ai_act/art/74.action: be understood as including all operators identified in Title III, Chapter 3 of this Regulation;
ai_act/art/74.span: any reference to an economic operator under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 shall be understood as including all operators identified in Title III, Chapter 3 of this Regulation;

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: any reference to a product under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
ai_act/art/74.action: be understood as including all AI systems falling within the scope of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/74.span: any reference to a product under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 shall be understood as including all AI systems falling within the scope of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: The national supervisory authority
ai_act/art/74.action: report to the Commission on a regular basis the outcomes of relevant market surveillance activities.
ai_act/art/74.span: The national supervisory authority shall report to the Commission on a regular basis the outcomes of relevant market surveillance activities.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: The national supervisory authority
ai_act/art/74.action: report, without delay, to the Commission and relevant national competition authorities any information identified in the course of market surveillance activities that may be of potential interest for the application of Union law on competition rules.
ai_act/art/74.span: The national supervisory authority shall report, without delay, to the Commission and relevant national competition authorities any information identified in the course of market surveillance activities that may be of potential interest for the application of Union law on competition rules.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems, related to products to which legal acts listed in Annex II, section A apply, the market surveillance authority for the purposes of this Regulation
ai_act/art/74.action: be the authority responsible for market surveillance activities designated under those legal acts.
ai_act/art/74.span: For high-risk AI systems, related to products to which legal acts listed in Annex II, section A apply, the market surveillance authority for the purposes of this Regulation shall be the authority responsible for market surveillance activities designated under those legal acts.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: For AI systems placed on the market, put into service or used by financial institutions regulated by Union legislation on financial services, the market surveillance authority for the purposes of this Regulation
ai_act/art/74.action: be the relevant authority responsible for the financial supervision of those institutions under that legislation.
ai_act/art/74.span: For AI systems placed on the market, put into service or used by financial institutions regulated by Union legislation on financial services, the market surveillance authority for the purposes of this Regulation shall be the relevant authority responsible for the financial supervision of those institutions under that legislation.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: For AI systems listed in point 1(a) in so far as the systems are used for law enforcement purposes, points 6 and 7 of Annex III, Member States
ai_act/art/74.action: designate as market surveillance authorities for the purposes of this Regulation either the competent data protection supervisory authorities under Directive (EU) 2016/680, or Regulation 2016/679 or the national competent authorities supervising the activities of the law enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities putting into service or using those systems.
ai_act/art/74.span: For AI systems listed in point 1(a) in so far as the systems are used for law enforcement purposes, points 6 and 7 of Annex III, Member States shall designate as market surveillance authorities for the purposes of this Regulation either the competent data protection supervisory authorities under Directive (EU) 2016/680, or Regulation 2016/679 or the national competent authorities supervising the activities of the law enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities putting into service or using those systems.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: the European Data Protection Supervisor
ai_act/art/74.condition: Where Union institutions, agencies and bodies fall within the scope of this Regulation
ai_act/art/74.action: act as their market surveillance authority.
ai_act/art/74.span: Where Union institutions, agencies and bodies fall within the scope of this Regulation, the European Data Protection Supervisor shall act as their market surveillance authority.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: Member States
ai_act/art/74.action: facilitate the coordination between market surveillance authorities designated under this Regulation and other relevant national authorities or bodies which supervise the application of Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex II or other Union legislation that might be relevant for the high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III.
ai_act/art/74.span: Member States shall facilitate the coordination between market surveillance authorities designated under this Regulation and other relevant national authorities or bodies which supervise the application of Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex II or other Union legislation that might be relevant for the high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III.

ai_act/art/77.addressee_text: Access to data and documentation in the context of their activities, the market surveillance authorities
ai_act/art/77.action: be granted full access to the training, validation and testing datasets used by the provider, including through application programming interfaces (‘API’) or other appropriate technical means and tools enabling remote access.
ai_act/art/77.span: Access to data and documentation in the context of their activities, the market surveillance authorities shall be granted full access to the training, validation and testing datasets used by the provider, including through application programming interfaces (‘API’) or other appropriate technical means and tools enabling remote access.

ai_act/art/77.condition: Where necessary to assess the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Title III, Chapter 2 and upon a reasoned request
ai_act/art/77.action: be granted access to the source code of the AI system.
ai_act/art/77.span: Where necessary to assess the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Title III, Chapter 2 and upon a reasoned request, the market surveillance authorities shall be granted access to the source code of the AI system.

ai_act/art/77.addressee_text: National public authorities or bodies which supervise or enforce the respect of obligations under Union law protecting fundamental rights in relation to the use of high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III
ai_act/art/77.action: have the power to request and access any documentation created or maintained under this Regulation when access to that documentation is necessary for the fulfilment of the competences under their mandate within the limits of their jurisdiction.
ai_act/art/77.span: National public authorities or bodies which supervise or enforce the respect of obligations under Union law protecting fundamental rights in relation to the use of high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III shall have the power to request and access any documentation created or maintained under this Regulation when access to that documentation is necessary for the fulfilment of the competences under their mandate within the limits of their jurisdiction.

ai_act/art/77.addressee_text: The relevant public authority or body
ai_act/art/77.action: inform the market surveillance authority of the Member State concerned of any such request.
ai_act/art/77.span: The relevant public authority or body shall inform the market surveillance authority of the Member State concerned of any such request.

ai_act/art/77.addressee_text: By 3 months after the entering into force of this Regulation, each Member State
ai_act/art/77.action: identify the public authorities or bodies referred to in paragraph 3 and make a list publicly available on the website of the national supervisory authority.
ai_act/art/77.span: By 3 months after the entering into force of this Regulation, each Member State shall identify the public authorities or bodies referred to in paragraph 3 and make a list publicly available on the website of the national supervisory authority.

ai_act/art/77.action: notify the list to the Commission and all other Member States and keep the list up to date.
ai_act/art/77.span: Member States shall notify the list to the Commission and all other Member States and keep the list up to date.

ai_act/art/77.addressee_text: the public authority or body referred to paragraph 3
ai_act/art/77.condition: Where the documentation referred to in paragraph 3 is insufficient to ascertain whether a breach of obligations under Union law intended to protect fundamental rights has occurred
ai_act/art/77.action: make a reasoned request to the market surveillance authority to organise testing of the high-risk AI system through technical means.
ai_act/art/77.span: Where the documentation referred to in paragraph 3 is insufficient to ascertain whether a breach of obligations under Union law intended to protect fundamental rights has occurred, the public authority or body referred to paragraph 3 may make a reasoned request to the market surveillance authority to organise testing of the high-risk AI system through technical means.

ai_act/art/77.action: organise the testing with the close involvement of the requesting public authority or body within reasonable time following the request.
ai_act/art/77.span: The market surveillance authority shall organise the testing with the close involvement of the requesting public authority or body within reasonable time following the request.

ai_act/art/77.addressee_text: Any information and documentation obtained by the national public authorities or bodies referred to in paragraph 3 pursuant to the provisions of this Article
ai_act/art/77.action: be treated in compliance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 70.
ai_act/art/77.span: Any information and documentation obtained by the national public authorities or bodies referred to in paragraph 3 pursuant to the provisions of this Article shall be treated in compliance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 70.

ai_act/art/79.action: be understood as a product presenting a risk defined in Article 3, point 19 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 insofar as risks to the health or safety or to the protection of fundamental rights of persons are concerned.
ai_act/art/79.span: AI systems presenting a risk shall be understood as a product presenting a risk defined in Article 3, point 19 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 insofar as risks to the health or safety or to the protection of fundamental rights of persons are concerned.

ai_act/art/79.condition: Where the market surveillance authority of a Member State has sufficient reasons to consider that an AI system presents a risk as referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/79.action: carry out an evaluation of the AI system concerned in respect of its compliance with all the requirements and obligations laid down in this Regulation.
ai_act/art/79.span: Where the market surveillance authority of a Member State has sufficient reasons to consider that an AI system presents a risk as referred to in paragraph 1, they shall carry out an evaluation of the AI system concerned in respect of its compliance with all the requirements and obligations laid down in this Regulation.

ai_act/art/79.condition: When risks to the protection of fundamental rights are present
ai_act/art/79.action: also inform the relevant national public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 64(3).
ai_act/art/79.span: When risks to the protection of fundamental rights are present, the market surveillance authority shall also inform the relevant national public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 64(3).

ai_act/art/79.action: cooperate as necessary with the market surveillance authorities and the other national public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 64(3).
ai_act/art/79.span: The relevant operators shall cooperate as necessary with the market surveillance authorities and the other national public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 64(3).

ai_act/art/79.condition: Where, in the course of that evaluation, the market surveillance authority finds that the AI system does not comply with the requirements and obligations laid down in this Regulation
ai_act/art/79.action: without delay require the relevant operator to take all appropriate corrective actions to bring the AI system into compliance, to withdraw the AI system from the market, or to recall it within a reasonable period, commensurate with the nature of the risk, as it may prescribe.
ai_act/art/79.span: Where, in the course of that evaluation, the market surveillance authority finds that the AI system does not comply with the requirements and obligations laid down in this Regulation, it shall without delay require the relevant operator to take all appropriate corrective actions to bring the AI system into compliance, to withdraw the AI system from the market, or to recall it within a reasonable period, commensurate with the nature of the risk, as it may prescribe.

ai_act/art/79.action: inform the relevant notified body accordingly.
ai_act/art/79.span: The market surveillance authority shall inform the relevant notified body accordingly.

ai_act/art/79.action: apply to the measures referred to in the second subparagraph.
ai_act/art/79.span: Article 18 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 shall apply to the measures referred to in the second subparagraph.

ai_act/art/79.condition: Where the market surveillance authority considers that non-compliance is not restricted to its national territory
ai_act/art/79.action: inform the Commission and the other Member States of the results of the evaluation and of the actions which it has required the operator to take.
ai_act/art/79.span: Where the market surveillance authority considers that non-compliance is not restricted to its national territory, it shall inform the Commission and the other Member States of the results of the evaluation and of the actions which it has required the operator to take.

ai_act/art/79.action: ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken in respect of all the AI systems concerned that it has made available on the market throughout the Union.
ai_act/art/79.span: The operator shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken in respect of all the AI systems concerned that it has made available on the market throughout the Union.

ai_act/art/79.condition: Where the operator of an AI system does not take adequate corrective action within the period referred to in paragraph 2
ai_act/art/79.action: take all appropriate provisional measures to prohibit or restrict the AI system's being made available on its national market, to withdraw the product from that market or to recall it.
ai_act/art/79.span: Where the operator of an AI system does not take adequate corrective action within the period referred to in paragraph 2, the market surveillance authority shall take all appropriate provisional measures to prohibit or restrict the AI system's being made available on its national market, to withdraw the product from that market or to recall it.

ai_act/art/79.action: inform the Commission and the other Member States, without delay, of those measures.
ai_act/art/79.span: That authority shall inform the Commission and the other Member States, without delay, of those measures.

ai_act/art/79.addressee_text: The information referred to in paragraph 5
ai_act/art/79.action: include all available details, in particular the data necessary for the identification of the non-compliant AI system, the origin of the AI system, the nature of the non-compliance alleged and the risk involved, the nature and duration of the national measures taken and the arguments put forward by the relevant operator.
ai_act/art/79.span: The information referred to in paragraph 5 shall include all available details, in particular the data necessary for the identification of the non-compliant AI system, the origin of the AI system, the nature of the non-compliance alleged and the risk involved, the nature and duration of the national measures taken and the arguments put forward by the relevant operator.

ai_act/art/79.addressee_text: In particular, the market surveillance authorities
ai_act/art/79.action: indicate whether the non-compliance is due to one or more of the following — a failure of the AI system to meet requirements set out in Title III, Chapter 2;
ai_act/art/79.span: a failure of the AI system to meet requirements set out in Title III, Chapter 2;

ai_act/art/79.addressee_text: In particular, the market surveillance authorities
ai_act/art/79.action: indicate whether the non-compliance is due to one or more of the following — shortcomings in the harmonised standards or common specifications referred to in Articles 40 and 41 conferring a presumption of conformity.
ai_act/art/79.span: shortcomings in the harmonised standards or common specifications referred to in Articles 40 and 41 conferring a presumption of conformity.

ai_act/art/79.addressee_text: The market surveillance authorities of the Member States other than the market surveillance authority of the Member State initiating the procedure
ai_act/art/79.action: without delay inform the Commission and the other Member States of any measures adopted and of any additional information at their disposal relating to the non-compliance of the AI system concerned, and, in the event of disagreement with the notified national measure, of their objections.
ai_act/art/79.span: The market surveillance authorities of the Member States other than the market surveillance authority of the Member State initiating the procedure shall without delay inform the Commission and the other Member States of any measures adopted and of any additional information at their disposal relating to the non-compliance of the AI system concerned, and, in the event of disagreement with the notified national measure, of their objections.

ai_act/art/79.condition: Where, within three months of receipt of the information referred to in paragraph 5, no objection has been raised by either a Member State or the Commission in respect of a provisional measure taken by a Member State
ai_act/art/79.action: be deemed justified.
ai_act/art/79.span: Where, within three months of receipt of the information referred to in paragraph 5, no objection has been raised by either a Member State or the Commission in respect of a provisional measure taken by a Member State, that measure shall be deemed justified.

ai_act/art/79.addressee_text: The market surveillance authorities of all Member States
ai_act/art/79.action: ensure that appropriate restrictive measures are taken in respect of the product concerned, such as withdrawal of the product from their market, without delay.
ai_act/art/79.span: The market surveillance authorities of all Member States shall ensure that appropriate restrictive measures are taken in respect of the product concerned, such as withdrawal of the product from their market, without delay.

ai_act/art/81.condition: Where, within three months of receipt of the notification referred to in Article 65(5), objections are raised by a Member State against a measure taken by another Member State, or where the Commission considers the measure to be contrary to Union law
ai_act/art/81.action: without delay enter into consultation with the relevant Member State and operator or operators and shall evaluate the national measure.
ai_act/art/81.span: Where, within three months of receipt of the notification referred to in Article 65(5), objections are raised by a Member State against a measure taken by another Member State, or where the Commission considers the measure to be contrary to Union law, the Commission shall without delay enter into consultation with the relevant Member State and operator or operators and shall evaluate the national measure.

ai_act/art/81.condition: On the basis of the results of that evaluation
ai_act/art/81.action: decide whether the national measure is justified or not within 9 months from the notification referred to in Article 65(5) and notify such decision to the Member State concerned.
ai_act/art/81.span: On the basis of the results of that evaluation, the Commission shall decide whether the national measure is justified or not within 9 months from the notification referred to in Article 65(5) and notify such decision to the Member State concerned.

ai_act/art/81.condition: If the national measure is considered justified
ai_act/art/81.action: take the measures necessary to ensure that the non-compliant AI system is withdrawn from their market, and shall inform the Commission accordingly.
ai_act/art/81.span: If the national measure is considered justified, all Member States shall take the measures necessary to ensure that the non-compliant AI system is withdrawn from their market, and shall inform the Commission accordingly.

ai_act/art/81.condition: If the national measure is considered unjustified
ai_act/art/81.span: If the national measure is considered unjustified, the Member State concerned shall withdraw the measure.

ai_act/art/81.condition: Where the national measure is considered justified and the non-compliance of the AI system is attributed to shortcomings in the harmonised standards or common specifications referred to in Articles 40 and 41 of this Regulation
ai_act/art/81.action: apply the procedure provided for in Article 11 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012.
ai_act/art/81.span: Where the national measure is considered justified and the non-compliance of the AI system is attributed to shortcomings in the harmonised standards or common specifications referred to in Articles 40 and 41 of this Regulation, the Commission shall apply the procedure provided for in Article 11 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012.

ai_act/art/82.condition: Where, having performed an evaluation under Article 65, the market surveillance authority of a Member State finds that although an AI system is in compliance with this Regulation, it presents a risk to the health or safety of persons, to the compliance with obligations under Union or national law intended to protect fundamental rights or to other aspects of public interest protection
ai_act/art/82.action: require the relevant operator to take all appropriate measures to ensure that the AI system concerned, when placed on the market or put into service, no longer presents that risk, to withdraw the AI system from the market or to recall it within a reasonable period, commensurate with the nature of the risk, as it may prescribe.
ai_act/art/82.span: Where, having performed an evaluation under Article 65, the market surveillance authority of a Member State finds that although an AI system is in compliance with this Regulation, it presents a risk to the health or safety of persons, to the compliance with obligations under Union or national law intended to protect fundamental rights or to other aspects of public interest protection, it shall require the relevant operator to take all appropriate measures to ensure that the AI system concerned, when placed on the market or put into service, no longer presents that risk, to withdraw the AI system from the market or to recall it within a reasonable period, commensurate with the nature of the risk, as it may prescribe.

ai_act/art/82.addressee_text: The provider or other relevant operators
ai_act/art/82.action: ensure that corrective action is taken in respect of all the AI systems concerned that they have made available on the market throughout the Union within the timeline prescribed by the market surveillance authority of the Member State referred to in paragraph 1.
ai_act/art/82.span: The provider or other relevant operators shall ensure that corrective action is taken in respect of all the AI systems concerned that they have made available on the market throughout the Union within the timeline prescribed by the market surveillance authority of the Member State referred to in paragraph 1.

ai_act/art/82.action: immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States.
ai_act/art/82.span: The Member State shall immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States.

ai_act/art/82.action: include all available details, in particular the data necessary for the identification of the AI system concerned, the origin and the supply chain of the AI system, the nature of the risk involved and the nature and duration of the national measures taken.
ai_act/art/82.span: That information shall include all available details, in particular the data necessary for the identification of the AI system concerned, the origin and the supply chain of the AI system, the nature of the risk involved and the nature and duration of the national measures taken.

ai_act/art/82.action: without delay enter into consultation with the Member States and the relevant operator and shall evaluate the national measures taken.
ai_act/art/82.span: The Commission shall without delay enter into consultation with the Member States and the relevant operator and shall evaluate the national measures taken.

ai_act/art/82.condition: On the basis of the results of that evaluation
ai_act/art/82.action: decide whether the measure is justified or not and, where necessary, propose appropriate measures.
ai_act/art/82.span: On the basis of the results of that evaluation, the Commission shall decide whether the measure is justified or not and, where necessary, propose appropriate measures.

ai_act/art/82.action: address its decision to the Member States.
ai_act/art/82.span: The Commission shall address its decision to the Member States.

ai_act/art/83.condition: Where the market surveillance authority of a Member State makes one of the following findings
ai_act/art/83.action: require the relevant provider to put an end to the non-compliance concerned — the conformity marking has been affixed in violation of Article 49;
ai_act/art/83.span: the conformity marking has been affixed in violation of Article 49;

ai_act/art/83.condition: Where the market surveillance authority of a Member State makes one of the following findings
ai_act/art/83.action: require the relevant provider to put an end to the non-compliance concerned — the conformity marking has not been affixed;
ai_act/art/83.span: the conformity marking has not been affixed;

ai_act/art/83.condition: Where the market surveillance authority of a Member State makes one of the following findings
ai_act/art/83.action: require the relevant provider to put an end to the non-compliance concerned — the EU declaration of conformity has not been drawn up;
ai_act/art/83.span: the EU declaration of conformity has not been drawn up;

ai_act/art/83.condition: Where the market surveillance authority of a Member State makes one of the following findings
ai_act/art/83.action: require the relevant provider to put an end to the non-compliance concerned — the EU declaration of conformity has not been drawn up correctly;
ai_act/art/83.span: the EU declaration of conformity has not been drawn up correctly;

ai_act/art/83.condition: Where the market surveillance authority of a Member State makes one of the following findings
ai_act/art/83.action: require the relevant provider to put an end to the non-compliance concerned — the identification number of the notified body, which is involved in the conformity assessment procedure, where applicable, has not been affixed;
ai_act/art/83.span: the identification number of the notified body, which is involved in the conformity assessment procedure, where applicable, has not been affixed;

ai_act/art/83.condition: Where the non-compliance referred to in paragraph 1 persists
ai_act/art/83.action: take all appropriate measures to restrict or prohibit the high-risk AI system being made available on the market or ensure that it is recalled or withdrawn from the market.
ai_act/art/83.span: Where the non-compliance referred to in paragraph 1 persists, the Member State concerned shall take all appropriate measures to restrict or prohibit the high-risk AI system being made available on the market or ensure that it is recalled or withdrawn from the market.

ai_act/art/95.addressee_text: The Commission and the Member States
ai_act/art/95.action: encourage and facilitate the drawing up of codes of conduct intended to foster the voluntary application to AI systems other than high-risk AI systems of the requirements set out in Title III, Chapter 2 on the basis of technical specifications and solutions that are appropriate means of ensuring compliance with such requirements in light of the intended purpose of the systems.
ai_act/art/95.span: The Commission and the Member States shall encourage and facilitate the drawing up of codes of conduct intended to foster the voluntary application to AI systems other than high-risk AI systems of the requirements set out in Title III, Chapter 2 on the basis of technical specifications and solutions that are appropriate means of ensuring compliance with such requirements in light of the intended purpose of the systems.

ai_act/art/95.action: encourage and facilitate the drawing up of codes of conduct intended to foster the voluntary application to AI systems of requirements related for example to environmental sustainability, accessibility for persons with a disability, stakeholders participation in the design and development of the AI systems and diversity of development teams on the basis of clear objectives and key performance indicators to measure the achievement of those objectives.
ai_act/art/95.span: The Commission and the Board shall encourage and facilitate the drawing up of codes of conduct intended to foster the voluntary application to AI systems of requirements related for example to environmental sustainability, accessibility for persons with a disability, stakeholders participation in the design and development of the AI systems and diversity of development teams on the basis of clear objectives and key performance indicators to measure the achievement of those objectives.

ai_act/art/95.action: be drawn up by individual providers of AI systems or by organisations representing them or by both, including with the involvement of users and any interested stakeholders and their representative organisations.
ai_act/art/95.span: Codes of conduct may be drawn up by individual providers of AI systems or by organisations representing them or by both, including with the involvement of users and any interested stakeholders and their representative organisations.

ai_act/art/95.action: cover one or more AI systems taking into account the similarity of the intended purpose of the relevant systems.
ai_act/art/95.span: Codes of conduct may cover one or more AI systems taking into account the similarity of the intended purpose of the relevant systems.

ai_act/art/95.action: take into account the specific interests and needs of the small-scale providers and start-ups when encouraging and facilitating the drawing up of codes of conduct.
ai_act/art/95.span: The Commission and the Board shall take into account the specific interests and needs of the small-scale providers and start-ups when encouraging and facilitating the drawing up of codes of conduct.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: National competent authorities and notified bodies involved in the application of this Regulation
ai_act/art/78.action: respect the confidentiality of information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks and activities in such a manner as to protect, in particular — intellectual property rights, and confidential business information or trade secrets of a natural or legal person, including source code, except the cases referred to in Article 5 of Directive 2016/943 on the protection of undisclosed know-how and business information (trade secrets) against their unlawful acquisition, use and disclosure apply.
ai_act/art/78.span: intellectual property rights, and confidential business information or trade secrets of a natural or legal person, including source code, except the cases referred to in Article 5 of Directive 2016/943 on the protection of undisclosed know-how and business information (trade secrets) against their unlawful acquisition, use and disclosure apply.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: National competent authorities and notified bodies involved in the application of this Regulation
ai_act/art/78.action: respect the confidentiality of information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks and activities in such a manner as to protect, in particular — the effective implementation of this Regulation, in particular for the purpose of inspections, investigations or audits;(c) public and national security interests;
ai_act/art/78.span: the effective implementation of this Regulation, in particular for the purpose of inspections, investigations or audits;(c) public and national security interests;

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: National competent authorities and notified bodies involved in the application of this Regulation
ai_act/art/78.action: respect the confidentiality of information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks and activities in such a manner as to protect, in particular — integrity of criminal or administrative proceedings.
ai_act/art/78.span: integrity of criminal or administrative proceedings.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: information exchanged on a confidential basis between the national competent authorities and between national competent authorities and the Commission
ai_act/art/78.action: be disclosed without the prior consultation of the originating national competent authority and the user when high-risk AI systems referred to in points 1, 6 and 7 of Annex III are used by law enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities, when such disclosure would jeopardise public and national security interests.
ai_act/art/78.span: Without prejudice to paragraph 1, information exchanged on a confidential basis between the national competent authorities and between national competent authorities and the Commission shall not be disclosed without the prior consultation of the originating national competent authority and the user when high-risk AI systems referred to in points 1, 6 and 7 of Annex III are used by law enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities, when such disclosure would jeopardise public and national security interests.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV
ai_act/art/78.condition: When the law enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities are providers of high-risk AI systems referred to in points 1, 6 and 7 of Annex III
ai_act/art/78.action: remain within the premises of those authorities.
ai_act/art/78.span: When the law enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities are providers of high-risk AI systems referred to in points 1, 6 and 7 of Annex III, the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV shall remain within the premises of those authorities.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: Those authorities
ai_act/art/78.action: ensure that the market surveillance authorities referred to in Article 63(5) and (6), as applicable, can, upon request, immediately access the documentation or obtain a copy thereof.
ai_act/art/78.span: Those authorities shall ensure that the market surveillance authorities referred to in Article 63(5) and (6), as applicable, can, upon request, immediately access the documentation or obtain a copy thereof.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: Only staff of the market surveillance authority holding the appropriate level of security clearance
ai_act/art/78.action: be allowed to access that documentation or any copy thereof.
ai_act/art/78.span: Only staff of the market surveillance authority holding the appropriate level of security clearance shall be allowed to access that documentation or any copy thereof.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: Paragraphs 1 and 2
ai_act/art/78.action: affect the rights and obligations of the Commission, Member States and notified bodies with regard to the exchange of information and the dissemination of warnings, nor the obligations of the parties concerned to provide information under criminal law of the Member States.
ai_act/art/78.span: Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not affect the rights and obligations of the Commission, Member States and notified bodies with regard to the exchange of information and the dissemination of warnings, nor the obligations of the parties concerned to provide information under criminal law of the Member States.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: The Commission and Member States
ai_act/art/78.action: exchange, where necessary, confidential information with regulatory authorities of third countries with which they have concluded bilateral or multilateral confidentiality arrangements guaranteeing an adequate level of confidentiality.
ai_act/art/78.span: The Commission and Member States may exchange, where necessary, confidential information with regulatory authorities of third countries with which they have concluded bilateral or multilateral confidentiality arrangements guaranteeing an adequate level of confidentiality.

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: In compliance with the terms and conditions laid down in this Regulation, Member States
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: lay down the rules on penalties, including administrative fines, applicable to infringements of this Regulation and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are properly and effectively implemented.
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: In compliance with the terms and conditions laid down in this Regulation, Member States shall lay down the rules on penalties, including administrative fines, applicable to infringements of this Regulation and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are properly and effectively implemented.

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: The penalties provided for
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: be effective, proportionate, and dissuasive.
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: The penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate, and dissuasive.

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: They
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: take into particular account the interests of small-scale providers and start-up and their economic viability.
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: They shall take into particular account the interests of small-scale providers and start-up and their economic viability.

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: The Member States
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: notify the Commission of those rules and of those measures and shall notify it, without delay, of any subsequent amendment affecting them.
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: The Member States shall notify the Commission of those rules and of those measures and shall notify it, without delay, of any subsequent amendment affecting them.

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: The following infringements
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: be subject to administrative fines of up to 30 000 000 EUR or, if the offender is company, up to 6 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher — non-compliance with the prohibition of the artificial intelligence practices referred to in Article 5;
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: non-compliance with the prohibition of the artificial intelligence practices referred to in Article 5;

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: The following infringements
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: be subject to administrative fines of up to 30 000 000 EUR or, if the offender is company, up to 6 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher — non-compliance of the AI system with the requirements laid down in Article 10.
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: non-compliance of the AI system with the requirements laid down in Article 10.

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: The non-compliance of the AI system with any requirements or obligations under this Regulation, other than those laid down in Articles 5 and 10,
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: be subject to administrative fines of up to 20 000 000 EUR or, if the offender is a company, up to 4 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: The non-compliance of the AI system with any requirements or obligations under this Regulation, other than those laid down in Articles 5 and 10, shall be subject to administrative fines of up to 20 000 000 EUR or, if the offender is a company, up to 4 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: The supply of incorrect, incomplete or misleading information to notified bodies and national competent authorities in reply to a request
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: be subject to administrative fines of up to 10 000 000 EUR or, if the offender is a company, up to 2 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: The supply of incorrect, incomplete or misleading information to notified bodies and national competent authorities in reply to a request shall be subject to administrative fines of up to 10 000 000 EUR or, if the offender is a company, up to 2 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: all relevant circumstances of the specific situation
