ai_act/penalties/penalties.condition: When deciding on the amount of the administrative fine in each individual case
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: be taken into account and due regard shall be given to the following — the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement and of its consequences;
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement and of its consequences;

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: all relevant circumstances of the specific situation
ai_act/penalties/penalties.condition: When deciding on the amount of the administrative fine in each individual case
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: be taken into account and due regard shall be given to the following — whether administrative fines have been already applied by other market surveillance authorities to the same operator for the same infringement.
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: whether administrative fines have been already applied by other market surveillance authorities to the same operator for the same infringement.

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: all relevant circumstances of the specific situation
ai_act/penalties/penalties.condition: When deciding on the amount of the administrative fine in each individual case
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: be taken into account and due regard shall be given to the following — the size and market share of the operator committing the infringement;
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: the size and market share of the operator committing the infringement;

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: Each Member State
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: lay down rules on whether and to what extent administrative fines may be imposed on public authorities and bodies established in that Member State.
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: Each Member State shall lay down rules on whether and to what extent administrative fines may be imposed on public authorities and bodies established in that Member State.

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: Depending on the legal system of the Member States, the rules on administrative fines
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: be applied in such a manner that the fines are imposed by competent national courts of other bodies as applicable in those Member States.
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: Depending on the legal system of the Member States, the rules on administrative fines may be applied in such a manner that the fines are imposed by competent national courts of other bodies as applicable in those Member States.

ai_act/penalties/penalties.addressee_text: The application of such rules in those Member States
ai_act/penalties/penalties.action: have an equivalent effect.
ai_act/penalties/penalties.span: The application of such rules in those Member States shall have an equivalent effect.

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: The European Data Protection Supervisor
ai_act/art/100.action: impose administrative fines on Union institutions, agencies and bodies falling within the scope of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/100.span: The European Data Protection Supervisor may impose administrative fines on Union institutions, agencies and bodies falling within the scope of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: all relevant circumstances of the specific situation
ai_act/art/100.condition: When deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and deciding on the amount of the administrative fine in each individual case
ai_act/art/100.action: be taken into account and due regard shall be given to the following — the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement and of its consequences;
ai_act/art/100.span: the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement and of its consequences;

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: all relevant circumstances of the specific situation
ai_act/art/100.condition: When deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and deciding on the amount of the administrative fine in each individual case
ai_act/art/100.action: be taken into account and due regard shall be given to the following — the cooperation with the European Data Protection Supervisor in order to remedy the infringement and mitigate the possible adverse effects of the infringement, including compliance with any of the measures previously ordered by the European Data Protection Supervisor against the Union institution or agency or body concerned with regard to the same subject matter;
ai_act/art/100.span: the cooperation with the European Data Protection Supervisor in order to remedy the infringement and mitigate the possible adverse effects of the infringement, including compliance with any of the measures previously ordered by the European Data Protection Supervisor against the Union institution or agency or body concerned with regard to the same subject matter;

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: all relevant circumstances of the specific situation
ai_act/art/100.condition: When deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and deciding on the amount of the administrative fine in each individual case
ai_act/art/100.action: be taken into account and due regard shall be given to the following — any similar previous infringements by the Union institution, agency or body;
ai_act/art/100.span: any similar previous infringements by the Union institution, agency or body;

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: The following infringements
ai_act/art/100.action: be subject to administrative fines of up to 500 000 EUR — non-compliance with the prohibition of the artificial intelligence practices referred to in Article 5;
ai_act/art/100.span: non-compliance with the prohibition of the artificial intelligence practices referred to in Article 5;

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: The following infringements
ai_act/art/100.action: be subject to administrative fines of up to 500 000 EUR — non-compliance of the AI system with the requirements laid down in Article 10.
ai_act/art/100.span: non-compliance of the AI system with the requirements laid down in Article 10.

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: The non-compliance of the AI system with any requirements or obligations under this Regulation, other than those laid down in Articles 5 and 10,
ai_act/art/100.action: be subject to administrative fines of up to 250 000 EUR.
ai_act/art/100.span: The non-compliance of the AI system with any requirements or obligations under this Regulation, other than those laid down in Articles 5 and 10, shall be subject to administrative fines of up to 250 000 EUR.

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: the European Data Protection Supervisor
ai_act/art/100.condition: Before taking decisions pursuant to this Article
ai_act/art/100.action: give the Union institution, agency or body which is the subject of the proceedings conducted by the European Data Protection Supervisor the opportunity of being heard on the matter regarding the possible infringement.
ai_act/art/100.span: Before taking decisions pursuant to this Article, the European Data Protection Supervisor shall give the Union institution, agency or body which is the subject of the proceedings conducted by the European Data Protection Supervisor the opportunity of being heard on the matter regarding the possible infringement.

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: The European Data Protection Supervisor
ai_act/art/100.action: base his or her decisions only on elements and circumstances on which the parties concerned have been able to comment.
ai_act/art/100.span: The European Data Protection Supervisor shall base his or her decisions only on elements and circumstances on which the parties concerned have been able to comment.

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: Complainants, if any,
ai_act/art/100.action: be associated closely with the proceedings.
ai_act/art/100.span: Complainants, if any, shall be associated closely with the proceedings.

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: The rights of defense of the parties concerned
ai_act/art/100.action: be fully respected in the proceedings.
ai_act/art/100.span: The rights of defense of the parties concerned shall be fully respected in the proceedings.

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: They
ai_act/art/100.action: be entitled to have access to the European Data Protection Supervisor’s file, subject to the legitimate interest of individuals or undertakings in the protection of their personal data or business secrets.
ai_act/art/100.span: They shall be entitled to have access to the European Data Protection Supervisor’s file, subject to the legitimate interest of individuals or undertakings in the protection of their personal data or business secrets.

ai_act/art/100.addressee_text: Funds collected by imposition of fines in this Article
ai_act/art/100.action: be the income of the general budget of the Union.
ai_act/art/100.span: Funds collected by imposition of fines in this Article shall be the income of the general budget of the Union.

ai_act/annex/IV.span: Detailed information about the monitoring, functioning and control of the AI system, in particular with regard to: its capabilities and limitations in performance, including the degrees of accuracy for specific persons or groups of persons on which the system is intended to be used and the overall expected level of accuracy in relation to its intended purpose; the foreseeable unintended outcomes and sources of risks to health and safety, fundamental rights and discrimination in view of the intended purpose of the AI system; the human oversight measures needed in accordance with Article 14, including the technical measures put in place to facilitate the interpretation of the outputs of AI systems by the users; specifications on input data, as appropriate;

ai_act/art/4.addressee_text: Providers and deployers of AI systems
ai_act/art/4.action: take measures to ensure, to their best extent, a sufficient level of AI literacy of their staff and other persons dealing with the operation and use of AI systems on their behalf, taking into account their technical knowledge, experience, education and training and the context the AI systems are to be used in, and considering the persons or groups of persons on whom the AI systems are to be used.
ai_act/art/4.span: Providers and deployers of AI systems shall take measures to ensure, to their best extent, a sufficient level of AI literacy of their staff and other persons dealing with the operation and use of AI systems on their behalf, taking into account their technical knowledge, experience, education and training and the context the AI systems are to be used in, and considering the persons or groups of persons on whom the AI systems are to be used.

ai_act/art/5.action: be prohibited — the placing on the market, the putting into service or the use of an AI system that deploys subliminal techniques beyond a person’s consciousness or purposefully manipulative or deceptive techniques, with the objective, or the effect of materially distorting the behaviour of a person or a group of persons by appreciably impairing their ability to make an informed decision, thereby causing them to take a decision that they would not have otherwise taken in a manner that causes or is reasonably likely to cause that person, another person or group of persons significant harm;
ai_act/art/5.span: the placing on the market, the putting into service or the use of an AI system that deploys subliminal techniques beyond a person’s consciousness or purposefully manipulative or deceptive techniques, with the objective, or the effect of materially distorting the behaviour of a person or a group of persons by appreciably impairing their ability to make an informed decision, thereby causing them to take a decision that they would not have otherwise taken in a manner that causes or is reasonably likely to cause that person, another person or group of persons significant harm;

ai_act/art/5.action: be prohibited — the placing on the market, the putting into service or the use of an AI system that exploits any of the vulnerabilities of a natural person or a specific group of persons due to their age, disability or a specific social or economic situation, with the objective, or the effect, of materially distorting the behaviour of that person or a person belonging to that group in a manner that causes or is reasonably likely to cause that person or another person significant harm;
ai_act/art/5.span: the placing on the market, the putting into service or the use of an AI system that exploits any of the vulnerabilities of a natural person or a specific group of persons due to their age, disability or a specific social or economic situation, with the objective, or the effect, of materially distorting the behaviour of that person or a person belonging to that group in a manner that causes or is reasonably likely to cause that person or another person significant harm;

ai_act/art/5.action: be prohibited — the placing on the market, the putting into service or the use of AI systems for the evaluation or classification of natural persons or groups of persons over a certain period of time based on their social behaviour or known, inferred or predicted personal or personality characteristics, with the social score leading to either or both of the following:

ai_act/art/5.addressee_text: the placing on the market, the putting into service for this specific purpose, or the use of an AI system for making risk assessments of natural persons in order to assess or predict the risk of a natural person committing a criminal offence, based solely on the profiling of a natural person or on assessing their personality traits and characteristics; this prohibition

ai_act/art/5.span: the placing on the market, the putting into service for this specific purpose, or the use of AI systems to infer emotions of a natural person in the areas of workplace and education institutions, except where the use of the AI system is intended to be put in place or into the market for medical or safety reasons;

ai_act/art/5.span: the placing on the market, the putting into service for this specific purpose, or the use of biometric categorisation systems that categorise individually natural persons based on their biometric data to deduce or infer their race, political opinions, trade union membership, religious or philosophical beliefs, sex life or sexual orientation; this prohibition does not cover any labelling or filtering of lawfully acquired biometric datasets, such as images, based on biometric data or categorizing of biometric data in the area of law enforcement;

ai_act/art/5.span: the consequences of the use of the system for the rights and freedoms of all persons concerned, in particular the seriousness, probability and scale of those consequences.

ai_act/art/6.span: the AI system is intended to improve the result of a previously completed human activity;

ai_act/art/6.action: apply where any of the following conditions is fulfilled — the AI system is intended to detect decision-making patterns or deviations from prior decision-making patterns and is not meant to replace or influence the previously completed human assessment, without proper human review; or
ai_act/art/6.span: the AI system is intended to detect decision-making patterns or deviations from prior decision-making patterns and is not meant to replace or influence the previously completed human assessment, without proper human review; or

ai_act/art/6.action: apply where any of the following conditions is fulfilled — the AI system is intended to perform a preparatory task to an assessment relevant for the purposes of the use cases listed in Annex III.
ai_act/art/6.span: the AI system is intended to perform a preparatory task to an assessment relevant for the purposes of the use cases listed in Annex III.

ai_act/art/6.addressee_text: an AI system referred to in Annex III
ai_act/art/6.action: always be considered to be high-risk where the AI system performs profiling of natural persons.
ai_act/art/6.span: Notwithstanding the first subparagraph, an AI system referred to in Annex III shall always be considered to be high-risk where the AI system performs profiling of natural persons.

ai_act/art/6.addressee_text: A provider who considers that an AI system referred to in Annex III is not high-risk
ai_act/art/6.action: document its assessment before that system is placed on the market or put into service.
ai_act/art/6.span: A provider who considers that an AI system referred to in Annex III is not high-risk shall document its assessment before that system is placed on the market or put into service.

ai_act/art/6.action: be subject to the registration obligation set out in Article 49(2).
ai_act/art/6.span: Such provider shall be subject to the registration obligation set out in Article 49(2).

ai_act/art/6.condition: Upon request of national competent authorities
ai_act/art/6.action: provide the documentation of the assessment.
ai_act/art/6.span: Upon request of national competent authorities, the provider shall provide the documentation of the assessment.

ai_act/art/6.action: , after consulting the European Artificial Intelligence Board (the ‘Board’), and no later than 2 February 2026, provide guidelines specifying the practical implementation of this Article in line with Article 96 together with a comprehensive list of practical examples of use cases of AI systems that are high-risk and not high-risk.
ai_act/art/6.span: The Commission shall, after consulting the European Artificial Intelligence Board (the ‘Board’), and no later than 2 February 2026, provide guidelines specifying the practical implementation of this Article in line with Article 96 together with a comprehensive list of practical examples of use cases of AI systems that are high-risk and not high-risk.

ai_act/art/6.action: adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 97 in order to amend paragraph 3, second subparagraph, of this Article by deleting any of the conditions laid down therein, where there is concrete and reliable evidence that this is necessary to maintain the level of protection of health, safety and fundamental rights provided for by this Regulation.
ai_act/art/6.span: The Commission shall adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 97 in order to amend paragraph 3, second subparagraph, of this Article by deleting any of the conditions laid down therein, where there is concrete and reliable evidence that this is necessary to maintain the level of protection of health, safety and fundamental rights provided for by this Regulation.

ai_act/art/6.addressee_text: Any amendment to the conditions laid down in paragraph 3, second subparagraph, adopted in accordance with paragraphs 6 and 7 of this Article
ai_act/art/6.action: decrease the overall level of protection of health, safety and fundamental rights provided for by this Regulation and shall ensure consistency with the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 7(1), and take account of market and technological developments.
ai_act/art/6.span: Any amendment to the conditions laid down in paragraph 3, second subparagraph, adopted in accordance with paragraphs 6 and 7 of this Article shall not decrease the overall level of protection of health, safety and fundamental rights provided for by this Regulation and shall ensure consistency with the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 7(1), and take account of market and technological developments.

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing the condition under paragraph 1, point (b)
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the intended purpose of the AI system;
ai_act/art/7.span: the intended purpose of the AI system;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing the condition under paragraph 1, point (b)
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the extent to which an AI system has been used or is likely to be used;
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which an AI system has been used or is likely to be used;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing the condition under paragraph 1, point (b)
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the nature and amount of the data processed and used by the AI system, in particular whether special categories of personal data are processed;
ai_act/art/7.span: the nature and amount of the data processed and used by the AI system, in particular whether special categories of personal data are processed;

ai_act/art/7.addressee_text: the extent to which the AI system acts autonomously and the possibility for a human to override a decision or recommendations that
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which the AI system acts autonomously and the possibility for a human to override a decision or recommendations that may lead to potential harm;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing the condition under paragraph 1, point (b)
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the extent to which the use of an AI system has already caused harm to health and safety, has had an adverse impact on fundamental rights or has given rise to significant concerns in relation to the likelihood of such harm or adverse impact, as demonstrated, for example, by reports or documented allegations submitted to national competent authorities or by other reports, as appropriate;
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which the use of an AI system has already caused harm to health and safety, has had an adverse impact on fundamental rights or has given rise to significant concerns in relation to the likelihood of such harm or adverse impact, as demonstrated, for example, by reports or documented allegations submitted to national competent authorities or by other reports, as appropriate;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing the condition under paragraph 1, point (b)
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the potential extent of such harm or such adverse impact, in particular in terms of its intensity and its ability to affect multiple persons or to disproportionately affect a particular group of persons;
ai_act/art/7.span: the potential extent of such harm or such adverse impact, in particular in terms of its intensity and its ability to affect multiple persons or to disproportionately affect a particular group of persons;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing the condition under paragraph 1, point (b)
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the extent to which persons who are potentially harmed or suffer an adverse impact are dependent on the outcome produced with an AI system, in particular because for practical or legal reasons it is not reasonably possible to opt-out from that outcome;
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which persons who are potentially harmed or suffer an adverse impact are dependent on the outcome produced with an AI system, in particular because for practical or legal reasons it is not reasonably possible to opt-out from that outcome;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing the condition under paragraph 1, point (b)
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the extent to which there is an imbalance of power, or the persons who are potentially harmed or suffer an adverse impact are in a vulnerable position in relation to the deployer of an AI system, in particular due to status, authority, knowledge, economic or social circumstances, or age;
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which there is an imbalance of power, or the persons who are potentially harmed or suffer an adverse impact are in a vulnerable position in relation to the deployer of an AI system, in particular due to status, authority, knowledge, economic or social circumstances, or age;

ai_act/art/7.addressee_text: the extent to which the outcome produced involving an AI system is easily corrigible or reversible, taking into account the technical solutions available to correct or reverse it, whereby outcomes having an adverse impact on health, safety or fundamental rights,
ai_act/art/7.action: be considered to be easily corrigible or reversible;
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which the outcome produced involving an AI system is easily corrigible or reversible, taking into account the technical solutions available to correct or reverse it, whereby outcomes having an adverse impact on health, safety or fundamental rights, shall not be considered to be easily corrigible or reversible;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing the condition under paragraph 1, point (b)
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the magnitude and likelihood of benefit of the deployment of the AI system for individuals, groups, or society at large, including possible improvements in product safety;
ai_act/art/7.span: the magnitude and likelihood of benefit of the deployment of the AI system for individuals, groups, or society at large, including possible improvements in product safety;

ai_act/art/7.condition: When assessing the condition under paragraph 1, point (b)
ai_act/art/7.action: take into account the following criteria — the extent to which existing Union law provides for:
ai_act/art/7.span: the extent to which existing Union law provides for:

ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.action: comply with the requirements laid down in this Section, taking into account their intended purpose as well as the generally acknowledged state of the art on AI and AI-related technologies.
ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.span: High-risk AI systems shall comply with the requirements laid down in this Section, taking into account their intended purpose as well as the generally acknowledged state of the art on AI and AI-related technologies.

ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.addressee_text: The risk management system referred to in Article 9
ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.action: be taken into account when ensuring compliance with those requirements.
ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.span: The risk management system referred to in Article 9 shall be taken into account when ensuring compliance with those requirements.

ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.condition: Where a product contains an AI system, to which the requirements of this Regulation as well as requirements of the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I apply
ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.action: be responsible for ensuring that their product is fully compliant with all applicable requirements under applicable Union harmonisation legislation.
ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.span: Where a product contains an AI system, to which the requirements of this Regulation as well as requirements of the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I apply, providers shall be responsible for ensuring that their product is fully compliant with all applicable requirements under applicable Union harmonisation legislation.

ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.addressee_text: In ensuring the compliance of high-risk AI systems referred to in paragraph 1 with the requirements set out in this Section, and in order to ensure consistency, avoid duplication and minimise additional burdens, providers
ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.action: have a choice of integrating, as appropriate, the necessary testing and reporting processes, information and documentation they provide with regard to their product into documentation and procedures that already exist and are required under the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I.
ai_act/high_risk/compliance_with_require.span: In ensuring the compliance of high-risk AI systems referred to in paragraph 1 with the requirements set out in this Section, and in order to ensure consistency, avoid duplication and minimise additional burdens, providers shall have a choice of integrating, as appropriate, the necessary testing and reporting processes, information and documentation they provide with regard to their product into documentation and procedures that already exist and are required under the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be established, implemented, documented and maintained in relation to high-risk AI systems.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: A risk management system shall be established, implemented, documented and maintained in relation to high-risk AI systems.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be understood as a continuous iterative process planned and run throughout the entire lifecycle of a high-risk AI system, requiring regular systematic review and updating.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: The risk management system shall be understood as a continuous iterative process planned and run throughout the entire lifecycle of a high-risk AI system, requiring regular systematic review and updating.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: comprise the following steps — the identification and analysis of the known and the reasonably foreseeable risks that the high-risk AI system can pose to health, safety or fundamental rights when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose;
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: the identification and analysis of the known and the reasonably foreseeable risks that the high-risk AI system can pose to health, safety or fundamental rights when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose;

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: the estimation and evaluation of the risks that
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: emerge when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose, and under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse;
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: the estimation and evaluation of the risks that may emerge when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose, and under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse;

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: comprise the following steps — the evaluation of other risks possibly arising, based on the analysis of data gathered from the post-market monitoring system referred to in Article 72;
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: the evaluation of other risks possibly arising, based on the analysis of data gathered from the post-market monitoring system referred to in Article 72;

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: comprise the following steps — the adoption of appropriate and targeted risk management measures designed to address the risks identified pursuant to point (a).
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: the adoption of appropriate and targeted risk management measures designed to address the risks identified pursuant to point (a).

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: The risks referred to in this Article
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: concern only those which may be reasonably mitigated or eliminated through the development or design of the high-risk AI system, or the provision of adequate technical information.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: The risks referred to in this Article shall concern only those which may be reasonably mitigated or eliminated through the development or design of the high-risk AI system, or the provision of adequate technical information.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: The risk management measures referred to in paragraph 2, point (d),
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: give due consideration to the effects and possible interaction resulting from the combined application of the requirements set out in this Section, with a view to minimising risks more effectively while achieving an appropriate balance in implementing the measures to fulfil those requirements.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: The risk management measures referred to in paragraph 2, point (d), shall give due consideration to the effects and possible interaction resulting from the combined application of the requirements set out in this Section, with a view to minimising risks more effectively while achieving an appropriate balance in implementing the measures to fulfil those requirements.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: The risk management measures referred to in paragraph 2, point (d),
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be such that the relevant residual risk associated with each hazard, as well as the overall residual risk of the high-risk AI systems is judged to be acceptable.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: The risk management measures referred to in paragraph 2, point (d), shall be such that the relevant residual risk associated with each hazard, as well as the overall residual risk of the high-risk AI systems is judged to be acceptable.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: In identifying the most appropriate risk management measures, the following
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be ensured — elimination or reduction of risks identified and evaluated pursuant to paragraph 2 in as far as technically feasible through adequate design and development of the high-risk AI system;
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: elimination or reduction of risks identified and evaluated pursuant to paragraph 2 in as far as technically feasible through adequate design and development of the high-risk AI system;

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: In identifying the most appropriate risk management measures, the following
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be ensured — where appropriate, implementation of adequate mitigation and control measures addressing risks that cannot be eliminated;
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: where appropriate, implementation of adequate mitigation and control measures addressing risks that cannot be eliminated;

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: In identifying the most appropriate risk management measures, the following
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be ensured — provision of information required pursuant to Article 13 and, where appropriate, training to deployers.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: provision of information required pursuant to Article 13 and, where appropriate, training to deployers.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: With a view to eliminating or reducing risks related to the use of the high-risk AI system, due consideration
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be given to the technical knowledge, experience, education, the training to be expected by the deployer, and the presumable context in which the system is intended to be used.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: With a view to eliminating or reducing risks related to the use of the high-risk AI system, due consideration shall be given to the technical knowledge, experience, education, the training to be expected by the deployer, and the presumable context in which the system is intended to be used.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be tested for the purpose of identifying the most appropriate and targeted risk management measures.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: High-risk AI systems shall be tested for the purpose of identifying the most appropriate and targeted risk management measures.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: ensure that high-risk AI systems perform consistently for their intended purpose and that they are in compliance with the requirements set out in this Section.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: Testing shall ensure that high-risk AI systems perform consistently for their intended purpose and that they are in compliance with the requirements set out in this Section.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: include testing in real-world conditions in accordance with Article 60.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: Testing procedures may include testing in real-world conditions in accordance with Article 60.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: The testing of high-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be performed, as appropriate, at any time throughout the development process, and, in any event, prior to their being placed on the market or put into service.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.timing: prior to their being placed on the market or put into service
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: The testing of high-risk AI systems shall be performed, as appropriate, at any time throughout the development process, and, in any event, prior to their being placed on the market or put into service.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be carried out against prior defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds that are appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: Testing shall be carried out against prior defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds that are appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.condition: When implementing the risk management system as provided for in paragraphs 1 to 7
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: give consideration to whether in view of its intended purpose the high-risk AI system is likely to have an adverse impact on persons under the age of 18 and, as appropriate, other vulnerable groups.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: When implementing the risk management system as provided for in paragraphs 1 to 7, providers shall give consideration to whether in view of its intended purpose the high-risk AI system is likely to have an adverse impact on persons under the age of 18 and, as appropriate, other vulnerable groups.

ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.addressee_text: For providers of high-risk AI systems that are subject to requirements regarding internal risk management processes under other relevant provisions of Union law, the aspects provided in paragraphs 1 to 9
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.action: be part of, or combined with, the risk management procedures established pursuant to that law.
ai_act/high_risk/risk_management.span: For providers of high-risk AI systems that are subject to requirements regarding internal risk management processes under other relevant provisions of Union law, the aspects provided in paragraphs 1 to 9 may be part of, or combined with, the risk management procedures established pursuant to that law.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems which make use of techniques involving the training of AI models with data
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be developed on the basis of training, validation and testing data sets that meet the quality criteria referred to in paragraphs 2 to 5 whenever such data sets are used.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: High-risk AI systems which make use of techniques involving the training of AI models with data shall be developed on the basis of training, validation and testing data sets that meet the quality criteria referred to in paragraphs 2 to 5 whenever such data sets are used.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Training, validation and testing data sets
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be subject to data governance and management practices appropriate for the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be subject to data governance and management practices appropriate for the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Those practices
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: concern in particular — the relevant design choices;
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: the relevant design choices;

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Those practices
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: concern in particular — data collection processes and the origin of data, and in the case of personal data, the original purpose of the data collection;
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: data collection processes and the origin of data, and in the case of personal data, the original purpose of the data collection;

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Those practices
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: concern in particular — relevant data-preparation processing operations, such as annotation, labelling, cleaning, updating, enrichment and aggregation;
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: relevant data-preparation processing operations, such as annotation, labelling, cleaning, updating, enrichment and aggregation;

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Those practices
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: concern in particular — the formulation of assumptions, in particular with respect to the information that the data are supposed to measure and represent;
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: the formulation of assumptions, in particular with respect to the information that the data are supposed to measure and represent;

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Those practices
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: concern in particular — an assessment of the availability, quantity and suitability of the data sets that are needed;
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: an assessment of the availability, quantity and suitability of the data sets that are needed;

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Those practices
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: concern in particular — examination in view of possible biases that are likely to affect the health and safety of persons, have a negative impact on fundamental rights or lead to discrimination prohibited under Union law, especially where data outputs influence inputs for future operations;
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: examination in view of possible biases that are likely to affect the health and safety of persons, have a negative impact on fundamental rights or lead to discrimination prohibited under Union law, especially where data outputs influence inputs for future operations;

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Those practices
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: concern in particular — appropriate measures to detect, prevent and mitigate possible biases identified according to point (f);
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: appropriate measures to detect, prevent and mitigate possible biases identified according to point (f);

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Those practices
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: concern in particular — the identification of relevant data gaps or shortcomings that prevent compliance with this Regulation, and how those gaps and shortcomings can be addressed.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: the identification of relevant data gaps or shortcomings that prevent compliance with this Regulation, and how those gaps and shortcomings can be addressed.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Training, validation and testing data sets
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be relevant, sufficiently representative, and to the best extent possible, free of errors and complete in view of the intended purpose.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be relevant, sufficiently representative, and to the best extent possible, free of errors and complete in view of the intended purpose.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: They
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: have the appropriate statistical properties, including, where applicable, as regards the persons or groups of persons in relation to whom the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: They shall have the appropriate statistical properties, including, where applicable, as regards the persons or groups of persons in relation to whom the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Those characteristics of the data sets
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be met at the level of individual data sets or at the level of a combination thereof.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: Those characteristics of the data sets may be met at the level of individual data sets or at the level of a combination thereof.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: Data sets
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: take into account, to the extent required by the intended purpose, the characteristics or elements that are particular to the specific geographical, contextual, behavioural or functional setting within which the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: Data sets shall take into account, to the extent required by the intended purpose, the characteristics or elements that are particular to the specific geographical, contextual, behavioural or functional setting within which the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: the providers of such systems
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.condition: To the extent that it is strictly necessary for the purpose of ensuring bias detection and correction in relation to the high-risk AI systems in accordance with paragraph (2), points (f) and (g) of this Article
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: exceptionally process special categories of personal data, subject to appropriate safeguards for the fundamental rights and freedoms of natural persons.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: To the extent that it is strictly necessary for the purpose of ensuring bias detection and correction in relation to the high-risk AI systems in accordance with paragraph (2), points (f) and (g) of this Article, the providers of such systems may exceptionally process special categories of personal data, subject to appropriate safeguards for the fundamental rights and freedoms of natural persons.

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: In addition to the provisions set out in Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680, all the following conditions
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be met in order for such processing to occur — the bias detection and correction cannot be effectively fulfilled by processing other data, including synthetic or anonymised data;
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: the bias detection and correction cannot be effectively fulfilled by processing other data, including synthetic or anonymised data;

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: In addition to the provisions set out in Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680, all the following conditions
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be met in order for such processing to occur — the special categories of personal data are subject to technical limitations on the re-use of the personal data, and state-of-the-art security and privacy-preserving measures, including pseudonymisation;
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: the special categories of personal data are subject to technical limitations on the re-use of the personal data, and state-of-the-art security and privacy-preserving measures, including pseudonymisation;

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: In addition to the provisions set out in Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680, all the following conditions
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be met in order for such processing to occur — the special categories of personal data are subject to measures to ensure that the personal data processed are secured, protected, subject to suitable safeguards, including strict controls and documentation of the access, to avoid misuse and ensure that only authorised persons have access to those personal data with appropriate confidentiality obligations;
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: the special categories of personal data are subject to measures to ensure that the personal data processed are secured, protected, subject to suitable safeguards, including strict controls and documentation of the access, to avoid misuse and ensure that only authorised persons have access to those personal data with appropriate confidentiality obligations;

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: In addition to the provisions set out in Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680, all the following conditions
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be met in order for such processing to occur — the special categories of personal data are not to be transmitted, transferred or otherwise accessed by other parties;
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: the special categories of personal data are not to be transmitted, transferred or otherwise accessed by other parties;

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: In addition to the provisions set out in Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680, all the following conditions
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be met in order for such processing to occur — the special categories of personal data are deleted once the bias has been corrected or the personal data has reached the end of its retention period, whichever comes first;
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: the special categories of personal data are deleted once the bias has been corrected or the personal data has reached the end of its retention period, whichever comes first;

ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.addressee_text: In addition to the provisions set out in Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680, all the following conditions
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.action: be met in order for such processing to occur — the records of processing activities pursuant to Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680 include the reasons why the processing of special categories of personal data was strictly necessary to detect and correct biases, and why that objective could not be achieved by processing other data.
ai_act/high_risk/data_governance.span: the records of processing activities pursuant to Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680 include the reasons why the processing of special categories of personal data was strictly necessary to detect and correct biases, and why that objective could not be achieved by processing other data.

ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.addressee_text: The technical documentation of a high-risk AI system
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.action: be drawn up before that system is placed on the market or put into service and shall be kept up-to date.
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.span: The technical documentation of a high-risk AI system shall be drawn up before that system is placed on the market or put into service and shall be kept up-to date.

ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.action: be drawn up in such a way as to demonstrate that the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements set out in this Section and to provide national competent authorities and notified bodies with the necessary information in a clear and comprehensive form to assess the compliance of the AI system with those requirements.
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.span: The technical documentation shall be drawn up in such a way as to demonstrate that the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements set out in this Section and to provide national competent authorities and notified bodies with the necessary information in a clear and comprehensive form to assess the compliance of the AI system with those requirements.

ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.action: contain, at a minimum, the elements set out in Annex IV.
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.span: It shall contain, at a minimum, the elements set out in Annex IV.

ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.action: provide the elements of the technical documentation specified in Annex IV in a simplified manner.
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.span: SMEs, including start-ups, may provide the elements of the technical documentation specified in Annex IV in a simplified manner.

ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.action: establish a simplified technical documentation form targeted at the needs of small and microenterprises.
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.span: To that end, the Commission shall establish a simplified technical documentation form targeted at the needs of small and microenterprises.

ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.condition: Where an SME, including a start-up, opts to provide the information required in Annex IV in a simplified manner
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.action: use the form referred to in this paragraph.
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.span: Where an SME, including a start-up, opts to provide the information required in Annex IV in a simplified manner, it shall use the form referred to in this paragraph.

ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.action: accept the form for the purposes of the conformity assessment.
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.span: Notified bodies shall accept the form for the purposes of the conformity assessment.

ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.addressee_text: a single set of technical documentation
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.condition: Where a high-risk AI system related to a product covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I is placed on the market or put into service
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.action: be drawn up containing all the information set out in paragraph 1, as well as the information required under those legal acts.
ai_act/high_risk/technical_documentation.span: Where a high-risk AI system related to a product covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I is placed on the market or put into service, a single set of technical documentation shall be drawn up containing all the information set out in paragraph 1, as well as the information required under those legal acts.

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system.
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: High-risk AI systems shall technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system.

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: result in the high-risk AI system presenting a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1) or in a substantial modification;
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: identifying situations that may result in the high-risk AI system presenting a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1) or in a substantial modification;

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.condition: In order to ensure a level of traceability of the functioning of a high-risk AI system that is appropriate to the intended purpose of the system
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: enable the recording of events relevant for — facilitating the post-market monitoring referred to in Article 72; and
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: facilitating the post-market monitoring referred to in Article 72; and

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.condition: In order to ensure a level of traceability of the functioning of a high-risk AI system that is appropriate to the intended purpose of the system
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: enable the recording of events relevant for — monitoring the operation of high-risk AI systems referred to in Article 26(5).
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: monitoring the operation of high-risk AI systems referred to in Article 26(5).

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1 (a), of Annex III, the logging capabilities
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: provide, at a minimum — recording of the period of each use of the system (start date and time and end date and time of each use);
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: recording of the period of each use of the system (start date and time and end date and time of each use);

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1 (a), of Annex III, the logging capabilities
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: provide, at a minimum — the reference database against which input data has been checked by the system;
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: the reference database against which input data has been checked by the system;

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1 (a), of Annex III, the logging capabilities
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: provide, at a minimum — the input data for which the search has led to a match;
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: the input data for which the search has led to a match;

ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1 (a), of Annex III, the logging capabilities
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.action: provide, at a minimum — the identification of the natural persons involved in the verification of the results, as referred to in Article 14(5).
ai_act/high_risk/record_keeping.span: the identification of the natural persons involved in the verification of the results, as referred to in Article 14(5).

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: be designed and developed in such a way as to ensure that their operation is sufficiently transparent to enable deployers to interpret a system’s output and use it appropriately.
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way as to ensure that their operation is sufficiently transparent to enable deployers to interpret a system’s output and use it appropriately.

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: An appropriate type and degree of transparency
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: be ensured with a view to achieving compliance with the relevant obligations of the provider and deployer set out in Section 3.
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: An appropriate type and degree of transparency shall be ensured with a view to achieving compliance with the relevant obligations of the provider and deployer set out in Section 3.

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: be accompanied by instructions for use in an appropriate digital format or otherwise that include concise, complete, correct and clear information that is relevant, accessible and comprehensible to deployers.
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: High-risk AI systems shall be accompanied by instructions for use in an appropriate digital format or otherwise that include concise, complete, correct and clear information that is relevant, accessible and comprehensible to deployers.

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: The instructions for use
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: contain at least the following information — the identity and the contact details of the provider and, where applicable, of its authorised representative;
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: the identity and the contact details of the provider and, where applicable, of its authorised representative;

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: The instructions for use
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: contain at least the following information — the characteristics, capabilities and limitations of performance of the high-risk AI system, including:
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: the characteristics, capabilities and limitations of performance of the high-risk AI system, including:

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: the level of accuracy, including its metrics, robustness and cybersecurity referred to in Article 15 against which the high-risk AI system has been tested and validated and which can be expected, and any known and foreseeable circumstances that
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: have an impact on that expected level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity;
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: the level of accuracy, including its metrics, robustness and cybersecurity referred to in Article 15 against which the high-risk AI system has been tested and validated and which can be expected, and any known and foreseeable circumstances that may have an impact on that expected level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity;

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: any known or foreseeable circumstance, related to the use of the high-risk AI system in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse, which
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: lead to risks to the health and safety or fundamental rights referred to in Article 9(2);
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: any known or foreseeable circumstance, related to the use of the high-risk AI system in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse, which may lead to risks to the health and safety or fundamental rights referred to in Article 9(2);

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: The instructions for use
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: contain at least the following information — the changes to the high-risk AI system and its performance which have been pre-determined by the provider at the moment of the initial conformity assessment, if any;
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: the changes to the high-risk AI system and its performance which have been pre-determined by the provider at the moment of the initial conformity assessment, if any;

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: The instructions for use
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: contain at least the following information — the human oversight measures referred to in Article 14, including the technical measures put in place to facilitate the interpretation of the outputs of the high-risk AI systems by the deployers;
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: the human oversight measures referred to in Article 14, including the technical measures put in place to facilitate the interpretation of the outputs of the high-risk AI systems by the deployers;

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: The instructions for use
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: contain at least the following information — the computational and hardware resources needed, the expected lifetime of the high-risk AI system and any necessary maintenance and care measures, including their frequency, to ensure the proper functioning of that AI system, including as regards software updates;
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: the computational and hardware resources needed, the expected lifetime of the high-risk AI system and any necessary maintenance and care measures, including their frequency, to ensure the proper functioning of that AI system, including as regards software updates;

ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.addressee_text: The instructions for use
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.action: contain at least the following information — where relevant, a description of the mechanisms included within the high-risk AI system that allows deployers to properly collect, store and interpret the logs in accordance with Article 12.
ai_act/high_risk/transparency_informatio.span: where relevant, a description of the mechanisms included within the high-risk AI system that allows deployers to properly collect, store and interpret the logs in accordance with Article 12.

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: aim to prevent or minimise the risks to health, safety or fundamental rights that may emerge when a high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse, in particular where such risks persist despite the application of other requirements set out in this Section.
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: Human oversight shall aim to prevent or minimise the risks to health, safety or fundamental rights that may emerge when a high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse, in particular where such risks persist despite the application of other requirements set out in this Section.

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be commensurate with the risks, level of autonomy and context of use of the high-risk AI system, and shall be ensured through either one or both of the following types of measures — measures identified and built, when technically feasible, into the high-risk AI system by the provider before it is placed on the market or put into service;
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: measures identified and built, when technically feasible, into the high-risk AI system by the provider before it is placed on the market or put into service;

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be commensurate with the risks, level of autonomy and context of use of the high-risk AI system, and shall be ensured through either one or both of the following types of measures — measures identified by the provider before placing the high-risk AI system on the market or putting it into service and that are appropriate to be implemented by the deployer.
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.timing: before placing the high-risk AI system on the market or putting it into service and that are appropriate to be implemented by the deployer
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: measures identified by the provider before placing the high-risk AI system on the market or putting it into service and that are appropriate to be implemented by the deployer.

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.condition: For the purpose of implementing paragraphs 1, 2 and 3
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be provided to the deployer in such a way that natural persons to whom human oversight is assigned are enabled, as appropriate and proportionate — to properly understand the relevant capacities and limitations of the high-risk AI system and be able to duly monitor its operation, including in view of detecting and addressing anomalies, dysfunctions and unexpected performance;
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: to properly understand the relevant capacities and limitations of the high-risk AI system and be able to duly monitor its operation, including in view of detecting and addressing anomalies, dysfunctions and unexpected performance;

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.condition: For the purpose of implementing paragraphs 1, 2 and 3
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be provided to the deployer in such a way that natural persons to whom human oversight is assigned are enabled, as appropriate and proportionate — to remain aware of the possible tendency of automatically relying or over-relying on the output produced by a high-risk AI system (automation bias), in particular for high-risk AI systems used to provide information or recommendations for decisions to be taken by natural persons;
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: to remain aware of the possible tendency of automatically relying or over-relying on the output produced by a high-risk AI system (automation bias), in particular for high-risk AI systems used to provide information or recommendations for decisions to be taken by natural persons;

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.condition: For the purpose of implementing paragraphs 1, 2 and 3
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be provided to the deployer in such a way that natural persons to whom human oversight is assigned are enabled, as appropriate and proportionate — to correctly interpret the high-risk AI system’s output, taking into account, for example, the interpretation tools and methods available;
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: to correctly interpret the high-risk AI system’s output, taking into account, for example, the interpretation tools and methods available;

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.condition: For the purpose of implementing paragraphs 1, 2 and 3
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be provided to the deployer in such a way that natural persons to whom human oversight is assigned are enabled, as appropriate and proportionate — to decide, in any particular situation, not to use the high-risk AI system or to otherwise disregard, override or reverse the output of the high-risk AI system;
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: to decide, in any particular situation, not to use the high-risk AI system or to otherwise disregard, override or reverse the output of the high-risk AI system;

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.condition: For the purpose of implementing paragraphs 1, 2 and 3
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be provided to the deployer in such a way that natural persons to whom human oversight is assigned are enabled, as appropriate and proportionate — to intervene in the operation of the high-risk AI system or interrupt the system through a ‘stop’ button or a similar procedure that allows the system to come to a halt in a safe state.
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: to intervene in the operation of the high-risk AI system or interrupt the system through a ‘stop’ button or a similar procedure that allows the system to come to a halt in a safe state.

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1(a) of Annex III, the measures referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: be such as to ensure that, in addition, no action or decision is taken by the deployer on the basis of the identification resulting from the system unless that identification has been separately verified and confirmed by at least two natural persons with the necessary competence, training and authority.
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: For high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1(a) of Annex III, the measures referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article shall be such as to ensure that, in addition, no action or decision is taken by the deployer on the basis of the identification resulting from the system unless that identification has been separately verified and confirmed by at least two natural persons with the necessary competence, training and authority.

ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.addressee_text: The requirement for a separate verification by at least two natural persons
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.action: apply to high-risk AI systems used for the purposes of law enforcement, migration, border control or asylum, where Union or national law considers the application of this requirement to be disproportionate.
ai_act/high_risk/human_oversight.span: The requirement for a separate verification by at least two natural persons shall not apply to high-risk AI systems used for the purposes of law enforcement, migration, border control or asylum, where Union or national law considers the application of this requirement to be disproportionate.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be designed and developed in such a way that they achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity, and that they perform consistently in those respects throughout their lifecycle.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity, and that they perform consistently in those respects throughout their lifecycle.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.addressee_text: To address the technical aspects of how to measure the appropriate levels of accuracy and robustness set out in paragraph 1 and any other relevant performance metrics, the Commission
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: , in cooperation with relevant stakeholders and organisations such as metrology and benchmarking authorities, encourage, as appropriate, the development of benchmarks and measurement methodologies.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: To address the technical aspects of how to measure the appropriate levels of accuracy and robustness set out in paragraph 1 and any other relevant performance metrics, the Commission shall, in cooperation with relevant stakeholders and organisations such as metrology and benchmarking authorities, encourage, as appropriate, the development of benchmarks and measurement methodologies.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.addressee_text: The levels of accuracy and the relevant accuracy metrics of high-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be declared in the accompanying instructions of use.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: The levels of accuracy and the relevant accuracy metrics of high-risk AI systems shall be declared in the accompanying instructions of use.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be as resilient as possible regarding errors, faults or inconsistencies that may occur within the system or the environment in which the system operates, in particular due to their interaction with natural persons or other systems.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: High-risk AI systems shall be as resilient as possible regarding errors, faults or inconsistencies that may occur within the system or the environment in which the system operates, in particular due to their interaction with natural persons or other systems.
Technical and organisational measures shall be taken in this regard.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.addressee_text: The robustness of high-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be achieved through technical redundancy solutions, which may include backup or fail-safe plans.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: The robustness of high-risk AI systems may be achieved through technical redundancy solutions, which may include backup or fail-safe plans.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems that continue to learn after being placed on the market or put into service
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be developed in such a way as to eliminate or reduce as far as possible the risk of possibly biased outputs influencing input for future operations (feedback loops), and as to ensure that any such feedback loops are duly addressed with appropriate mitigation measures.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: High-risk AI systems that continue to learn after being placed on the market or put into service shall be developed in such a way as to eliminate or reduce as far as possible the risk of possibly biased outputs influencing input for future operations (feedback loops), and as to ensure that any such feedback loops are duly addressed with appropriate mitigation measures.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be resilient against attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter their use, outputs or performance by exploiting system vulnerabilities.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: High-risk AI systems shall be resilient against attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter their use, outputs or performance by exploiting system vulnerabilities.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.addressee_text: The technical solutions aiming to ensure the cybersecurity of high-risk AI systems
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: be appropriate to the relevant circumstances and the risks.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: The technical solutions aiming to ensure the cybersecurity of high-risk AI systems shall be appropriate to the relevant circumstances and the risks.

ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.addressee_text: The technical solutions to address AI specific vulnerabilities
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.action: include, where appropriate, measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for attacks trying to manipulate the training data set (data poisoning), or pre-trained components used in training (model poisoning), inputs designed to cause the AI model to make a mistake (adversarial examples or model evasion), confidentiality attacks or model flaws.
ai_act/high_risk/accuracy_robustness_cyb.span: The technical solutions to address AI specific vulnerabilities shall include, where appropriate, measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for attacks trying to manipulate the training data set (data poisoning), or pre-trained components used in training (model poisoning), inputs designed to cause the AI model to make a mistake (adversarial examples or model evasion), confidentiality attacks or model flaws.

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — ensure that their high-risk AI systems are compliant with the requirements set out in Section 2;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: ensure that their high-risk AI systems are compliant with the requirements set out in Section 2;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — indicate on the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, as applicable, their name, registered trade name or registered trade mark, the address at which they can be contacted;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: indicate on the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, as applicable, their name, registered trade name or registered trade mark, the address at which they can be contacted;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — have a quality management system in place which complies with Article 17;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: have a quality management system in place which complies with Article 17;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — keep the documentation referred to in Article 18;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: keep the documentation referred to in Article 18;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — when under their control, keep the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems as referred to in Article 19;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: when under their control, keep the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems as referred to in Article 19;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — ensure that the high-risk AI system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure as referred to in Article 43, prior to its being placed on the market or put into service;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.timing: prior to its being placed on the market or put into service
