ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: ensure that the high-risk AI system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure as referred to in Article 43, prior to its being placed on the market or put into service;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — draw up an EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 47;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: draw up an EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 47;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — affix the CE marking to the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, to indicate conformity with this Regulation, in accordance with Article 48;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: affix the CE marking to the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, to indicate conformity with this Regulation, in accordance with Article 48;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1);
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1);

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — take the necessary corrective actions and provide information as required in Article 20;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: take the necessary corrective actions and provide information as required in Article 20;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — upon a reasoned request of a national competent authority, demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2;
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: upon a reasoned request of a national competent authority, demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2;

ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.action: — ensure that the high-risk AI system complies with accessibility requirements in accordance with Directives (EU) 2016/2102 and (EU) 2019/882.
ai_act/high_risk/provider_obligations.span: ensure that the high-risk AI system complies with accessibility requirements in accordance with Directives (EU) 2016/2102 and (EU) 2019/882.

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: put a quality management system in place that ensures compliance with this Regulation.
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall put a quality management system in place that ensures compliance with this Regulation.

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — a strategy for regulatory compliance, including compliance with conformity assessment procedures and procedures for the management of modifications to the high-risk AI system;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: a strategy for regulatory compliance, including compliance with conformity assessment procedures and procedures for the management of modifications to the high-risk AI system;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — techniques, procedures and systematic actions to be used for the design, design control and design verification of the high-risk AI system;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: techniques, procedures and systematic actions to be used for the design, design control and design verification of the high-risk AI system;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — techniques, procedures and systematic actions to be used for the development, quality control and quality assurance of the high-risk AI system;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: techniques, procedures and systematic actions to be used for the development, quality control and quality assurance of the high-risk AI system;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — examination, test and validation procedures to be carried out before, during and after the development of the high-risk AI system, and the frequency with which they have to be carried out;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: examination, test and validation procedures to be carried out before, during and after the development of the high-risk AI system, and the frequency with which they have to be carried out;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — technical specifications, including standards, to be applied and, where the relevant harmonised standards are not applied in full or do not cover all of the relevant requirements set out in Section 2, the means to be used to ensure that the high-risk AI system complies with those requirements;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: technical specifications, including standards, to be applied and, where the relevant harmonised standards are not applied in full or do not cover all of the relevant requirements set out in Section 2, the means to be used to ensure that the high-risk AI system complies with those requirements;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — systems and procedures for data management, including data acquisition, data collection, data analysis, data labelling, data storage, data filtration, data mining, data aggregation, data retention and any other operation regarding the data that is performed before and for the purpose of the placing on the market or the putting into service of high-risk AI systems;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: systems and procedures for data management, including data acquisition, data collection, data analysis, data labelling, data storage, data filtration, data mining, data aggregation, data retention and any other operation regarding the data that is performed before and for the purpose of the placing on the market or the putting into service of high-risk AI systems;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — the risk management system referred to in Article 9;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: the risk management system referred to in Article 9;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — the setting-up, implementation and maintenance of a post-market monitoring system, in accordance with Article 72;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: the setting-up, implementation and maintenance of a post-market monitoring system, in accordance with Article 72;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — procedures related to the reporting of a serious incident in accordance with Article 73;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: procedures related to the reporting of a serious incident in accordance with Article 73;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — the handling of communication with national competent authorities, other relevant authorities, including those providing or supporting the access to data, notified bodies, other operators, customers or other interested parties;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: the handling of communication with national competent authorities, other relevant authorities, including those providing or supporting the access to data, notified bodies, other operators, customers or other interested parties;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — systems and procedures for record-keeping of all relevant documentation and information;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: systems and procedures for record-keeping of all relevant documentation and information;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — resource management, including security-of-supply related measures;
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: resource management, including security-of-supply related measures;

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the following aspects — an accountability framework setting out the responsibilities of the management and other staff with regard to all the aspects listed in this paragraph.
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: an accountability framework setting out the responsibilities of the management and other staff with regard to all the aspects listed in this paragraph.

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.addressee_text: The implementation of the aspects referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be proportionate to the size of the provider’s organisation.
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: The implementation of the aspects referred to in paragraph 1 shall be proportionate to the size of the provider’s organisation.

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: , in any event, respect the degree of rigour and the level of protection required to ensure the compliance of their high-risk AI systems with this Regulation.
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: Providers shall, in any event, respect the degree of rigour and the level of protection required to ensure the compliance of their high-risk AI systems with this Regulation.

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.addressee_text: Providers of high-risk AI systems that are subject to obligations regarding quality management systems or an equivalent function under relevant sectoral Union law
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: include the aspects listed in paragraph 1 as part of the quality management systems pursuant to that law.
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems that are subject to obligations regarding quality management systems or an equivalent function under relevant sectoral Union law may include the aspects listed in paragraph 1 as part of the quality management systems pursuant to that law.

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.addressee_text: For providers that are financial institutions subject to requirements regarding their internal governance, arrangements or processes under Union financial services law, the obligation to put in place a quality management system, with the exception of paragraph 1, points (g), (h) and (i) of this Article,
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be deemed to be fulfilled by complying with the rules on internal governance arrangements or processes pursuant to the relevant Union financial services law.
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: For providers that are financial institutions subject to requirements regarding their internal governance, arrangements or processes under Union financial services law, the obligation to put in place a quality management system, with the exception of paragraph 1, points (g), (h) and (i) of this Article, shall be deemed to be fulfilled by complying with the rules on internal governance arrangements or processes pursuant to the relevant Union financial services law.

ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.addressee_text: To that end, any harmonised standards referred to in Article 40
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.action: be taken into account.
ai_act/high_risk/quality_management_syst.span: To that end, any harmonised standards referred to in Article 40 shall be taken into account.

ai_act/art/18.action: , for a period ending 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, keep at the disposal of the national competent authorities — the technical documentation referred to in Article 11;
ai_act/art/18.span: the technical documentation referred to in Article 11;

ai_act/art/18.action: , for a period ending 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, keep at the disposal of the national competent authorities — the documentation concerning the quality management system referred to in Article 17;
ai_act/art/18.span: the documentation concerning the quality management system referred to in Article 17;

ai_act/art/18.action: , for a period ending 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, keep at the disposal of the national competent authorities — the documentation concerning the changes approved by notified bodies, where applicable;
ai_act/art/18.span: the documentation concerning the changes approved by notified bodies, where applicable;

ai_act/art/18.action: , for a period ending 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, keep at the disposal of the national competent authorities — the decisions and other documents issued by the notified bodies, where applicable;
ai_act/art/18.span: the decisions and other documents issued by the notified bodies, where applicable;

ai_act/art/18.action: , for a period ending 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, keep at the disposal of the national competent authorities — the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47.
ai_act/art/18.span: the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47.

ai_act/art/18.action: determine conditions under which the documentation referred to in paragraph 1 remains at the disposal of the national competent authorities for the period indicated in that paragraph for the cases when a provider or its authorised representative established on its territory goes bankrupt or ceases its activity prior to the end of that period.
ai_act/art/18.timing: prior to the end of that period
ai_act/art/18.span: Each Member State shall determine conditions under which the documentation referred to in paragraph 1 remains at the disposal of the national competent authorities for the period indicated in that paragraph for the cases when a provider or its authorised representative established on its territory goes bankrupt or ceases its activity prior to the end of that period.

ai_act/art/18.addressee_text: Providers that are financial institutions subject to requirements regarding their internal governance, arrangements or processes under Union financial services law
ai_act/art/18.action: maintain the technical documentation as part of the documentation kept under the relevant Union financial services law.
ai_act/art/18.span: Providers that are financial institutions subject to requirements regarding their internal governance, arrangements or processes under Union financial services law shall maintain the technical documentation as part of the documentation kept under the relevant Union financial services law.

ai_act/art/19.action: keep the logs referred to in Article 12(1), automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems, to the extent such logs are under their control.
ai_act/art/19.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall keep the logs referred to in Article 12(1), automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems, to the extent such logs are under their control.

ai_act/art/19.condition: Without prejudice to applicable Union or national law
ai_act/art/19.action: be kept for a period appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system, of at least six months, unless provided otherwise in the applicable Union or national law, in particular in Union law on the protection of personal data.
ai_act/art/19.span: Without prejudice to applicable Union or national law, the logs shall be kept for a period appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system, of at least six months, unless provided otherwise in the applicable Union or national law, in particular in Union law on the protection of personal data.

ai_act/art/19.addressee_text: Providers that are financial institutions subject to requirements regarding their internal governance, arrangements or processes under Union financial services law
ai_act/art/19.action: maintain the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems as part of the documentation kept under the relevant financial services law.
ai_act/art/19.span: Providers that are financial institutions subject to requirements regarding their internal governance, arrangements or processes under Union financial services law shall maintain the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems as part of the documentation kept under the relevant financial services law.

ai_act/art/20.addressee_text: Providers of high-risk AI systems which consider or have reason to consider that a high-risk AI system that they have placed on the market or put into service is not in conformity with this Regulation
ai_act/art/20.action: immediately take the necessary corrective actions to bring that system into conformity, to withdraw it, to disable it, or to recall it, as appropriate.
ai_act/art/20.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems which consider or have reason to consider that a high-risk AI system that they have placed on the market or put into service is not in conformity with this Regulation shall immediately take the necessary corrective actions to bring that system into conformity, to withdraw it, to disable it, or to recall it, as appropriate.

ai_act/art/20.action: inform the distributors of the high-risk AI system concerned and, where applicable, the deployers, the authorised representative and importers accordingly.
ai_act/art/20.span: They shall inform the distributors of the high-risk AI system concerned and, where applicable, the deployers, the authorised representative and importers accordingly.

ai_act/art/20.condition: Where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1) and the provider becomes aware of that risk
ai_act/art/20.action: immediately investigate the causes, in collaboration with the reporting deployer, where applicable, and inform the market surveillance authorities competent for the high-risk AI system concerned and, where applicable, the notified body that issued a certificate for that high-risk AI system in accordance with Article 44, in particular, of the nature of the non-compliance and of any relevant corrective action taken.
ai_act/art/20.span: Where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1) and the provider becomes aware of that risk, it shall immediately investigate the causes, in collaboration with the reporting deployer, where applicable, and inform the market surveillance authorities competent for the high-risk AI system concerned and, where applicable, the notified body that issued a certificate for that high-risk AI system in accordance with Article 44, in particular, of the nature of the non-compliance and of any relevant corrective action taken.

ai_act/art/21.action: , upon a reasoned request by a competent authority, provide that authority all the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2, in a language which can be easily understood by the authority in one of the official languages of the institutions of the Union as indicated by the Member State concerned.
ai_act/art/21.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall, upon a reasoned request by a competent authority, provide that authority all the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2, in a language which can be easily understood by the authority in one of the official languages of the institutions of the Union as indicated by the Member State concerned.

ai_act/art/21.condition: Upon a reasoned request by a competent authority
ai_act/art/21.action: also give the requesting competent authority, as applicable, access to the automatically generated logs of the high-risk AI system referred to in Article 12(1), to the extent such logs are under their control.
ai_act/art/21.span: Upon a reasoned request by a competent authority, providers shall also give the requesting competent authority, as applicable, access to the automatically generated logs of the high-risk AI system referred to in Article 12(1), to the extent such logs are under their control.

ai_act/art/21.addressee_text: Any information obtained by a competent authority pursuant to this Article
ai_act/art/21.action: be treated in accordance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 78.
ai_act/art/21.span: Any information obtained by a competent authority pursuant to this Article shall be treated in accordance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 78.

ai_act/art/22.condition: Prior to making their high-risk AI systems available on the Union market
ai_act/art/22.action: , by written mandate, appoint an authorised representative which is established in the Union.
ai_act/art/22.span: Prior to making their high-risk AI systems available on the Union market, providers established in third countries shall, by written mandate, appoint an authorised representative which is established in the Union.

ai_act/art/22.action: enable its authorised representative to perform the tasks specified in the mandate received from the provider.
ai_act/art/22.span: The provider shall enable its authorised representative to perform the tasks specified in the mandate received from the provider.

ai_act/art/22.action: perform the tasks specified in the mandate received from the provider.
ai_act/art/22.span: The authorised representative shall perform the tasks specified in the mandate received from the provider.

ai_act/art/22.action: provide a copy of the mandate to the market surveillance authorities upon request, in one of the official languages of the institutions of the Union, as indicated by the competent authority.
ai_act/art/22.span: It shall provide a copy of the mandate to the market surveillance authorities upon request, in one of the official languages of the institutions of the Union, as indicated by the competent authority.

ai_act/art/22.condition: For the purposes of this Regulation
ai_act/art/22.action: empower the authorised representative to carry out the following tasks: […] The mandate shall empower the authorised representative to be addressed, in addition to or instead of the provider, by the competent authorities, on all issues related to ensuring compliance with this Regulation.
ai_act/art/22.span: For the purposes of this Regulation, the mandate shall empower the authorised representative to carry out the following tasks: […] The mandate shall empower the authorised representative to be addressed, in addition to or instead of the provider, by the competent authorities, on all issues related to ensuring compliance with this Regulation.

ai_act/art/22.condition: For the purposes of this Regulation
ai_act/art/22.action: empower the authorised representative to carry out the following tasks — verify that the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47 and the technical documentation referred to in Article 11 have been drawn up and that an appropriate conformity assessment procedure has been carried out by the provider;
ai_act/art/22.span: verify that the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47 and the technical documentation referred to in Article 11 have been drawn up and that an appropriate conformity assessment procedure has been carried out by the provider;

ai_act/art/22.condition: For the purposes of this Regulation
ai_act/art/22.action: empower the authorised representative to carry out the following tasks — keep at the disposal of the competent authorities and national authorities or bodies referred to in Article 74(10), for a period of 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, the contact details of the provider that appointed the authorised representative, a copy of the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47, the technical documentation and, if applicable, the certificate issued by the notified body;
ai_act/art/22.timing: for a period of 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service
ai_act/art/22.span: keep at the disposal of the competent authorities and national authorities or bodies referred to in Article 74(10), for a period of 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, the contact details of the provider that appointed the authorised representative, a copy of the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47, the technical documentation and, if applicable, the certificate issued by the notified body;

ai_act/art/22.condition: For the purposes of this Regulation
ai_act/art/22.action: empower the authorised representative to carry out the following tasks — provide a competent authority, upon a reasoned request, with all the information and documentation, including that referred to in point (b) of this subparagraph, necessary to demonstrate the conformity of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2, including access to the logs, as referred to in Article 12(1), automatically generated by the high-risk AI system, to the extent such logs are under the control of the provider;
ai_act/art/22.span: provide a competent authority, upon a reasoned request, with all the information and documentation, including that referred to in point (b) of this subparagraph, necessary to demonstrate the conformity of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2, including access to the logs, as referred to in Article 12(1), automatically generated by the high-risk AI system, to the extent such logs are under the control of the provider;

ai_act/art/22.condition: For the purposes of this Regulation
ai_act/art/22.action: empower the authorised representative to carry out the following tasks — cooperate with competent authorities, upon a reasoned request, in any action the latter take in relation to the high-risk AI system, in particular to reduce and mitigate the risks posed by the high-risk AI system;
ai_act/art/22.span: cooperate with competent authorities, upon a reasoned request, in any action the latter take in relation to the high-risk AI system, in particular to reduce and mitigate the risks posed by the high-risk AI system;

ai_act/art/22.condition: For the purposes of this Regulation
ai_act/art/22.action: empower the authorised representative to carry out the following tasks — where applicable, comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1), or, if the registration is carried out by the provider itself, ensure that the information referred to in point 3 of Section A of Annex VIII is correct.
ai_act/art/22.span: where applicable, comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1), or, if the registration is carried out by the provider itself, ensure that the information referred to in point 3 of Section A of Annex VIII is correct.

ai_act/art/22.action: terminate the mandate if it considers or has reason to consider the provider to be acting contrary to its obligations pursuant to this Regulation.
ai_act/art/22.span: The authorised representative shall terminate the mandate if it considers or has reason to consider the provider to be acting contrary to its obligations pursuant to this Regulation.

ai_act/art/22.action: immediately inform the relevant market surveillance authority, as well as, where applicable, the relevant notified body, about the termination of the mandate and the reasons therefor.
ai_act/art/22.span: In such a case, it shall immediately inform the relevant market surveillance authority, as well as, where applicable, the relevant notified body, about the termination of the mandate and the reasons therefor.

ai_act/art/23.condition: Before placing a high-risk AI system on the market
ai_act/art/23.action: ensure that the system is in conformity with this Regulation by verifying that — the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 43 has been carried out by the provider of the high-risk AI system;
ai_act/art/23.span: the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 43 has been carried out by the provider of the high-risk AI system;

ai_act/art/23.condition: Before placing a high-risk AI system on the market
ai_act/art/23.action: ensure that the system is in conformity with this Regulation by verifying that — the provider has drawn up the technical documentation in accordance with Article 11 and Annex IV;
ai_act/art/23.span: the provider has drawn up the technical documentation in accordance with Article 11 and Annex IV;

ai_act/art/23.condition: Before placing a high-risk AI system on the market
ai_act/art/23.action: ensure that the system is in conformity with this Regulation by verifying that — the system bears the required CE marking and is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47 and instructions for use;
ai_act/art/23.span: the system bears the required CE marking and is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47 and instructions for use;

ai_act/art/23.condition: Before placing a high-risk AI system on the market
ai_act/art/23.action: ensure that the system is in conformity with this Regulation by verifying that — the provider has appointed an authorised representative in accordance with Article 22(1).
ai_act/art/23.span: the provider has appointed an authorised representative in accordance with Article 22(1).

ai_act/art/23.condition: Where an importer has sufficient reason to consider that a high-risk AI system is not in conformity with this Regulation, or is falsified, or accompanied by falsified documentation
ai_act/art/23.action: place the system on the market until it has been brought into conformity.
ai_act/art/23.span: Where an importer has sufficient reason to consider that a high-risk AI system is not in conformity with this Regulation, or is falsified, or accompanied by falsified documentation, it shall not place the system on the market until it has been brought into conformity.

ai_act/art/23.condition: Where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1)
ai_act/art/23.action: inform the provider of the system, the authorised representative and the market surveillance authorities to that effect.
ai_act/art/23.span: Where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1), the importer shall inform the provider of the system, the authorised representative and the market surveillance authorities to that effect.

ai_act/art/23.action: indicate their name, registered trade name or registered trade mark, and the address at which they can be contacted on the high-risk AI system and on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, where applicable.
ai_act/art/23.span: Importers shall indicate their name, registered trade name or registered trade mark, and the address at which they can be contacted on the high-risk AI system and on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, where applicable.

ai_act/art/23.action: ensure that, while a high-risk AI system is under their responsibility, storage or transport conditions, where applicable, do not jeopardise its compliance with the requirements set out in Section 2.
ai_act/art/23.span: Importers shall ensure that, while a high-risk AI system is under their responsibility, storage or transport conditions, where applicable, do not jeopardise its compliance with the requirements set out in Section 2.

ai_act/art/23.action: keep, for a period of 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, a copy of the certificate issued by the notified body, where applicable, of the instructions for use, and of the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47.
ai_act/art/23.timing: for a period of 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service
ai_act/art/23.span: Importers shall keep, for a period of 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, a copy of the certificate issued by the notified body, where applicable, of the instructions for use, and of the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47.

ai_act/art/23.action: provide the relevant competent authorities, upon a reasoned request, with all the necessary information and documentation, including that referred to in paragraph 5, to demonstrate the conformity of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2 in a language which can be easily understood by them.
ai_act/art/23.span: Importers shall provide the relevant competent authorities, upon a reasoned request, with all the necessary information and documentation, including that referred to in paragraph 5, to demonstrate the conformity of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2 in a language which can be easily understood by them.

ai_act/art/23.action: also ensure that the technical documentation can be made available to those authorities.
ai_act/art/23.span: For this purpose, they shall also ensure that the technical documentation can be made available to those authorities.

ai_act/art/23.action: cooperate with the relevant competent authorities in any action those authorities take in relation to a high-risk AI system placed on the market by the importers, in particular to reduce and mitigate the risks posed by it.
ai_act/art/23.span: Importers shall cooperate with the relevant competent authorities in any action those authorities take in relation to a high-risk AI system placed on the market by the importers, in particular to reduce and mitigate the risks posed by it.

ai_act/art/24.condition: Before making a high-risk AI system available on the market
ai_act/art/24.action: verify that it bears the required CE marking, that it is accompanied by a copy of the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47 and instructions for use, and that the provider and the importer of that system, as applicable, have complied with their respective obligations as laid down in Article 16, points (b) and (c) and Article 23(3).
ai_act/art/24.span: Before making a high-risk AI system available on the market, distributors shall verify that it bears the required CE marking, that it is accompanied by a copy of the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47 and instructions for use, and that the provider and the importer of that system, as applicable, have complied with their respective obligations as laid down in Article 16, points (b) and (c) and Article 23(3).

ai_act/art/24.condition: Where a distributor considers or has reason to consider, on the basis of the information in its possession, that a high-risk AI system is not in conformity with the requirements set out in Section 2
ai_act/art/24.action: make the high-risk AI system available on the market until the system has been brought into conformity with those requirements.
ai_act/art/24.span: Where a distributor considers or has reason to consider, on the basis of the information in its possession, that a high-risk AI system is not in conformity with the requirements set out in Section 2, it shall not make the high-risk AI system available on the market until the system has been brought into conformity with those requirements.

ai_act/art/24.addressee_text: Furthermore, where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1), the distributor
ai_act/art/24.action: inform the provider or the importer of the system, as applicable, to that effect.
ai_act/art/24.span: Furthermore, where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1), the distributor shall inform the provider or the importer of the system, as applicable, to that effect.

ai_act/art/24.action: ensure that, while a high-risk AI system is under their responsibility, storage or transport conditions, where applicable, do not jeopardise the compliance of the system with the requirements set out in Section 2.
ai_act/art/24.span: Distributors shall ensure that, while a high-risk AI system is under their responsibility, storage or transport conditions, where applicable, do not jeopardise the compliance of the system with the requirements set out in Section 2.

ai_act/art/24.addressee_text: A distributor that considers or has reason to consider, on the basis of the information in its possession, a high-risk AI system which it has made available on the market not to be in conformity with the requirements set out in Section 2,
ai_act/art/24.action: take the corrective actions necessary to bring that system into conformity with those requirements, to withdraw it or recall it, or shall ensure that the provider, the importer or any relevant operator, as appropriate, takes those corrective actions.
ai_act/art/24.span: A distributor that considers or has reason to consider, on the basis of the information in its possession, a high-risk AI system which it has made available on the market not to be in conformity with the requirements set out in Section 2, shall take the corrective actions necessary to bring that system into conformity with those requirements, to withdraw it or recall it, or shall ensure that the provider, the importer or any relevant operator, as appropriate, takes those corrective actions.

ai_act/art/24.condition: Where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1)
ai_act/art/24.action: immediately inform the provider or importer of the system and the authorities competent for the high-risk AI system concerned, giving details, in particular, of the non-compliance and of any corrective actions taken.
ai_act/art/24.span: Where the high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1), the distributor shall immediately inform the provider or importer of the system and the authorities competent for the high-risk AI system concerned, giving details, in particular, of the non-compliance and of any corrective actions taken.

ai_act/art/24.addressee_text: distributors of a high-risk AI system
ai_act/art/24.condition: Upon a reasoned request from a relevant competent authority
ai_act/art/24.action: provide that authority with all the information and documentation regarding their actions pursuant to paragraphs 1 to 4 necessary to demonstrate the conformity of that system with the requirements set out in Section 2.
ai_act/art/24.span: Upon a reasoned request from a relevant competent authority, distributors of a high-risk AI system shall provide that authority with all the information and documentation regarding their actions pursuant to paragraphs 1 to 4 necessary to demonstrate the conformity of that system with the requirements set out in Section 2.

ai_act/art/24.action: cooperate with the relevant competent authorities in any action those authorities take in relation to a high-risk AI system made available on the market by the distributors, in particular to reduce or mitigate the risk posed by it.
ai_act/art/24.span: Distributors shall cooperate with the relevant competent authorities in any action those authorities take in relation to a high-risk AI system made available on the market by the distributors, in particular to reduce or mitigate the risk posed by it.

ai_act/art/25.addressee_text: Any distributor, importer, deployer or other third-party
ai_act/art/25.action: be considered to be a provider of a high-risk AI system for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the provider under Article 16, in any of the following circumstances:
ai_act/art/25.span: Any distributor, importer, deployer or other third-party shall be considered to be a provider of a high-risk AI system for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the provider under Article 16, in any of the following circumstances:

ai_act/art/25.addressee_text: Any distributor, importer, deployer or other third-party
ai_act/art/25.action: be considered to be a provider of a high-risk AI system for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the provider under Article 16, in any of the following circumstances — they put their name or trademark on a high-risk AI system already placed on the market or put into service, without prejudice to contractual arrangements stipulating that the obligations are otherwise allocated;
ai_act/art/25.span: they put their name or trademark on a high-risk AI system already placed on the market or put into service, without prejudice to contractual arrangements stipulating that the obligations are otherwise allocated;

ai_act/art/25.addressee_text: Any distributor, importer, deployer or other third-party
ai_act/art/25.action: be considered to be a provider of a high-risk AI system for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the provider under Article 16, in any of the following circumstances — they make a substantial modification to a high-risk AI system that has already been placed on the market or has already been put into service in such a way that it remains a high-risk AI system pursuant to Article 6;
ai_act/art/25.span: they make a substantial modification to a high-risk AI system that has already been placed on the market or has already been put into service in such a way that it remains a high-risk AI system pursuant to Article 6;

ai_act/art/25.addressee_text: Any distributor, importer, deployer or other third-party
ai_act/art/25.action: be considered to be a provider of a high-risk AI system for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the provider under Article 16, in any of the following circumstances — they modify the intended purpose of an AI system, including a general-purpose AI system, which has not been classified as high-risk and has already been placed on the market or put into service in such a way that the AI system concerned becomes a high-risk AI system in accordance with Article 6.
ai_act/art/25.span: they modify the intended purpose of an AI system, including a general-purpose AI system, which has not been classified as high-risk and has already been placed on the market or put into service in such a way that the AI system concerned becomes a high-risk AI system in accordance with Article 6.

ai_act/art/25.addressee_text: the provider that initially placed the AI system on the market or put it into service
ai_act/art/25.condition: Where the circumstances referred to in paragraph 1 occur
ai_act/art/25.action: no longer be considered to be a provider of that specific AI system for the purposes of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/25.span: Where the circumstances referred to in paragraph 1 occur, the provider that initially placed the AI system on the market or put it into service shall no longer be considered to be a provider of that specific AI system for the purposes of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/25.action: closely cooperate with new providers and shall make available the necessary information and provide the reasonably expected technical access and other assistance that are required for the fulfilment of the obligations set out in this Regulation, in particular regarding the compliance with the conformity assessment of high-risk AI systems.
ai_act/art/25.span: That initial provider shall closely cooperate with new providers and shall make available the necessary information and provide the reasonably expected technical access and other assistance that are required for the fulfilment of the obligations set out in this Regulation, in particular regarding the compliance with the conformity assessment of high-risk AI systems.

ai_act/art/25.action: apply in cases where the initial provider has clearly specified that its AI system is not to be changed into a high-risk AI system and therefore does not fall under the obligation to hand over the documentation.
ai_act/art/25.span: This paragraph shall not apply in cases where the initial provider has clearly specified that its AI system is not to be changed into a high-risk AI system and therefore does not fall under the obligation to hand over the documentation.

ai_act/art/25.condition: In the case of high-risk AI systems that are safety components of products covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I
ai_act/art/25.action: be considered to be the provider of the high-risk AI system, and shall be subject to the obligations under Article 16 under either of the following circumstances — the high-risk AI system is placed on the market together with the product under the name or trademark of the product manufacturer;
ai_act/art/25.span: the high-risk AI system is placed on the market together with the product under the name or trademark of the product manufacturer;

ai_act/art/25.condition: In the case of high-risk AI systems that are safety components of products covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I
ai_act/art/25.action: be considered to be the provider of the high-risk AI system, and shall be subject to the obligations under Article 16 under either of the following circumstances — the high-risk AI system is put into service under the name or trademark of the product manufacturer after the product has been placed on the market.
ai_act/art/25.span: the high-risk AI system is put into service under the name or trademark of the product manufacturer after the product has been placed on the market.

ai_act/art/25.addressee_text: The provider of a high-risk AI system and the third party that supplies an AI system, tools, services, components, or processes that are used or integrated in a high-risk AI system
ai_act/art/25.action: , by written agreement, specify the necessary information, capabilities, technical access and other assistance based on the generally acknowledged state of the art, in order to enable the provider of the high-risk AI system to fully comply with the obligations set out in this Regulation.
ai_act/art/25.span: The provider of a high-risk AI system and the third party that supplies an AI system, tools, services, components, or processes that are used or integrated in a high-risk AI system shall, by written agreement, specify the necessary information, capabilities, technical access and other assistance based on the generally acknowledged state of the art, in order to enable the provider of the high-risk AI system to fully comply with the obligations set out in this Regulation.

ai_act/art/25.action: apply to third parties making accessible to the public tools, services, processes, or components, other than general-purpose AI models, under a free and open-source licence.
ai_act/art/25.span: This paragraph shall not apply to third parties making accessible to the public tools, services, processes, or components, other than general-purpose AI models, under a free and open-source licence.

ai_act/art/25.action: develop and recommend voluntary model terms for contracts between providers of high-risk AI systems and third parties that supply tools, services, components or processes that are used for or integrated into high-risk AI systems.
ai_act/art/25.span: The AI Office may develop and recommend voluntary model terms for contracts between providers of high-risk AI systems and third parties that supply tools, services, components or processes that are used for or integrated into high-risk AI systems.

ai_act/art/25.condition: When developing those voluntary model terms
ai_act/art/25.action: take into account possible contractual requirements applicable in specific sectors or business cases.
ai_act/art/25.span: When developing those voluntary model terms, the AI Office shall take into account possible contractual requirements applicable in specific sectors or business cases.

ai_act/art/25.action: be published and be available free of charge in an easily usable electronic format.
ai_act/art/25.span: The voluntary model terms shall be published and be available free of charge in an easily usable electronic format.

ai_act/art/26.action: take appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure they use such systems in accordance with the instructions for use accompanying the systems, pursuant to paragraphs 3 and 6.
ai_act/art/26.span: Deployers of high-risk AI systems shall take appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure they use such systems in accordance with the instructions for use accompanying the systems, pursuant to paragraphs 3 and 6.

ai_act/art/26.action: assign human oversight to natural persons who have the necessary competence, training and authority, as well as the necessary support.
ai_act/art/26.span: Deployers shall assign human oversight to natural persons who have the necessary competence, training and authority, as well as the necessary support.

ai_act/art/26.condition: Without prejudice to paragraphs 1 and 2, to the extent the deployer exercises control over the input data
ai_act/art/26.action: ensure that input data is relevant and sufficiently representative in view of the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/art/26.span: Without prejudice to paragraphs 1 and 2, to the extent the deployer exercises control over the input data, that deployer shall ensure that input data is relevant and sufficiently representative in view of the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/art/26.action: monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system on the basis of the instructions for use and, where relevant, inform providers in accordance with Article 72.
ai_act/art/26.span: Deployers shall monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system on the basis of the instructions for use and, where relevant, inform providers in accordance with Article 72.

ai_act/art/26.condition: Where deployers have reason to consider that the use of the high-risk AI system in accordance with the instructions
ai_act/art/26.action: result in that AI system presenting a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1), they shall, without undue delay, inform the provider or distributor and the relevant market surveillance authority, and shall suspend the use of that system.
ai_act/art/26.span: Where deployers have reason to consider that the use of the high-risk AI system in accordance with the instructions may result in that AI system presenting a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1), they shall, without undue delay, inform the provider or distributor and the relevant market surveillance authority, and shall suspend the use of that system.

ai_act/art/26.condition: Where deployers have identified a serious incident
ai_act/art/26.action: also immediately inform first the provider, and then the importer or distributor and the relevant market surveillance authorities of that incident.
ai_act/art/26.span: Where deployers have identified a serious incident, they shall also immediately inform first the provider, and then the importer or distributor and the relevant market surveillance authorities of that incident.

ai_act/art/26.condition: If the deployer is not able to reach the provider
ai_act/art/26.action: apply mutatis mutandis.
ai_act/art/26.span: If the deployer is not able to reach the provider, Article 73 shall apply mutatis mutandis.

ai_act/art/26.action: cover sensitive operational data of deployers of AI systems which are law enforcement authorities.
ai_act/art/26.span: This obligation shall not cover sensitive operational data of deployers of AI systems which are law enforcement authorities.

ai_act/art/26.addressee_text: For deployers that are financial institutions subject to requirements regarding their internal governance, arrangements or processes under Union financial services law, the monitoring obligation set out in the first subparagraph
ai_act/art/26.action: be deemed to be fulfilled by complying with the rules on internal governance arrangements, processes and mechanisms pursuant to the relevant financial service law.
ai_act/art/26.span: For deployers that are financial institutions subject to requirements regarding their internal governance, arrangements or processes under Union financial services law, the monitoring obligation set out in the first subparagraph shall be deemed to be fulfilled by complying with the rules on internal governance arrangements, processes and mechanisms pursuant to the relevant financial service law.

ai_act/art/26.action: keep the logs automatically generated by that high-risk AI system to the extent such logs are under their control, for a period appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system, of at least six months, unless provided otherwise in applicable Union or national law, in particular in Union law on the protection of personal data.
ai_act/art/26.span: Deployers of high-risk AI systems shall keep the logs automatically generated by that high-risk AI system to the extent such logs are under their control, for a period appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system, of at least six months, unless provided otherwise in applicable Union or national law, in particular in Union law on the protection of personal data.

ai_act/art/26.addressee_text: Deployers that are financial institutions subject to requirements regarding their internal governance, arrangements or processes under Union financial services law
ai_act/art/26.action: maintain the logs as part of the documentation kept pursuant to the relevant Union financial service law.
ai_act/art/26.span: Deployers that are financial institutions subject to requirements regarding their internal governance, arrangements or processes under Union financial services law shall maintain the logs as part of the documentation kept pursuant to the relevant Union financial service law.

ai_act/art/26.condition: Before putting into service or using a high-risk AI system at the workplace
ai_act/art/26.action: inform workers’ representatives and the affected workers that they will be subject to the use of the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/art/26.span: Before putting into service or using a high-risk AI system at the workplace, deployers who are employers shall inform workers’ representatives and the affected workers that they will be subject to the use of the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/art/26.action: be provided, where applicable, in accordance with the rules and procedures laid down in Union and national law and practice on information of workers and their representatives.
ai_act/art/26.span: This information shall be provided, where applicable, in accordance with the rules and procedures laid down in Union and national law and practice on information of workers and their representatives.

ai_act/art/26.addressee_text: Deployers of high-risk AI systems that are public authorities, or Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies
ai_act/art/26.action: comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49.
ai_act/art/26.span: Deployers of high-risk AI systems that are public authorities, or Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies shall comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49.

ai_act/art/26.condition: When such deployers find that the high-risk AI system that they envisage using has not been registered in the EU database referred to in Article 71
ai_act/art/26.action: use that system and shall inform the provider or the distributor.
ai_act/art/26.span: When such deployers find that the high-risk AI system that they envisage using has not been registered in the EU database referred to in Article 71, they shall not use that system and shall inform the provider or the distributor.

ai_act/art/26.action: use the information provided under Article 13 of this Regulation to comply with their obligation to carry out a data protection impact assessment under Article 35 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 or Article 27 of Directive (EU) 2016/680.
ai_act/art/26.span: Where applicable, deployers of high-risk AI systems shall use the information provided under Article 13 of this Regulation to comply with their obligation to carry out a data protection impact assessment under Article 35 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 or Article 27 of Directive (EU) 2016/680.

ai_act/art/26.addressee_text: the deployer of a high-risk AI system for post-remote biometric identification
ai_act/art/26.condition: Without prejudice to Directive (EU) 2016/680, in the framework of an investigation for the targeted search of a person suspected or convicted of having committed a criminal offence
ai_act/art/26.action: request an authorisation, ex ante, or without undue delay and no later than 48 hours, by a judicial authority or an administrative authority whose decision is binding and subject to judicial review, for the use of that system, except when it is used for the initial identification of a potential suspect based on objective and verifiable facts directly linked to the offence.
ai_act/art/26.span: Without prejudice to Directive (EU) 2016/680, in the framework of an investigation for the targeted search of a person suspected or convicted of having committed a criminal offence, the deployer of a high-risk AI system for post-remote biometric identification shall request an authorisation, ex ante, or without undue delay and no later than 48 hours, by a judicial authority or an administrative authority whose decision is binding and subject to judicial review, for the use of that system, except when it is used for the initial identification of a potential suspect based on objective and verifiable facts directly linked to the offence.

ai_act/art/26.action: be limited to what is strictly necessary for the investigation of a specific criminal offence.
ai_act/art/26.span: Each use shall be limited to what is strictly necessary for the investigation of a specific criminal offence.

ai_act/art/26.addressee_text: the use of the post-remote biometric identification system linked to that requested authorisation
ai_act/art/26.condition: If the authorisation requested pursuant to the first subparagraph is rejected
ai_act/art/26.action: be stopped with immediate effect and the personal data linked to the use of the high-risk AI system for which the authorisation was requested shall be deleted.
ai_act/art/26.span: If the authorisation requested pursuant to the first subparagraph is rejected, the use of the post-remote biometric identification system linked to that requested authorisation shall be stopped with immediate effect and the personal data linked to the use of the high-risk AI system for which the authorisation was requested shall be deleted.

ai_act/art/26.action: such high-risk AI system for post-remote biometric identification be used for law enforcement purposes in an untargeted way, without any link to a criminal offence, a criminal proceeding, a genuine and present or genuine and foreseeable threat of a criminal offence, or the search for a specific missing person.
ai_act/art/26.span: In no case shall such high-risk AI system for post-remote biometric identification be used for law enforcement purposes in an untargeted way, without any link to a criminal offence, a criminal proceeding, a genuine and present or genuine and foreseeable threat of a criminal offence, or the search for a specific missing person.

ai_act/art/26.action: be ensured that no decision that produces an adverse legal effect on a person may be taken by the law enforcement authorities based solely on the output of such post-remote biometric identification systems.
ai_act/art/26.span: It shall be ensured that no decision that produces an adverse legal effect on a person may be taken by the law enforcement authorities based solely on the output of such post-remote biometric identification systems.

ai_act/art/26.addressee_text: Regardless of the purpose or deployer, each use of such high-risk AI systems
ai_act/art/26.action: be documented in the relevant police file and shall be made available to the relevant market surveillance authority and the national data protection authority upon request, excluding the disclosure of sensitive operational data related to law enforcement.
ai_act/art/26.span: Regardless of the purpose or deployer, each use of such high-risk AI systems shall be documented in the relevant police file and shall be made available to the relevant market surveillance authority and the national data protection authority upon request, excluding the disclosure of sensitive operational data related to law enforcement.

ai_act/art/26.action: be without prejudice to the powers conferred by Directive (EU) 2016/680 on supervisory authorities.
ai_act/art/26.span: This subparagraph shall be without prejudice to the powers conferred by Directive (EU) 2016/680 on supervisory authorities.

ai_act/art/26.action: submit annual reports to the relevant market surveillance and national data protection authorities on their use of post-remote biometric identification systems, excluding the disclosure of sensitive operational data related to law enforcement.
ai_act/art/26.span: Deployers shall submit annual reports to the relevant market surveillance and national data protection authorities on their use of post-remote biometric identification systems, excluding the disclosure of sensitive operational data related to law enforcement.

ai_act/art/26.action: be aggregated to cover more than one deployment.
ai_act/art/26.span: The reports may be aggregated to cover more than one deployment.

ai_act/art/26.action: introduce, in accordance with Union law, more restrictive laws on the use of post-remote biometric identification systems.
ai_act/art/26.span: Member States may introduce, in accordance with Union law, more restrictive laws on the use of post-remote biometric identification systems.

ai_act/art/26.addressee_text: deployers of high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III that make decisions or assist in making decisions related to natural persons
ai_act/art/26.condition: Without prejudice to Article 50 of this Regulation
ai_act/art/26.action: inform the natural persons that they are subject to the use of the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/art/26.span: Without prejudice to Article 50 of this Regulation, deployers of high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III that make decisions or assist in making decisions related to natural persons shall inform the natural persons that they are subject to the use of the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/art/26.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems used for law enforcement purposes Article 13 of Directive (EU) 2016/680
ai_act/art/26.action: apply.
ai_act/art/26.span: For high-risk AI systems used for law enforcement purposes Article 13 of Directive (EU) 2016/680 shall apply.

ai_act/art/26.action: cooperate with the relevant competent authorities in any action those authorities take in relation to the high-risk AI system in order to implement this Regulation.
ai_act/art/26.span: Deployers shall cooperate with the relevant competent authorities in any action those authorities take in relation to the high-risk AI system in order to implement this Regulation.

ai_act/art/27.condition: Prior to deploying a high-risk AI system referred to in Article 6(2), with the exception of high-risk AI systems intended to be used in the area listed in point 2 of Annex III, deployers that are bodies governed by public law, or are private entities providing public services, and deployers of high-risk AI systems referred to in points 5 (b) and (c) of Annex III
ai_act/art/27.action: perform an assessment of the impact on fundamental rights that the use of such system may produce.
ai_act/art/27.span: Prior to deploying a high-risk AI system referred to in Article 6(2), with the exception of high-risk AI systems intended to be used in the area listed in point 2 of Annex III, deployers that are bodies governed by public law, or are private entities providing public services, and deployers of high-risk AI systems referred to in points 5 (b) and (c) of Annex III, shall perform an assessment of the impact on fundamental rights that the use of such system may produce.

ai_act/art/27.action: perform an assessment consisting of — a description of the deployer’s processes in which the high-risk AI system will be used in line with its intended purpose;
ai_act/art/27.span: a description of the deployer’s processes in which the high-risk AI system will be used in line with its intended purpose;

ai_act/art/27.action: perform an assessment consisting of — a description of the period of time within which, and the frequency with which, each high-risk AI system is intended to be used;
ai_act/art/27.span: a description of the period of time within which, and the frequency with which, each high-risk AI system is intended to be used;

ai_act/art/27.action: perform an assessment consisting of — the categories of natural persons and groups likely to be affected by its use in the specific context;
ai_act/art/27.span: the categories of natural persons and groups likely to be affected by its use in the specific context;

ai_act/art/27.action: perform an assessment consisting of — the specific risks of harm likely to have an impact on the categories of natural persons or groups of persons identified pursuant to point (c) of this paragraph, taking into account the information given by the provider pursuant to Article 13;
ai_act/art/27.span: the specific risks of harm likely to have an impact on the categories of natural persons or groups of persons identified pursuant to point (c) of this paragraph, taking into account the information given by the provider pursuant to Article 13;

ai_act/art/27.action: perform an assessment consisting of — a description of the implementation of human oversight measures, according to the instructions for use;
ai_act/art/27.span: a description of the implementation of human oversight measures, according to the instructions for use;

ai_act/art/27.action: perform an assessment consisting of — the measures to be taken in the case of the materialisation of those risks, including the arrangements for internal governance and complaint mechanisms.
ai_act/art/27.span: the measures to be taken in the case of the materialisation of those risks, including the arrangements for internal governance and complaint mechanisms.

ai_act/art/27.action: , in similar cases, rely on previously conducted fundamental rights impact assessments or existing impact assessments carried out by provider.
ai_act/art/27.span: The deployer may, in similar cases, rely on previously conducted fundamental rights impact assessments or existing impact assessments carried out by provider.

ai_act/art/27.condition: If, during the use of the high-risk AI system, the deployer considers that any of the elements listed in paragraph 1 has changed or is no longer up to date
ai_act/art/27.action: take the necessary steps to update the information.
ai_act/art/27.span: If, during the use of the high-risk AI system, the deployer considers that any of the elements listed in paragraph 1 has changed or is no longer up to date, the deployer shall take the necessary steps to update the information.

ai_act/art/27.condition: Once the assessment referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article has been performed
ai_act/art/27.action: notify the market surveillance authority of its results, submitting the filled-out template referred to in paragraph 5 of this Article as part of the notification.
ai_act/art/27.span: Once the assessment referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article has been performed, the deployer shall notify the market surveillance authority of its results, submitting the filled-out template referred to in paragraph 5 of this Article as part of the notification.

ai_act/art/27.condition: In the case referred to in Article 46(1)
ai_act/art/27.action: be exempt from that obligation to notify.
ai_act/art/27.span: In the case referred to in Article 46(1), deployers may be exempt from that obligation to notify.

ai_act/art/27.addressee_text: the fundamental rights impact assessment referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article
ai_act/art/27.condition: If any of the obligations laid down in this Article is already met through the data protection impact assessment conducted pursuant to Article 35 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 or Article 27 of Directive (EU) 2016/680
ai_act/art/27.action: complement that data protection impact assessment.
ai_act/art/27.span: If any of the obligations laid down in this Article is already met through the data protection impact assessment conducted pursuant to Article 35 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 or Article 27 of Directive (EU) 2016/680, the fundamental rights impact assessment referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall complement that data protection impact assessment.

ai_act/art/27.action: develop a template for a questionnaire, including through an automated tool, to facilitate deployers in complying with their obligations under this Article in a simplified manner.
ai_act/art/27.span: The AI Office shall develop a template for a questionnaire, including through an automated tool, to facilitate deployers in complying with their obligations under this Article in a simplified manner.

ai_act/art/28.action: designate or establish at least one notifying authority responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment, designation and notification of conformity assessment bodies and for their monitoring.
ai_act/art/28.span: Each Member State shall designate or establish at least one notifying authority responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment, designation and notification of conformity assessment bodies and for their monitoring.

ai_act/art/28.action: be developed in cooperation between the notifying authorities of all Member States.
ai_act/art/28.span: Those procedures shall be developed in cooperation between the notifying authorities of all Member States.

ai_act/art/28.action: decide that the assessment and monitoring referred to in paragraph 1 is to be carried out by a national accreditation body within the meaning of, and in accordance with, Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.
ai_act/art/28.span: Member States may decide that the assessment and monitoring referred to in paragraph 1 is to be carried out by a national accreditation body within the meaning of, and in accordance with, Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.

ai_act/art/28.action: be established, organised and operated in such a way that no conflict of interest arises with conformity assessment bodies, and that the objectivity and impartiality of their activities are safeguarded.
ai_act/art/28.span: Notifying authorities shall be established, organised and operated in such a way that no conflict of interest arises with conformity assessment bodies, and that the objectivity and impartiality of their activities are safeguarded.

ai_act/art/28.action: be organised in such a way that decisions relating to the notification of conformity assessment bodies are taken by competent persons different from those who carried out the assessment of those bodies.
ai_act/art/28.span: Notifying authorities shall be organised in such a way that decisions relating to the notification of conformity assessment bodies are taken by competent persons different from those who carried out the assessment of those bodies.

ai_act/art/28.action: offer or provide neither any activities that conformity assessment bodies perform, nor any consultancy services on a commercial or competitive basis.
ai_act/art/28.span: Notifying authorities shall offer or provide neither any activities that conformity assessment bodies perform, nor any consultancy services on a commercial or competitive basis.

ai_act/art/28.action: safeguard the confidentiality of the information that they obtain, in accordance with Article 78.
ai_act/art/28.span: Notifying authorities shall safeguard the confidentiality of the information that they obtain, in accordance with Article 78.

ai_act/art/28.action: have an adequate number of competent personnel at their disposal for the proper performance of their tasks.
ai_act/art/28.span: Notifying authorities shall have an adequate number of competent personnel at their disposal for the proper performance of their tasks.

ai_act/art/28.action: have the necessary expertise, where applicable, for their function, in fields such as information technologies, AI and law, including the supervision of fundamental rights.
ai_act/art/28.span: Competent personnel shall have the necessary expertise, where applicable, for their function, in fields such as information technologies, AI and law, including the supervision of fundamental rights.

ai_act/art/29.action: submit an application for notification to the notifying authority of the Member State in which they are established.
ai_act/art/29.span: Conformity assessment bodies shall submit an application for notification to the notifying authority of the Member State in which they are established.

ai_act/art/29.action: be accompanied by a description of the conformity assessment activities, the conformity assessment module or modules and the types of AI systems for which the conformity assessment body claims to be competent, as well as by an accreditation certificate, where one exists, issued by a national accreditation body attesting that the conformity assessment body fulfils the requirements laid down in Article 31.
ai_act/art/29.span: The application for notification shall be accompanied by a description of the conformity assessment activities, the conformity assessment module or modules and the types of AI systems for which the conformity assessment body claims to be competent, as well as by an accreditation certificate, where one exists, issued by a national accreditation body attesting that the conformity assessment body fulfils the requirements laid down in Article 31.

ai_act/art/29.addressee_text: Any valid document related to existing designations of the applicant notified body under any other Union harmonisation legislation
ai_act/art/29.span: Any valid document related to existing designations of the applicant notified body under any other Union harmonisation legislation shall be added.

ai_act/art/29.condition: Where the conformity assessment body concerned cannot provide an accreditation certificate
ai_act/art/29.action: provide the notifying authority with all the documentary evidence necessary for the verification, recognition and regular monitoring of its compliance with the requirements laid down in Article 31.
ai_act/art/29.span: Where the conformity assessment body concerned cannot provide an accreditation certificate, it shall provide the notifying authority with all the documentary evidence necessary for the verification, recognition and regular monitoring of its compliance with the requirements laid down in Article 31.

ai_act/art/29.addressee_text: For notified bodies which are designated under any other Union harmonisation legislation, all documents and certificates linked to those designations
ai_act/art/29.action: be used to support their designation procedure under this Regulation, as appropriate.
ai_act/art/29.span: For notified bodies which are designated under any other Union harmonisation legislation, all documents and certificates linked to those designations may be used to support their designation procedure under this Regulation, as appropriate.

ai_act/art/29.action: update the documentation referred to in paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article whenever relevant changes occur, in order to enable the authority responsible for notified bodies to monitor and verify continuous compliance with all the requirements laid down in Article 31.
ai_act/art/29.span: The notified body shall update the documentation referred to in paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article whenever relevant changes occur, in order to enable the authority responsible for notified bodies to monitor and verify continuous compliance with all the requirements laid down in Article 31.

ai_act/art/30.action: notify only conformity assessment bodies which have satisfied the requirements laid down in Article 31.
ai_act/art/30.span: Notifying authorities may notify only conformity assessment bodies which have satisfied the requirements laid down in Article 31.

ai_act/art/30.action: notify the Commission and the other Member States, using the electronic notification tool developed and managed by the Commission, of each conformity assessment body referred to in paragraph 1.
ai_act/art/30.span: Notifying authorities shall notify the Commission and the other Member States, using the electronic notification tool developed and managed by the Commission, of each conformity assessment body referred to in paragraph 1.

ai_act/art/30.addressee_text: The notification referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article
ai_act/art/30.action: include full details of the conformity assessment activities, the conformity assessment module or modules, the types of AI systems concerned, and the relevant attestation of competence.
ai_act/art/30.span: The notification referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article shall include full details of the conformity assessment activities, the conformity assessment module or modules, the types of AI systems concerned, and the relevant attestation of competence.

ai_act/art/30.condition: Where a notification is not based on an accreditation certificate as referred to in Article 29(2)
ai_act/art/30.action: provide the Commission and the other Member States with documentary evidence which attests to the competence of the conformity assessment body and to the arrangements in place to ensure that that body will be monitored regularly and will continue to satisfy the requirements laid down in Article 31.
