ai_act/art/30.span: Where a notification is not based on an accreditation certificate as referred to in Article 29(2), the notifying authority shall provide the Commission and the other Member States with documentary evidence which attests to the competence of the conformity assessment body and to the arrangements in place to ensure that that body will be monitored regularly and will continue to satisfy the requirements laid down in Article 31.

ai_act/art/30.action: perform the activities of a notified body only where no objections are raised by the Commission or the other Member States within two weeks of a notification by a notifying authority where it includes an accreditation certificate referred to in Article 29(2), or within two months of a notification by the notifying authority where it includes documentary evidence referred to in Article 29(3).
ai_act/art/30.timing: within two weeks; within two months
ai_act/art/30.span: The conformity assessment body concerned may perform the activities of a notified body only where no objections are raised by the Commission or the other Member States within two weeks of a notification by a notifying authority where it includes an accreditation certificate referred to in Article 29(2), or within two months of a notification by the notifying authority where it includes documentary evidence referred to in Article 29(3).

ai_act/art/30.action: , without delay, enter into consultations with the relevant Member States and the conformity assessment body.
ai_act/art/30.span: Where objections are raised, the Commission shall, without delay, enter into consultations with the relevant Member States and the conformity assessment body.

ai_act/art/30.action: decide whether the authorisation is justified.
ai_act/art/30.span: In view thereof, the Commission shall decide whether the authorisation is justified.

ai_act/art/30.action: address its decision to the Member State concerned and to the relevant conformity assessment body.
ai_act/art/30.span: The Commission shall address its decision to the Member State concerned and to the relevant conformity assessment body.

ai_act/art/31.action: be established under the national law of a Member State and shall have legal personality.
ai_act/art/31.span: A notified body shall be established under the national law of a Member State and shall have legal personality.

ai_act/art/31.action: satisfy the organisational, quality management, resources and process requirements that are necessary to fulfil their tasks, as well as suitable cybersecurity requirements.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall satisfy the organisational, quality management, resources and process requirements that are necessary to fulfil their tasks, as well as suitable cybersecurity requirements.

ai_act/art/31.addressee_text: The organisational structure, allocation of responsibilities, reporting lines and operation of notified bodies
ai_act/art/31.action: ensure confidence in their performance, and in the results of the conformity assessment activities that the notified bodies conduct.
ai_act/art/31.span: The organisational structure, allocation of responsibilities, reporting lines and operation of notified bodies shall ensure confidence in their performance, and in the results of the conformity assessment activities that the notified bodies conduct.

ai_act/art/31.action: be independent of the provider of a high-risk AI system in relation to which they perform conformity assessment activities.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall be independent of the provider of a high-risk AI system in relation to which they perform conformity assessment activities.

ai_act/art/31.action: also be independent of any other operator having an economic interest in high-risk AI systems assessed, as well as of any competitors of the provider.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall also be independent of any other operator having an economic interest in high-risk AI systems assessed, as well as of any competitors of the provider.

ai_act/art/31.action: preclude the use of assessed high-risk AI systems that are necessary for the operations of the conformity assessment body, or the use of such high-risk AI systems for personal purposes.
ai_act/art/31.span: This shall not preclude the use of assessed high-risk AI systems that are necessary for the operations of the conformity assessment body, or the use of such high-risk AI systems for personal purposes.

ai_act/art/31.addressee_text: Neither a conformity assessment body, its top-level management nor the personnel responsible for carrying out its conformity assessment tasks
ai_act/art/31.action: be directly involved in the design, development, marketing or use of high-risk AI systems, nor shall they represent the parties engaged in those activities.
ai_act/art/31.span: Neither a conformity assessment body, its top-level management nor the personnel responsible for carrying out its conformity assessment tasks shall be directly involved in the design, development, marketing or use of high-risk AI systems, nor shall they represent the parties engaged in those activities.

ai_act/art/31.action: engage in any activity that might conflict with their independence of judgement or integrity in relation to conformity assessment activities for which they are notified.
ai_act/art/31.span: They shall not engage in any activity that might conflict with their independence of judgement or integrity in relation to conformity assessment activities for which they are notified.

ai_act/art/31.action: , in particular, apply to consultancy services.
ai_act/art/31.span: This shall, in particular, apply to consultancy services.

ai_act/art/31.action: be organised and operated so as to safeguard the independence, objectivity and impartiality of their activities.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall be organised and operated so as to safeguard the independence, objectivity and impartiality of their activities.

ai_act/art/31.action: document and implement a structure and procedures to safeguard impartiality and to promote and apply the principles of impartiality throughout their organisation, personnel and assessment activities.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall document and implement a structure and procedures to safeguard impartiality and to promote and apply the principles of impartiality throughout their organisation, personnel and assessment activities.

ai_act/art/31.action: have documented procedures in place ensuring that their personnel, committees, subsidiaries, subcontractors and any associated body or personnel of external bodies maintain, in accordance with Article 78, the confidentiality of the information which comes into their possession during the performance of conformity assessment activities, except when its disclosure is required by law.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall have documented procedures in place ensuring that their personnel, committees, subsidiaries, subcontractors and any associated body or personnel of external bodies maintain, in accordance with Article 78, the confidentiality of the information which comes into their possession during the performance of conformity assessment activities, except when its disclosure is required by law.

ai_act/art/31.action: be bound to observe professional secrecy with regard to all information obtained in carrying out their tasks under this Regulation, except in relation to the notifying authorities of the Member State in which their activities are carried out.
ai_act/art/31.span: The staff of notified bodies shall be bound to observe professional secrecy with regard to all information obtained in carrying out their tasks under this Regulation, except in relation to the notifying authorities of the Member State in which their activities are carried out.

ai_act/art/31.action: have procedures for the performance of activities which take due account of the size of a provider, the sector in which it operates, its structure, and the degree of complexity of the AI system concerned.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall have procedures for the performance of activities which take due account of the size of a provider, the sector in which it operates, its structure, and the degree of complexity of the AI system concerned.

ai_act/art/31.action: take out appropriate liability insurance for their conformity assessment activities, unless liability is assumed by the Member State in which they are established in accordance with national law or that Member State is itself directly responsible for the conformity assessment.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall take out appropriate liability insurance for their conformity assessment activities, unless liability is assumed by the Member State in which they are established in accordance with national law or that Member State is itself directly responsible for the conformity assessment.

ai_act/art/31.action: be capable of carrying out all their tasks under this Regulation with the highest degree of professional integrity and the requisite competence in the specific field, whether those tasks are carried out by notified bodies themselves or on their behalf and under their responsibility.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall be capable of carrying out all their tasks under this Regulation with the highest degree of professional integrity and the requisite competence in the specific field, whether those tasks are carried out by notified bodies themselves or on their behalf and under their responsibility.

ai_act/art/31.action: have sufficient internal competences to be able effectively to evaluate the tasks conducted by external parties on their behalf.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall have sufficient internal competences to be able effectively to evaluate the tasks conducted by external parties on their behalf.

ai_act/art/31.action: have permanent availability of sufficient administrative, technical, legal and scientific personnel who possess experience and knowledge relating to the relevant types of AI systems, data and data computing, and relating to the requirements set out in Section 2.
ai_act/art/31.span: The notified body shall have permanent availability of sufficient administrative, technical, legal and scientific personnel who possess experience and knowledge relating to the relevant types of AI systems, data and data computing, and relating to the requirements set out in Section 2.

ai_act/art/31.action: participate in coordination activities as referred to in Article 38.
ai_act/art/31.span: Notified bodies shall participate in coordination activities as referred to in Article 38.

ai_act/art/31.action: also take part directly, or be represented in, European standardisation organisations, or ensure that they are aware and up to date in respect of relevant standards.
ai_act/art/31.span: They shall also take part directly, or be represented in, European standardisation organisations, or ensure that they are aware and up to date in respect of relevant standards.

ai_act/art/32.condition: Where a conformity assessment body demonstrates its conformity with the criteria laid down in the relevant harmonised standards or parts thereof, the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union
ai_act/art/32.action: be presumed to comply with the requirements set out in Article 31 in so far as the applicable harmonised standards cover those requirements.
ai_act/art/32.span: Where a conformity assessment body demonstrates its conformity with the criteria laid down in the relevant harmonised standards or parts thereof, the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union, it shall be presumed to comply with the requirements set out in Article 31 in so far as the applicable harmonised standards cover those requirements.

ai_act/art/33.condition: Where a notified body subcontracts specific tasks connected with the conformity assessment or has recourse to a subsidiary
ai_act/art/33.action: ensure that the subcontractor or the subsidiary meets the requirements laid down in Article 31, and shall inform the notifying authority accordingly.
ai_act/art/33.span: Where a notified body subcontracts specific tasks connected with the conformity assessment or has recourse to a subsidiary, it shall ensure that the subcontractor or the subsidiary meets the requirements laid down in Article 31, and shall inform the notifying authority accordingly.

ai_act/art/33.action: take full responsibility for the tasks performed by any subcontractors or subsidiaries.
ai_act/art/33.span: Notified bodies shall take full responsibility for the tasks performed by any subcontractors or subsidiaries.

ai_act/art/33.action: be subcontracted or carried out by a subsidiary only with the agreement of the provider.
ai_act/art/33.span: Activities may be subcontracted or carried out by a subsidiary only with the agreement of the provider.

ai_act/art/33.action: make a list of their subsidiaries publicly available.
ai_act/art/33.span: Notified bodies shall make a list of their subsidiaries publicly available.

ai_act/art/33.addressee_text: The relevant documents concerning the assessment of the qualifications of the subcontractor or the subsidiary and the work carried out by them under this Regulation
ai_act/art/33.action: be kept at the disposal of the notifying authority for a period of five years from the termination date of the subcontracting.
ai_act/art/33.timing: for a period of five years from the termination date of the subcontracting
ai_act/art/33.span: The relevant documents concerning the assessment of the qualifications of the subcontractor or the subsidiary and the work carried out by them under this Regulation shall be kept at the disposal of the notifying authority for a period of five years from the termination date of the subcontracting.

ai_act/art/34.action: verify the conformity of high-risk AI systems in accordance with the conformity assessment procedures set out in Article 43.
ai_act/art/34.span: Notified bodies shall verify the conformity of high-risk AI systems in accordance with the conformity assessment procedures set out in Article 43.

ai_act/art/34.action: avoid unnecessary burdens for providers when performing their activities, and take due account of the size of the provider, the sector in which it operates, its structure and the degree of complexity of the high-risk AI system concerned, in particular in view of minimising administrative burdens and compliance costs for micro- and small enterprises within the meaning of Recommendation 2003/361/EC.
ai_act/art/34.span: Notified bodies shall avoid unnecessary burdens for providers when performing their activities, and take due account of the size of the provider, the sector in which it operates, its structure and the degree of complexity of the high-risk AI system concerned, in particular in view of minimising administrative burdens and compliance costs for micro- and small enterprises within the meaning of Recommendation 2003/361/EC.

ai_act/art/34.action: , nevertheless, respect the degree of rigour and the level of protection required for the compliance of the high-risk AI system with the requirements of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/34.span: The notified body shall, nevertheless, respect the degree of rigour and the level of protection required for the compliance of the high-risk AI system with the requirements of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/34.action: make available and submit upon request all relevant documentation, including the providers’ documentation, to the notifying authority referred to in Article 28 to allow that authority to conduct its assessment, designation, notification and monitoring activities, and to facilitate the assessment outlined in this Section.
ai_act/art/34.span: Notified bodies shall make available and submit upon request all relevant documentation, including the providers’ documentation, to the notifying authority referred to in Article 28 to allow that authority to conduct its assessment, designation, notification and monitoring activities, and to facilitate the assessment outlined in this Section.

ai_act/art/35.action: assign a single identification number to each notified body, even where a body is notified under more than one Union act.
ai_act/art/35.span: The Commission shall assign a single identification number to each notified body, even where a body is notified under more than one Union act.

ai_act/art/35.action: make publicly available the list of the bodies notified under this Regulation, including their identification numbers and the activities for which they have been notified.
ai_act/art/35.span: The Commission shall make publicly available the list of the bodies notified under this Regulation, including their identification numbers and the activities for which they have been notified.

ai_act/art/35.action: ensure that the list is kept up to date.
ai_act/art/35.span: The Commission shall ensure that the list is kept up to date.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: The notifying authority
ai_act/art/36.action: notify the Commission and the other Member States of any relevant changes to the notification of a notified body via the electronic notification tool referred to in Article 30(2).
ai_act/art/36.span: The notifying authority shall notify the Commission and the other Member States of any relevant changes to the notification of a notified body via the electronic notification tool referred to in Article 30(2).

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: The procedures laid down in Articles 29 and 30
ai_act/art/36.action: apply to extensions of the scope of the notification.
ai_act/art/36.span: The procedures laid down in Articles 29 and 30 shall apply to extensions of the scope of the notification.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: For changes to the notification other than extensions of its scope, the procedures laid down in paragraphs (3) to (9)
ai_act/art/36.action: apply.
ai_act/art/36.span: For changes to the notification other than extensions of its scope, the procedures laid down in paragraphs (3) to (9) shall apply.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: it
ai_act/art/36.condition: Where a notified body decides to cease its conformity assessment activities
ai_act/art/36.action: inform the notifying authority and the providers concerned as soon as possible and, in the case of a planned cessation, at least one year before ceasing its activities.
ai_act/art/36.span: Where a notified body decides to cease its conformity assessment activities, it shall inform the notifying authority and the providers concerned as soon as possible and, in the case of a planned cessation, at least one year before ceasing its activities.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: The certificates of the notified body
ai_act/art/36.action: remain valid for a period of nine months after cessation of the notified body’s activities, on condition that another notified body has confirmed in writing that it will assume responsibilities for the high-risk AI systems covered by those certificates.
ai_act/art/36.timing: for a period of nine months after cessation of the notified body’s activities
ai_act/art/36.span: The certificates of the notified body may remain valid for a period of nine months after cessation of the notified body’s activities, on condition that another notified body has confirmed in writing that it will assume responsibilities for the high-risk AI systems covered by those certificates.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: The latter notified body
ai_act/art/36.action: complete a full assessment of the high-risk AI systems affected by the end of that nine-month-period before issuing new certificates for those systems.
ai_act/art/36.span: The latter notified body shall complete a full assessment of the high-risk AI systems affected by the end of that nine-month-period before issuing new certificates for those systems.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: the notifying authority
ai_act/art/36.condition: Where the notified body has ceased its activity
ai_act/art/36.action: withdraw the designation.
ai_act/art/36.span: Where the notified body has ceased its activity, the notifying authority shall withdraw the designation.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: the notifying authority
ai_act/art/36.condition: Where a notifying authority has sufficient reason to consider that a notified body no longer meets the requirements laid down in Article 31, or that it is failing to fulfil its obligations
ai_act/art/36.action: without delay investigate the matter with the utmost diligence.
ai_act/art/36.span: Where a notifying authority has sufficient reason to consider that a notified body no longer meets the requirements laid down in Article 31, or that it is failing to fulfil its obligations, the notifying authority shall without delay investigate the matter with the utmost diligence.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: In that context, it
ai_act/art/36.action: inform the notified body concerned about the objections raised and give it the possibility to make its views known.
ai_act/art/36.span: In that context, it shall inform the notified body concerned about the objections raised and give it the possibility to make its views known.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: it
ai_act/art/36.condition: If the notifying authority comes to the conclusion that the notified body no longer meets the requirements laid down in Article 31 or that it is failing to fulfil its obligations
ai_act/art/36.action: restrict, suspend or withdraw the designation as appropriate, depending on the seriousness of the failure to meet those requirements or fulfil those obligations.
ai_act/art/36.span: If the notifying authority comes to the conclusion that the notified body no longer meets the requirements laid down in Article 31 or that it is failing to fulfil its obligations, it shall restrict, suspend or withdraw the designation as appropriate, depending on the seriousness of the failure to meet those requirements or fulfil those obligations.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: It
ai_act/art/36.action: immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States accordingly.
ai_act/art/36.span: It shall immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States accordingly.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: the notified body
ai_act/art/36.condition: Where its designation has been suspended, restricted, or fully or partially withdrawn
ai_act/art/36.action: inform the providers concerned within 10 days.
ai_act/art/36.span: Where its designation has been suspended, restricted, or fully or partially withdrawn, the notified body shall inform the providers concerned within 10 days.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: In the event of the restriction, suspension or withdrawal of a designation, the notifying authority
ai_act/art/36.action: take appropriate steps to ensure that the files of the notified body concerned are kept, and to make them available to notifying authorities in other Member States and to market surveillance authorities at their request.
ai_act/art/36.span: In the event of the restriction, suspension or withdrawal of a designation, the notifying authority shall take appropriate steps to ensure that the files of the notified body concerned are kept, and to make them available to notifying authorities in other Member States and to market surveillance authorities at their request.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: In the event of the restriction, suspension or withdrawal of a designation, the notifying authority
ai_act/art/36.action: — assess the impact on the certificates issued by the notified body;
ai_act/art/36.span: assess the impact on the certificates issued by the notified body;

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: In the event of the restriction, suspension or withdrawal of a designation, the notifying authority
ai_act/art/36.action: — submit a report on its findings to the Commission and the other Member States within three months of having notified the changes to the designation;
ai_act/art/36.span: submit a report on its findings to the Commission and the other Member States within three months of having notified the changes to the designation;

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: In the event of the restriction, suspension or withdrawal of a designation, the notifying authority
ai_act/art/36.action: — require the notified body to suspend or withdraw, within a reasonable period of time determined by the authority, any certificates which were unduly issued, in order to ensure the continuing conformity of high-risk AI systems on the market;
ai_act/art/36.span: require the notified body to suspend or withdraw, within a reasonable period of time determined by the authority, any certificates which were unduly issued, in order to ensure the continuing conformity of high-risk AI systems on the market;

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: In the event of the restriction, suspension or withdrawal of a designation, the notifying authority
ai_act/art/36.action: — inform the Commission and the Member States about certificates the suspension or withdrawal of which it has required;
ai_act/art/36.span: inform the Commission and the Member States about certificates the suspension or withdrawal of which it has required;

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: provide the national competent authorities of the Member State in which the provider has its registered place of business with all relevant information about the certificates of which it has required the suspension or withdrawal; that authority
ai_act/art/36.action: take the appropriate measures, where necessary, to avoid a potential risk to health, safety or fundamental rights.
ai_act/art/36.span: provide the national competent authorities of the Member State in which the provider has its registered place of business with all relevant information about the certificates of which it has required the suspension or withdrawal; that authority shall take the appropriate measures, where necessary, to avoid a potential risk to health, safety or fundamental rights.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: With the exception of certificates unduly issued, and where a designation has been suspended or restricted, the certificates
ai_act/art/36.action: remain valid in one of the following circumstances — the notifying authority has confirmed, within one month of the suspension or restriction, that there is no risk to health, safety or fundamental rights in relation to certificates affected by the suspension or restriction, and the notifying authority has outlined a timeline for actions to remedy the suspension or restriction; or
ai_act/art/36.span: the notifying authority has confirmed, within one month of the suspension or restriction, that there is no risk to health, safety or fundamental rights in relation to certificates affected by the suspension or restriction, and the notifying authority has outlined a timeline for actions to remedy the suspension or restriction; or

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: the notifying authority has confirmed that no certificates relevant to the suspension will be issued, amended or re-issued during the course of the suspension or restriction, and states whether the notified body has the capability of continuing to monitor and remain responsible for existing certificates issued for the period of the suspension or restriction; in the event that the notifying authority determines that the notified body does not have the capability to support existing certificates issued, the provider of the system covered by the certificate
ai_act/art/36.action: confirm in writing to the national competent authorities of the Member State in which it has its registered place of business, within three months of the suspension or restriction, that another qualified notified body is temporarily assuming the functions of the notified body to monitor and remain responsible for the certificates during the period of suspension or restriction.
ai_act/art/36.span: the notifying authority has confirmed that no certificates relevant to the suspension will be issued, amended or re-issued during the course of the suspension or restriction, and states whether the notified body has the capability of continuing to monitor and remain responsible for existing certificates issued for the period of the suspension or restriction; in the event that the notifying authority determines that the notified body does not have the capability to support existing certificates issued, the provider of the system covered by the certificate shall confirm in writing to the national competent authorities of the Member State in which it has its registered place of business, within three months of the suspension or restriction, that another qualified notified body is temporarily assuming the functions of the notified body to monitor and remain responsible for the certificates during the period of suspension or restriction.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: With the exception of certificates unduly issued, and where a designation has been withdrawn, the certificates
ai_act/art/36.action: remain valid for a period of nine months under the following circumstances — the national competent authority of the Member State in which the provider of the high-risk AI system covered by the certificate has its registered place of business has confirmed that there is no risk to health, safety or fundamental rights associated with the high-risk AI systems concerned; and
ai_act/art/36.timing: for a period of nine months under the following circumstances — the national competent authority of the Member State in which the provider of the high-risk AI system covered by the certificate has its registered place of business has confirmed that there is no risk to health
ai_act/art/36.span: the national competent authority of the Member State in which the provider of the high-risk AI system covered by the certificate has its registered place of business has confirmed that there is no risk to health, safety or fundamental rights associated with the high-risk AI systems concerned; and

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: With the exception of certificates unduly issued, and where a designation has been withdrawn, the certificates
ai_act/art/36.action: remain valid for a period of nine months under the following circumstances — another notified body has confirmed in writing that it will assume immediate responsibility for those AI systems and completes its assessment within 12 months of the withdrawal of the designation.
ai_act/art/36.timing: within 12 months; for a period of nine months under the following circumstances — another notified body has confirmed in writing that it will assume immediate responsibility for those AI systems and completes its assessment within 12 months of the withdrawal of the designation
ai_act/art/36.span: another notified body has confirmed in writing that it will assume immediate responsibility for those AI systems and completes its assessment within 12 months of the withdrawal of the designation.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: In the circumstances referred to in the first subparagraph, the national competent authority of the Member State in which the provider of the system covered by the certificate has its place of business
ai_act/art/36.action: extend the provisional validity of the certificates for additional periods of three months, which shall not exceed 12 months in total.
ai_act/art/36.span: In the circumstances referred to in the first subparagraph, the national competent authority of the Member State in which the provider of the system covered by the certificate has its place of business may extend the provisional validity of the certificates for additional periods of three months, which shall not exceed 12 months in total.

ai_act/art/36.addressee_text: The national competent authority or the notified body assuming the functions of the notified body affected by the change of designation
ai_act/art/36.action: immediately inform the Commission, the other Member States and the other notified bodies thereof.
ai_act/art/36.span: The national competent authority or the notified body assuming the functions of the notified body affected by the change of designation shall immediately inform the Commission, the other Member States and the other notified bodies thereof.

ai_act/art/37.action: , where necessary, investigate all cases where there are reasons to doubt the competence of a notified body or the continued fulfilment by a notified body of the requirements laid down in Article 31 and of its applicable responsibilities.
ai_act/art/37.span: The Commission shall, where necessary, investigate all cases where there are reasons to doubt the competence of a notified body or the continued fulfilment by a notified body of the requirements laid down in Article 31 and of its applicable responsibilities.

ai_act/art/37.action: provide the Commission, on request, with all relevant information relating to the notification or the maintenance of the competence of the notified body concerned.
ai_act/art/37.span: The notifying authority shall provide the Commission, on request, with all relevant information relating to the notification or the maintenance of the competence of the notified body concerned.

ai_act/art/37.action: ensure that all sensitive information obtained in the course of its investigations pursuant to this Article is treated confidentially in accordance with Article 78.
ai_act/art/37.span: The Commission shall ensure that all sensitive information obtained in the course of its investigations pursuant to this Article is treated confidentially in accordance with Article 78.

ai_act/art/37.condition: Where the Commission ascertains that a notified body does not meet or no longer meets the requirements for its notification
ai_act/art/37.action: inform the notifying Member State accordingly and request it to take the necessary corrective measures, including the suspension or withdrawal of the notification if necessary.
ai_act/art/37.span: Where the Commission ascertains that a notified body does not meet or no longer meets the requirements for its notification, it shall inform the notifying Member State accordingly and request it to take the necessary corrective measures, including the suspension or withdrawal of the notification if necessary.

ai_act/art/37.condition: Where the Member State fails to take the necessary corrective measures
ai_act/art/37.action: , by means of an implementing act, suspend, restrict or withdraw the designation.
ai_act/art/37.span: Where the Member State fails to take the necessary corrective measures, the Commission may, by means of an implementing act, suspend, restrict or withdraw the designation.

ai_act/art/38.action: ensure that, with regard to high-risk AI systems, appropriate coordination and cooperation between notified bodies active in the conformity assessment procedures pursuant to this Regulation are put in place and properly operated in the form of a sectoral group of notified bodies.
ai_act/art/38.span: The Commission shall ensure that, with regard to high-risk AI systems, appropriate coordination and cooperation between notified bodies active in the conformity assessment procedures pursuant to this Regulation are put in place and properly operated in the form of a sectoral group of notified bodies.

ai_act/art/38.action: ensure that the bodies notified by it participate in the work of a group referred to in paragraph 1, directly or through designated representatives.
ai_act/art/38.span: Each notifying authority shall ensure that the bodies notified by it participate in the work of a group referred to in paragraph 1, directly or through designated representatives.
