ai_act/art/38.span: The Commission shall provide for the exchange of knowledge and best practices between notifying authorities.

ai_act/art/39.addressee_text: Conformity assessment bodies established under the law of a third country with which the Union has concluded an agreement
ai_act/art/39.action: be authorised to carry out the activities of notified bodies under this Regulation, provided that they meet the requirements laid down in Article 31 or they ensure an equivalent level of compliance.
ai_act/art/39.span: Conformity assessment bodies established under the law of a third country with which the Union has concluded an agreement may be authorised to carry out the activities of notified bodies under this Regulation, provided that they meet the requirements laid down in Article 31 or they ensure an equivalent level of compliance.

ai_act/art/40.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems or general-purpose AI models which are in conformity with harmonised standards or parts thereof the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012
ai_act/art/40.action: be presumed to be in conformity with the requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, with the obligations set out in of Chapter V, Sections 2 and 3, of this Regulation, to the extent that those standards cover those requirements or obligations.
ai_act/art/40.span: High-risk AI systems or general-purpose AI models which are in conformity with harmonised standards or parts thereof the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 shall be presumed to be in conformity with the requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, with the obligations set out in of Chapter V, Sections 2 and 3, of this Regulation, to the extent that those standards cover those requirements or obligations.

ai_act/art/40.condition: In accordance with Article 10 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012
ai_act/art/40.action: issue, without undue delay, standardisation requests covering all requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter and, as applicable, standardisation requests covering obligations set out in Chapter V, Sections 2 and 3, of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/40.span: In accordance with Article 10 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012, the Commission shall issue, without undue delay, standardisation requests covering all requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter and, as applicable, standardisation requests covering obligations set out in Chapter V, Sections 2 and 3, of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/40.action: also ask for deliverables on reporting and documentation processes to improve AI systems’ resource performance, such as reducing the high-risk AI system’s consumption of energy and of other resources during its lifecycle, and on the energy-efficient development of general-purpose AI models.
ai_act/art/40.span: The standardisation request shall also ask for deliverables on reporting and documentation processes to improve AI systems’ resource performance, such as reducing the high-risk AI system’s consumption of energy and of other resources during its lifecycle, and on the energy-efficient development of general-purpose AI models.

ai_act/art/40.action: consult the Board and relevant stakeholders, including the advisory forum.
ai_act/art/40.span: When preparing a standardisation request, the Commission shall consult the Board and relevant stakeholders, including the advisory forum.

ai_act/art/40.condition: When issuing a standardisation request to European standardisation organisations
ai_act/art/40.action: specify that standards have to be clear, consistent, including with the standards developed in the various sectors for products covered by the existing Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I, and aiming to ensure that high-risk AI systems or general-purpose AI models placed on the market or put into service in the Union meet the relevant requirements or obligations laid down in this Regulation.
ai_act/art/40.span: When issuing a standardisation request to European standardisation organisations, the Commission shall specify that standards have to be clear, consistent, including with the standards developed in the various sectors for products covered by the existing Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I, and aiming to ensure that high-risk AI systems or general-purpose AI models placed on the market or put into service in the Union meet the relevant requirements or obligations laid down in this Regulation.

ai_act/art/40.action: request the European standardisation organisations to provide evidence of their best efforts to fulfil the objectives referred to in the first and the second subparagraph of this paragraph in accordance with Article 24 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012.
ai_act/art/40.span: The Commission shall request the European standardisation organisations to provide evidence of their best efforts to fulfil the objectives referred to in the first and the second subparagraph of this paragraph in accordance with Article 24 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012.

ai_act/art/40.addressee_text: The participants in the standardisation process
ai_act/art/40.action: seek to promote investment and innovation in AI, including through increasing legal certainty, as well as the competitiveness and growth of the Union market, to contribute to strengthening global cooperation on standardisation and taking into account existing international standards in the field of AI that are consistent with Union values, fundamental rights and interests, and to enhance multi-stakeholder governance ensuring a balanced representation of interests and the effective participation of all relevant stakeholders in accordance with Articles 5, 6, and 7 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012.
ai_act/art/40.span: The participants in the standardisation process shall seek to promote investment and innovation in AI, including through increasing legal certainty, as well as the competitiveness and growth of the Union market, to contribute to strengthening global cooperation on standardisation and taking into account existing international standards in the field of AI that are consistent with Union values, fundamental rights and interests, and to enhance multi-stakeholder governance ensuring a balanced representation of interests and the effective participation of all relevant stakeholders in accordance with Articles 5, 6, and 7 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012.

ai_act/art/41.action: adopt, implementing acts establishing common specifications for the requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, for the obligations set out in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V where the following conditions have been fulfilled:
ai_act/art/41.span: The Commission may adopt, implementing acts establishing common specifications for the requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, for the obligations set out in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V where the following conditions have been fulfilled:

ai_act/art/41.action: adopt, implementing acts establishing common specifications for the requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, for the obligations set out in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V where the following conditions have been fulfilled — the Commission has requested, pursuant to Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012, one or more European standardisation organisations to draft a harmonised standard for the requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter, or, as applicable, for the obligations set out in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V, and:
ai_act/art/41.span: the Commission has requested, pursuant to Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012, one or more European standardisation organisations to draft a harmonised standard for the requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter, or, as applicable, for the obligations set out in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V, and:

ai_act/art/41.action: adopt, implementing acts establishing common specifications for the requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, for the obligations set out in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V where the following conditions have been fulfilled — no reference to harmonised standards covering the requirements referred to in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, the obligations referred to in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V has been published in the Official Journal of the European Union in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012, and no such reference is expected to be published within a reasonable period.
ai_act/art/41.span: no reference to harmonised standards covering the requirements referred to in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, the obligations referred to in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V has been published in the Official Journal of the European Union in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012, and no such reference is expected to be published within a reasonable period.

ai_act/art/41.action: consult the advisory forum referred to in Article 67.
ai_act/art/41.span: When drafting the common specifications, the Commission shall consult the advisory forum referred to in Article 67.

ai_act/art/41.addressee_text: The implementing acts referred to in the first subparagraph of this paragraph
ai_act/art/41.action: be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 98(2).
ai_act/art/41.span: The implementing acts referred to in the first subparagraph of this paragraph shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 98(2).

ai_act/art/41.condition: Before preparing a draft implementing act
ai_act/art/41.action: inform the committee referred to in Article 22 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 that it considers the conditions laid down in paragraph 1 of this Article to be fulfilled.
ai_act/art/41.span: Before preparing a draft implementing act, the Commission shall inform the committee referred to in Article 22 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 that it considers the conditions laid down in paragraph 1 of this Article to be fulfilled.

ai_act/art/41.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems or general-purpose AI models which are in conformity with the common specifications referred to in paragraph 1, or parts of those specifications,
ai_act/art/41.action: be presumed to be in conformity with the requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, to comply with the obligations referred to in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V, to the extent those common specifications cover those requirements or those obligations.
ai_act/art/41.span: High-risk AI systems or general-purpose AI models which are in conformity with the common specifications referred to in paragraph 1, or parts of those specifications, shall be presumed to be in conformity with the requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, to comply with the obligations referred to in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V, to the extent those common specifications cover those requirements or those obligations.

ai_act/art/41.condition: Where a harmonised standard is adopted by a European standardisation organisation and proposed to the Commission for the publication of its reference in the Official Journal of the European Union
ai_act/art/41.action: assess the harmonised standard in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012.
ai_act/art/41.span: Where a harmonised standard is adopted by a European standardisation organisation and proposed to the Commission for the publication of its reference in the Official Journal of the European Union, the Commission shall assess the harmonised standard in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012.

ai_act/art/41.condition: When reference to a harmonised standard is published in the Official Journal of the European Union
ai_act/art/41.action: repeal the implementing acts referred to in paragraph 1, or parts thereof which cover the same requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, the same obligations set out in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V.
ai_act/art/41.span: When reference to a harmonised standard is published in the Official Journal of the European Union, the Commission shall repeal the implementing acts referred to in paragraph 1, or parts thereof which cover the same requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, the same obligations set out in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V.

ai_act/art/41.condition: Where providers of high-risk AI systems or general-purpose AI models do not comply with the common specifications referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/41.action: duly justify that they have adopted technical solutions that meet the requirements referred to in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, comply with the obligations set out in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V to a level at least equivalent thereto.
ai_act/art/41.span: Where providers of high-risk AI systems or general-purpose AI models do not comply with the common specifications referred to in paragraph 1, they shall duly justify that they have adopted technical solutions that meet the requirements referred to in Section 2 of this Chapter or, as applicable, comply with the obligations set out in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V to a level at least equivalent thereto.

ai_act/art/41.condition: Where a Member State considers that a common specification does not entirely meet the requirements set out in Section 2 or, as applicable, comply with obligations set out in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V
ai_act/art/41.action: inform the Commission thereof with a detailed explanation.
ai_act/art/41.span: Where a Member State considers that a common specification does not entirely meet the requirements set out in Section 2 or, as applicable, comply with obligations set out in Sections 2 and 3 of Chapter V, it shall inform the Commission thereof with a detailed explanation.

ai_act/art/41.action: assess that information and, if appropriate, amend the implementing act establishing the common specification concerned.
ai_act/art/41.span: The Commission shall assess that information and, if appropriate, amend the implementing act establishing the common specification concerned.

ai_act/art/42.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems that have been trained and tested on data reflecting the specific geographical, behavioural, contextual or functional setting within which they are intended to be used
ai_act/art/42.action: be presumed to comply with the relevant requirements laid down in Article 10(4).
ai_act/art/42.span: High-risk AI systems that have been trained and tested on data reflecting the specific geographical, behavioural, contextual or functional setting within which they are intended to be used shall be presumed to comply with the relevant requirements laid down in Article 10(4).

ai_act/art/42.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems that have been certified or for which a statement of conformity has been issued under a cybersecurity scheme pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/881 and the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union
ai_act/art/42.action: be presumed to comply with the cybersecurity requirements set out in Article 15 of this Regulation in so far as the cybersecurity certificate or statement of conformity or parts thereof cover those requirements.
ai_act/art/42.span: High-risk AI systems that have been certified or for which a statement of conformity has been issued under a cybersecurity scheme pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/881 and the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union shall be presumed to comply with the cybersecurity requirements set out in Article 15 of this Regulation in so far as the cybersecurity certificate or statement of conformity or parts thereof cover those requirements.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems listed in point 1 of Annex III, where, in demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2, the provider has applied harmonised standards referred to in Article 40, or, where applicable, common specifications referred to in Article 41, the provider
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: opt for one of the following conformity assessment procedures based on — the internal control referred to in Annex VI; or
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: the internal control referred to in Annex VI; or

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems listed in point 1 of Annex III, where, in demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2, the provider has applied harmonised standards referred to in Article 40, or, where applicable, common specifications referred to in Article 41, the provider
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: opt for one of the following conformity assessment procedures based on — the assessment of the quality management system and the assessment of the technical documentation, with the involvement of a notified body, referred to in Annex VII.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: the assessment of the quality management system and the assessment of the technical documentation, with the involvement of a notified body, referred to in Annex VII.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: In demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2, the provider
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: follow the conformity assessment procedure set out in Annex VII where — harmonised standards referred to in Article 40 do not exist, and common specifications referred to in Article 41 are not available;
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: harmonised standards referred to in Article 40 do not exist, and common specifications referred to in Article 41 are not available;

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: In demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2, the provider
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: follow the conformity assessment procedure set out in Annex VII where — the provider has not applied, or has applied only part of, the harmonised standard;
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: the provider has not applied, or has applied only part of, the harmonised standard;

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: In demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2, the provider
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: follow the conformity assessment procedure set out in Annex VII where — the common specifications referred to in point (a) exist, but the provider has not applied them;
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: the common specifications referred to in point (a) exist, but the provider has not applied them;

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: In demonstrating the compliance of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2, the provider
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: follow the conformity assessment procedure set out in Annex VII where — one or more of the harmonised standards referred to in point (a) has been published with a restriction, and only on the part of the standard that was restricted.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: one or more of the harmonised standards referred to in point (a) has been published with a restriction, and only on the part of the standard that was restricted.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: the provider
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.condition: For the purposes of the conformity assessment procedure referred to in Annex VII
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: choose any of the notified bodies.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: For the purposes of the conformity assessment procedure referred to in Annex VII, the provider may choose any of the notified bodies.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: However, where the high-risk AI system is intended to be put into service by law enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies, the market surveillance authority referred to in Article 74(8) or (9), as applicable,
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: act as a notified body.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: However, where the high-risk AI system is intended to be put into service by law enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies, the market surveillance authority referred to in Article 74(8) or (9), as applicable, shall act as a notified body.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in points 2 to 8 of Annex III, providers
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: follow the conformity assessment procedure based on internal control as referred to in Annex VI, which does not provide for the involvement of a notified body.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: For high-risk AI systems referred to in points 2 to 8 of Annex III, providers shall follow the conformity assessment procedure based on internal control as referred to in Annex VI, which does not provide for the involvement of a notified body.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I, the provider
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: follow the relevant conformity assessment procedure as required under those legal acts.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: For high-risk AI systems covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I, the provider shall follow the relevant conformity assessment procedure as required under those legal acts.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: The requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: apply to those high-risk AI systems and shall be part of that assessment.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: The requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter shall apply to those high-risk AI systems and shall be part of that assessment.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: Points 4.3., 4.4., 4.5. and the fifth paragraph of point 4.6 of Annex VII
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: also apply.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: Points 4.3., 4.4., 4.5. and the fifth paragraph of point 4.6 of Annex VII shall also apply.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: notified bodies which have been notified under those legal acts
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.condition: For the purposes of that assessment
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: be entitled to control the conformity of the high-risk AI systems with the requirements set out in Section 2, provided that the compliance of those notified bodies with requirements laid down in Article 31(4), (5), (10) and (11) has been assessed in the context of the notification procedure under those legal acts.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: For the purposes of that assessment, notified bodies which have been notified under those legal acts shall be entitled to control the conformity of the high-risk AI systems with the requirements set out in Section 2, provided that the compliance of those notified bodies with requirements laid down in Article 31(4), (5), (10) and (11) has been assessed in the context of the notification procedure under those legal acts.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: that manufacturer
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.condition: Where a legal act listed in Section A of Annex I enables the product manufacturer to opt out from a third-party conformity assessment, provided that that manufacturer has applied all harmonised standards covering all the relevant requirements
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: use that option only if it has also applied harmonised standards or, where applicable, common specifications referred to in Article 41, covering all requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: Where a legal act listed in Section A of Annex I enables the product manufacturer to opt out from a third-party conformity assessment, provided that that manufacturer has applied all harmonised standards covering all the relevant requirements, that manufacturer may use that option only if it has also applied harmonised standards or, where applicable, common specifications referred to in Article 41, covering all requirements set out in Section 2 of this Chapter.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems that have already been subject to a conformity assessment procedure
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: undergo a new conformity assessment procedure in the event of a substantial modification, regardless of whether the modified system is intended to be further distributed or continues to be used by the current deployer.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: High-risk AI systems that have already been subject to a conformity assessment procedure shall undergo a new conformity assessment procedure in the event of a substantial modification, regardless of whether the modified system is intended to be further distributed or continues to be used by the current deployer.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems that continue to learn after being placed on the market or put into service, changes to the high-risk AI system and its performance that have been pre-determined by the provider at the moment of the initial conformity assessment and are part of the information contained in the technical documentation referred to in point 2(f) of Annex IV,
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: constitute a substantial modification.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: For high-risk AI systems that continue to learn after being placed on the market or put into service, changes to the high-risk AI system and its performance that have been pre-determined by the provider at the moment of the initial conformity assessment and are part of the information contained in the technical documentation referred to in point 2(f) of Annex IV, shall not constitute a substantial modification.

ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.addressee_text: The Commission
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.action: adopt such delegated acts taking into account the effectiveness of the conformity assessment procedure based on internal control referred to in Annex VI in preventing or minimising the risks to health and safety and protection of fundamental rights posed by such systems, as well as the availability of adequate capacities and resources among notified bodies.
ai_act/high_risk/conformity_assessment.span: The Commission shall adopt such delegated acts taking into account the effectiveness of the conformity assessment procedure based on internal control referred to in Annex VI in preventing or minimising the risks to health and safety and protection of fundamental rights posed by such systems, as well as the availability of adequate capacities and resources among notified bodies.

ai_act/art/44.addressee_text: Certificates issued by notified bodies in accordance with Annex VII
ai_act/art/44.action: be drawn-up in a language which can be easily understood by the relevant authorities in the Member State in which the notified body is established.
ai_act/art/44.span: Certificates issued by notified bodies in accordance with Annex VII shall be drawn-up in a language which can be easily understood by the relevant authorities in the Member State in which the notified body is established.

ai_act/art/44.action: be valid for the period they indicate, which shall not exceed five years for AI systems covered by Annex I, and four years for AI systems covered by Annex III.
ai_act/art/44.span: Certificates shall be valid for the period they indicate, which shall not exceed five years for AI systems covered by Annex I, and four years for AI systems covered by Annex III.

ai_act/art/44.addressee_text: At the request of the provider, the validity of a certificate
ai_act/art/44.action: be extended for further periods, each not exceeding five years for AI systems covered by Annex I, and four years for AI systems covered by Annex III, based on a re-assessment in accordance with the applicable conformity assessment procedures.
ai_act/art/44.span: At the request of the provider, the validity of a certificate may be extended for further periods, each not exceeding five years for AI systems covered by Annex I, and four years for AI systems covered by Annex III, based on a re-assessment in accordance with the applicable conformity assessment procedures.

ai_act/art/44.action: remain valid, provided that the certificate which it supplements is valid.
ai_act/art/44.span: Any supplement to a certificate shall remain valid, provided that the certificate which it supplements is valid.

ai_act/art/44.condition: Where a notified body finds that an AI system no longer meets the requirements set out in Section 2
ai_act/art/44.action: , taking account of the principle of proportionality, suspend or withdraw the certificate issued or impose restrictions on it, unless compliance with those requirements is ensured by appropriate corrective action taken by the provider of the system within an appropriate deadline set by the notified body.
ai_act/art/44.span: Where a notified body finds that an AI system no longer meets the requirements set out in Section 2, it shall, taking account of the principle of proportionality, suspend or withdraw the certificate issued or impose restrictions on it, unless compliance with those requirements is ensured by appropriate corrective action taken by the provider of the system within an appropriate deadline set by the notified body.
The notified body shall give reasons for its decision.

ai_act/art/44.addressee_text: An appeal procedure against decisions of the notified bodies, including on conformity certificates issued,
ai_act/art/44.span: An appeal procedure against decisions of the notified bodies, including on conformity certificates issued, shall be available.

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the notifying authority of the following — any Union technical documentation assessment certificates, any supplements to those certificates, and any quality management system approvals issued in accordance with the requirements of Annex VII;
ai_act/art/45.span: any Union technical documentation assessment certificates, any supplements to those certificates, and any quality management system approvals issued in accordance with the requirements of Annex VII;

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the notifying authority of the following — any refusal, restriction, suspension or withdrawal of a Union technical documentation assessment certificate or a quality management system approval issued in accordance with the requirements of Annex VII;
ai_act/art/45.span: any refusal, restriction, suspension or withdrawal of a Union technical documentation assessment certificate or a quality management system approval issued in accordance with the requirements of Annex VII;

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the notifying authority of the following — any circumstances affecting the scope of or conditions for notification;
ai_act/art/45.span: any circumstances affecting the scope of or conditions for notification;

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the notifying authority of the following — any request for information which they have received from market surveillance authorities regarding conformity assessment activities;
ai_act/art/45.span: any request for information which they have received from market surveillance authorities regarding conformity assessment activities;

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the notifying authority of the following — on request, conformity assessment activities performed within the scope of their notification and any other activity performed, including cross-border activities and subcontracting.
ai_act/art/45.span: on request, conformity assessment activities performed within the scope of their notification and any other activity performed, including cross-border activities and subcontracting.

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the other notified bodies of — quality management system approvals which it has refused, suspended or withdrawn, and, upon request, of quality system approvals which it has issued;
ai_act/art/45.span: quality management system approvals which it has refused, suspended or withdrawn, and, upon request, of quality system approvals which it has issued;

ai_act/art/45.action: inform the other notified bodies of — Union technical documentation assessment certificates or any supplements thereto which it has refused, withdrawn, suspended or otherwise restricted, and, upon request, of the certificates and/or supplements thereto which it has issued.
ai_act/art/45.span: Union technical documentation assessment certificates or any supplements thereto which it has refused, withdrawn, suspended or otherwise restricted, and, upon request, of the certificates and/or supplements thereto which it has issued.

ai_act/art/45.action: provide the other notified bodies carrying out similar conformity assessment activities covering the same types of AI systems with relevant information on issues relating to negative and, on request, positive conformity assessment results.
ai_act/art/45.span: Each notified body shall provide the other notified bodies carrying out similar conformity assessment activities covering the same types of AI systems with relevant information on issues relating to negative and, on request, positive conformity assessment results.

ai_act/art/45.action: safeguard the confidentiality of the information that they obtain, in accordance with Article 78.
ai_act/art/45.span: Notified bodies shall safeguard the confidentiality of the information that they obtain, in accordance with Article 78.

ai_act/art/46.condition: By way of derogation from Article 43 and upon a duly justified request
ai_act/art/46.action: authorise the placing on the market or the putting into service of specific high-risk AI systems within the territory of the Member State concerned, for exceptional reasons of public security or the protection of life and health of persons, environmental protection or the protection of key industrial and infrastructural assets.
ai_act/art/46.span: By way of derogation from Article 43 and upon a duly justified request, any market surveillance authority may authorise the placing on the market or the putting into service of specific high-risk AI systems within the territory of the Member State concerned, for exceptional reasons of public security or the protection of life and health of persons, environmental protection or the protection of key industrial and infrastructural assets.

ai_act/art/46.action: be for a limited period while the necessary conformity assessment procedures are being carried out, taking into account the exceptional reasons justifying the derogation.
ai_act/art/46.span: That authorisation shall be for a limited period while the necessary conformity assessment procedures are being carried out, taking into account the exceptional reasons justifying the derogation.

ai_act/art/46.action: be undertaken without undue delay.
ai_act/art/46.span: The completion of those procedures shall be undertaken without undue delay.

ai_act/art/46.addressee_text: In a duly justified situation of urgency for exceptional reasons of public security or in the case of specific, substantial and imminent threat to the life or physical safety of natural persons, law-enforcement authorities or civil protection authorities
ai_act/art/46.action: put a specific high-risk AI system into service without the authorisation referred to in paragraph 1, provided that such authorisation is requested during or after the use without undue delay.
ai_act/art/46.span: In a duly justified situation of urgency for exceptional reasons of public security or in the case of specific, substantial and imminent threat to the life or physical safety of natural persons, law-enforcement authorities or civil protection authorities may put a specific high-risk AI system into service without the authorisation referred to in paragraph 1, provided that such authorisation is requested during or after the use without undue delay.

ai_act/art/46.addressee_text: the use of the high-risk AI system
ai_act/art/46.condition: If the authorisation referred to in paragraph 1 is refused
ai_act/art/46.action: be stopped with immediate effect and all the results and outputs of such use shall be immediately discarded.
ai_act/art/46.span: If the authorisation referred to in paragraph 1 is refused, the use of the high-risk AI system shall be stopped with immediate effect and all the results and outputs of such use shall be immediately discarded.

ai_act/art/46.addressee_text: The authorisation referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/46.action: be issued only if the market surveillance authority concludes that the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements of Section 2.
ai_act/art/46.span: The authorisation referred to in paragraph 1 shall be issued only if the market surveillance authority concludes that the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements of Section 2.

ai_act/art/46.action: inform the Commission and the other Member States of any authorisation issued pursuant to paragraphs 1 and 2.
ai_act/art/46.span: The market surveillance authority shall inform the Commission and the other Member States of any authorisation issued pursuant to paragraphs 1 and 2.

ai_act/art/46.action: cover sensitive operational data in relation to the activities of law-enforcement authorities.
ai_act/art/46.span: This obligation shall not cover sensitive operational data in relation to the activities of law-enforcement authorities.

ai_act/art/46.condition: Where, within 15 calendar days of receipt of the information referred to in paragraph 3, no objection has been raised by either a Member State or the Commission in respect of an authorisation issued by a market surveillance authority of a Member State in accordance with paragraph 1
ai_act/art/46.action: be deemed justified.
ai_act/art/46.span: Where, within 15 calendar days of receipt of the information referred to in paragraph 3, no objection has been raised by either a Member State or the Commission in respect of an authorisation issued by a market surveillance authority of a Member State in accordance with paragraph 1, that authorisation shall be deemed justified.

ai_act/art/46.condition: Where, within 15 calendar days of receipt of the notification referred to in paragraph 3, objections are raised by a Member State against an authorisation issued by a market surveillance authority of another Member State, or where the Commission considers the authorisation to be contrary to Union law, or the conclusion of the Member States regarding the compliance of the system as referred to in paragraph 3 to be unfounded
ai_act/art/46.action: , without delay, enter into consultations with the relevant Member State.
ai_act/art/46.span: Where, within 15 calendar days of receipt of the notification referred to in paragraph 3, objections are raised by a Member State against an authorisation issued by a market surveillance authority of another Member State, or where the Commission considers the authorisation to be contrary to Union law, or the conclusion of the Member States regarding the compliance of the system as referred to in paragraph 3 to be unfounded, the Commission shall, without delay, enter into consultations with the relevant Member State.

ai_act/art/46.action: be consulted and have the possibility to present their views.
ai_act/art/46.span: The operators concerned shall be consulted and have the possibility to present their views.

ai_act/art/46.action: decide whether the authorisation is justified.
ai_act/art/46.span: Having regard thereto, the Commission shall decide whether the authorisation is justified.

ai_act/art/46.action: address its decision to the Member State concerned and to the relevant operators.
ai_act/art/46.span: The Commission shall address its decision to the Member State concerned and to the relevant operators.

ai_act/art/46.condition: Where the Commission considers the authorisation unjustified
ai_act/art/46.action: be withdrawn by the market surveillance authority of the Member State concerned.
ai_act/art/46.span: Where the Commission considers the authorisation unjustified, it shall be withdrawn by the market surveillance authority of the Member State concerned.

ai_act/art/46.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems related to products covered by Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I, only the derogations from the conformity assessment established in that Union harmonisation legislation
ai_act/art/46.action: apply.
ai_act/art/46.span: For high-risk AI systems related to products covered by Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I, only the derogations from the conformity assessment established in that Union harmonisation legislation shall apply.

ai_act/art/47.action: draw up a written machine readable, physical or electronically signed EU declaration of conformity for each high-risk AI system, and keep it at the disposal of the national competent authorities for 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service.
ai_act/art/47.span: The provider shall draw up a written machine readable, physical or electronically signed EU declaration of conformity for each high-risk AI system, and keep it at the disposal of the national competent authorities for 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service.

ai_act/art/47.action: identify the high-risk AI system for which it has been drawn up.
ai_act/art/47.span: The EU declaration of conformity shall identify the high-risk AI system for which it has been drawn up.

ai_act/art/47.addressee_text: A copy of the EU declaration of conformity
ai_act/art/47.action: be submitted to the relevant national competent authorities upon request.
ai_act/art/47.span: A copy of the EU declaration of conformity shall be submitted to the relevant national competent authorities upon request.

ai_act/art/47.action: state that the high-risk AI system concerned meets the requirements set out in Section 2.
ai_act/art/47.span: The EU declaration of conformity shall state that the high-risk AI system concerned meets the requirements set out in Section 2.

ai_act/art/47.action: contain the information set out in Annex V, and shall be translated into a language that can be easily understood by the national competent authorities of the Member States in which the high-risk AI system is placed on the market or made available.
ai_act/art/47.span: The EU declaration of conformity shall contain the information set out in Annex V, and shall be translated into a language that can be easily understood by the national competent authorities of the Member States in which the high-risk AI system is placed on the market or made available.

ai_act/art/47.addressee_text: a single EU declaration of conformity
ai_act/art/47.condition: Where high-risk AI systems are subject to other Union harmonisation legislation which also requires an EU declaration of conformity
ai_act/art/47.action: be drawn up in respect of all Union law applicable to the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/art/47.span: Where high-risk AI systems are subject to other Union harmonisation legislation which also requires an EU declaration of conformity, a single EU declaration of conformity shall be drawn up in respect of all Union law applicable to the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/art/47.action: contain all the information required to identify the Union harmonisation legislation to which the declaration relates.
ai_act/art/47.span: The declaration shall contain all the information required to identify the Union harmonisation legislation to which the declaration relates.

ai_act/art/47.addressee_text: By drawing up the EU declaration of conformity, the provider
ai_act/art/47.action: assume responsibility for compliance with the requirements set out in Section 2.
ai_act/art/47.span: By drawing up the EU declaration of conformity, the provider shall assume responsibility for compliance with the requirements set out in Section 2.

ai_act/art/47.action: keep the EU declaration of conformity up-to-date as appropriate.
ai_act/art/47.span: The provider shall keep the EU declaration of conformity up-to-date as appropriate.

ai_act/art/48.action: be subject to the general principles set out in Article 30 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.
ai_act/art/48.span: The CE marking shall be subject to the general principles set out in Article 30 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.

ai_act/art/48.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems provided digitally, a digital CE marking
ai_act/art/48.action: be used, only if it can easily be accessed via the interface from which that system is accessed or via an easily accessible machine-readable code or other electronic means.
ai_act/art/48.span: For high-risk AI systems provided digitally, a digital CE marking shall be used, only if it can easily be accessed via the interface from which that system is accessed or via an easily accessible machine-readable code or other electronic means.

ai_act/art/48.action: be affixed visibly, legibly and indelibly for high-risk AI systems.
ai_act/art/48.span: The CE marking shall be affixed visibly, legibly and indelibly for high-risk AI systems.

ai_act/art/48.condition: Where that is not possible or not warranted on account of the nature of the high-risk AI system
ai_act/art/48.action: be affixed to the packaging or to the accompanying documentation, as appropriate.
ai_act/art/48.span: Where that is not possible or not warranted on account of the nature of the high-risk AI system, it shall be affixed to the packaging or to the accompanying documentation, as appropriate.

ai_act/art/48.action: be followed by the identification number of the notified body responsible for the conformity assessment procedures set out in Article 43.
ai_act/art/48.span: Where applicable, the CE marking shall be followed by the identification number of the notified body responsible for the conformity assessment procedures set out in Article 43.

ai_act/art/48.addressee_text: The identification number of the notified body
ai_act/art/48.action: be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the provider or by the provider’s authorised representative.
ai_act/art/48.span: The identification number of the notified body shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the provider or by the provider’s authorised representative.

ai_act/art/48.action: also be indicated in any promotional material which mentions that the high-risk AI system fulfils the requirements for CE marking.
ai_act/art/48.span: The identification number shall also be indicated in any promotional material which mentions that the high-risk AI system fulfils the requirements for CE marking.

ai_act/art/48.condition: Where high-risk AI systems are subject to other Union law which also provides for the affixing of the CE marking
ai_act/art/48.action: indicate that the high-risk AI system also fulfil the requirements of that other law.
ai_act/art/48.span: Where high-risk AI systems are subject to other Union law which also provides for the affixing of the CE marking, the CE marking shall indicate that the high-risk AI system also fulfil the requirements of that other law.

ai_act/art/49.condition: Before placing on the market or putting into service a high-risk AI system listed in Annex III, with the exception of high-risk AI systems referred to in point 2 of Annex III, the provider or, where applicable
ai_act/art/49.action: register themselves and their system in the EU database referred to in Article 71.
ai_act/art/49.span: Before placing on the market or putting into service a high-risk AI system listed in Annex III, with the exception of high-risk AI systems referred to in point 2 of Annex III, the provider or, where applicable, the authorised representative shall register themselves and their system in the EU database referred to in Article 71.

ai_act/art/49.condition: Before placing on the market or putting into service an AI system for which the provider has concluded that it is not high-risk according to Article 6(3), that provider or, where applicable
ai_act/art/49.action: register themselves and that system in the EU database referred to in Article 71.
ai_act/art/49.span: Before placing on the market or putting into service an AI system for which the provider has concluded that it is not high-risk according to Article 6(3), that provider or, where applicable, the authorised representative shall register themselves and that system in the EU database referred to in Article 71.

ai_act/art/49.addressee_text: offices or agencies or persons acting on their behalf
ai_act/art/49.condition: Before putting into service or using a high-risk AI system listed in Annex III, with the exception of high-risk AI systems listed in point 2 of Annex III, deployers that are public authorities, Union institutions, bodies
ai_act/art/49.action: register themselves, select the system and register its use in the EU database referred to in Article 71.
ai_act/art/49.span: Before putting into service or using a high-risk AI system listed in Annex III, with the exception of high-risk AI systems listed in point 2 of Annex III, deployers that are public authorities, Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies or persons acting on their behalf shall register themselves, select the system and register its use in the EU database referred to in Article 71.

ai_act/art/49.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in points 1, 6 and 7 of Annex III, in the areas of law enforcement, migration, asylum and border control management, the registration referred to in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 of this Article
ai_act/art/49.action: be in a secure non-public section of the EU database referred to in Article 71 and shall include only the following information, as applicable, referred to in — Section A, points 1 to 10, of Annex VIII, with the exception of points 6, 8 and 9;
ai_act/art/49.span: Section A, points 1 to 10, of Annex VIII, with the exception of points 6, 8 and 9;

ai_act/art/49.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in points 1, 6 and 7 of Annex III, in the areas of law enforcement, migration, asylum and border control management, the registration referred to in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 of this Article
ai_act/art/49.action: be in a secure non-public section of the EU database referred to in Article 71 and shall include only the following information, as applicable, referred to in — Section B, points 1 to 5, and points 8 and 9 of Annex VIII;
ai_act/art/49.span: Section B, points 1 to 5, and points 8 and 9 of Annex VIII;

ai_act/art/49.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in points 1, 6 and 7 of Annex III, in the areas of law enforcement, migration, asylum and border control management, the registration referred to in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 of this Article
ai_act/art/49.action: be in a secure non-public section of the EU database referred to in Article 71 and shall include only the following information, as applicable, referred to in — Section C, points 1 to 3, of Annex VIII;
ai_act/art/49.span: Section C, points 1 to 3, of Annex VIII;

ai_act/art/49.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in points 1, 6 and 7 of Annex III, in the areas of law enforcement, migration, asylum and border control management, the registration referred to in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 of this Article
ai_act/art/49.action: be in a secure non-public section of the EU database referred to in Article 71 and shall include only the following information, as applicable, referred to in — points 1, 2, 3 and 5, of Annex IX.

ai_act/art/49.addressee_text: Only the Commission and national authorities referred to in Article 74(8)
ai_act/art/49.action: have access to the respective restricted sections of the EU database listed in the first subparagraph of this paragraph.
ai_act/art/49.span: Only the Commission and national authorities referred to in Article 74(8) shall have access to the respective restricted sections of the EU database listed in the first subparagraph of this paragraph.

ai_act/art/49.addressee_text: High-risk AI systems referred to in point 2 of Annex III
ai_act/art/49.span: High-risk AI systems referred to in point 2 of Annex III shall be registered at national level.

ai_act/art/50.action: ensure that AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons are designed and developed in such a way that the natural persons concerned are informed that they are interacting with an AI system, unless this is obvious from the point of view of a natural person who is reasonably well-informed, observant and circumspect, taking into account the circumstances and the context of use.
ai_act/art/50.span: Providers shall ensure that AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons are designed and developed in such a way that the natural persons concerned are informed that they are interacting with an AI system, unless this is obvious from the point of view of a natural person who is reasonably well-informed, observant and circumspect, taking into account the circumstances and the context of use.

ai_act/art/50.action: apply to AI systems authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offences, subject to appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of third parties, unless those systems are available for the public to report a criminal offence.
ai_act/art/50.span: This obligation shall not apply to AI systems authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offences, subject to appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of third parties, unless those systems are available for the public to report a criminal offence.

ai_act/art/50.addressee_text: Providers of AI systems, including general-purpose AI systems, generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content,
ai_act/art/50.action: ensure that the outputs of the AI system are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated.
ai_act/art/50.span: Providers of AI systems, including general-purpose AI systems, generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content, shall ensure that the outputs of the AI system are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated.

ai_act/art/50.action: ensure their technical solutions are effective, interoperable, robust and reliable as far as this is technically feasible, taking into account the specificities and limitations of various types of content, the costs of implementation and the generally acknowledged state of the art, as may be reflected in relevant technical standards.
ai_act/art/50.span: Providers shall ensure their technical solutions are effective, interoperable, robust and reliable as far as this is technically feasible, taking into account the specificities and limitations of various types of content, the costs of implementation and the generally acknowledged state of the art, as may be reflected in relevant technical standards.

ai_act/art/50.action: apply to the extent the AI systems perform an assistive function for standard editing or do not substantially alter the input data provided by the deployer or the semantics thereof, or where authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offences.
ai_act/art/50.span: This obligation shall not apply to the extent the AI systems perform an assistive function for standard editing or do not substantially alter the input data provided by the deployer or the semantics thereof, or where authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offences.

ai_act/art/50.addressee_text: Deployers of an emotion recognition system or a biometric categorisation system
ai_act/art/50.action: inform the natural persons exposed thereto of the operation of the system, and shall process the personal data in accordance with Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680, as applicable.
ai_act/art/50.span: Deployers of an emotion recognition system or a biometric categorisation system shall inform the natural persons exposed thereto of the operation of the system, and shall process the personal data in accordance with Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680, as applicable.

ai_act/art/50.action: apply to AI systems used for biometric categorisation and emotion recognition, which are permitted by law to detect, prevent or investigate criminal offences, subject to appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of third parties, and in accordance with Union law.
ai_act/art/50.span: This obligation shall not apply to AI systems used for biometric categorisation and emotion recognition, which are permitted by law to detect, prevent or investigate criminal offences, subject to appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of third parties, and in accordance with Union law.

ai_act/art/50.addressee_text: Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates image, audio or video content constituting a deep fake,
ai_act/art/50.action: disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated.
ai_act/art/50.span: Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates image, audio or video content constituting a deep fake, shall disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated.

ai_act/art/50.action: apply where the use is authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offence.
ai_act/art/50.span: This obligation shall not apply where the use is authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offence.

ai_act/art/50.addressee_text: Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates text which is published with the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest
ai_act/art/50.action: disclose that the text has been artificially generated or manipulated.
ai_act/art/50.span: Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates text which is published with the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest shall disclose that the text has been artificially generated or manipulated.

ai_act/art/50.action: apply where the use is authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offences or where the AI-generated content has undergone a process of human review or editorial control and where a natural or legal person holds editorial responsibility for the publication of the content.
ai_act/art/50.span: This obligation shall not apply where the use is authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offences or where the AI-generated content has undergone a process of human review or editorial control and where a natural or legal person holds editorial responsibility for the publication of the content.

ai_act/art/50.addressee_text: The information referred to in paragraphs 1 to 4
ai_act/art/50.action: be provided to the natural persons concerned in a clear and distinguishable manner at the latest at the time of the first interaction or exposure.
ai_act/art/50.timing: at the latest at the time of the first interaction or exposure
ai_act/art/50.span: The information referred to in paragraphs 1 to 4 shall be provided to the natural persons concerned in a clear and distinguishable manner at the latest at the time of the first interaction or exposure.

ai_act/art/50.action: conform to the applicable accessibility requirements.
ai_act/art/50.span: The information shall conform to the applicable accessibility requirements.

ai_act/art/50.action: affect the requirements and obligations set out in Chapter III, and shall be without prejudice to other transparency obligations laid down in Union or national law for deployers of AI systems.
ai_act/art/50.span: Paragraphs 1 to 4 shall not affect the requirements and obligations set out in Chapter III, and shall be without prejudice to other transparency obligations laid down in Union or national law for deployers of AI systems.

ai_act/art/50.action: encourage and facilitate the drawing up of codes of practice at Union level to facilitate the effective implementation of the obligations regarding the detection and labelling of artificially generated or manipulated content.
ai_act/art/50.span: The AI Office shall encourage and facilitate the drawing up of codes of practice at Union level to facilitate the effective implementation of the obligations regarding the detection and labelling of artificially generated or manipulated content.

ai_act/art/50.action: adopt implementing acts to approve those codes of practice in accordance with the procedure laid down in Article 56 (6).
ai_act/art/50.span: The Commission may adopt implementing acts to approve those codes of practice in accordance with the procedure laid down in Article 56 (6).

ai_act/art/50.condition: If it deems the code is not adequate
ai_act/art/50.action: adopt an implementing act specifying common rules for the implementation of those obligations in accordance with the examination procedure laid down in Article 98(2).
ai_act/art/50.span: If it deems the code is not adequate, the Commission may adopt an implementing act specifying common rules for the implementation of those obligations in accordance with the examination procedure laid down in Article 98(2).

ai_act/art/51.action: be classified as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk if it meets any of the following conditions — it has high impact capabilities evaluated on the basis of appropriate technical tools and methodologies, including indicators and benchmarks;
ai_act/art/51.span: it has high impact capabilities evaluated on the basis of appropriate technical tools and methodologies, including indicators and benchmarks;

ai_act/art/51.action: be classified as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk if it meets any of the following conditions — based on a decision of the Commission, ex officio or following a qualified alert from the scientific panel, it has capabilities or an impact equivalent to those set out in point (a) having regard to the criteria set out in Annex XIII.
ai_act/art/51.span: based on a decision of the Commission, ex officio or following a qualified alert from the scientific panel, it has capabilities or an impact equivalent to those set out in point (a) having regard to the criteria set out in Annex XIII.

ai_act/art/51.action: be presumed to have high impact capabilities pursuant to paragraph 1, point (a), when the cumulative amount of computation used for its training measured in floating point operations is greater than 10^25.
ai_act/art/51.span: A general-purpose AI model shall be presumed to have high impact capabilities pursuant to paragraph 1, point (a), when the cumulative amount of computation used for its training measured in floating point operations is greater than 10^25.

ai_act/art/51.action: adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 97 to amend the thresholds listed in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, as well as to supplement benchmarks and indicators in light of evolving technological developments, such as algorithmic improvements or increased hardware efficiency, when necessary, for these thresholds to reflect the state of the art.
ai_act/art/51.span: The Commission shall adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 97 to amend the thresholds listed in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, as well as to supplement benchmarks and indicators in light of evolving technological developments, such as algorithmic improvements or increased hardware efficiency, when necessary, for these thresholds to reflect the state of the art.

ai_act/art/52.condition: Where a general-purpose AI model meets the condition referred to in Article 51(1), point (a)
ai_act/art/52.action: notify the Commission without delay and in any event within two weeks after that requirement is met or it becomes known that it will be met.
ai_act/art/52.span: Where a general-purpose AI model meets the condition referred to in Article 51(1), point (a), the relevant provider shall notify the Commission without delay and in any event within two weeks after that requirement is met or it becomes known that it will be met.

ai_act/art/52.action: include the information necessary to demonstrate that the relevant requirement has been met.
ai_act/art/52.span: That notification shall include the information necessary to demonstrate that the relevant requirement has been met.

ai_act/art/52.condition: If the Commission becomes aware of a general-purpose AI model presenting systemic risks of which it has not been notified
ai_act/art/52.action: decide to designate it as a model with systemic risk.
ai_act/art/52.span: If the Commission becomes aware of a general-purpose AI model presenting systemic risks of which it has not been notified, it may decide to designate it as a model with systemic risk.

ai_act/art/52.addressee_text: The provider of a general-purpose AI model that meets the condition referred to in Article 51(1), point (a),
ai_act/art/52.action: present, with its notification, sufficiently substantiated arguments to demonstrate that, exceptionally, although it meets that requirement, the general-purpose AI model does not present, due to its specific characteristics, systemic risks and therefore should not be classified as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk.
ai_act/art/52.span: The provider of a general-purpose AI model that meets the condition referred to in Article 51(1), point (a), may present, with its notification, sufficiently substantiated arguments to demonstrate that, exceptionally, although it meets that requirement, the general-purpose AI model does not present, due to its specific characteristics, systemic risks and therefore should not be classified as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk.

ai_act/art/52.condition: Where the Commission concludes that the arguments submitted pursuant to paragraph 2 are not sufficiently substantiated and the relevant provider was not able to demonstrate that the general-purpose AI model does not present, due to its specific characteristics, systemic risks
ai_act/art/52.action: reject those arguments, and the general-purpose AI model shall be considered to be a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk.
ai_act/art/52.span: Where the Commission concludes that the arguments submitted pursuant to paragraph 2 are not sufficiently substantiated and the relevant provider was not able to demonstrate that the general-purpose AI model does not present, due to its specific characteristics, systemic risks, it shall reject those arguments, and the general-purpose AI model shall be considered to be a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk.

ai_act/art/52.action: designate a general-purpose AI model as presenting systemic risks, ex officio or following a qualified alert from the scientific panel pursuant to Article 90(1), point (a), on the basis of criteria set out in Annex XIII.
ai_act/art/52.span: The Commission may designate a general-purpose AI model as presenting systemic risks, ex officio or following a qualified alert from the scientific panel pursuant to Article 90(1), point (a), on the basis of criteria set out in Annex XIII.

ai_act/art/52.condition: Upon a reasoned request of a provider whose model has been designated as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk pursuant to paragraph 4
ai_act/art/52.action: take the request into account and may decide to reassess whether the general-purpose AI model can still be considered to present systemic risks on the basis of the criteria set out in Annex XIII.
ai_act/art/52.span: Upon a reasoned request of a provider whose model has been designated as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk pursuant to paragraph 4, the Commission shall take the request into account and may decide to reassess whether the general-purpose AI model can still be considered to present systemic risks on the basis of the criteria set out in Annex XIII.

ai_act/art/52.action: contain objective, detailed and new reasons that have arisen since the designation decision.
ai_act/art/52.span: Such a request shall contain objective, detailed and new reasons that have arisen since the designation decision.

ai_act/art/52.action: request reassessment at the earliest six months after the designation decision.
ai_act/art/52.span: Providers may request reassessment at the earliest six months after the designation decision.

ai_act/art/52.condition: Where the Commission, following its reassessment, decides to maintain the designation as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk
ai_act/art/52.action: request reassessment at the earliest six months after that decision.
ai_act/art/52.span: Where the Commission, following its reassessment, decides to maintain the designation as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk, providers may request reassessment at the earliest six months after that decision.

ai_act/art/53.action: — draw up and make publicly available a sufficiently detailed summary about the content used for training of the general-purpose AI model, according to a template provided by the AI Office.

ai_act/art/53.action: apply to general-purpose AI models with systemic risks.

ai_act/art/53.span: Providers of general-purpose AI models who do not adhere to an approved code of practice or do not comply with a European harmonised standard shall demonstrate alternative adequate means of compliance for assessment by the Commission.

ai_act/art/54.condition: For the purposes of this Regulation

ai_act/art/54.span: cooperate with the AI Office and competent authorities, upon a reasoned request, in any action they take in relation to the general-purpose AI model, including when the model is integrated into AI systems placed on the market or put into service in the Union.

ai_act/art/54.addressee_text: The obligation set out in this Article
ai_act/art/54.action: apply to providers of general-purpose AI models that are released under a free and open-source licence that allows for the access, usage, modification, and distribution of the model, and whose parameters, including the weights, the information on the model architecture, and the information on model usage, are made publicly available, unless the general-purpose AI models present systemic risks.
ai_act/art/54.span: The obligation set out in this Article shall not apply to providers of general-purpose AI models that are released under a free and open-source licence that allows for the access, usage, modification, and distribution of the model, and whose parameters, including the weights, the information on the model architecture, and the information on model usage, are made publicly available, unless the general-purpose AI models present systemic risks.

ai_act/art/55.addressee_text: In addition to the obligations listed in Articles 53 and 54, providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk
ai_act/art/55.action: — perform model evaluation in accordance with standardised protocols and tools reflecting the state of the art, including conducting and documenting adversarial testing of the model with a view to identifying and mitigating systemic risks;
ai_act/art/55.span: perform model evaluation in accordance with standardised protocols and tools reflecting the state of the art, including conducting and documenting adversarial testing of the model with a view to identifying and mitigating systemic risks;

ai_act/art/55.span: assess and mitigate possible systemic risks at Union level, including their sources, that may stem from the development, the placing on the market, or the use of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk;

ai_act/art/55.span: keep track of, document, and report, without undue delay, to the AI Office and, as appropriate, to national competent authorities, relevant information about serious incidents and possible corrective measures to address them;

ai_act/art/55.span: Providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risks who do not adhere to an approved code of practice or do not comply with a European harmonised standard shall demonstrate alternative adequate means of compliance for assessment by the Commission.

ai_act/art/56.action: encourage and facilitate the drawing up of codes of practice at Union level in order to contribute to the proper application of this Regulation, taking into account international approaches.

ai_act/art/56.span: the means to ensure that the information referred to in Article 53(1), points (a) and (b), is kept up to date in light of market and technological developments;

ai_act/art/56.action: aim to ensure that the codes of practice clearly set out their specific objectives and contain commitments or measures, including key performance indicators as appropriate, to ensure the achievement of those objectives, and that they take due account of the needs and interests of all interested parties, including affected persons, at Union level.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: ensure that their competent authorities establish at least one AI regulatory sandbox at national level, which shall be operational by 2 August 2026.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: provide for a controlled environment that fosters innovation and facilitates the development, training, testing and validation of innovative AI systems for a limited time before their being placed on the market or put into service pursuant to a specific sandbox plan agreed between the providers or prospective providers and the competent authority.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: AI regulatory sandboxes established under paragraph 1 shall provide for a controlled environment that fosters innovation and facilitates the development, training, testing and validation of innovative AI systems for a limited time before their being placed on the market or put into service pursuant to a specific sandbox plan agreed between the providers or prospective providers and the competent authority.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: include testing in real world conditions supervised therein.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: Such sandboxes may include testing in real world conditions supervised therein.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: Competent authorities shall provide, as appropriate, guidance, supervision and support within the AI regulatory sandbox with a view to identifying risks, in particular to fundamental rights, health and safety, testing, mitigation measures, and their effectiveness in relation to the obligations and requirements of this Regulation and, where relevant, other Union and national law supervised within the sandbox.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: The establishment of AI regulatory sandboxes
