ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: improving legal certainty to achieve regulatory compliance with this Regulation or, where relevant, other applicable Union and national law;

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: The establishment of AI regulatory sandboxes
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: aim to contribute to the following objectives — supporting the sharing of best practices through cooperation with the authorities involved in the AI regulatory sandbox;
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: supporting the sharing of best practices through cooperation with the authorities involved in the AI regulatory sandbox;

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: The establishment of AI regulatory sandboxes
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: aim to contribute to the following objectives — fostering innovation and competitiveness and facilitating the development of an AI ecosystem;
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: fostering innovation and competitiveness and facilitating the development of an AI ecosystem;

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: The establishment of AI regulatory sandboxes
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: aim to contribute to the following objectives — contributing to evidence-based regulatory learning;
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: contributing to evidence-based regulatory learning;

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: The establishment of AI regulatory sandboxes
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: aim to contribute to the following objectives — facilitating and accelerating access to the Union market for AI systems, in particular when provided by SMEs, including start-ups.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: facilitating and accelerating access to the Union market for AI systems, in particular when provided by SMEs, including start-ups.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: ensure that, to the extent the innovative AI systems involve the processing of personal data or otherwise fall under the supervisory remit of other national authorities or competent authorities providing or supporting access to data, the national data protection authorities and those other national or competent authorities are associated with the operation of the AI regulatory sandbox and involved in the supervision of those aspects to the extent of their respective tasks and powers.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: National competent authorities shall ensure that, to the extent the innovative AI systems involve the processing of personal data or otherwise fall under the supervisory remit of other national authorities or competent authorities providing or supporting access to data, the national data protection authorities and those other national or competent authorities are associated with the operation of the AI regulatory sandbox and involved in the supervision of those aspects to the extent of their respective tasks and powers.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: affect the supervisory or corrective powers of the competent authorities supervising the sandboxes, including at regional or local level.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: The AI regulatory sandboxes shall not affect the supervisory or corrective powers of the competent authorities supervising the sandboxes, including at regional or local level.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: Any significant risks to health and safety and fundamental rights identified during the development and testing of such AI systems
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: result in an adequate mitigation.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: Any significant risks to health and safety and fundamental rights identified during the development and testing of such AI systems shall result in an adequate mitigation.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: have the power to temporarily or permanently suspend the testing process, or the participation in the sandbox if no effective mitigation is possible, and shall inform the AI Office of such decision.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: National competent authorities shall have the power to temporarily or permanently suspend the testing process, or the participation in the sandbox if no effective mitigation is possible, and shall inform the AI Office of such decision.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: exercise their supervisory powers within the limits of the relevant law, using their discretionary powers when implementing legal provisions in respect of a specific AI regulatory sandbox project, with the objective of supporting innovation in AI in the Union.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: National competent authorities shall exercise their supervisory powers within the limits of the relevant law, using their discretionary powers when implementing legal provisions in respect of a specific AI regulatory sandbox project, with the objective of supporting innovation in AI in the Union.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: Providers and prospective providers participating in the AI regulatory sandbox
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: remain liable under applicable Union and national liability law for any damage inflicted on third parties as a result of the experimentation taking place in the sandbox.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: Providers and prospective providers participating in the AI regulatory sandbox shall remain liable under applicable Union and national liability law for any damage inflicted on third parties as a result of the experimentation taking place in the sandbox.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.addressee_text: However, provided that the prospective providers observe the specific plan and the terms and conditions for their participation and follow in good faith the guidance given by the national competent authority, no administrative fines
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: be imposed by the authorities for infringements of this Regulation.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: However, provided that the prospective providers observe the specific plan and the terms and conditions for their participation and follow in good faith the guidance given by the national competent authority, no administrative fines shall be imposed by the authorities for infringements of this Regulation.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.condition: Where other competent authorities responsible for other Union and national law were actively involved in the supervision of the AI system in the sandbox and provided guidance for compliance
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: be imposed regarding that law.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: Where other competent authorities responsible for other Union and national law were actively involved in the supervision of the AI system in the sandbox and provided guidance for compliance, no administrative fines shall be imposed regarding that law.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: be designed and implemented in such a way that, where relevant, they facilitate cross-border cooperation between national competent authorities.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: The AI regulatory sandboxes shall be designed and implemented in such a way that, where relevant, they facilitate cross-border cooperation between national competent authorities.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: coordinate their activities and cooperate within the framework of the Board.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: National competent authorities shall coordinate their activities and cooperate within the framework of the Board.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: inform the AI Office and the Board of the establishment of a sandbox, and may ask them for support and guidance.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: National competent authorities shall inform the AI Office and the Board of the establishment of a sandbox, and may ask them for support and guidance.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: make publicly available a list of planned and existing sandboxes and keep it up to date in order to encourage more interaction in the AI regulatory sandboxes and cross-border cooperation.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: The AI Office shall make publicly available a list of planned and existing sandboxes and keep it up to date in order to encourage more interaction in the AI regulatory sandboxes and cross-border cooperation.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: submit annual reports to the AI Office and to the Board, from one year after the establishment of the AI regulatory sandbox and every year thereafter until its termination, and a final report.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: National competent authorities shall submit annual reports to the AI Office and to the Board, from one year after the establishment of the AI regulatory sandbox and every year thereafter until its termination, and a final report.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: provide information on the progress and results of the implementation of those sandboxes, including best practices, incidents, lessons learnt and recommendations on their setup and, where relevant, on the application and possible revision of this Regulation, including its delegated and implementing acts, and on the application of other Union law supervised by the competent authorities within the sandbox.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: Those reports shall provide information on the progress and results of the implementation of those sandboxes, including best practices, incidents, lessons learnt and recommendations on their setup and, where relevant, on the application and possible revision of this Regulation, including its delegated and implementing acts, and on the application of other Union law supervised by the competent authorities within the sandbox.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: make those annual reports or abstracts thereof available to the public, online.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: The national competent authorities shall make those annual reports or abstracts thereof available to the public, online.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: , where appropriate, take the annual reports into account when exercising its tasks under this Regulation.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: The Commission shall, where appropriate, take the annual reports into account when exercising its tasks under this Regulation.

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: develop a single and dedicated interface containing all relevant information related to AI regulatory sandboxes to allow stakeholders to interact with AI regulatory sandboxes and to raise enquiries with competent authorities, and to seek non-binding guidance on the conformity of innovative products, services, business models embedding AI technologies, in accordance with Article 62(1), point (c).
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: The Commission shall develop a single and dedicated interface containing all relevant information related to AI regulatory sandboxes to allow stakeholders to interact with AI regulatory sandboxes and to raise enquiries with competent authorities, and to seek non-binding guidance on the conformity of innovative products, services, business models embedding AI technologies, in accordance with Article 62(1), point (c).

ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.action: proactively coordinate with national competent authorities, where relevant.
ai_act/innovation/regulatory_sandboxes.span: The Commission shall proactively coordinate with national competent authorities, where relevant.

ai_act/art/58.condition: In order to avoid fragmentation across the Union
ai_act/art/58.action: adopt implementing acts specifying the detailed arrangements for the establishment, development, implementation, operation and supervision of the AI regulatory sandboxes.
ai_act/art/58.span: In order to avoid fragmentation across the Union, the Commission shall adopt implementing acts specifying the detailed arrangements for the establishment, development, implementation, operation and supervision of the AI regulatory sandboxes.

ai_act/art/58.action: include common principles on the following issues — eligibility and selection criteria for participation in the AI regulatory sandbox;
ai_act/art/58.span: eligibility and selection criteria for participation in the AI regulatory sandbox;

ai_act/art/58.action: include common principles on the following issues — procedures for the application, participation, monitoring, exiting from and termination of the AI regulatory sandbox, including the sandbox plan and the exit report;
ai_act/art/58.span: procedures for the application, participation, monitoring, exiting from and termination of the AI regulatory sandbox, including the sandbox plan and the exit report;

ai_act/art/58.action: include common principles on the following issues — the terms and conditions applicable to the participants.
ai_act/art/58.span: the terms and conditions applicable to the participants.

ai_act/art/58.action: be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 98(2).
ai_act/art/58.span: Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 98(2).

ai_act/art/58.addressee_text: that AI regulatory sandboxes are open to any applying provider or prospective provider of an AI system who fulfils eligibility and selection criteria, which
ai_act/art/58.action: be transparent and fair, and that national competent authorities inform applicants of their decision within three months of the application;
ai_act/art/58.span: that AI regulatory sandboxes are open to any applying provider or prospective provider of an AI system who fulfils eligibility and selection criteria, which shall be transparent and fair, and that national competent authorities inform applicants of their decision within three months of the application;

ai_act/art/58.addressee_text: that AI regulatory sandboxes allow broad and equal access and keep up with demand for participation; providers and prospective providers
ai_act/art/58.action: also submit applications in partnerships with deployers and other relevant third parties;
ai_act/art/58.span: that AI regulatory sandboxes allow broad and equal access and keep up with demand for participation; providers and prospective providers may also submit applications in partnerships with deployers and other relevant third parties;

ai_act/art/58.addressee_text: The implementing acts referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/58.action: ensure — that the detailed arrangements for, and conditions concerning AI regulatory sandboxes support, to the best extent possible, flexibility for national competent authorities to establish and operate their AI regulatory sandboxes;
ai_act/art/58.span: that the detailed arrangements for, and conditions concerning AI regulatory sandboxes support, to the best extent possible, flexibility for national competent authorities to establish and operate their AI regulatory sandboxes;

ai_act/art/58.addressee_text: that access to the AI regulatory sandboxes is free of charge for SMEs, including start-ups, without prejudice to exceptional costs that national competent authorities
ai_act/art/58.action: recover in a fair and proportionate manner;
ai_act/art/58.span: that access to the AI regulatory sandboxes is free of charge for SMEs, including start-ups, without prejudice to exceptional costs that national competent authorities may recover in a fair and proportionate manner;

ai_act/art/58.addressee_text: The implementing acts referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/58.action: ensure — that they facilitate providers and prospective providers, by means of the learning outcomes of the AI regulatory sandboxes, in complying with conformity assessment obligations under this Regulation and the voluntary application of the codes of conduct referred to in Article 95;
ai_act/art/58.span: that they facilitate providers and prospective providers, by means of the learning outcomes of the AI regulatory sandboxes, in complying with conformity assessment obligations under this Regulation and the voluntary application of the codes of conduct referred to in Article 95;

ai_act/art/58.addressee_text: The implementing acts referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/58.action: ensure — that AI regulatory sandboxes facilitate the involvement of other relevant actors within the AI ecosystem, such as notified bodies and standardisation organisations, SMEs, including start-ups, enterprises, innovators, testing and experimentation facilities, research and experimentation labs and European Digital Innovation Hubs, centres of excellence, individual researchers, in order to allow and facilitate cooperation with the public and private sectors;
ai_act/art/58.span: that AI regulatory sandboxes facilitate the involvement of other relevant actors within the AI ecosystem, such as notified bodies and standardisation organisations, SMEs, including start-ups, enterprises, innovators, testing and experimentation facilities, research and experimentation labs and European Digital Innovation Hubs, centres of excellence, individual researchers, in order to allow and facilitate cooperation with the public and private sectors;

ai_act/art/58.addressee_text: The implementing acts referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/58.action: ensure — that procedures, processes and administrative requirements for application, selection, participation and exiting the AI regulatory sandbox are simple, easily intelligible, and clearly communicated in order to facilitate the participation of SMEs, including start-ups, with limited legal and administrative capacities and are streamlined across the Union, in order to avoid fragmentation and that participation in an AI regulatory sandbox established by a Member State, or by the European Data Protection Supervisor is mutually and uniformly recognised and carries the same legal effects across the Union;
ai_act/art/58.span: that procedures, processes and administrative requirements for application, selection, participation and exiting the AI regulatory sandbox are simple, easily intelligible, and clearly communicated in order to facilitate the participation of SMEs, including start-ups, with limited legal and administrative capacities and are streamlined across the Union, in order to avoid fragmentation and that participation in an AI regulatory sandbox established by a Member State, or by the European Data Protection Supervisor is mutually and uniformly recognised and carries the same legal effects across the Union;

ai_act/art/58.addressee_text: that participation in the AI regulatory sandbox is limited to a period that is appropriate to the complexity and scale of the project and that
ai_act/art/58.action: be extended by the national competent authority;
ai_act/art/58.span: that participation in the AI regulatory sandbox is limited to a period that is appropriate to the complexity and scale of the project and that may be extended by the national competent authority;

ai_act/art/58.addressee_text: The implementing acts referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/58.action: ensure — that AI regulatory sandboxes facilitate the development of tools and infrastructure for testing, benchmarking, assessing and explaining dimensions of AI systems relevant for regulatory learning, such as accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity, as well as measures to mitigate risks to fundamental rights and society at large.
ai_act/art/58.span: that AI regulatory sandboxes facilitate the development of tools and infrastructure for testing, benchmarking, assessing and explaining dimensions of AI systems relevant for regulatory learning, such as accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity, as well as measures to mitigate risks to fundamental rights and society at large.

ai_act/art/58.addressee_text: Prospective providers in the AI regulatory sandboxes, in particular SMEs and start-ups,
ai_act/art/58.action: be directed, where relevant, to pre-deployment services such as guidance on the implementation of this Regulation, to other value-adding services such as help with standardisation documents and certification, testing and experimentation facilities, European Digital Innovation Hubs and centres of excellence.
ai_act/art/58.span: Prospective providers in the AI regulatory sandboxes, in particular SMEs and start-ups, shall be directed, where relevant, to pre-deployment services such as guidance on the implementation of this Regulation, to other value-adding services such as help with standardisation documents and certification, testing and experimentation facilities, European Digital Innovation Hubs and centres of excellence.

ai_act/art/58.condition: Where national competent authorities consider authorising testing in real world conditions supervised within the framework of an AI regulatory sandbox to be established under this Article
ai_act/art/58.action: specifically agree the terms and conditions of such testing and, in particular, the appropriate safeguards with the participants, with a view to protecting fundamental rights, health and safety.
ai_act/art/58.span: Where national competent authorities consider authorising testing in real world conditions supervised within the framework of an AI regulatory sandbox to be established under this Article, they shall specifically agree the terms and conditions of such testing and, in particular, the appropriate safeguards with the participants, with a view to protecting fundamental rights, health and safety.

ai_act/art/58.action: cooperate with other national competent authorities with a view to ensuring consistent practices across the Union.
ai_act/art/58.span: Where appropriate, they shall cooperate with other national competent authorities with a view to ensuring consistent practices across the Union.

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: AI systems
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be developed for safeguarding substantial public interest by a public authority or another natural or legal person and in one or more of the following areas — public safety and public health, including disease detection, diagnosis prevention, control and treatment and improvement of health care systems;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: public safety and public health, including disease detection, diagnosis prevention, control and treatment and improvement of health care systems;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: AI systems
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be developed for safeguarding substantial public interest by a public authority or another natural or legal person and in one or more of the following areas — a high level of protection and improvement of the quality of the environment, protection of biodiversity, protection against pollution, green transition measures, climate change mitigation and adaptation measures;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: a high level of protection and improvement of the quality of the environment, protection of biodiversity, protection against pollution, green transition measures, climate change mitigation and adaptation measures;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: AI systems
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be developed for safeguarding substantial public interest by a public authority or another natural or legal person and in one or more of the following areas — energy sustainability;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: energy sustainability;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: AI systems
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be developed for safeguarding substantial public interest by a public authority or another natural or legal person and in one or more of the following areas — safety and resilience of transport systems and mobility, critical infrastructure and networks;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: safety and resilience of transport systems and mobility, critical infrastructure and networks;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: AI systems
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be developed for safeguarding substantial public interest by a public authority or another natural or legal person and in one or more of the following areas — efficiency and quality of public administration and public services;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: efficiency and quality of public administration and public services;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox, personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed solely for the purpose of developing, training and testing certain AI systems in the sandbox when all of the following conditions are met — the data processed are necessary for complying with one or more of the requirements referred to in Chapter III, Section 2 where those requirements cannot effectively be fulfilled by processing anonymised, synthetic or other non-personal data;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: the data processed are necessary for complying with one or more of the requirements referred to in Chapter III, Section 2 where those requirements cannot effectively be fulfilled by processing anonymised, synthetic or other non-personal data;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: there are effective monitoring mechanisms to identify if any high risks to the rights and freedoms of the data subjects, as referred to in Article 35 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and in Article 39 of Regulation (EU) 2018/1725,
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: arise during the sandbox experimentation, as well as response mechanisms to promptly mitigate those risks and, where necessary, stop the processing;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: there are effective monitoring mechanisms to identify if any high risks to the rights and freedoms of the data subjects, as referred to in Article 35 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and in Article 39 of Regulation (EU) 2018/1725, may arise during the sandbox experimentation, as well as response mechanisms to promptly mitigate those risks and, where necessary, stop the processing;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox, personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed solely for the purpose of developing, training and testing certain AI systems in the sandbox when all of the following conditions are met — any personal data to be processed in the context of the sandbox are in a functionally separate, isolated and protected data processing environment under the control of the prospective provider and only authorised persons have access to those data;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: any personal data to be processed in the context of the sandbox are in a functionally separate, isolated and protected data processing environment under the control of the prospective provider and only authorised persons have access to those data;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox, personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed solely for the purpose of developing, training and testing certain AI systems in the sandbox when all of the following conditions are met — providers can further share the originally collected data only in accordance with Union data protection law; any personal data created in the sandbox cannot be shared outside the sandbox;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: providers can further share the originally collected data only in accordance with Union data protection law; any personal data created in the sandbox cannot be shared outside the sandbox;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox, personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed solely for the purpose of developing, training and testing certain AI systems in the sandbox when all of the following conditions are met — any processing of personal data in the context of the sandbox neither leads to measures or decisions affecting the data subjects nor does it affect the application of their rights laid down in Union law on the protection of personal data;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: any processing of personal data in the context of the sandbox neither leads to measures or decisions affecting the data subjects nor does it affect the application of their rights laid down in Union law on the protection of personal data;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox, personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed solely for the purpose of developing, training and testing certain AI systems in the sandbox when all of the following conditions are met — any personal data processed in the context of the sandbox are protected by means of appropriate technical and organisational measures and deleted once the participation in the sandbox has terminated or the personal data has reached the end of its retention period;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: any personal data processed in the context of the sandbox are protected by means of appropriate technical and organisational measures and deleted once the participation in the sandbox has terminated or the personal data has reached the end of its retention period;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox, personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed solely for the purpose of developing, training and testing certain AI systems in the sandbox when all of the following conditions are met — the logs of the processing of personal data in the context of the sandbox are kept for the duration of the participation in the sandbox, unless provided otherwise by Union or national law;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: the logs of the processing of personal data in the context of the sandbox are kept for the duration of the participation in the sandbox, unless provided otherwise by Union or national law;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: In the AI regulatory sandbox, personal data lawfully collected for other purposes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be processed solely for the purpose of developing, training and testing certain AI systems in the sandbox when all of the following conditions are met — a complete and detailed description of the process and rationale behind the training, testing and validation of the AI system is kept together with the testing results as part of the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV;
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: a complete and detailed description of the process and rationale behind the training, testing and validation of the AI system is kept together with the testing results as part of the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV;

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: a short summary of the AI project developed in the sandbox, its objectives and expected results is published on the website of the competent authorities; this obligation
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: cover sensitive operational data in relation to the activities of law enforcement, border control, immigration or asylum authorities.
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: a short summary of the AI project developed in the sandbox, its objectives and expected results is published on the website of the competent authorities; this obligation shall not cover sensitive operational data in relation to the activities of law enforcement, border control, immigration or asylum authorities.

ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.addressee_text: the processing of personal data in AI regulatory sandboxes
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.condition: For the purposes of the prevention, investigation, detection or prosecution of criminal offences or the execution of criminal penalties, including safeguarding against and preventing threats to public security, under the control and responsibility of law enforcement authorities
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.action: be based on a specific Union or national law and subject to the same cumulative conditions as referred to in paragraph 1.
ai_act/innovation/sandbox_personal_data.span: For the purposes of the prevention, investigation, detection or prosecution of criminal offences or the execution of criminal penalties, including safeguarding against and preventing threats to public security, under the control and responsibility of law enforcement authorities, the processing of personal data in AI regulatory sandboxes shall be based on a specific Union or national law and subject to the same cumulative conditions as referred to in paragraph 1.

ai_act/art/60.addressee_text: Testing of high-risk AI systems in real world conditions outside AI regulatory sandboxes
ai_act/art/60.action: be conducted by providers or prospective providers of high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III, in accordance with this Article and the real-world testing plan referred to in this Article, without prejudice to the prohibitions under Article 5.
ai_act/art/60.span: Testing of high-risk AI systems in real world conditions outside AI regulatory sandboxes may be conducted by providers or prospective providers of high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III, in accordance with this Article and the real-world testing plan referred to in this Article, without prejudice to the prohibitions under Article 5.

ai_act/art/60.action: , by means of implementing acts, specify the detailed elements of the real-world testing plan.
ai_act/art/60.span: The Commission shall, by means of implementing acts, specify the detailed elements of the real-world testing plan.

ai_act/art/60.action: be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 98(2).
ai_act/art/60.span: Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 98(2).

ai_act/art/60.action: be without prejudice to Union or national law on the testing in real world conditions of high-risk AI systems related to products covered by Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I.
ai_act/art/60.span: This paragraph shall be without prejudice to Union or national law on the testing in real world conditions of high-risk AI systems related to products covered by Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I.

ai_act/art/60.action: conduct testing of high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III in real world conditions at any time before the placing on the market or the putting into service of the AI system on their own or in partnership with one or more deployers or prospective deployers.
ai_act/art/60.span: Providers or prospective providers may conduct testing of high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III in real world conditions at any time before the placing on the market or the putting into service of the AI system on their own or in partnership with one or more deployers or prospective deployers.

ai_act/art/60.addressee_text: The testing of high-risk AI systems in real world conditions under this Article
ai_act/art/60.action: be without prejudice to any ethical review that is required by Union or national law.
ai_act/art/60.span: The testing of high-risk AI systems in real world conditions under this Article shall be without prejudice to any ethical review that is required by Union or national law.

ai_act/art/60.action: conduct the testing in real world conditions only where all of the following conditions are met — the provider or prospective provider has drawn up a real-world testing plan and submitted it to the market surveillance authority in the Member State where the testing in real world conditions is to be conducted;
ai_act/art/60.span: the provider or prospective provider has drawn up a real-world testing plan and submitted it to the market surveillance authority in the Member State where the testing in real world conditions is to be conducted;

ai_act/art/60.addressee_text: the market surveillance authority in the Member State where the testing in real world conditions is to be conducted has approved the testing in real world conditions and the real-world testing plan; where the market surveillance authority has not provided an answer within 30 days, the testing in real world conditions and the real-world testing plan
ai_act/art/60.action: be understood to have been approved; where national law does not provide for a tacit approval, the testing in real world conditions shall remain subject to an authorisation;
ai_act/art/60.span: the market surveillance authority in the Member State where the testing in real world conditions is to be conducted has approved the testing in real world conditions and the real-world testing plan; where the market surveillance authority has not provided an answer within 30 days, the testing in real world conditions and the real-world testing plan shall be understood to have been approved; where national law does not provide for a tacit approval, the testing in real world conditions shall remain subject to an authorisation;
