ai_act/art/67.action: be balanced with regard to commercial and non-commercial interests and, within the category of commercial interests, with regard to SMEs and other undertakings.
ai_act/art/67.span: The membership of the advisory forum shall be balanced with regard to commercial and non-commercial interests and, within the category of commercial interests, with regard to SMEs and other undertakings.

ai_act/art/67.action: appoint the members of the advisory forum, in accordance with the criteria set out in paragraph 2, from amongst stakeholders with recognised expertise in the field of AI.
ai_act/art/67.span: The Commission shall appoint the members of the advisory forum, in accordance with the criteria set out in paragraph 2, from amongst stakeholders with recognised expertise in the field of AI.

ai_act/art/67.addressee_text: The term of office of the members of the advisory forum
ai_act/art/67.action: be two years, which may be extended by up to no more than four years.
ai_act/art/67.span: The term of office of the members of the advisory forum shall be two years, which may be extended by up to no more than four years.

ai_act/art/67.addressee_text: The Fundamental Rights Agency, ENISA, the European Committee for Standardization (CEN), the European Committee for Electrotechnical Standardization (CENELEC), and the European Telecommunications Standards Institute (ETSI)
ai_act/art/67.action: be permanent members of the advisory forum.
ai_act/art/67.span: The Fundamental Rights Agency, ENISA, the European Committee for Standardization (CEN), the European Committee for Electrotechnical Standardization (CENELEC), and the European Telecommunications Standards Institute (ETSI) shall be permanent members of the advisory forum.

ai_act/art/67.action: draw up its rules of procedure.
ai_act/art/67.span: The advisory forum shall draw up its rules of procedure.

ai_act/art/67.action: elect two co-chairs from among its members, in accordance with criteria set out in paragraph 2.
ai_act/art/67.span: It shall elect two co-chairs from among its members, in accordance with criteria set out in paragraph 2.

ai_act/art/67.addressee_text: The term of office of the co-chairs
ai_act/art/67.span: The term of office of the co-chairs shall be two years, renewable once.

ai_act/art/67.action: hold meetings at least twice a year.
ai_act/art/67.span: The advisory forum shall hold meetings at least twice a year.

ai_act/art/67.action: invite experts and other stakeholders to its meetings.
ai_act/art/67.span: The advisory forum may invite experts and other stakeholders to its meetings.

ai_act/art/67.action: prepare opinions, recommendations and written contributions at the request of the Board or the Commission.
ai_act/art/67.span: The advisory forum may prepare opinions, recommendations and written contributions at the request of the Board or the Commission.

ai_act/art/67.action: establish standing or temporary sub-groups as appropriate for the purpose of examining specific questions related to the objectives of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/67.span: The advisory forum may establish standing or temporary sub-groups as appropriate for the purpose of examining specific questions related to the objectives of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/67.action: prepare an annual report on its activities.
ai_act/art/67.span: The advisory forum shall prepare an annual report on its activities.
That report shall be made publicly available.

ai_act/art/68.action: , by means of an implementing act, make provisions on the establishment of a scientific panel of independent experts (the ‘scientific panel’) intended to support the enforcement activities under this Regulation.
ai_act/art/68.span: The Commission shall, by means of an implementing act, make provisions on the establishment of a scientific panel of independent experts (the ‘scientific panel’) intended to support the enforcement activities under this Regulation.

ai_act/art/68.action: be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 98(2).
ai_act/art/68.span: That implementing act shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 98(2).

ai_act/art/68.action: consist of experts selected by the Commission on the basis of up-to-date scientific or technical expertise in the field of AI necessary for the tasks set out in paragraph 3, and shall be able to demonstrate meeting all of the following conditions:
ai_act/art/68.span: The scientific panel shall consist of experts selected by the Commission on the basis of up-to-date scientific or technical expertise in the field of AI necessary for the tasks set out in paragraph 3, and shall be able to demonstrate meeting all of the following conditions:

ai_act/art/68.action: consist of experts selected by the Commission on the basis of up-to-date scientific or technical expertise in the field of AI necessary for the tasks set out in paragraph 3, and shall be able to demonstrate meeting all of the following conditions — having particular expertise and competence and scientific or technical expertise in the field of AI;
ai_act/art/68.span: having particular expertise and competence and scientific or technical expertise in the field of AI;

ai_act/art/68.action: consist of experts selected by the Commission on the basis of up-to-date scientific or technical expertise in the field of AI necessary for the tasks set out in paragraph 3, and shall be able to demonstrate meeting all of the following conditions — independence from any provider of AI systems or general-purpose AI models;
ai_act/art/68.span: independence from any provider of AI systems or general-purpose AI models;

ai_act/art/68.action: consist of experts selected by the Commission on the basis of up-to-date scientific or technical expertise in the field of AI necessary for the tasks set out in paragraph 3, and shall be able to demonstrate meeting all of the following conditions — an ability to carry out activities diligently, accurately and objectively.
ai_act/art/68.span: an ability to carry out activities diligently, accurately and objectively.

ai_act/art/68.addressee_text: The Commission, in consultation with the Board,
ai_act/art/68.action: determine the number of experts on the panel in accordance with the required needs and shall ensure fair gender and geographical representation.
ai_act/art/68.span: The Commission, in consultation with the Board, shall determine the number of experts on the panel in accordance with the required needs and shall ensure fair gender and geographical representation.

ai_act/art/68.action: advise and support the AI Office, in particular with regard to the following tasks — supporting the implementation and enforcement of this Regulation as regards general-purpose AI models and systems, in particular by:
ai_act/art/68.span: supporting the implementation and enforcement of this Regulation as regards general-purpose AI models and systems, in particular by:

ai_act/art/68.action: advise and support the AI Office, in particular with regard to the following tasks — supporting the work of market surveillance authorities, at their request;
ai_act/art/68.span: supporting the work of market surveillance authorities, at their request;

ai_act/art/68.action: advise and support the AI Office, in particular with regard to the following tasks — supporting cross-border market surveillance activities as referred to in Article 74(11), without prejudice to the powers of market surveillance authorities;
ai_act/art/68.span: supporting cross-border market surveillance activities as referred to in Article 74(11), without prejudice to the powers of market surveillance authorities;

ai_act/art/68.action: advise and support the AI Office, in particular with regard to the following tasks — supporting the AI Office in carrying out its duties in the context of the Union safeguard procedure pursuant to Article 81.
ai_act/art/68.span: supporting the AI Office in carrying out its duties in the context of the Union safeguard procedure pursuant to Article 81.

ai_act/art/68.addressee_text: The experts on the scientific panel
ai_act/art/68.action: perform their tasks with impartiality and objectivity, and shall ensure the confidentiality of information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks and activities.
ai_act/art/68.span: The experts on the scientific panel shall perform their tasks with impartiality and objectivity, and shall ensure the confidentiality of information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks and activities.

ai_act/art/68.action: neither seek nor take instructions from anyone when exercising their tasks under paragraph 3.
ai_act/art/68.span: They shall neither seek nor take instructions from anyone when exercising their tasks under paragraph 3.

ai_act/art/68.action: draw up a declaration of interests, which shall be made publicly available.
ai_act/art/68.span: Each expert shall draw up a declaration of interests, which shall be made publicly available.

ai_act/art/68.action: establish systems and procedures to actively manage and prevent potential conflicts of interest.
ai_act/art/68.span: The AI Office shall establish systems and procedures to actively manage and prevent potential conflicts of interest.

ai_act/art/68.addressee_text: The implementing act referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/68.action: include provisions on the conditions, procedures and detailed arrangements for the scientific panel and its members to issue alerts, and to request the assistance of the AI Office for the performance of the tasks of the scientific panel.
ai_act/art/68.span: The implementing act referred to in paragraph 1 shall include provisions on the conditions, procedures and detailed arrangements for the scientific panel and its members to issue alerts, and to request the assistance of the AI Office for the performance of the tasks of the scientific panel.

ai_act/art/69.action: call upon experts of the scientific panel to support their enforcement activities under this Regulation.
ai_act/art/69.span: Member States may call upon experts of the scientific panel to support their enforcement activities under this Regulation.

ai_act/art/69.action: be required to pay fees for the advice and support provided by the experts.
ai_act/art/69.span: The Member States may be required to pay fees for the advice and support provided by the experts.

ai_act/art/69.addressee_text: The structure and the level of fees as well as the scale and structure of recoverable costs
ai_act/art/69.action: be set out in the implementing act referred to in Article 68(1), taking into account the objectives of the adequate implementation of this Regulation, cost-effectiveness and the necessity of ensuring effective access to experts for all Member States.
ai_act/art/69.span: The structure and the level of fees as well as the scale and structure of recoverable costs shall be set out in the implementing act referred to in Article 68(1), taking into account the objectives of the adequate implementation of this Regulation, cost-effectiveness and the necessity of ensuring effective access to experts for all Member States.

ai_act/art/69.action: facilitate timely access to the experts by the Member States, as needed, and ensure that the combination of support activities carried out by Union AI testing support pursuant to Article 84 and experts pursuant to this Article is efficiently organised and provides the best possible added value.
ai_act/art/69.span: The Commission shall facilitate timely access to the experts by the Member States, as needed, and ensure that the combination of support activities carried out by Union AI testing support pursuant to Article 84 and experts pursuant to this Article is efficiently organised and provides the best possible added value.

ai_act/art/70.action: establish or designate as national competent authorities at least one notifying authority and at least one market surveillance authority for the purposes of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/70.span: Each Member State shall establish or designate as national competent authorities at least one notifying authority and at least one market surveillance authority for the purposes of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/70.action: exercise their powers independently, impartially and without bias so as to safeguard the objectivity of their activities and tasks, and to ensure the application and implementation of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/70.span: Those national competent authorities shall exercise their powers independently, impartially and without bias so as to safeguard the objectivity of their activities and tasks, and to ensure the application and implementation of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/70.action: refrain from any action incompatible with their duties.
ai_act/art/70.span: The members of those authorities shall refrain from any action incompatible with their duties.

ai_act/art/70.addressee_text: Provided that those principles are observed, such activities and tasks
ai_act/art/70.action: be performed by one or more designated authorities, in accordance with the organisational needs of the Member State.
ai_act/art/70.span: Provided that those principles are observed, such activities and tasks may be performed by one or more designated authorities, in accordance with the organisational needs of the Member State.

ai_act/art/70.action: communicate to the Commission the identity of the notifying authorities and the market surveillance authorities and the tasks of those authorities, as well as any subsequent changes thereto.
ai_act/art/70.span: Member States shall communicate to the Commission the identity of the notifying authorities and the market surveillance authorities and the tasks of those authorities, as well as any subsequent changes thereto.

ai_act/art/70.action: make publicly available information on how competent authorities and single points of contact can be contacted, through electronic communication means by 2 August 2025.
ai_act/art/70.span: Member States shall make publicly available information on how competent authorities and single points of contact can be contacted, through electronic communication means by 2 August 2025.

ai_act/art/70.action: designate a market surveillance authority to act as the single point of contact for this Regulation, and shall notify the Commission of the identity of the single point of contact.
ai_act/art/70.span: Member States shall designate a market surveillance authority to act as the single point of contact for this Regulation, and shall notify the Commission of the identity of the single point of contact.

ai_act/art/70.action: make a list of the single points of contact publicly available.
ai_act/art/70.span: The Commission shall make a list of the single points of contact publicly available.

ai_act/art/70.action: ensure that their national competent authorities are provided with adequate technical, financial and human resources, and with infrastructure to fulfil their tasks effectively under this Regulation.
ai_act/art/70.span: Member States shall ensure that their national competent authorities are provided with adequate technical, financial and human resources, and with infrastructure to fulfil their tasks effectively under this Regulation.

ai_act/art/70.addressee_text: In particular, the national competent authorities
ai_act/art/70.action: have a sufficient number of personnel permanently available whose competences and expertise shall include an in-depth understanding of AI technologies, data and data computing, personal data protection, cybersecurity, fundamental rights, health and safety risks and knowledge of existing standards and legal requirements.
ai_act/art/70.span: In particular, the national competent authorities shall have a sufficient number of personnel permanently available whose competences and expertise shall include an in-depth understanding of AI technologies, data and data computing, personal data protection, cybersecurity, fundamental rights, health and safety risks and knowledge of existing standards and legal requirements.

ai_act/art/70.action: assess and, if necessary, update competence and resource requirements referred to in this paragraph on an annual basis.
ai_act/art/70.span: Member States shall assess and, if necessary, update competence and resource requirements referred to in this paragraph on an annual basis.

ai_act/art/70.action: take appropriate measures to ensure an adequate level of cybersecurity.
ai_act/art/70.span: National competent authorities shall take appropriate measures to ensure an adequate level of cybersecurity.

ai_act/art/70.action: act in accordance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 78.
ai_act/art/70.span: When performing their tasks, the national competent authorities shall act in accordance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 78.

ai_act/art/70.addressee_text: By 2 August 2025, and once every two years thereafter, Member States
ai_act/art/70.action: report to the Commission on the status of the financial and human resources of the national competent authorities, with an assessment of their adequacy.
ai_act/art/70.span: By 2 August 2025, and once every two years thereafter, Member States shall report to the Commission on the status of the financial and human resources of the national competent authorities, with an assessment of their adequacy.

ai_act/art/70.action: transmit that information to the Board for discussion and possible recommendations.
ai_act/art/70.span: The Commission shall transmit that information to the Board for discussion and possible recommendations.

ai_act/art/70.action: facilitate the exchange of experience between national competent authorities.
ai_act/art/70.span: The Commission shall facilitate the exchange of experience between national competent authorities.

ai_act/art/70.action: provide guidance and advice on the implementation of this Regulation, in particular to SMEs including start-ups, taking into account the guidance and advice of the Board and the Commission, as appropriate.
ai_act/art/70.span: National competent authorities may provide guidance and advice on the implementation of this Regulation, in particular to SMEs including start-ups, taking into account the guidance and advice of the Board and the Commission, as appropriate.

ai_act/art/70.addressee_text: the national competent authorities under that Union law
ai_act/art/70.condition: Whenever national competent authorities intend to provide guidance and advice with regard to an AI system in areas covered by other Union law
ai_act/art/70.action: be consulted, as appropriate.
ai_act/art/70.span: Whenever national competent authorities intend to provide guidance and advice with regard to an AI system in areas covered by other Union law, the national competent authorities under that Union law shall be consulted, as appropriate.

ai_act/art/70.condition: Where Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies fall within the scope of this Regulation
ai_act/art/70.action: act as the competent authority for their supervision.
ai_act/art/70.span: Where Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies fall within the scope of this Regulation, the European Data Protection Supervisor shall act as the competent authority for their supervision.

ai_act/art/71.action: , in collaboration with the Member States, set up and maintain an EU database containing information referred to in paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article concerning high-risk AI systems referred to in Article 6(2) which are registered in accordance with Articles 49 and 60 and AI systems that are not considered as high-risk pursuant to Article 6(3) and which are registered in accordance with Article 6(4) and Article 49.
ai_act/art/71.span: The Commission shall, in collaboration with the Member States, set up and maintain an EU database containing information referred to in paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article concerning high-risk AI systems referred to in Article 6(2) which are registered in accordance with Articles 49 and 60 and AI systems that are not considered as high-risk pursuant to Article 6(3) and which are registered in accordance with Article 6(4) and Article 49.

ai_act/art/71.condition: When setting the functional specifications of such database
ai_act/art/71.action: consult the relevant experts, and when updating the functional specifications of such database, the Commission shall consult the Board.
ai_act/art/71.span: When setting the functional specifications of such database, the Commission shall consult the relevant experts, and when updating the functional specifications of such database, the Commission shall consult the Board.

ai_act/art/71.addressee_text: The data listed in Sections A and B of Annex VIII
ai_act/art/71.action: be entered into the EU database by the provider or, where applicable, by the authorised representative.
ai_act/art/71.span: The data listed in Sections A and B of Annex VIII shall be entered into the EU database by the provider or, where applicable, by the authorised representative.

ai_act/art/71.addressee_text: The data listed in Section C of Annex VIII
ai_act/art/71.action: be entered into the EU database by the deployer who is, or who acts on behalf of, a public authority, agency or body, in accordance with Article 49(3) and (4).
ai_act/art/71.span: The data listed in Section C of Annex VIII shall be entered into the EU database by the deployer who is, or who acts on behalf of, a public authority, agency or body, in accordance with Article 49(3) and (4).

ai_act/art/71.addressee_text: With the exception of the section referred to in Article 49(4) and Article 60(4), point (c), the information contained in the EU database registered in accordance with Article 49
ai_act/art/71.action: be accessible and publicly available in a user-friendly manner.
ai_act/art/71.span: With the exception of the section referred to in Article 49(4) and Article 60(4), point (c), the information contained in the EU database registered in accordance with Article 49 shall be accessible and publicly available in a user-friendly manner.

ai_act/art/71.addressee_text: The information registered in accordance with Article 60
ai_act/art/71.action: be accessible only to market surveillance authorities and the Commission, unless the prospective provider or provider has given consent for also making the information accessible the public.
ai_act/art/71.span: The information registered in accordance with Article 60 shall be accessible only to market surveillance authorities and the Commission, unless the prospective provider or provider has given consent for also making the information accessible the public.

ai_act/art/71.action: contain personal data only in so far as necessary for collecting and processing information in accordance with this Regulation.
ai_act/art/71.span: The EU database shall contain personal data only in so far as necessary for collecting and processing information in accordance with this Regulation.

ai_act/art/71.action: include the names and contact details of natural persons who are responsible for registering the system and have the legal authority to represent the provider or the deployer, as applicable.
ai_act/art/71.span: That information shall include the names and contact details of natural persons who are responsible for registering the system and have the legal authority to represent the provider or the deployer, as applicable.

ai_act/art/71.action: be the controller of the EU database.
ai_act/art/71.span: The Commission shall be the controller of the EU database.

ai_act/art/71.action: make available to providers, prospective providers and deployers adequate technical and administrative support.
ai_act/art/71.span: It shall make available to providers, prospective providers and deployers adequate technical and administrative support.

ai_act/art/71.action: comply with the applicable accessibility requirements.
ai_act/art/71.span: The EU database shall comply with the applicable accessibility requirements.

ai_act/art/72.action: establish and document a post-market monitoring system in a manner that is proportionate to the nature of the AI technologies and the risks of the high-risk AI system.
ai_act/art/72.span: Providers shall establish and document a post-market monitoring system in a manner that is proportionate to the nature of the AI technologies and the risks of the high-risk AI system.

ai_act/art/72.action: actively and systematically collect, document and analyse relevant data which may be provided by deployers or which may be collected through other sources on the performance of high-risk AI systems throughout their lifetime, and which allow the provider to evaluate the continuous compliance of AI systems with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2.
ai_act/art/72.span: The post-market monitoring system shall actively and systematically collect, document and analyse relevant data which may be provided by deployers or which may be collected through other sources on the performance of high-risk AI systems throughout their lifetime, and which allow the provider to evaluate the continuous compliance of AI systems with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2.

ai_act/art/72.action: include an analysis of the interaction with other AI systems.
ai_act/art/72.span: Where relevant, post-market monitoring shall include an analysis of the interaction with other AI systems.

ai_act/art/72.action: cover sensitive operational data of deployers which are law-enforcement authorities.
ai_act/art/72.span: This obligation shall not cover sensitive operational data of deployers which are law-enforcement authorities.

ai_act/art/72.action: be based on a post-market monitoring plan.
ai_act/art/72.span: The post-market monitoring system shall be based on a post-market monitoring plan.

ai_act/art/72.action: be part of the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV.
ai_act/art/72.span: The post-market monitoring plan shall be part of the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV.

ai_act/art/72.action: adopt an implementing act laying down detailed provisions establishing a template for the post-market monitoring plan and the list of elements to be included in the plan by 2 February 2026.
ai_act/art/72.span: The Commission shall adopt an implementing act laying down detailed provisions establishing a template for the post-market monitoring plan and the list of elements to be included in the plan by 2 February 2026.

ai_act/art/72.action: be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 98(2).
ai_act/art/72.span: That implementing act shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 98(2).

ai_act/art/72.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I, where a post-market monitoring system and plan are already established under that legislation, in order to ensure consistency, avoid duplications and minimise additional burdens, providers
ai_act/art/72.action: have a choice of integrating, as appropriate, the necessary elements described in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 using the template referred in paragraph 3 into systems and plans already existing under that legislation, provided that it achieves an equivalent level of protection.
ai_act/art/72.span: For high-risk AI systems covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I, where a post-market monitoring system and plan are already established under that legislation, in order to ensure consistency, avoid duplications and minimise additional burdens, providers shall have a choice of integrating, as appropriate, the necessary elements described in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 using the template referred in paragraph 3 into systems and plans already existing under that legislation, provided that it achieves an equivalent level of protection.

ai_act/art/72.addressee_text: The first subparagraph of this paragraph
ai_act/art/72.action: also apply to high-risk AI systems referred to in point 5 of Annex III placed on the market or put into service by financial institutions that are subject to requirements under Union financial services law regarding their internal governance, arrangements or processes.
ai_act/art/72.span: The first subparagraph of this paragraph shall also apply to high-risk AI systems referred to in point 5 of Annex III placed on the market or put into service by financial institutions that are subject to requirements under Union financial services law regarding their internal governance, arrangements or processes.

ai_act/art/73.addressee_text: Providers of high-risk AI systems placed on the Union market
ai_act/art/73.action: report any serious incident to the market surveillance authorities of the Member States where that incident occurred.
ai_act/art/73.span: Providers of high-risk AI systems placed on the Union market shall report any serious incident to the market surveillance authorities of the Member States where that incident occurred.

ai_act/art/73.addressee_text: The report referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/73.action: be made immediately after the provider has established a causal link between the AI system and the serious incident or the reasonable likelihood of such a link, and, in any event, not later than 15 days after the provider or, where applicable, the deployer, becomes aware of the serious incident.
ai_act/art/73.span: The report referred to in paragraph 1 shall be made immediately after the provider has established a causal link between the AI system and the serious incident or the reasonable likelihood of such a link, and, in any event, not later than 15 days after the provider or, where applicable, the deployer, becomes aware of the serious incident.

ai_act/art/73.addressee_text: The period for the reporting referred to in the first subparagraph
ai_act/art/73.action: take account of the severity of the serious incident.
ai_act/art/73.span: The period for the reporting referred to in the first subparagraph shall take account of the severity of the serious incident.

ai_act/art/73.addressee_text: the report referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article
ai_act/art/73.condition: Notwithstanding paragraph 2 of this Article, in the event of a widespread infringement or a serious incident as defined in Article 3, point (49)(b)
ai_act/art/73.action: be provided immediately, and not later than two days after the provider or, where applicable, the deployer becomes aware of that incident.
ai_act/art/73.span: Notwithstanding paragraph 2 of this Article, in the event of a widespread infringement or a serious incident as defined in Article 3, point (49)(b), the report referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be provided immediately, and not later than two days after the provider or, where applicable, the deployer becomes aware of that incident.

ai_act/art/73.condition: Notwithstanding paragraph 2, in the event of the death of a person
ai_act/art/73.action: be provided immediately after the provider or the deployer has established, or as soon as it suspects, a causal relationship between the high-risk AI system and the serious incident, but not later than 10 days after the date on which the provider or, where applicable, the deployer becomes aware of the serious incident.
ai_act/art/73.span: Notwithstanding paragraph 2, in the event of the death of a person, the report shall be provided immediately after the provider or the deployer has established, or as soon as it suspects, a causal relationship between the high-risk AI system and the serious incident, but not later than 10 days after the date on which the provider or, where applicable, the deployer becomes aware of the serious incident.

ai_act/art/73.condition: Where necessary to ensure timely reporting, the provider or, where applicable, the deployer
ai_act/art/73.action: submit an initial report that is incomplete, followed by a complete report.
ai_act/art/73.span: Where necessary to ensure timely reporting, the provider or, where applicable, the deployer, may submit an initial report that is incomplete, followed by a complete report.

ai_act/art/73.condition: Following the reporting of a serious incident pursuant to paragraph 1
ai_act/art/73.action: , without delay, perform the necessary investigations in relation to the serious incident and the AI system concerned.
ai_act/art/73.span: Following the reporting of a serious incident pursuant to paragraph 1, the provider shall, without delay, perform the necessary investigations in relation to the serious incident and the AI system concerned.

ai_act/art/73.action: include a risk assessment of the incident, and corrective action.
ai_act/art/73.span: This shall include a risk assessment of the incident, and corrective action.

ai_act/art/73.action: cooperate with the competent authorities, and where relevant with the notified body concerned, during the investigations referred to in the first subparagraph, and shall not perform any investigation which involves altering the AI system concerned in a way which may affect any subsequent evaluation of the causes of the incident, prior to informing the competent authorities of such action.
ai_act/art/73.span: The provider shall cooperate with the competent authorities, and where relevant with the notified body concerned, during the investigations referred to in the first subparagraph, and shall not perform any investigation which involves altering the AI system concerned in a way which may affect any subsequent evaluation of the causes of the incident, prior to informing the competent authorities of such action.

ai_act/art/73.condition: Upon receiving a notification related to a serious incident referred to in Article 3, point (49)(c)
ai_act/art/73.action: inform the national public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 77(1).
ai_act/art/73.span: Upon receiving a notification related to a serious incident referred to in Article 3, point (49)(c), the relevant market surveillance authority shall inform the national public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 77(1).

ai_act/art/73.action: develop dedicated guidance to facilitate compliance with the obligations set out in paragraph 1 of this Article.
ai_act/art/73.span: The Commission shall develop dedicated guidance to facilitate compliance with the obligations set out in paragraph 1 of this Article.

ai_act/art/73.action: be issued by 2 August 2025, and shall be assessed regularly.
ai_act/art/73.span: That guidance shall be issued by 2 August 2025, and shall be assessed regularly.

ai_act/art/73.action: take appropriate measures, as provided for in Article 19 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, within seven days from the date it received the notification referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, and shall follow the notification procedures as provided in that Regulation.
ai_act/art/73.span: The market surveillance authority shall take appropriate measures, as provided for in Article 19 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, within seven days from the date it received the notification referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, and shall follow the notification procedures as provided in that Regulation.

ai_act/art/73.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III that are placed on the market or put into service by providers that are subject to Union legislative instruments laying down reporting obligations equivalent to those set out in this Regulation, the notification of serious incidents
ai_act/art/73.action: be limited to those referred to in Article 3, point (49)(c).
ai_act/art/73.span: For high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III that are placed on the market or put into service by providers that are subject to Union legislative instruments laying down reporting obligations equivalent to those set out in this Regulation, the notification of serious incidents shall be limited to those referred to in Article 3, point (49)(c).

ai_act/art/73.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems which are safety components of devices, or are themselves devices, covered by Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746, the notification of serious incidents
ai_act/art/73.action: be limited to those referred to in Article 3, point (49)(c) of this Regulation, and shall be made to the national competent authority chosen for that purpose by the Member States where the incident occurred.
ai_act/art/73.span: For high-risk AI systems which are safety components of devices, or are themselves devices, covered by Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746, the notification of serious incidents shall be limited to those referred to in Article 3, point (49)(c) of this Regulation, and shall be made to the national competent authority chosen for that purpose by the Member States where the incident occurred.

ai_act/art/73.action: immediately notify the Commission of any serious incident, whether or not they have taken action on it, in accordance with Article 20 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.
ai_act/art/73.span: National competent authorities shall immediately notify the Commission of any serious incident, whether or not they have taken action on it, in accordance with Article 20 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
ai_act/art/74.action: apply to AI systems covered by this Regulation.
ai_act/art/74.span: Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 shall apply to AI systems covered by this Regulation.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: any reference to an economic operator under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
ai_act/art/74.action: be understood as including all operators identified in Article 2(1) of this Regulation;
ai_act/art/74.span: any reference to an economic operator under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 shall be understood as including all operators identified in Article 2(1) of this Regulation;

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: any reference to a product under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
ai_act/art/74.action: be understood as including all AI systems falling within the scope of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/74.span: any reference to a product under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 shall be understood as including all AI systems falling within the scope of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: As part of their reporting obligations under Article 34(4) of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, the market surveillance authorities
ai_act/art/74.action: report annually to the Commission and relevant national competition authorities any information identified in the course of market surveillance activities that may be of potential interest for the application of Union law on competition rules.
ai_act/art/74.span: As part of their reporting obligations under Article 34(4) of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, the market surveillance authorities shall report annually to the Commission and relevant national competition authorities any information identified in the course of market surveillance activities that may be of potential interest for the application of Union law on competition rules.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: They
ai_act/art/74.action: also annually report to the Commission about the use of prohibited practices that occurred during that year and about the measures taken.
ai_act/art/74.span: They shall also annually report to the Commission about the use of prohibited practices that occurred during that year and about the measures taken.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems related to products covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I, the market surveillance authority for the purposes of this Regulation
ai_act/art/74.action: be the authority responsible for market surveillance activities designated under those legal acts.
ai_act/art/74.span: For high-risk AI systems related to products covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section A of Annex I, the market surveillance authority for the purposes of this Regulation shall be the authority responsible for market surveillance activities designated under those legal acts.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: By derogation from the first subparagraph, and in appropriate circumstances, Member States
ai_act/art/74.action: designate another relevant authority to act as a market surveillance authority, provided they ensure coordination with the relevant sectoral market surveillance authorities responsible for the enforcement of the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I.
ai_act/art/74.span: By derogation from the first subparagraph, and in appropriate circumstances, Member States may designate another relevant authority to act as a market surveillance authority, provided they ensure coordination with the relevant sectoral market surveillance authorities responsible for the enforcement of the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: The procedures referred to in Articles 79 to 83 of this Regulation
ai_act/art/74.action: apply to AI systems related to products covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in section A of Annex I, where such legal acts already provide for procedures ensuring an equivalent level of protection and having the same objective.
ai_act/art/74.span: The procedures referred to in Articles 79 to 83 of this Regulation shall not apply to AI systems related to products covered by the Union harmonisation legislation listed in section A of Annex I, where such legal acts already provide for procedures ensuring an equivalent level of protection and having the same objective.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: In such cases, the relevant sectoral procedures
ai_act/art/74.action: apply instead.
ai_act/art/74.span: In such cases, the relevant sectoral procedures shall apply instead.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: market surveillance authorities
ai_act/art/74.condition: Without prejudice to the powers of market surveillance authorities under Article 14 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, for the purpose of ensuring the effective enforcement of this Regulation
ai_act/art/74.action: exercise the powers referred to in Article 14(4), points (d) and (j), of that Regulation remotely, as appropriate.
ai_act/art/74.span: Without prejudice to the powers of market surveillance authorities under Article 14 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, for the purpose of ensuring the effective enforcement of this Regulation, market surveillance authorities may exercise the powers referred to in Article 14(4), points (d) and (j), of that Regulation remotely, as appropriate.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems placed on the market, put into service, or used by financial institutions regulated by Union financial services law, the market surveillance authority for the purposes of this Regulation
ai_act/art/74.action: be the relevant national authority responsible for the financial supervision of those institutions under that legislation in so far as the placing on the market, putting into service, or the use of the AI system is in direct connection with the provision of those financial services.
ai_act/art/74.span: For high-risk AI systems placed on the market, put into service, or used by financial institutions regulated by Union financial services law, the market surveillance authority for the purposes of this Regulation shall be the relevant national authority responsible for the financial supervision of those institutions under that legislation in so far as the placing on the market, putting into service, or the use of the AI system is in direct connection with the provision of those financial services.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: another relevant authority
ai_act/art/74.condition: By way of derogation from paragraph 6, in appropriate circumstances, and provided that coordination is ensured
ai_act/art/74.action: be identified by the Member State as market surveillance authority for the purposes of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/74.span: By way of derogation from paragraph 6, in appropriate circumstances, and provided that coordination is ensured, another relevant authority may be identified by the Member State as market surveillance authority for the purposes of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: National market surveillance authorities supervising regulated credit institutions regulated under Directive 2013/36/EU, which are participating in the Single Supervisory Mechanism established by Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013, should report, without delay, to the European Central Bank any information identified in the course of their market surveillance activities that
ai_act/art/74.action: be of potential interest for the prudential supervisory tasks of the European Central Bank specified in that Regulation.
ai_act/art/74.span: National market surveillance authorities supervising regulated credit institutions regulated under Directive 2013/36/EU, which are participating in the Single Supervisory Mechanism established by Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013, should report, without delay, to the European Central Bank any information identified in the course of their market surveillance activities that may be of potential interest for the prudential supervisory tasks of the European Central Bank specified in that Regulation.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: For high-risk AI systems listed in point 1 of Annex III to this Regulation, in so far as the systems are used for law enforcement purposes, border management and justice and democracy, and for high-risk AI systems listed in points 6, 7 and 8 of Annex III to this Regulation, Member States
ai_act/art/74.action: designate as market surveillance authorities for the purposes of this Regulation either the competent data protection supervisory authorities under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 or Directive (EU) 2016/680, or any other authority designated pursuant to the same conditions laid down in Articles 41 to 44 of Directive (EU) 2016/680.
ai_act/art/74.span: For high-risk AI systems listed in point 1 of Annex III to this Regulation, in so far as the systems are used for law enforcement purposes, border management and justice and democracy, and for high-risk AI systems listed in points 6, 7 and 8 of Annex III to this Regulation, Member States shall designate as market surveillance authorities for the purposes of this Regulation either the competent data protection supervisory authorities under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 or Directive (EU) 2016/680, or any other authority designated pursuant to the same conditions laid down in Articles 41 to 44 of Directive (EU) 2016/680.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: Market surveillance activities
ai_act/art/74.action: in no way affect the independence of judicial authorities, or otherwise interfere with their activities when acting in their judicial capacity.
ai_act/art/74.span: Market surveillance activities shall in no way affect the independence of judicial authorities, or otherwise interfere with their activities when acting in their judicial capacity.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: the European Data Protection Supervisor
ai_act/art/74.condition: Where Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies fall within the scope of this Regulation
ai_act/art/74.action: act as their market surveillance authority, except in relation to the Court of Justice of the European Union acting in its judicial capacity.
ai_act/art/74.span: Where Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies fall within the scope of this Regulation, the European Data Protection Supervisor shall act as their market surveillance authority, except in relation to the Court of Justice of the European Union acting in its judicial capacity.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: Member States
ai_act/art/74.action: facilitate coordination between market surveillance authorities designated under this Regulation and other relevant national authorities or bodies which supervise the application of Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I, or in other Union law, that might be relevant for the high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III.
ai_act/art/74.span: Member States shall facilitate coordination between market surveillance authorities designated under this Regulation and other relevant national authorities or bodies which supervise the application of Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I, or in other Union law, that might be relevant for the high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: Market surveillance authorities and the Commission
ai_act/art/74.action: be able to propose joint activities, including joint investigations, to be conducted by either market surveillance authorities or market surveillance authorities jointly with the Commission, that have the aim of promoting compliance, identifying non-compliance, raising awareness or providing guidance in relation to this Regulation with respect to specific categories of high-risk AI systems that are found to present a serious risk across two or more Member States in accordance with Article 9 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.
ai_act/art/74.span: Market surveillance authorities and the Commission shall be able to propose joint activities, including joint investigations, to be conducted by either market surveillance authorities or market surveillance authorities jointly with the Commission, that have the aim of promoting compliance, identifying non-compliance, raising awareness or providing guidance in relation to this Regulation with respect to specific categories of high-risk AI systems that are found to present a serious risk across two or more Member States in accordance with Article 9 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: The AI Office
ai_act/art/74.action: provide coordination support for joint investigations.
ai_act/art/74.span: The AI Office shall provide coordination support for joint investigations.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: the market surveillance authorities
ai_act/art/74.condition: Without prejudice to the powers provided for under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, and where relevant and limited to what is necessary to fulfil their tasks
ai_act/art/74.action: be granted full access by providers to the documentation as well as the training, validation and testing data sets used for the development of high-risk AI systems, including, where appropriate and subject to security safeguards, through application programming interfaces (API) or other relevant technical means and tools enabling remote access.
ai_act/art/74.span: Without prejudice to the powers provided for under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, and where relevant and limited to what is necessary to fulfil their tasks, the market surveillance authorities shall be granted full access by providers to the documentation as well as the training, validation and testing data sets used for the development of high-risk AI systems, including, where appropriate and subject to security safeguards, through application programming interfaces (API) or other relevant technical means and tools enabling remote access.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: Market surveillance authorities
ai_act/art/74.action: be granted access to the source code of the high-risk AI system upon a reasoned request and only when both of the following conditions are fulfilled — access to source code is necessary to assess the conformity of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2; and
ai_act/art/74.span: access to source code is necessary to assess the conformity of a high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2; and

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: Market surveillance authorities
ai_act/art/74.action: be granted access to the source code of the high-risk AI system upon a reasoned request and only when both of the following conditions are fulfilled — testing or auditing procedures and verifications based on the data and documentation provided by the provider have been exhausted or proved insufficient.
ai_act/art/74.span: testing or auditing procedures and verifications based on the data and documentation provided by the provider have been exhausted or proved insufficient.

ai_act/art/74.addressee_text: Any information or documentation obtained by market surveillance authorities
ai_act/art/74.action: be treated in accordance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 78.
ai_act/art/74.span: Any information or documentation obtained by market surveillance authorities shall be treated in accordance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 78.

ai_act/art/75.condition: Where an AI system is based on a general-purpose AI model, and the model and the system are developed by the same provider
ai_act/art/75.action: have powers to monitor and supervise compliance of that AI system with obligations under this Regulation.
ai_act/art/75.span: Where an AI system is based on a general-purpose AI model, and the model and the system are developed by the same provider, the AI Office shall have powers to monitor and supervise compliance of that AI system with obligations under this Regulation.

ai_act/art/75.addressee_text: To carry out its monitoring and supervision tasks, the AI Office
ai_act/art/75.action: have all the powers of a market surveillance authority provided for in this Section and Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.
ai_act/art/75.span: To carry out its monitoring and supervision tasks, the AI Office shall have all the powers of a market surveillance authority provided for in this Section and Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.

ai_act/art/75.condition: Where the relevant market surveillance authorities have sufficient reason to consider general-purpose AI systems that can be used directly by deployers for at least one purpose that is classified as high-risk pursuant to this Regulation to be non-compliant with the requirements laid down in this Regulation
ai_act/art/75.action: cooperate with the AI Office to carry out compliance evaluations, and shall inform the Board and other market surveillance authorities accordingly.
ai_act/art/75.span: Where the relevant market surveillance authorities have sufficient reason to consider general-purpose AI systems that can be used directly by deployers for at least one purpose that is classified as high-risk pursuant to this Regulation to be non-compliant with the requirements laid down in this Regulation, they shall cooperate with the AI Office to carry out compliance evaluations, and shall inform the Board and other market surveillance authorities accordingly.

ai_act/art/75.condition: Where a market surveillance authority is unable to conclude its investigation of the high-risk AI system because of its inability to access certain information related to the general-purpose AI model despite having made all appropriate efforts to obtain that information
ai_act/art/75.action: submit a reasoned request to the AI Office, by which access to that information shall be enforced.
ai_act/art/75.span: Where a market surveillance authority is unable to conclude its investigation of the high-risk AI system because of its inability to access certain information related to the general-purpose AI model despite having made all appropriate efforts to obtain that information, it may submit a reasoned request to the AI Office, by which access to that information shall be enforced.

ai_act/art/75.addressee_text: In that case, the AI Office
ai_act/art/75.action: supply to the applicant authority without delay, and in any event within 30 days, any information that the AI Office considers to be relevant in order to establish whether a high-risk AI system is non-compliant.
ai_act/art/75.span: In that case, the AI Office shall supply to the applicant authority without delay, and in any event within 30 days, any information that the AI Office considers to be relevant in order to establish whether a high-risk AI system is non-compliant.

ai_act/art/75.action: safeguard the confidentiality of the information that they obtain in accordance with Article 78 of this Regulation.
ai_act/art/75.span: Market surveillance authorities shall safeguard the confidentiality of the information that they obtain in accordance with Article 78 of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/75.addressee_text: The procedure provided for in Chapter VI of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
ai_act/art/75.span: The procedure provided for in Chapter VI of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 shall apply mutatis mutandis.

ai_act/art/76.action: have competences and powers to ensure that testing in real world conditions is in accordance with this Regulation.
ai_act/art/76.span: Market surveillance authorities shall have competences and powers to ensure that testing in real world conditions is in accordance with this Regulation.

ai_act/art/76.condition: Where testing in real world conditions is conducted for AI systems that are supervised within an AI regulatory sandbox under Article 58
ai_act/art/76.action: verify the compliance with Article 60 as part of their supervisory role for the AI regulatory sandbox.
ai_act/art/76.span: Where testing in real world conditions is conducted for AI systems that are supervised within an AI regulatory sandbox under Article 58, the market surveillance authorities shall verify the compliance with Article 60 as part of their supervisory role for the AI regulatory sandbox.

ai_act/art/76.action: , as appropriate, allow the testing in real world conditions to be conducted by the provider or prospective provider, in derogation from the conditions set out in Article 60(4), points (f) and (g).
ai_act/art/76.span: Those authorities may, as appropriate, allow the testing in real world conditions to be conducted by the provider or prospective provider, in derogation from the conditions set out in Article 60(4), points (f) and (g).

ai_act/art/76.condition: Where a market surveillance authority has been informed by the prospective provider, the provider or any third party of a serious incident or has other grounds for considering that the conditions set out in Articles 60 and 61 are not met
ai_act/art/76.action: take either of the following decisions on its territory, as appropriate — to suspend or terminate the testing in real world conditions;
ai_act/art/76.span: to suspend or terminate the testing in real world conditions;

ai_act/art/76.condition: Where a market surveillance authority has been informed by the prospective provider, the provider or any third party of a serious incident or has other grounds for considering that the conditions set out in Articles 60 and 61 are not met
ai_act/art/76.action: take either of the following decisions on its territory, as appropriate — to require the provider or prospective provider and the deployer or prospective deployer to modify any aspect of the testing in real world conditions.
ai_act/art/76.span: to require the provider or prospective provider and the deployer or prospective deployer to modify any aspect of the testing in real world conditions.

ai_act/art/76.condition: Where a market surveillance authority has taken a decision referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article, or has issued an objection within the meaning of Article 60(4), point (b)
ai_act/art/76.action: indicate the grounds therefor and how the provider or prospective provider can challenge the decision or objection.
ai_act/art/76.span: Where a market surveillance authority has taken a decision referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article, or has issued an objection within the meaning of Article 60(4), point (b), the decision or the objection shall indicate the grounds therefor and how the provider or prospective provider can challenge the decision or objection.

ai_act/art/76.condition: Where applicable, where a market surveillance authority has taken a decision referred to in paragraph 3
ai_act/art/76.action: communicate the grounds therefor to the market surveillance authorities of other Member States in which the AI system has been tested in accordance with the testing plan.
ai_act/art/76.span: Where applicable, where a market surveillance authority has taken a decision referred to in paragraph 3, it shall communicate the grounds therefor to the market surveillance authorities of other Member States in which the AI system has been tested in accordance with the testing plan.

ai_act/art/77.addressee_text: National public authorities or bodies which supervise or enforce the respect of obligations under Union law protecting fundamental rights, including the right to non-discrimination, in relation to the use of high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III
ai_act/art/77.action: have the power to request and access any documentation created or maintained under this Regulation in accessible language and format when access to that documentation is necessary for effectively fulfilling their mandates within the limits of their jurisdiction.
ai_act/art/77.span: National public authorities or bodies which supervise or enforce the respect of obligations under Union law protecting fundamental rights, including the right to non-discrimination, in relation to the use of high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III shall have the power to request and access any documentation created or maintained under this Regulation in accessible language and format when access to that documentation is necessary for effectively fulfilling their mandates within the limits of their jurisdiction.

ai_act/art/77.addressee_text: The relevant public authority or body
ai_act/art/77.action: inform the market surveillance authority of the Member State concerned of any such request.
ai_act/art/77.span: The relevant public authority or body shall inform the market surveillance authority of the Member State concerned of any such request.

ai_act/art/77.action: identify the public authorities or bodies referred to in paragraph 1 and make a list of them publicly available.
ai_act/art/77.span: By 2 November 2024, each Member State shall identify the public authorities or bodies referred to in paragraph 1 and make a list of them publicly available.

ai_act/art/77.action: notify the list to the Commission and to the other Member States, and shall keep the list up to date.
ai_act/art/77.span: Member States shall notify the list to the Commission and to the other Member States, and shall keep the list up to date.

ai_act/art/77.addressee_text: the public authority or body referred to in paragraph 1
ai_act/art/77.condition: Where the documentation referred to in paragraph 1 is insufficient to ascertain whether an infringement of obligations under Union law protecting fundamental rights has occurred
ai_act/art/77.action: make a reasoned request to the market surveillance authority, to organise testing of the high-risk AI system through technical means.
ai_act/art/77.span: Where the documentation referred to in paragraph 1 is insufficient to ascertain whether an infringement of obligations under Union law protecting fundamental rights has occurred, the public authority or body referred to in paragraph 1 may make a reasoned request to the market surveillance authority, to organise testing of the high-risk AI system through technical means.

ai_act/art/77.action: organise the testing with the close involvement of the requesting public authority or body within a reasonable time following the request.
ai_act/art/77.span: The market surveillance authority shall organise the testing with the close involvement of the requesting public authority or body within a reasonable time following the request.

ai_act/art/77.addressee_text: Any information or documentation obtained by the national public authorities or bodies referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article pursuant to this Article
ai_act/art/77.action: be treated in accordance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 78.
ai_act/art/77.span: Any information or documentation obtained by the national public authorities or bodies referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article pursuant to this Article shall be treated in accordance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 78.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: The Commission, market surveillance authorities and notified bodies and any other natural or legal person involved in the application of this Regulation
ai_act/art/78.action: , in accordance with Union or national law, respect the confidentiality of information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks and activities in such a manner as to protect, in particular — the intellectual property rights and confidential business information or trade secrets of a natural or legal person, including source code, except in the cases referred to in Article 5 of Directive (EU) 2016/943 of the European Parliament and of the Council;
ai_act/art/78.span: the intellectual property rights and confidential business information or trade secrets of a natural or legal person, including source code, except in the cases referred to in Article 5 of Directive (EU) 2016/943 of the European Parliament and of the Council;

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: The Commission, market surveillance authorities and notified bodies and any other natural or legal person involved in the application of this Regulation
ai_act/art/78.action: , in accordance with Union or national law, respect the confidentiality of information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks and activities in such a manner as to protect, in particular — the effective implementation of this Regulation, in particular for the purposes of inspections, investigations or audits;
ai_act/art/78.span: the effective implementation of this Regulation, in particular for the purposes of inspections, investigations or audits;

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: The Commission, market surveillance authorities and notified bodies and any other natural or legal person involved in the application of this Regulation
ai_act/art/78.action: , in accordance with Union or national law, respect the confidentiality of information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks and activities in such a manner as to protect, in particular — public and national security interests;
ai_act/art/78.span: public and national security interests;

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: The Commission, market surveillance authorities and notified bodies and any other natural or legal person involved in the application of this Regulation
ai_act/art/78.action: , in accordance with Union or national law, respect the confidentiality of information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks and activities in such a manner as to protect, in particular — the conduct of criminal or administrative proceedings;
ai_act/art/78.span: the conduct of criminal or administrative proceedings;

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: The Commission, market surveillance authorities and notified bodies and any other natural or legal person involved in the application of this Regulation
ai_act/art/78.action: , in accordance with Union or national law, respect the confidentiality of information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks and activities in such a manner as to protect, in particular — information classified pursuant to Union or national law.
ai_act/art/78.span: information classified pursuant to Union or national law.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: The authorities involved in the application of this Regulation pursuant to paragraph 1
ai_act/art/78.action: request only data that is strictly necessary for the assessment of the risk posed by AI systems and for the exercise of their powers in accordance with this Regulation and with Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.
ai_act/art/78.span: The authorities involved in the application of this Regulation pursuant to paragraph 1 shall request only data that is strictly necessary for the assessment of the risk posed by AI systems and for the exercise of their powers in accordance with this Regulation and with Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: They
ai_act/art/78.action: put in place adequate and effective cybersecurity measures to protect the security and confidentiality of the information and data obtained, and shall delete the data collected as soon as it is no longer needed for the purpose for which it was obtained, in accordance with applicable Union or national law.
ai_act/art/78.span: They shall put in place adequate and effective cybersecurity measures to protect the security and confidentiality of the information and data obtained, and shall delete the data collected as soon as it is no longer needed for the purpose for which it was obtained, in accordance with applicable Union or national law.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: information exchanged on a confidential basis between the national competent authorities or between national competent authorities and the Commission
ai_act/art/78.action: be disclosed without prior consultation of the originating national competent authority and the deployer when high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1, 6 or 7 of Annex III are used by law enforcement, border control, immigration or asylum authorities and when such disclosure would jeopardise public and national security interests.
ai_act/art/78.span: Without prejudice to paragraphs 1 and 2, information exchanged on a confidential basis between the national competent authorities or between national competent authorities and the Commission shall not be disclosed without prior consultation of the originating national competent authority and the deployer when high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1, 6 or 7 of Annex III are used by law enforcement, border control, immigration or asylum authorities and when such disclosure would jeopardise public and national security interests.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: This exchange of information
ai_act/art/78.action: cover sensitive operational data in relation to the activities of law enforcement, border control, immigration or asylum authorities.
ai_act/art/78.span: This exchange of information shall not cover sensitive operational data in relation to the activities of law enforcement, border control, immigration or asylum authorities.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV
ai_act/art/78.condition: When the law enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities are providers of high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1, 6 or 7 of Annex III
ai_act/art/78.action: remain within the premises of those authorities.
ai_act/art/78.span: When the law enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities are providers of high-risk AI systems referred to in point 1, 6 or 7 of Annex III, the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV shall remain within the premises of those authorities.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: Those authorities
ai_act/art/78.action: ensure that the market surveillance authorities referred to in Article 74(8) and (9), as applicable, can, upon request, immediately access the documentation or obtain a copy thereof.
ai_act/art/78.span: Those authorities shall ensure that the market surveillance authorities referred to in Article 74(8) and (9), as applicable, can, upon request, immediately access the documentation or obtain a copy thereof.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: Only staff of the market surveillance authority holding the appropriate level of security clearance
ai_act/art/78.action: be allowed to access that documentation or any copy thereof.
ai_act/art/78.span: Only staff of the market surveillance authority holding the appropriate level of security clearance shall be allowed to access that documentation or any copy thereof.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: Paragraphs 1, 2 and 3
ai_act/art/78.action: affect the rights or obligations of the Commission, Member States and their relevant authorities, as well as those of notified bodies, with regard to the exchange of information and the dissemination of warnings, including in the context of cross-border cooperation, nor shall they affect the obligations of the parties concerned to provide information under criminal law of the Member States.
ai_act/art/78.span: Paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 shall not affect the rights or obligations of the Commission, Member States and their relevant authorities, as well as those of notified bodies, with regard to the exchange of information and the dissemination of warnings, including in the context of cross-border cooperation, nor shall they affect the obligations of the parties concerned to provide information under criminal law of the Member States.

ai_act/art/78.addressee_text: The Commission and Member States

ai_act/art/78.span: The Commission and Member States may exchange, where necessary and in accordance with relevant provisions of international and trade agreements, confidential information with regulatory authorities of third countries with which they have concluded bilateral or multilateral confidentiality arrangements guaranteeing an adequate level of confidentiality.

ai_act/art/79.condition: Where the market surveillance authority of a Member State has sufficient reason to consider an AI system to present a risk as referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article
ai_act/art/79.action: carry out an evaluation of the AI system concerned in respect of its compliance with all the requirements and obligations laid down in this Regulation.
ai_act/art/79.span: Where the market surveillance authority of a Member State has sufficient reason to consider an AI system to present a risk as referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, it shall carry out an evaluation of the AI system concerned in respect of its compliance with all the requirements and obligations laid down in this Regulation.

ai_act/art/79.action: be given to AI systems presenting a risk to vulnerable groups.
ai_act/art/79.span: Particular attention shall be given to AI systems presenting a risk to vulnerable groups.

ai_act/art/79.action: also inform and fully cooperate with the relevant national public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 77(1).
ai_act/art/79.span: Where risks to fundamental rights are identified, the market surveillance authority shall also inform and fully cooperate with the relevant national public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 77(1).

ai_act/art/79.action: cooperate as necessary with the market surveillance authority and with the other national public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 77(1).
ai_act/art/79.span: The relevant operators shall cooperate as necessary with the market surveillance authority and with the other national public authorities or bodies referred to in Article 77(1).

ai_act/art/79.condition: Where, in the course of that evaluation, the market surveillance authority or, where applicable the market surveillance authority in cooperation with the national public authority referred to in Article 77(1), finds that the AI system does not comply with the requirements and obligations laid down in this Regulation
ai_act/art/79.action: without undue delay require the relevant operator to take all appropriate corrective actions to bring the AI system into compliance, to withdraw the AI system from the market, or to recall it within a period the market surveillance authority may prescribe, and in any event within the shorter of 15 working days, or as provided for in the relevant Union harmonisation legislation.
ai_act/art/79.span: Where, in the course of that evaluation, the market surveillance authority or, where applicable the market surveillance authority in cooperation with the national public authority referred to in Article 77(1), finds that the AI system does not comply with the requirements and obligations laid down in this Regulation, it shall without undue delay require the relevant operator to take all appropriate corrective actions to bring the AI system into compliance, to withdraw the AI system from the market, or to recall it within a period the market surveillance authority may prescribe, and in any event within the shorter of 15 working days, or as provided for in the relevant Union harmonisation legislation.

ai_act/art/79.action: inform the relevant notified body accordingly.
ai_act/art/79.span: The market surveillance authority shall inform the relevant notified body accordingly.

ai_act/art/79.span: Where the operator of an AI system does not take adequate corrective action within the period referred to in paragraph 2, the market surveillance authority shall take all appropriate provisional measures to prohibit or restrict the AI system’s being made available on its national market or put into service, to withdraw the product or the standalone AI system from that market or to recall it.

ai_act/art/79.action: without undue delay notify the Commission and the other Member States of those measures.

ai_act/art/79.span: The notification referred to in paragraph 5 shall include all available details, in particular the information necessary for the identification of the non-compliant AI system, the origin of the AI system and the supply chain, the nature of the non-compliance alleged and the risk involved, the nature and duration of the national measures taken and the arguments put forward by the relevant operator.

ai_act/art/79.span: The market surveillance authorities other than the market surveillance authority of the Member State initiating the procedure shall, without undue delay, inform the Commission and the other Member States of any measures adopted and of any additional information at their disposal relating to the non-compliance of the AI system concerned, and, in the event of disagreement with the notified national measure, of their objections.

ai_act/art/79.span: The three-month period referred to in this paragraph shall be reduced to 30 days in the event of non-compliance with the prohibition of the AI practices referred to in Article 5 of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/79.action: ensure that appropriate restrictive measures are taken in respect of the product or the AI system concerned, such as withdrawal of the product or the AI system from their market, without undue delay.

ai_act/art/80.span: Where a market surveillance authority has sufficient reason to consider that an AI system classified by the provider as non-high-risk pursuant to Article 6(3) is indeed high-risk, the market surveillance authority shall carry out an evaluation of the AI system concerned in respect of its classification as a high-risk AI system based on the conditions set out in Article 6(3) and the Commission guidelines.

ai_act/art/80.condition: Where, in the course of that evaluation, the market surveillance authority finds that the AI system concerned is high-risk

ai_act/art/80.condition: Where the market surveillance authority considers that the use of the AI system concerned is not restricted to its national territory
