ai_act/art/80.span: Where the market surveillance authority considers that the use of the AI system concerned is not restricted to its national territory, it shall inform the Commission and the other Member States without undue delay of the results of the evaluation and of the actions which it has required the provider to take.

ai_act/art/80.action: ensure that all necessary action is taken to bring the AI system into compliance with the requirements and obligations laid down in this Regulation.
ai_act/art/80.span: The provider shall ensure that all necessary action is taken to bring the AI system into compliance with the requirements and obligations laid down in this Regulation.

ai_act/art/80.condition: Where the provider of an AI system concerned does not bring the AI system into compliance with those requirements and obligations within the period referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article
ai_act/art/80.action: be subject to fines in accordance with Article 99.
ai_act/art/80.span: Where the provider of an AI system concerned does not bring the AI system into compliance with those requirements and obligations within the period referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article, the provider shall be subject to fines in accordance with Article 99.

ai_act/art/80.action: ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken in respect of all the AI systems concerned that it has made available on the Union market.
ai_act/art/80.span: The provider shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken in respect of all the AI systems concerned that it has made available on the Union market.

ai_act/art/80.span: Where the provider of the AI system concerned does not take adequate corrective action within the period referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article, Article 79(5) to (9) shall apply.

ai_act/art/80.action: be subject to fines in accordance with Article 99.
ai_act/art/80.span: Where, in the course of the evaluation pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article, the market surveillance authority establishes that the AI system was misclassified by the provider as non-high-risk in order to circumvent the application of requirements in Chapter III, Section 2, the provider shall be subject to fines in accordance with Article 99.

ai_act/art/80.addressee_text: In exercising their power to monitor the application of this Article, and in accordance with Article 11 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, market surveillance authorities

ai_act/art/80.span: In exercising their power to monitor the application of this Article, and in accordance with Article 11 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, market surveillance authorities may perform appropriate checks, taking into account in particular information stored in the EU database referred to in Article 71 of this Regulation.

ai_act/art/81.condition: Where, within three months of receipt of the notification referred to in Article 79(5), or within 30 days in the case of non-compliance with the prohibition of the AI practices referred to in Article 5, objections are raised by the market surveillance authority of a Member State to a measure taken by another market surveillance authority, or where the Commission considers the measure to be contrary to Union law
ai_act/art/81.action: without undue delay enter into consultation with the market surveillance authority of the relevant Member State and the operator or operators, and shall evaluate the national measure.
ai_act/art/81.timing: within three months; within 30 days; without undue delay
ai_act/art/81.span: Where, within three months of receipt of the notification referred to in Article 79(5), or within 30 days in the case of non-compliance with the prohibition of the AI practices referred to in Article 5, objections are raised by the market surveillance authority of a Member State to a measure taken by another market surveillance authority, or where the Commission considers the measure to be contrary to Union law, the Commission shall without undue delay enter into consultation with the market surveillance authority of the relevant Member State and the operator or operators, and shall evaluate the national measure.

ai_act/art/81.condition: On the basis of the results of that evaluation
ai_act/art/81.action: , within six months, or within 60 days in the case of non-compliance with the prohibition of the AI practices referred to in Article 5, starting from the notification referred to in Article 79(5), decide whether the national measure is justified and shall notify its decision to the market surveillance authority of the Member State concerned.
ai_act/art/81.span: On the basis of the results of that evaluation, the Commission shall, within six months, or within 60 days in the case of non-compliance with the prohibition of the AI practices referred to in Article 5, starting from the notification referred to in Article 79(5), decide whether the national measure is justified and shall notify its decision to the market surveillance authority of the Member State concerned.

ai_act/art/81.action: also inform all other market surveillance authorities of its decision.
ai_act/art/81.span: The Commission shall also inform all other market surveillance authorities of its decision.

ai_act/art/81.condition: Where the Commission considers the measure taken by the relevant Member State to be justified
ai_act/art/81.action: ensure that they take appropriate restrictive measures in respect of the AI system concerned, such as requiring the withdrawal of the AI system from their market without undue delay, and shall inform the Commission accordingly.
ai_act/art/81.span: Where the Commission considers the measure taken by the relevant Member State to be justified, all Member States shall ensure that they take appropriate restrictive measures in respect of the AI system concerned, such as requiring the withdrawal of the AI system from their market without undue delay, and shall inform the Commission accordingly.

ai_act/art/81.condition: Where the Commission considers the national measure to be unjustified
ai_act/art/81.action: withdraw the measure and shall inform the Commission accordingly.
ai_act/art/81.span: Where the Commission considers the national measure to be unjustified, the Member State concerned shall withdraw the measure and shall inform the Commission accordingly.

ai_act/art/81.condition: Where the national measure is considered justified and the non-compliance of the AI system is attributed to shortcomings in the harmonised standards or common specifications referred to in Articles 40 and 41 of this Regulation
ai_act/art/81.action: apply the procedure provided for in Article 11 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012.
ai_act/art/81.span: Where the national measure is considered justified and the non-compliance of the AI system is attributed to shortcomings in the harmonised standards or common specifications referred to in Articles 40 and 41 of this Regulation, the Commission shall apply the procedure provided for in Article 11 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012.

ai_act/art/82.condition: Where, having performed an evaluation under Article 79, after consulting the relevant national public authority referred to in Article 77(1), the market surveillance authority of a Member State finds that although a high-risk AI system complies with this Regulation, it nevertheless presents a risk to the health or safety of persons, to fundamental rights, or to other aspects of public interest protection
ai_act/art/82.action: require the relevant operator to take all appropriate measures to ensure that the AI system concerned, when placed on the market or put into service, no longer presents that risk without undue delay, within a period it may prescribe.
ai_act/art/82.span: Where, having performed an evaluation under Article 79, after consulting the relevant national public authority referred to in Article 77(1), the market surveillance authority of a Member State finds that although a high-risk AI system complies with this Regulation, it nevertheless presents a risk to the health or safety of persons, to fundamental rights, or to other aspects of public interest protection, it shall require the relevant operator to take all appropriate measures to ensure that the AI system concerned, when placed on the market or put into service, no longer presents that risk without undue delay, within a period it may prescribe.

ai_act/art/82.addressee_text: The provider or other relevant operator

ai_act/art/82.span: The provider or other relevant operator shall ensure that corrective action is taken in respect of all the AI systems concerned that it has made available on the Union market within the timeline prescribed by the market surveillance authority of the Member State referred to in paragraph 1.

ai_act/art/82.action: immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States of a finding under paragraph 1.

ai_act/art/82.action: include all available details, in particular the data necessary for the identification of the AI system concerned, the origin and the supply chain of the AI system, the nature of the risk involved and the nature and duration of the national measures taken.

ai_act/art/82.action: immediately communicate its decision to the Member States concerned and to the relevant operators.
ai_act/art/82.span: The Commission shall immediately communicate its decision to the Member States concerned and to the relevant operators.

ai_act/art/82.action: also inform the other Member States.

ai_act/annex/VII.span: In addition to the application referred to in point 3, an application with a notified body of their choice shall be lodged by the provider for the assessment of the technical documentation relating to the AI system which the provider intends to place on the market or put into service and which is covered by the quality management system referred to under point 3.

ai_act/annex/VII.action: include — the name and address of the provider;
ai_act/annex/VII.span: the name and address of the provider;

ai_act/annex/VII.action: include — a written declaration that the same application has not been lodged with any other notified body;
ai_act/annex/VII.span: a written declaration that the same application has not been lodged with any other notified body;

ai_act/annex/VII.action: include — the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV.

ai_act/annex/VII.action: be examined by the notified body.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: The technical documentation shall be examined by the notified body.

ai_act/annex/VII.condition: Where relevant, and limited to what is necessary to fulfil its tasks
ai_act/annex/VII.action: be granted full access to the training, validation, and testing data sets used, including, where appropriate and subject to security safeguards, through API or other relevant technical means and tools enabling remote access.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: Where relevant, and limited to what is necessary to fulfil its tasks, the notified body shall be granted full access to the training, validation, and testing data sets used, including, where appropriate and subject to security safeguards, through API or other relevant technical means and tools enabling remote access.

ai_act/annex/VII.addressee_text: In examining the technical documentation, the notified body
ai_act/annex/VII.action: require that the provider supply further evidence or carry out further tests so as to enable a proper assessment of the conformity of the AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: In examining the technical documentation, the notified body may require that the provider supply further evidence or carry out further tests so as to enable a proper assessment of the conformity of the AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2.

ai_act/annex/VII.condition: Where the notified body is not satisfied with the tests carried out by the provider
ai_act/annex/VII.action: itself directly carry out adequate tests, as appropriate.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: Where the notified body is not satisfied with the tests carried out by the provider, the notified body shall itself directly carry out adequate tests, as appropriate.

ai_act/annex/VII.condition: Where necessary to assess the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2, after all other reasonable means to verify conformity have been exhausted and have proven to be insufficient, and upon a reasoned request
ai_act/annex/VII.action: also be granted access to the training and trained models of the AI system, including its relevant parameters.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: Where necessary to assess the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2, after all other reasonable means to verify conformity have been exhausted and have proven to be insufficient, and upon a reasoned request, the notified body shall also be granted access to the training and trained models of the AI system, including its relevant parameters.

ai_act/annex/VII.action: be subject to existing Union law on the protection of intellectual property and trade secrets.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: Such access shall be subject to existing Union law on the protection of intellectual property and trade secrets.

ai_act/annex/VII.addressee_text: The decision of the notified body
ai_act/annex/VII.action: be notified to the provider or its authorised representative.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: The decision of the notified body shall be notified to the provider or its authorised representative.

ai_act/annex/VII.action: contain the conclusions of the assessment of the technical documentation and the reasoned assessment decision.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: The notification shall contain the conclusions of the assessment of the technical documentation and the reasoned assessment decision.

ai_act/annex/VII.condition: Where the AI system is in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2
ai_act/annex/VII.action: issue a Union technical documentation assessment certificate.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: Where the AI system is in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2, the notified body shall issue a Union technical documentation assessment certificate.

ai_act/annex/VII.action: indicate the name and address of the provider, the conclusions of the examination, the conditions (if any) for its validity and the data necessary for the identification of the AI system.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: The certificate shall indicate the name and address of the provider, the conclusions of the examination, the conditions (if any) for its validity and the data necessary for the identification of the AI system.

ai_act/annex/VII.action: contain all relevant information to allow the conformity of the AI system to be evaluated, and to allow for control of the AI system while in use, where applicable.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: The certificate and its annexes shall contain all relevant information to allow the conformity of the AI system to be evaluated, and to allow for control of the AI system while in use, where applicable.

ai_act/annex/VII.condition: Where the AI system is not in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2
ai_act/annex/VII.action: refuse to issue a Union technical documentation assessment certificate and shall inform the applicant accordingly, giving detailed reasons for its refusal.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: Where the AI system is not in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2, the notified body shall refuse to issue a Union technical documentation assessment certificate and shall inform the applicant accordingly, giving detailed reasons for its refusal.

ai_act/annex/VII.addressee_text: In this case, the reasoned assessment decision of the notified body refusing to issue the Union technical documentation assessment certificate
ai_act/annex/VII.action: contain specific considerations on the quality data used to train the AI system, in particular on the reasons for non-compliance.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: In this case, the reasoned assessment decision of the notified body refusing to issue the Union technical documentation assessment certificate shall contain specific considerations on the quality data used to train the AI system, in particular on the reasons for non-compliance.

ai_act/annex/VII.addressee_text: Any change to the AI system that could affect the compliance of the AI system with the requirements or its intended purpose
ai_act/annex/VII.action: be assessed by the notified body which issued the Union technical documentation assessment certificate.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: Any change to the AI system that could affect the compliance of the AI system with the requirements or its intended purpose shall be assessed by the notified body which issued the Union technical documentation assessment certificate.

ai_act/annex/VII.action: inform such notified body of its intention to introduce any of the abovementioned changes, or if it otherwise becomes aware of the occurrence of such changes.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: The provider shall inform such notified body of its intention to introduce any of the abovementioned changes, or if it otherwise becomes aware of the occurrence of such changes.

ai_act/annex/VII.action: be assessed by the notified body, which shall decide whether those changes require a new conformity assessment in accordance with Article 43(4) or whether they could be addressed by means of a supplement to the Union technical documentation assessment certificate.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: The intended changes shall be assessed by the notified body, which shall decide whether those changes require a new conformity assessment in accordance with Article 43(4) or whether they could be addressed by means of a supplement to the Union technical documentation assessment certificate.

ai_act/annex/VII.addressee_text: In the latter case, the notified body
ai_act/annex/VII.action: assess the changes, notify the provider of its decision and, where the changes are approved, issue to the provider a supplement to the Union technical documentation assessment certificate.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: In the latter case, the notified body shall assess the changes, notify the provider of its decision and, where the changes are approved, issue to the provider a supplement to the Union technical documentation assessment certificate.

ai_act/annex/VII.action: allow the notified body to access the premises where the design, development, testing of the AI systems is taking place.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: For assessment purposes, the provider shall allow the notified body to access the premises where the design, development, testing of the AI systems is taking place.

ai_act/annex/VII.action: further share with the notified body all necessary information.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: The provider shall further share with the notified body all necessary information.

ai_act/annex/VII.action: carry out periodic audits to make sure that the provider maintains and applies the quality management system and shall provide the provider with an audit report.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: The notified body shall carry out periodic audits to make sure that the provider maintains and applies the quality management system and shall provide the provider with an audit report.

ai_act/annex/VII.addressee_text: In the context of those audits, the notified body
ai_act/annex/VII.action: carry out additional tests of the AI systems for which a Union technical documentation assessment certificate was issued.
ai_act/annex/VII.span: In the context of those audits, the notified body may carry out additional tests of the AI systems for which a Union technical documentation assessment certificate was issued.

ai_act/annex/XI.addressee_text: A detailed description of the elements of the model referred to in point 1, and relevant information of the process for the development, including the following elements: […] With regard to point (e), where the energy consumption of the model is unknown, the energy consumption

ai_act/annex/XI.addressee_text: A detailed description of the elements of the model referred to in point 1, and relevant information of the process for the development, including the following elements: […] With regard to point (e), where the energy consumption of the model is unknown, the energy consumption

ai_act/annex/XII.addressee_text: The information referred to in Article 53(1), point (b)

ai_act/annex/XII.span: A general description of the general-purpose AI model including:

ai_act/annex/XII.span: A description of the elements of the model and of the process for its development, including:

ai_act/annex/XIII.condition: For the purpose of determining that a general-purpose AI model has capabilities or an impact equivalent to those set out in Article 51(1), point (a)
ai_act/annex/XIII.action: take into account the following criteria — the number of parameters of the model;
ai_act/annex/XIII.span: the number of parameters of the model;

ai_act/annex/XIII.condition: For the purpose of determining that a general-purpose AI model has capabilities or an impact equivalent to those set out in Article 51(1), point (a)
ai_act/annex/XIII.action: take into account the following criteria — the quality or size of the data set, for example measured through tokens;
ai_act/annex/XIII.span: the quality or size of the data set, for example measured through tokens;

ai_act/annex/XIII.condition: For the purpose of determining that a general-purpose AI model has capabilities or an impact equivalent to those set out in Article 51(1), point (a)
ai_act/annex/XIII.action: take into account the following criteria — the amount of computation used for training the model, measured in floating point operations or indicated by a combination of other variables such as estimated cost of training, estimated time required for the training, or estimated energy consumption for the training;
ai_act/annex/XIII.span: the amount of computation used for training the model, measured in floating point operations or indicated by a combination of other variables such as estimated cost of training, estimated time required for the training, or estimated energy consumption for the training;

ai_act/annex/XIII.condition: For the purpose of determining that a general-purpose AI model has capabilities or an impact equivalent to those set out in Article 51(1), point (a)
ai_act/annex/XIII.action: take into account the following criteria — the input and output modalities of the model, such as text to text (large language models), text to image, multi-modality, and the state of the art thresholds for determining high-impact capabilities for each modality, and the specific type of inputs and outputs (e.g. biological sequences);
ai_act/annex/XIII.span: the input and output modalities of the model, such as text to text (large language models), text to image, multi-modality, and the state of the art thresholds for determining high-impact capabilities for each modality, and the specific type of inputs and outputs (e.g. biological sequences);

ai_act/annex/XIII.condition: For the purpose of determining that a general-purpose AI model has capabilities or an impact equivalent to those set out in Article 51(1), point (a)
ai_act/annex/XIII.action: take into account the following criteria — the benchmarks and evaluations of capabilities of the model, including considering the number of tasks without additional training, adaptability to learn new, distinct tasks, its level of autonomy and scalability, the tools it has access to;
